1.name: account
1.desc: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

2.name: AdvId
2.desc: Unique identifier of advertisement message. (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int)

3.name: AdvRefID
3.desc: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE transaction types. (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int)

6.name: avgPx
6.desc: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

7.name: BeginSeqNo
7.desc: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent

8.name: BeginString
8.desc: Identifies beginning of new message and protocol version. ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted) FIX.4.3

9.name: BodyLength
9.desc: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field.  ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

10.name: CheckSum
10.desc:
Three byte, simple checksum  (see Volume 2: CheckSum Calculation for description).  ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE
i.e. serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter.  Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

11.name: clOrdID
11.desc: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the buy-side (institution, broker, intermediary  etc.) (identified by SenderCompID or OnBehalfOfCompID as appropriate).  Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day

12.name: commission
12.desc: Commission.  Note if CommType is percentage, Commission of 5percent should be represented as .05.

14.name: cumQty
14.desc: Total number of shares filled.(Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

15.name: currency
15.desc: Identifies ccy used for price. Absence of this field is interpreted as the default for the security.  It is recommended that systems provide the ccy value whenever possible.  See Appendix A: Valid ccy Codes for info on obtaining valid values.

16.name: EndSeqNo
16.desc: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent.  If request is for a single message BeginSeqNo is EndSeqNo.  If request is for all messages subsequent to a particular message, EndSeqNo is 0 (representing infinity).

17.name: execID
17.desc: Unique identifier of execution message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN) (will be 0 (zero) forExecType=I (Order Status)). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day or the life of a multi-day order

18.name: execInst
18.desc: Instructions for order handling on exchange trading floor.  If more than one instruction is applicable to an order, this field can contain multiple instructions separated by space.

19.name: execRefID
19.desc: Reference identifier used with Cancel and Correct transaction types.   (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int)

20.name: execTransType
20.desc: Identifies transaction type. Indicates status of the entity - for front office entities(Fill) this is owned by front office and for TC entities(subtypes of Security Trade Contracts) this is owned by TC

21.name: handlInst
21.desc: Instructions for order handling on Broker trading floor

22.name: iDSource
22.desc: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID value.  Required if SecurityID is specified. Formerly named IDSource prior to FIX 4.3

23.name: IOIid
23.desc: Unique identifier of IOI message.   (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int) [UD: this is an additional IOI ID. If an order is placed on the back of an IOI on those orders this field will optionally be set as a reference ID]

26.name: IOIRefID
26.desc: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE, transaction types.   (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int)

27.name: IOIShares
27.desc: Quantity (e.g. number of shares)in numeric form or relative size.

30.name: lastMkt
30.desc: Market of execution for last fill

32.name: LastShares
32.desc: Quantity (e.g. shares) bought/sold on this (last) fill.

33.name: LinesOfText
33.desc: Identifies number of lines of text body

35.name: fixMsgType
35.desc: Defines message type. ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)   Note: A U as the first character in the MsgType field (i.e. U1, U2, etc) indicates that the  message format is privately defined between the sender and receiver.

37.name: orderID
37.desc: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by broker.  Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day.  Firms which accept multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the OrderID field to assure uniqueness across days.

38.name: orderQty
38.desc: Number of shares ordered     (Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

40.name: ordType
40.desc: Order type. Three on close-related values (5, A and B) in the OrdType field have been replaced in FIX 4.3 by the combined use of a new TimeInForce At the Close value and OrdType values. This makes On close handling consistent with On open

41.name: origClOrdID
41.desc:
ClOrdID of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) as assigned by the external / sending institution, used to identify the previous order in
cancel and cancel/replace requests.

42.name: OrigTime
42.desc: Time of message origination (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT)) ( in GMT )

43.name: PossDupFlag
43.desc: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

44.name: price
44.desc: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

46.name: RelatdSym
46.desc: Symbol of issue related to story.  Can be repeated within message to identify multiple companies. No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned

47.name: Rule80A
47.desc: Describes the capacity of the firm placing the order. The Rule80A field will be replaced in FIX 4.3 by the combined use of OrderCapacity (528) and OrderRestrictions (529) fields.

48.name: securityID
48.desc: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource

49.name: SenderCompID
49.desc: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

50.name: senderSubID
50.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

51.name: SendingDate
51.desc: No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned

52.name: SendingTime
52.desc: Time of message transmission from exchange.(always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT) ( in GMT )

53.name: Shares
53.desc: Number of shares. In FIX 4.3 it is renamed as Quantity (We have already defined this with Fix Tag 10050)

55.name: symbol
55.desc: Ticker symbol. Common, human understood representation of the security. SecurityID value can be specified if no symbol exists (e.g. non-exchange traded Collective Investment Vehicles

56.name: TargetCompID
56.desc: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

57.name: TargetSubID
57.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message.  ADMIN reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

59.name: timeInForce
59.desc: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.  Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY. NOTE not applicable to CIV Orders. ( in GMT )

60.name: transactDate
60.desc: Time of execution/order creation (expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT) ( in GMT )

62.name: ValidUntilTime
62.desc: Indicates expiration time of indication message (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT) ( in GMT )

63.name: SettlmntTyp
63.desc: Indicates order settlement period.  Absence of this field is interpreted as Regular.  Regular is defined as the default settlement period for the particular security on the exchange of execution.

64.name: FutSettDate
64.desc: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format.  Required when SettlmntTyp is 6 (Future) or SettlmntTyp = 8 (Sellers Option).  (expressed in local time at place of settlement)

65.name: SymbolSfx
65.desc: Additional information about the security (e.g. preferred, warrants, etc.).   Note also see SecurityType. As defined in the NYSE Stock and bond Symbol Directory and in the AMEX Fitch Directory

66.name: listID
66.desc: Unique id for list as assigned by institution, used to associate multiple individual orders.  Uniqueness guaranteed in a single trading day. Firms generating multi-day orders should embed date in ListID to assure uniqueness across days.

67.name: ListSeqNo
67.desc: Sequence of individual order within list (i.e. ListSeqNo of TotNoOrds, 2 of 25, 3 of 25,   . . . )

68.name: TotNoOrders
68.desc: Total number of list order entries across all messages. Should be the sum of all NoOrders in each message that has repeating list order entries related to the same ListID. Used to support fragmentation.

69.name: listExecInst
69.desc: Free format text message containing list handling and execution instructions.

70.name: allocID
70.desc: Unique identifier for allocation message. (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int)

71.name: AllocTransType
71.desc: Identifies allocation transaction type. The Three fields which were removed from AllocTransType are now part of AllocType(626) introducted in FIX 4.3, which specifies the type or purpose of the Allocation message

72.name: refAllocID
72.desc: Reference identifier to be used with AllocTransType=Replace or Cancel or with AllocType=Sellside Calculated Using Preliminary. (Prior to FIX 4.1 this field was of type int)

73.name: NoOrders
73.desc: Indicates number of orders to be combined for average pricing and allocation.

74.name: AvgPrxPrecision
74.desc: Indicates number of decimal places to be used for average pricing.  Absence of this field indicates that default precision arranged by the broker/institution is to be used.

75.name: tradeDate
75.desc: Indicates date of trade referenced in this message in YYYYMMDD format.  Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade).

76.name: execBroker
76.desc: Identifies executing / give-up broker. From FIX 4.3 onwards, ExecBroker has been replaced with PartyID and PartyRole (452)= 1 (Executing Broker).  Note that Booker&TD often copy execBroker into contraBroker for TC to convert to a brokerAccount.

77.name: openClose
77.desc: Indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position. Used for omnibus accounting - where accounts are held on a gross basis instead of being netted together. Formerly named OpenClose prior to FIX 4.3

80.name: AllocShares
80.desc: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account. Formerly named AllocShares prior to FIX 4.3

81.name: processCode
81.desc: Processing code for sub-account.  Absence of this field in AllocAccount / AllocPrice/AllocShares / ProcessCode instance indicates regular trade.

82.name: NoRpts
82.desc: Total number of reports within series.

83.name: RptSeq
83.desc: Sequence number of message within report series.

84.name: CxlQty
84.desc: Total quantity canceled for this order. (Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

85.name: NoDlvyInst
85.desc: Number of delivery instruction fields to follow. No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned

86.name: DlvyInst
86.desc: Free format text field to indicate delivery instructions. No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned

88.name: AllocRejCode
88.desc: Identifies reason for rejection of the allocation

92.name: BrokerOfCredit
92.desc: Broker to receive trade credit. No Longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommisioned. This field introduced prior to FIX 4.3 have been removed and the equivalent values can now be specified via PartyRole (452) With Valid value 2 = Broker of credit

93.name: SignatureLength
93.desc: Number of bytes in signature field.

95.name: RawDataLength
95.desc: Number of bytes in raw data field.

96.name: RawData
96.desc: Unformatted raw data, can include bitmaps, word processor documents, etc.

97.name: PossResend
97.desc: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

99.name: StopPx
99.desc: Price per unit of quantity (e.g. per share)

100.name: exDestination
100.desc: Execution destination as defined by institution when order is entered

101.name: NotDefined
101.desc: This field has not been defined.

102.name: cxlRejReason
102.desc: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection.

103.name: ordRejReason
103.desc: Code to identify reason for order rejection.

105.name: waveNo
105.desc: Identifier to aid in the management of multiple lists derived from a single, master list.

106.name: Issuer
106.desc: Company name of security issuer (e.g. International Business Machines)

109.name: clientID
109.desc: Firm identifier used in third party-transactions. No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned. This field introduced prior to FIX 4.3 have been removed and the equivalent values can now be specified via PartyRole (452) With Valid value 3 = Client ID

110.name: minQty
110.desc: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed.(Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

111.name: maxFloor
111.desc: Maximum quantity (e.g. number of shares) within an order to be shown on the exchange floor at any given time. (Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

112.name: TestReqID
112.desc: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat

113.name: reportToExch
113.desc: Identifies party of trade responsible for exchange reporting.

114.name: LocateReqd
114.desc: Indicates whether the broker is to locate the stock in conjunction with a short sell order.

115.name: OnBehalfOfCompID
115.desc: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party  i.e.   the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

116.name: OnBehalfOfSubID
116.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

118.name: NetMoney
118.desc: Total amount due as the result of the transaction (e.g. for Buy order - principal + commission + fees) reported in currency of execution.

119.name: SettlCurrAmt
119.desc: Total amount due expressed in settlement currency (includes the effect of the forex transaction)

121.name: ForexReq
121.desc: Indicates request for forex accommodation trade to be executed along with security transaction.

122.name: OrigSendingTime
122.desc: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT) when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request. ( in GMT )

123.name: GapFillFlag
123.desc: Indicates that the Sequence Reset message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

124.name: NoExecs
124.desc: No of execution repeating group entries to follow.

125.name: CxlType
125.desc: No longer as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned

126.name: ExpireTime
126.desc: Time/Date of order expiration (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT) ( in GMT )

128.name: DeliverToCompID
128.desc: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party   i.e.  the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

129.name: DeliverToSubID
129.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

130.name: IOINaturalFlag
130.desc: Indicates that IOI is the result of an existing agency order or a facilitation position resulting from an agency order, not from principal trading or order solicitation activity.

134.name: BidSize
134.desc: Quantity of bid   (Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

135.name: OfferSize
135.desc: Quantity of offer   (Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

136.name: NoMiscFees
136.desc: Number of repeating groups of miscellaneous fees

141.name: ResetSeqNumFlag
141.desc: Indicates that the both sides of the FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

142.name: senderLocationID
142.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originators location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

143.name: targetLocationID
143.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message destinations location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

144.name: OnBehalfOfLocationID
144.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originators location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

145.name: DeliverToLocationID
145.desc: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipients location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

146.name: NoRelatedSym
146.desc: Specifies the number of repeating symbols specified.

147.name: Subject
147.desc: The subject of an Email message

148.name: Headline
148.desc: The headline of a News message

149.name: URLLink
149.desc: A URL (Uniform Resource Locator) link to additional information (i.e. http://www.XYZ.com/research.html)

150.name: execType
150.desc: Describes the specific ExecutionRpt (i.e. Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus will always identify the current order status (i.e. Partially Filled)

151.name: leavesQty
151.desc: Quantity open for further execution. If the OrdStatus is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty - CumQty

152.name: CashOrderQty
152.desc: Specifies the approximate  order quantity desired in total monetary units vs. as tradeable units (e.g. number of shares)

155.name: fxRate
155.desc: Foreign exchange rate used to compute SettlCurrAmount from Currency to SettlCurrency

156.name: SettlCurrFxRateCalc
156.desc: Specifies whether or not SettlCurrFxRate should be multiplied or divided.

157.name: NumDaysInterest
157.desc: Number of Days of Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income. Note value may be negative

158.name: AccruedInterestRate
158.desc: Accrued Interest Rate for convertible bonds and fixed income

159.name: AccruedInterestAmt
159.desc: Amount of Accrued Interest for convertible bonds and fixed income

160.name: SettlInstMode
160.desc: Indicates mode used for Settlement Instructions

161.name: allocText
161.desc: Free format text related to a specific AllocAccount.

162.name: SettlInstID
162.desc: Unique identifier for Settlement Instructions message.

164.name: EmailThreadID
164.desc: Unique identifier for an email thread (new and chain of replies)

166.name: SettlLocation
166.desc: Identifies Settlement Depository or Country Code. No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned. In FIX 4.3 this fields have been removed and the equivalent value can now be specified via PartyRole (452) With Valid value 10 = Settlement Location

167.name: SecurityType
167.desc: Indicates type of security. The CFICode(461) was introduced to improve granularity in specifying security type (Recommended for non-Fixed Income instruments). The adoption of CFICode has made the values for futures and options in SecurityType redundant

168.name: EffectiveTime
168.desc: Time the details within the message should take effect (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as GMT) ( in GMT )

169.name: StandInstDbType
169.desc: Identifies the Standing Instruction database used

170.name: StandInstDbName
170.desc: Name of the Standing Instruction database represented with StandInstDbType (i.e. the Global Custodians name).

171.name: StandInstDbID
171.desc: Unique identifier used on the Standing Instructions database for the Standing Instructions to be referenced.

173.name: SettlDepositoryCode
173.desc: Brokers account code at the depository (i.e. CEDEL ID  for CEDEL, FINS for DTC, or Euroclear ID for Euroclear) if SettlLocation is a depository

174.name: SettlBrkrCode
174.desc: BIC (Bank Identification Code-Swift managed) code of  the broker involved (i.e. for multi-company brokerage firms)

175.name: SettlInstCode
175.desc: BIC (Bank Identification Code-Swift managed) code of  the institution involved (i.e. for multi-company institution firms)

176.name: SecuritySettlAgentName
176.desc: Name of SettlInstSources local agent bank if SettlLocation is  not a depository

177.name: SecuritySettlAgentCode
177.desc: BIC (Bank Identification Code--Swift managed) code of  the SettlInstSources local agent bank if SettlLocation  is not a depository

178.name: SecuritySettlAgentAcctNum
178.desc: SettlInstSources account number at local agent bank if  SettlLocation is not a depository

179.name: SecuritySettlAgentAcctName
179.desc: Name of SettlInstSources account at local agent bank if  SettlLocation is not a depository

180.name: SecuritySettlAgentContactName
180.desc: Name of contact at local agent bank for SettlInstSources account if SettlLocation is not a depository

181.name: SecuritySettlAgentContactPhone
181.desc: Phone number for contact at local agent bank if  SettlLocation is not a depository

182.name: CashSettlAgentName
182.desc: Name of SettlInstSources local agent bank if SettlDeliveryType is Free

183.name: CashSettlAgentCode
183.desc: BIC (Bank Identification Code--Swift managed) code of  the SettlInstSources local agent bank if SettlDeliveryType= Free

184.name: CashSettlAgentAcctNum
184.desc: SettlInstSources account number at local agent bank if SettlDeliveryType is Free

185.name: CashSettlAgentAcctName
185.desc: Name of SettlInstSources account at local agent bank if SettlDeliveryType= Free

186.name: CashSettlAgentContactName
186.desc: Name of contact at local agent bank for SettlInstSources account  if SettlDeliveryType is Free

187.name: CashSettlAgentContactPhone
187.desc: Phone number for contact at local agent bank for SettlInstSources account  if SettlDeliveryType=Free

189.name: BidForwardPoints
189.desc: Bid F/X forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

191.name: OfferForwardPoints
191.desc: Offer F/X forward points added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

192.name: OrderQty2
192.desc: OrderQty of the future part of a F/X swap order.

193.name: FutSettDate2
193.desc: FutSettDate of the future part of a F/X swap order.

195.name: LastForwardPoints
195.desc: F/X forward points added to LastSpotRate.  May be a negative value.

196.name: AllocLinkID
196.desc: Can be used to link two different Allocation messages (each with unique AllocID) together, i.e. for F/X Netting or Swaps. Should be unique.

197.name: AllocLinkType
197.desc: Identifies the type of Allocation linkage when AllocLinkID is used.

198.name: secondaryOrderID
198.desc: Assigned by the party which accepts the order.  Can be used to provide the OrderID used by an exchange or executing system.

199.name: NoIOIQualifiers
199.desc: Number of repeating groups of IOIQualifiers.

200.name: MaturityMonthYear
200.desc: Month and Year of the maturity for SecurityType is FUT or SecurityType is OPT. Format: YYYYMM  (i.e. 199903)

201.name: PutOrCall
201.desc: Indicates whether an Option is for a put or call. No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned. The CFICode was introduced to improve granularity in specifying security type. The adoption of CFICode (461) has made the PutOrCall (tag 201) redundant.

203.name: CoveredOrUncovered
203.desc: Used for derivative products, such as options

204.name: customerOrFirm
204.desc: Used for options when delivering the order to an execution system/exchange. Specifies the order is for a customer or placed by firm . No longer used as of FIX 4.3 - decommissioned. The tag values have been merged into the new OrderCapacity (tag 528) field

205.name: MaturityDay
205.desc: Day of month used in conjunction with MaturityMonthYear to specify the maturity date for SecurityType is FUT or SecurityType is OPT. No longer used as of FIX 4.3- decommissioned. This field has been removed and replaced by the MaturityDate field (tag 541)

206.name: OptAttribute
206.desc: Can be used for SecurityType=OPT to identify a particular security. Valid values vary by SecurityExchange.

207.name: SecurityExchange
207.desc: Market used to help identify a security. See Appendix 6-C

208.name: NotifyBrokerOfCredit
208.desc: Indicates whether or not details should be communicated to BrokerOfCredit (i.e. step-in broker).

209.name: AllocHandlInst
209.desc: Indicates how the receiver (i.e. third party) of Allocation message should handle/process the account details.

210.name: maxShow
210.desc: Maximum quantity (e.g. number of shares) within an order to be shown  to other customers (i.e. sent via an IOI). (Prior to FIX 4.2 this field was of type int)

211.name: PegDifference
211.desc: Amount (signed) added to the price of the peg  for a pegged order.

212.name: XmlDataLen
212.desc: Length of the XmlData data block.

213.name: XmlData
213.desc: Actual XML data stream (e.g. FIXML). See approriate XML reference (e.g. FIXML).  Note: may contain embedded SOH characters.

214.name: SettlInstRefID
214.desc: Reference identifier for the SettlInstID with Cancel and Replace SettlInstTransType transaction types.

215.name: NoRoutingIDs
215.desc: Number of repeating groups of RoutingID and RoutingType values.   See Volume 3: Pre-Trade Message Targeting/Routing

216.name: RoutingType
216.desc: Indicates the type of RoutingID specified.

217.name: RoutingID
217.desc: Assigned value used to identify a specific routing destination.

218.name: Spread
218.desc: For Fixed Income.  Either Swap Spread or Spread to Benchmark depending upon the order type.  Spread to Benchmark:  Basis points relative to a benchmark.  To be expressed as count of basis points (vs. an absolute value)

219.name: Benchmark
219.desc: For Fixed Income.  Identifies the benchmark (e.g. used in conjunction with the SpreadToBenchmark field). Deprecated in FIX 4.3 by the combined use of BenchmarkCurveCurrency(220), BenchmarkCurveName(221) and BenchmarkCurvePoint(222) fields

220.name: BenchmarkCurveCurrency
220.desc: Identifies currency used for  benchmark curve. See Appendix 6-A: Valid Currency Codes for information on obtaining valid values. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

221.name: BenchmarkCurveName
221.desc: Name of benchmark curve. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

222.name: BenchmarkCurvePoint
222.desc: Point on benchmark curve.  Free form values:  e.g. 1Y, 7Y , INTERPOLATED. See Fixed Income-specific documentation at http://www.fixprotocol.org for additional values. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

223.name: CouponRate
223.desc: For Fixed Income.  Coupon rate of the bond.  Will be zero for step-up bonds.

224.name: CouponPaymentDate
224.desc: Date interest is to be paid.  Used in identifying Corporate Bond issues. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

225.name: IssueDate
225.desc: Date instrument was issued. For Fixed Income IOIs for new issues, specifies the issue date. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

226.name: RepurchaseTerm
226.desc: Number of business days before repurchase of a repo. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

227.name: RepurchaseRate
227.desc: Percent of par at which a Repo will be repaid. Represented as a percent, e.g. .9525 represents 95-1/4 percent of par. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

228.name: Factor
228.desc: Fraction for deriving Current face from Original face for TIPS, ABS or MBS Fixed Income securities. Note the fraction may be greater than, equal to or less than 1. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

229.name: TradeOriginationDate
229.desc: Used with Fixed Income for Muncipal New Issue Market.  Agreement in principal between counter-parties prior to actual trade date. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

230.name: ExDate
230.desc: The date when a distribution of interest is deducted from a securities assets or set aside for payment to bondholders. On the ex-date, the securities price drops by the amount of the distribution (plus or minus any market activity)

231.name: ContractMultiplier
231.desc: Specifies ratio or multiply factor to convert from contracts to shares e.g. 1.0, 100, 1000, etc. Applicable For Fixed Income, Convertible Bonds, Derivatives, etc. Note: If used, quantities should be expressed in the nominal amt, e.g. contracts vs. shares.

232.name: NoStipulations
232.desc: Number of stipulation entries (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

233.name: StipulationType
233.desc: For Fixed Income.  Type of Stipulation. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

234.name: StipulationValue
234.desc: For Fixed Income.  Value of stipulation. The expression can be an absolute single value or a combination of values and logical operators plus appropriate combinations of logical operators and other expressions by mutual agreement of the counterparties

545.desc: PartySubID value within a nested repeating group

565.desc: CoveredOrUncovered for leg of a multileg

572.desc: Reference identifier used with CANCEL and REPLACE transaction types

577.desc: Eligibility of this trade for clearing and central counterparty processing

584.desc: Value assigned by issuer of Mass Status Request to uniquely identify the request

611.desc: Multileg instrument's individual  security's MaturityDate.  Date of maturity

623.desc: The ratio of quantity for this individual leg relative to the entire multileg security

694.desc: Identifies the type of Quote Response.

698.name: YieldRedemptionPriceType

The price type of the YieldRedemptionPrice (697)

1 - Exercise
101 - Auto Blocking Of Short Option Position
102 - Scheduled Options Exercise

762.desc: Sub-type qualification/identification of the SecurityType (e.g. for SecurityType=

824.desc: Reference to the leg of a multileg instrument to which this trade refers

829.name: TrdSubType
829.desc: Further qualification to the trade type

834.name: ThresholdAmount
834.desc:
Used to indicate the minimum acceptable offset
between the Strike Price and the Market Price.

835.name: PegMoveType
835.desc: Describes whether peg is static or floats

837.name: PegLimitType
837.desc: Type of Peg Limit. Price improvement instruction to FCCP.

838.name: PegRoundDirection
838.desc: If the calculated peg price is not a valid tick price, specifies whether to round the price to be more or less aggressive

839.name: PeggedPrice
839.desc: The price the order is currently pegged at

841.name: DiscretionMoveType
841.desc: Describes whether discretionay price is static or floats

844.name: DiscretionRoundDirection
844.desc: If the calculated discretionary price is not a valid tick price, specifies whether to round the price to be more or less aggressive

845.name: DiscretionPrice
845.desc: The current discretionary price of the order

847.name: TargetStrategy
847.desc:
The target strategy of the order
1000+ = Reserved and available for bi-laterally agreed upon user defined values

848.name: TargetStrategyParameters
848.desc: Field to allow further specification of the TargetStrategy usage to be agreed between counterparties

849.name: ParticipationRate
849.desc: For a TargetStrategy=Participate order specifies the target particpation rate. For other order types this is a volume limit (i.e. do not be more than this percent of the market volume)

850.name: TargetStrategyPerformance
850.desc: For communication of the performance of the order versus the target strategy

851.name: LastLiquidityInd
851.desc: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

852.name: PublishTrdIndicator
852.desc: Indicates if a trade should be reported via a market reporting service.

854.name: QtyType
854.desc: Type of quantity specified in a quantity field. FIX 5.0 spec tag. Use 465 internally.

855.name: SecondaryTrdType
855.desc: Additional TrdType (see tag 828) assigned to a trade by trade match system.

861.name: ReportedPx
861.desc: Reported price (used to differentiate from AvgPx on a confirmation of a marked-up or marked-down principal trade)

863.name: OrderCapacityQty
863.desc: Quantity executed under a specific OrderCapacity (e.g. quantity executed as agent, quantity executed as principal)

865.name: EventType
865.desc: Code to represent the type of event

867.name: EventPx
867.desc: Predetermined price of issue at event, if applicable

873.name: DatedDt
873.desc: The effective date of a new securities issue determined by its underwriters. Often but not always the same as the Issue Date and the Interest Accrual Date.

874.name: InterestAccrualDate
874.desc: The start date used for calculating accrued interest on debt instruments which are being sold between interest payment dates. Often but not always the same as the Issue Date and the Dated Date

875.name: CPProgram
875.desc: The program under which a commercial paper is issued

876.name: CPRegType
876.desc: The registration type of a commercial paper issuance

877.name: UnderlyingCPProgram
877.desc: The program under which the underlying commercial paper is issued

878.name: UnderlyingCPRegType
878.desc: The registration type of the underlying commercial paper issuance

879.name: UnderlyingQty
879.desc: Unit amount of the underlying security (par, shares, currency, etc.)

880.name: TrdMatchID
880.desc: Identifier assigned to a trade by a matching system.

881.name: SecondaryTradeReportRefID
881.desc: Used to refer to a previous SecondaryTradeReportRefID when amending the transaction (cancel, replace, release, or reversal).

882.name: UnderlyingDirtyPrice
882.desc: Price (percent-of-par or per unit) of the underlying security or basket. "Dirty" means it includes accrued interest.

883.name: UnderlyingEndPrice
883.desc: Price (percent-of-par or per unit) of the underlying security or basket at the end of the agreement.

884.name: UnderlyingStartValue
884.desc: Currency value attributed to this collateral at the start of the agreement

885.name: UnderlyingCurrentValue
885.desc: Currency value currently attributed to this collateral

886.name: UnderlyingEndValue
886.desc: Currency value attributed to this collateral at the end of the agreement

888.name: UnderlyingStipType
888.desc: Type of stipulation. Same values as StipulationType (233).

889.name: UnderlyingStipValue
889.desc: Value of stipulation. Same values as StipulationValue (234)

891.name: MiscFeeBasis
891.desc: Defines the unit for a miscellaneous fee.

898.name: MarginRatio
898.desc: The fraction of the cash consideration that must be collateralized, expressed as a percent. A MarginRatio of 02% indicates that the value of the collateral (after deducting for "haircut") must exceed the cash consideration by 2%.

900.name: TotalNetValue
900.desc:
TotalNetValue is determined as follows: 
At the initial collateral assignment TotalNetValue is the sum of (UnderlyingStartValue * (1-haircut)).
 In a collateral substitution TotalNetValue is the sum of (UnderlyingCurrentValue * (1-haircut)).
 For liste

911.name: TotNumReports
911.desc: Total number of reports returned in response to a request.

912.name: LastRptRequested
912.desc: Indicates whether this message is that last report message in response to a request, such as Order Mass Status Request.

913.name: AgreementDesc
913.desc: The full name of the base standard agreement, annexes and amendments in place between the principals applicable to a financing transaction.

914.name: AgreementID
914.desc: A common reference to the applicable standing agreement between the counterparties to a financing transaction.

915.name: AgreementDate
915.desc: A reference to the date the underlying agreement specified by AgreementID and AgreementDesc was executed.

916.name: StartDate
916.desc: Start date of a financing deal, i.e. the date the buyer pays the seller cash and takes control of the collateral

917.name: EndDate
917.desc: End date of a financing deal, i.e. the date the seller reimburses the buyer and takes back control of the collateral

918.name: AgreementCurrency
918.desc: Contractual currency forming the basis of a financing agreement and associated transactions. Usually, but not always, the same as the trade currency.

920.name: EndAccruedInterestAmt
920.desc: Accrued Interest Amount applicable to a financing transaction on the End Date.

921.name: StartCash
921.desc: Starting dirty cash consideration of a financing deal, i.e. paid to the seller on the Start Date.

922.name: EndCash
922.desc: Ending dirty cash consideration of a financing deal. i.e. reimbursed to the buyer on the End Date.

923.name: UserRequestID
923.desc: Unique identifier for a User Request.

926.name: UserStatus
926.desc: Indicates the status of a user

927.name: UserStatusText
927.desc: A text description associated with a user status.

940.name: AffirmStatus
940.desc: Identifies the status of the ConfirmationAck.

941.name: UnderlyingStrikeCurrency
941.desc: Currency in which the strike price of an underlying instrument is denominated

942.name: LegStrikeCurrency
942.desc: Currency in which the strike price of a instrument leg of a multileg instrument is denominated

943.name: TimeBracket
943.desc: A code that represents a time interval in which a fill or trade occurred. Required for US futures markets

947.name: StrikeCurrency
947.desc: Currency in which the StrikePrice is denominated.

948.name: NoNested3PartyIDs
948.desc: Number of Nested3PartyID (949), Nested3PartyIDSource (950), and Nested3PartyRole (95) entries. (Added in FIX4.4)

951.name: Nested3PartyRole
951.desc: PartyRole value within a "third instance" Nested repeating group. Same values as PartyRole (452). (Added in FIX4.4)

955.name: LegContractSettlMonth
955.desc: Specifies when the contract (i.e. MBS/TBA) will settle.

956.name: LegInterestAccrualDate
956.desc: The start date used for calculating accrued interest on debt instruments which are being sold between interest payment dates. Often but not always the same as the Issue Date and the Dated Date

989.name: SecondaryIndividualAllocID
989.desc: Will allow the intermediary to specify an allocation ID generated by their system

990.name: LegReportID
990.desc: Additional attribute to store the Trade ID of the Leg.

991.name: RndPx
991.desc: Specifies average price rounded to quoted precision.

994.name: TierCode
994.desc: The Tier the trade was matched by the clearing system

996.name: UnitOfMeasure
996.desc: The unit of measure of the underlying commodity upon which the contract is based.

1003.name: TradeID
1003.desc: The unique ID assigned to the trade entity once it is received or matched by the exchange or central counterparty

1023.name: MDPriceLevel
1023.desc: Integer to convey the level of a bid or offer at a given price level. This is in contrast to MDEntryPositionNo which is used to convey the position of an order within a Price level.

1026.name: MDEntrySpotRate
1026.desc: The spot rate for an FX entry.

1027.name: MDEntryForwardPoints
1027.desc: Used for an F/X entry. The forward points to be added to or subtracted from the spot rate to get the "all-in" rate in MDEntryPx. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199.

1028.name: ManualOrderInd
1028.desc: Indicates if the order was initially received manually (as opposed to electronically).

1036.name: ExecAckStatus
1036.desc: The status of this execution acknowledgement message

1040.name: SecondaryTradeID
1040.desc: Used to carry an internal trade entity ID which may or may not be reported to the firm

1041.name: FirmTradeID
1041.desc: The ID assigned to a trade by the Firm to track a trade within the Firm system

1057.name: AggressorIndicator
1057.desc: Used to identify whether the order initiator is an aggressor or not in the trade

1067.name: LegBidFwdPoints
1067.desc: The bid FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199.FIX spec name=LegBidForwardPoints but already exists as 11449

1068.name: LegOfferFwdPoints
1068.desc: The offer FX forward points for the leg of an FX Swap. Value can be negative. Expressed in decimal form. For example, 61.99 points is expressed and sent as 0.006199.Fix spec name=LegOfferForwardPoints,but already exists as 11450.

1075.name: LegGrossTradeAmt
1075.desc: The gross trade amount of the leg. For FX Futures this is used to express the notional value of a fill when LegLastQty and other quantity fields are express in terms of contract size.

1084.name: DisplayMethod
1084.desc: Defines what value to use in DisplayQty (1138). If not specified the default DisplayMethod is "1".

1092.name: PriceProtectionScope
1092.desc: Defines the type of price protection the customer requires on their order.

1116.name: NoRootPartyIDs
1116.desc: Number of RootPartyID (1117), RootPartyIDSource (1118), and RootPartyRole (1119) entries

1117.name: RootPartyID
1117.desc: PartyID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyID (448)

1118.name: RootPartyIDSource
1118.desc: PartyIDSource value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyIDSource (447)

1119.name: RootPartyRole
1119.desc: PartyRole value within a root parties component. Same values as PartyRole (452)

1120.name: NoRootPartySubIDs
1120.desc: Number of RootPartySubID (1121) and RootPartySubIDType (1122) entries

1121.name: RootPartySubID
1121.desc: PartySubID value within a root parties component. Same values as PartySubID (523)

1122.name: RootPartySubIDType
1122.desc: Type of RootPartySubID (1121) value. Same values as PartySubIDType (803)

1123.name: TradeHandlingInstr
1123.desc: Specifies how a given trade report should be handled by the receiving party.

1126.name: OrigTradeId
1126.desc: Original trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transactionUsed to preserve original trade id when original trade is being referenced in a subsequent trade transaction such as a transfer

1128.name: ApplVerID
1128.desc: Specifies the service pack release being applied at message level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release.

1137.name: DefaultApplVerID
1137.desc: Specifies the service pack release being applied, by default, to message at the session level. Enumerated field with values assigned at time of service pack release. Uses same values as ApplVerID.

1180.name: ApplID
1180.desc: Identifies the application with which a message is associated. Used only if application sequencing is in effect.

1181.name: ApplSeqNum
1181.desc:
Data sequence number to be used when FIX
session is not in effect.

1184.name: SecurityXMLLen
1184.desc: Lenght of the SecurityXML data block

1185.name: SecurityXML
1185.desc: Actual XML data stream describing a security, normally FpML

1186.name: SecurityXMLSchema
1186.desc: The schema used to validate the contents of SecurityXML

1187.name: RefreshIndicator
1187.desc: Set by the sender to tell the receiver to perform an immediate refresh of the book due to disruptions in the accompanying real-time feed.

1328.name: RejectText
1328.desc: Those will be used by Firms to send a reason for rejecting a trade in an allocate claim model.

1363.name: FillExecID
1363.desc: Used when multiple partial fills are reported in single Execution Report

1366.name: LegExchExecMatchId
1366.desc: Captures tag 11921 (ExchExecMatchId) on leg of multileg instrument

1367.name: LegAllocSettlCurrency
1367.desc: Identifies settlement currency for the leg level allocation.

1369.name: MassActionReportID
1369.desc: Unique identifier of Order Mass Cancel Report or Order Mass Action Report message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN)

1373.name: MassActionType
1373.desc: Specifies the type of action requested

1374.name: MassActionScope
1374.desc: Specifies scope of Order Mass Action Request.

1375.name: MassActionResponse
1375.desc: Specifies the action taken by counterparty order handling system as a result of the action type indicated in MassActionType of the Order Mass Action Request

1376.name: MassActionRejectReason
1376.desc: Reason Order Mass Action Request was rejected

1388.name: TrdRepPartyRole
1388.desc: Identifies the type of party for trade reporting (Same values as PartyRole(452)).

1389.name: TrdRepInd
1389.desc: Specifies whether the trade should be reported (or not) to parties of the provided TrdRepPartyRole(1388). Used to override standard reporting behavior by the receiver of the trade report and thereby complements the PublTrdIndicator( tag1390).

1390.name: TradePublishType
1390.desc: Tag set on message to the exchange to request for delayed publication of trade report.

1408.name: AppProtocolVID
1408.desc: Exact identification of the version of the protocol used and expected by the client application. ( Protocol version id used by MS wrt any exchange, specifically used by Madrid)

1418.name: LegLastQty
1418.desc: Fill quantity for the leg instrument

1427.name: SideExecID
1427.desc: When reporting trades, used to reference the identifier of the execution (ExecID tag 17) being reported if different ExecIDs were assigned to each side of the trade. Added in FIX.5.0SP1 / EP77.

1430.name: VenueType
1430.desc: Indicates the type of venue on which this trade occurred. This field models the MMT Level 1 field

1444.name: SideLiquidityInd
1444.desc: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled. Added in FIX.5.0SP1 / EP81.

1449.name: RestructuringType
1449.desc: A category of CDS(Credit Default Swap) credit event in which the underlying bond experiences a restructuring.

1450.name: Seniority
1450.desc: Specifies which issue (underlying bond) will receive payment priority in the event of a default. Used to define a CDS (Credit Default Swap) instrument.

1500.name: MDStreamID
1500.desc: The identifier or name of the price stream.

1600.name: FIXEngineName
1600.desc: Name of the infrastructure component being used for session level communication

1601.name: FIXEngineVersion
1601.desc: Provides the version of the infrastructure component

1602.name: FIXEngineVendor
1602.desc: Provides the name of the vendor providing the infrastructure component

1688.name: ShortSaleExemptionReason
1688.desc: Indicates the reason a short sale order is exempted from applicable regulation (e.g. Reg SHO addendum (b)(1) in the U.S.).

1724.name: ExternalOrderOriginationType
1724.desc: Identifies whether the order was received from a customer of the firm, originated by the firm, or whether the order was received from another broker-dealer. MIFID2 usage. (contact BA team  if need to use this tag for other purpose)

1788.name: LegExchExecID
1788.desc: Captures tag 7211 (exchExecID) on leg of multileg instrument

1839.name: TradePriceCondition
1839.desc: This is an MMT level 3.6 tag which identifies the conditions associated with a given trade price.

1903.name: RegulatoryTradeID
1903.desc: Trade identifier required by government regulators or other regulatory organizations for regulatory reporting purposes. For example, unique swap identifer (USI) as required by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission.

1904.name: RegulatoryTradeIDEvent
1904.desc: Identifies the event which caused origination of the identifier in RegulatoryTradeID(1903)ID. When more than one event is the cause, use the higher enumeration value.

1905.name: RegulatoryTradeIDSource
1905.desc: Identifies the reporting entity that originated the value in RegulatoryTradeID(1903). The reporting entitiy identifier may be assigned by a regulator

1906.name: RegulatoryTradeIDType
1906.desc: Specifies the type of trade identifier provided in RegulatoryTradeID(1903), within the context of the hierarchy of trade events.

1907.name: NoRegulatoryTradeIDs
1907.desc: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group

1924.name: ClearingIntention
1924.desc: Specifies the party's or parties' intention to clear the trade.

1925.name: TradeClearingInstruction
1925.desc: Specifies the eligibility of this trade for clearing and central counterparty processing.

1927.name: ConfirmationMethod
1927.desc: Specifies how a trade was confirmed.

1928.name: MandatoryClearingIndicator
1928.desc: An indication that the trade is flagged for mandatory clearing.

2373.name: IntraFirmTradeIndicator
2373.desc: Indicates whether the trade was entered into as an intra-group transaction for intra group risk management purposes

2376.name: PartyRoleQualifier
2376.desc: This tag represents the nature of value submitted in PartyID (448).

2404.name: EurexComplianceText
2404.desc: Exchange memberID-traderID combination to be passed on to Eurex

2405.name: ExecutionMethod
2405.desc: Identifies the execution method employed by the firm, e.g automated, off-book etc. Used for MMT as the level 3.7 tag.

2411.name: RegulatoryLegRefId
2411.desc: This field may be used for multi-leg trades sent as a single message to indicate that the entry applies only to a specific leg

2524.name: TradeReportingIndicator
2524.desc: Used between parties to convey trade reporting status. MIFID2 Usage - MS will be setting this in the FO systems and passed back on fills as an indication to clients on what we intend to do for trade reporting - there are no guarantees on accuracy.

2589.name: RelatedClosePrice
2589.desc: Closing price of the underlying required to calculate the settlement price

2639.name: NoCommissionsAK
2639.desc: Number of commissions in the repeating group on allocation confirmation 35=AK.

2640.name: CommissionAmountAK
2640.desc: The commission amount on allocation confirmation 35=AK message. Required if NoCommissions(2639) > 0.

2641.name: CommissionAmountTypeAK
2641.desc: Indicates what type of commission is being expressed in CommissionAmount(2640)on allocation confirmation 35=AK message. Required if NoCommissions(2639) > 0.

2642.name: CommissionBasisAK
2642.desc: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission on allocation confirmation 35=AK message. Required if NoCommissions(2639) > 0.

2643.name: CommissionCurrencyAK
2643.desc: Specifies the currency denomination of the commission amount if different from the trade's currency on allocation confirmation 35=AK message. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

2653.name: NoCommissionsJ
2653.desc: The number of commission components provided in the repeating block on allocation request message (35=J)

2654.name: CommissionAmountJ
2654.desc:
On allocation request message (35=J)
Required if NoCommissions(2639) > 0. If the commission is based on a percentage of trade quantity or a factor of

2655.name: CommissionAmountTypeJ
2655.desc: On allocation request message (35=J).  Required if NoCommissions(2639) > 0.

2656.name: CommissionBasisJ
2656.desc: On allocation request message (35=J).  Required if NoCommissions(2639) > 0.

2657.name: CommissionCurrencyJ
2657.desc: It is expected that a commission expressed as a Fixed Amount will be in the same currency as the price of the trade.  optional field

2667.name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
2667.desc: Indicates that the order or trade originates from a computer program or algorithm requiring little-to-no human intervention.

2668.name: NoTrdRegPublications
2668.desc: Number of regulatory publication rules in repeating group.

2669.name: TrdRegPublicationType
2669.desc: Specifies the type of regulatory trade publication. Additional reasons for the publication type may be specified in TrdRegPublicationReason(2670).

2670.name: TrdRegPublicationReason
2670.desc: Additional reason for trade publication type specified in TrdRegPublicationType(2669). Reasons may be specific to regulatory trade publication rules.

2704.name: ExDestinationType
2704.desc: Order level preference to determine where the given order can be traded. Used for MIFID2 purposes.

2726.name: AllocCommissionSubType
2726.desc:
Used to differentiate among research payment types
Sample values: Research Payment Account (RPA), Commission Sharing Agreement (CSA) or Other (not RPA or CSA)

2896.name: TertiaryTrdType
2896.desc: Type of trade assigned to a trade. Used in addition to TrdType(828) and SecondaryTrdType(855)

5149.name: Memo
5149.desc:
Free format text field. This field may be used to
convey client's relevant info. It's always echoed in
the reports.

5177.name: FractionalOrderNotionalDollarAmt
5177.desc: Represents the requested notional dollar amount on notional-based orders; can be submitted out to two decimal places

5297.name: SbeBookInTimestamp
5297.desc: epoch timestamp in nanoseconds precision in integer format

5427.name: InstrAttribType
5427.desc: Instrument attribute type as defined by an external party, takes enumerated values - I=Interest,D=Discount.

6110.name: IndustryCode
6110.desc: This tag represents the Industry Classification. Present for SUPR messages only.

6160.name: LastPx2
6160.desc: Price of the far leg of a swap

6520.name: SWXTradeTypeCodeList
6520.desc: SWX proprietary. List of SWX Trade Type Codes. Must be of format String(20). May contain up to 4 trade type codes with the format string(1..2), spearated by (one or more) spaces.

6555.name: OrigTrdMatchID
6555.desc: TrdMatchID (880) of the original (previous - not the initial) trade.

6556.name: SWXBusinessTransactionType
6556.desc: SWX proprietary. Optional on One-Sided Trade Reports which are no Reversal nor Correction, else this field is ignored.

6583.name: SpreadPremium
6583.desc: The product spread premium as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

6584.name: SpreadPctPremium
6584.desc: The product spread premium percentage as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

6585.name: SpreadPctDiscount
6585.desc: The product spread discount percentage as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

6586.name: CashOffset
6586.desc: Cash Offset as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

6702.name: InCompete
6702.desc: To indicate whether it is in competition with anyone

6757.name: JitneyBrokerNumber
6757.desc: The broker number where a Jitney order is being executed on behalf of another Canadian Broker.

6760.name: RatesXInternalizationRule
6760.desc: Rule used for ratesx internalization in MSSWAT

7201.name: MSDestID
7201.desc: refers to the MS/virtual destination (e.g. LSE1)

7202.name: ReturnAddress
7202.desc: Incoming connection name to which message should be returned to.

7203.name: application
7203.desc: System from which the message originates.

7204.name: AmendType
7204.desc: Describes the specific amend taking place.

7205.name: ExecutingSystem
7205.desc: Destination to which execution order is being routed to. Value must match exchange name in OR.

7207.name: InitialOrderDate
7207.desc: Set by OM to today's date - time format upon creation of an execution order.

7208.name: InitialClOrdID
7208.desc: Captures clOrdID of an execution order for the first event version, set by systems external to MS. An event is a cancel, replace, etc. Generally set by OM, else TD rule to copy it from tag 11.
