7209.desc: On an execution bust/correct, this tag will capture the original execution price of the execution being busted/corrected. If value is not set on incoming message, OM will set this value.

7210.name: RefLastShares
7210.desc: On an execution bust/correct, this tag will capture the original execution shares of the execution being busted/corrected. If value is not set on incoming message, OM will set this value

7211.name: exchExecID
7211.desc: Captures the returned value of tag 17 (execID) from exchange since tag 17 is used by MS trading systems to hold an internally generated unique fill ID.

7212.name: currentOrderDate
7212.desc: Set by OR to today's date - time format.

7213.name: InitialExecID
7213.desc: Captures initial execID for executions in case executions go through various corrects and/or busts. AKA - E.entityPrimaryRefID. One part of four part key in generating E.entityOID. Generally set by OM, else TD rule to copy it from tag 17.

7214.name: residualQty
7214.desc: Amount of order quantity that has not been traded yet. AKA - pocket quantity.

7215.name: BasketName
7215.desc: User defined value for grouping together a 'basket' of stocks. Similar to the concept of a portfolio.

7216.name: EntryID
7216.desc: Unique id set by engine on all street slices to link back to the original incoming order.

7220.name: groupID
7220.desc: Used by MMETL to store a common ID for all fills from an IPO group exec. Used by PDT to hold the sub-groupID of the order placer.

7221.name: GroupParentID
7221.desc: ID of parent entity. For example, on a block message, this tag will hold the ID of the portfolio to which the block belongs.

7225.name: GroupAction
7225.desc: Instruction to OM indicating what kind of action to take on the various PBO levels. Instructions set by etsBroker, CDFR, etsGateway, etc.

7226.name: GroupInst
7226.desc: Instructions for OM/TOM indicating special behaviors on the various PBO levels. Instructions set by etsBroker, CDFR, etsGateway, etc.

7234.name: targetPrice
7234.desc: Used as a control parameter for the MBA/SORT facilitation laddering mechanism. MBA uses target price when sending base risk and last risk orders to SORT to work into the close. MBA sets target price to either bp with offset (for buy) or ap with offset (fo

7237.name: rootClOrdID
7237.desc: Hop linkage field used to capture initClOrdID of previous hop's EO. In MMETL, field used to capture orderID of previous hop's EO. To be decommissioned.

7239.name: LotSize
7239.desc: Lot size of the entity as defined in relevant product database (e.g. P2).

7246.name: CaptureFormat
7246.desc: Holds the format in which the fill was received.

7253.name: FilterSymbol
7253.desc: Symbol used to retrieve market data for a product. Value is usually the mdSymbol of the product.

7254.name: reportToRiskInd
7254.desc: Required to report to Risk Manager or not

7255.name: traderGroupID
7255.desc: Group to which trader belongs to. Can be set by order entry applications or processes like CDFR.

7256.name: SendMode
7256.desc: Indicates to hold or release depending on client's limit. Initial usage is by ATTN and also being used in SSV. Also used by market making to indicate whether the order is auto or manual.

7257.name: ValidationStatus
7257.desc: Status of limit checking validation or short sell checking validation.

7259.name: ClientData
7259.desc: Used to hold client specific information,e.g. limit policy.

7260.name: AppOrderID
7260.desc: Used by etsBroker to store a unique appReferenceID.

7261.name: OtherMarketSide
7261.desc: Stamped by internal systems that can generate executions. Represents the side of the counter party order.

7262.name: PositionID
7262.desc: Used internally as a position identifier for cross inventory within MBX/GT.

7270.name: crossActionType
7270.desc: Indicates type of an off-market cross. Different type off-market crosses are price adjustment, risk fill, or buy vs shortsell.

7273.name: SingleOrderInd
7273.desc: R=one symbol at time (trd by trd)

7274.name: clientMnemonic
7274.desc: Used to hold the mnemonic by which client is known. Not necessarily equal to clientID (tag 109).

7275.name: portfolioID
7275.desc: Unique identifier of a portfolio within a UPR message. AKA - P.entityPrimaryRefID. One part of four part key in generating P.entityOID. In general, it is genereated by processes such as CDFR, etsBroker, etsGateway, etc.

7276.name: crossID
7276.desc: Unique identifier to link two executions that were the result of a cross. Generated by the crossing and added to both the matched executions. For on-exchange crosses it should only be set if the cross was fulfilled and the intention was to cross.

7277.name: CounterPartyAccount
7277.desc: Stamped by internal systems that can generate executions. Represents the account of the counter party order.

7284.name: CounterPartyRule80A
7284.desc: Stamped by internal systems that can generate executions. Represents the order capacity of the counter party order.

7286.name: RequestID
7286.desc: UniqueID added on to a request

7287.name: PublishSecurityID
7287.desc: Contains the identifier of the product that is to be published. Generally set by OM, else set on incoming messages into OM.

7288.name: PublishSecurityIDSource
7288.desc: Identifies class or source of the PublishSecurityID value. Generally set by OM, else set on incoming messages into OM.

7289.name: CounterPartyClOrdID
7289.desc: Stamped by internal systems that can generate executions. Represents the client orderID of the counter party order.

7290.name: CounterPartyClientID
7290.desc: Represents the clientID of the counter party order. Can be stamped by internal systems that can generate executions or sent by exchanges in an external tag and copied by OR into CounterPartyClientID.

7291.name: IBSDealID
7291.desc: used as blockName comparable to portfolioName, Header file has DealID which implies e.g. IBS-Deal-ID

7295.name: OrigPrice
7295.desc: Original price. Used to store the limit price (tag 44) of the original customer order.

7297.name: OrigOrdType
7297.desc: The orignal value of OrdType(40) prior to it being changed.

7298.name: LineName
7298.desc: Set by DOT OR's to represent the line (session) the order was sent down.

7299.name: ownerID_alt
7299.desc: Trader who has ownership of the order. Populated with trader's kerberos ID.

7302.name: ExchangeAccount
7302.desc: exchangeAccountRefID - note, although the fix name can be kseAccount, the tag is generic and can be used for all exchanges.

7304.name: BookingFlag
7304.desc: Indicator used to identify whether the trading system should send the execution to the booking system.

7315.name: CrossType
7315.desc: Specifies what kind of crossing is requested for cross requests between upstream application and crossing engine.

7317.name: origOrderID
7317.desc: orderID used to identify the previous order state as assigned internally by MS (e.g. in Partial Fill, cancel/replace requests)

7318.name: initOrderID
7318.desc: Captures OrderID for execution order for the first event version, set internally by MS. An event is a cancel, replace, etc.

7319.name: marketID
7319.desc: Internal identifier populated with product's marketID as defined in relevant product database (e.g. P2).

7320.name: CrossIndicator
7320.desc: Code to indicate the type of cross in the case where an execution was due to a cross.

7321.name: BasePriceType
7321.desc: Holds the value of price type for an execution order. Possible values are - ap (Ask Price), bp (Bid Price), ccp (Close Price ), tp (Last Price), hp (High Price), lp (Low Price ), mp (Mid Price) etc. If order price = tp +2t, 7321=tp.

7322.name: PriceCalcType
7322.desc: When translating reference prices such as poc + 4c (poc-Primary Offical Close Price, c-cents per share), the PriceCalcType tells us if the incremental/decramental part of the price is cents per share, basis points or ticks. If order price = tp +2t, 7322=t

7323.name: PriceCalcOffset
7323.desc: Holds the value of price offset (in the form of either ticks or basis ponts. If order price = tp +2t, 7323=2.

7324.name: issueType
7324.desc: Populated with product's issueID as defined in relevant product database (e.g. P2).

7326.name: crossReport
7326.desc: Indicates type of reporting that needs to be done.

7329.name: OrderSeqNum
7329.desc: OrderSeqNum Represents where in sequence this Order is.

7331.name: SoftLimitOverride
7331.desc: Indicator used to override soft limit.

7332.name: GiveUp
7332.desc: AKA-GiveUpInd. Indicates that this order is to be given up to another broker rather than be allocated to a client. If this were a client trade, this would be similar to stepping out allocations to another broker in the US

7334.name: EntryAction
7334.desc: Action trader is taking on an order.

7336.name: allocatingApp
7336.desc: Defines what booking system should be used e.g. IBS, OMS, etc.

7337.name: OriginatingRegion
7337.desc: Identifies the entry point region into the MS infrastructure. Stamped on all orders received via FIX or user input.

7338.name: entryUser
7338.desc: Identifies the person or process who created the version of the entity (but does not necessarily own it).

7339.name: EntryTm
7339.desc: The time when an entity or a new version of an existing entity is created by an ETS component. It is set as the time when the transition to a new state occurs. entryTime should change for each version.

7340.name: SolicitedInd
7340.desc: Indicates if order action was initiated by client or by internal system.

7341.name: marginLocateCode
7341.desc: The locator key of stock borrowed from stock lending, EFS id or externally passed, text up to 15 chars

7342.name: Restricted
7342.desc: Indicator to specify whether symbol is a restricted symbol

7343.name: sideBySideClientID
7343.desc: Captures the client side trader's initials who is allowing the proprietary trader to trade side by side with the client.

7345.name: authForRestricted
7345.desc: Reason from client when client gives Morgan Stanley a trade for a stock from which Morgan Stanley is restricted from trading.

7347.name: TickSize
7347.desc: Size of tick as defined in relevant product database (e.g. P2).

7351.name: LegalEntityPosition
7351.desc: Stores the position of the Agg Unit Check for this account (i.e. to establish if overall the AggUnit is long or short).

7352.name: LastTradePrice
7352.desc: Used to store tp from market data at time of a fill.

7355.name: MinCrossPercentage
7355.desc: Minimum cross quantity as a percentage of the order.

7372.name: RejectReason
7372.desc: Reason for Reject  as provided by the Swap Provider

7401.name: appLoc
7401.desc: Location of the source application eg London

7433.name: execRole
7433.desc: Indicates whether the execution of this order accessed liquidity or provides liquidity. Note that valid values and their respective meanings differ depending on the destination providing the fill. (The current list normalized for EU flow.)

7440.name: lastHandlInst
7440.desc: How order was handled on exchange trading floor. Populated with the same values as HandlInst (21)

7458.name: TraderGrpID
7458.desc:
Group to which trader belongs to. Can be set by order entry applications or processes like CDFR. Values can be propdesk
lncvts
single
etc.

7460.name: TransStatus
7460.desc: TCspecific - status of booking in TC

7465.name: avgPriceType
7465.desc: Indicates whether the average price field represents an average price of a single execution or an average price of multiple executions.

7493.name: CustomRate
7493.desc: "Customer Rate" as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

7502.name: CrossedQty
7502.desc: Quantity that was crossed. Was originally 7502 - changed back from 7510.

7503.name: CrossCommitedQty
7503.desc: Expresses the total quantity available to cross.

7504.name: riskFactor
7504.desc: Indicated to the MBA engine the risk level to take when trading the order. Was originally 7504- changed back from 7512.

7505.name: mbaBenchMark
7505.desc: Indicates to the MBA engine which benchmark to use when trading the order.

7506.name: ReportSource
7506.desc: Was originally 7506- changed back from 7514. Set by OM to a value of OM to denote that the report was generated by OM internally.

7509.name: initEntryDt
7509.desc: Was originally 7509- changed back from 7487 ( in GMT )

7518.name: EndTime
7518.desc: Time in GMT when the engine should finish crossing the order.

7519.name: autoXQty
7519.desc: Quantity that was auto executed by MMETL.

7520.name: facilQty
7520.desc: Quantity that was facilitated by MMETL.

7521.name: insideBidPrice
7521.desc: Captures the market inside bid price at the time of execution.

7522.name: insideBidSize
7522.desc: Captures the market inside bid size at the time of execution.

7523.name: insideAskPrice
7523.desc: Captures the market inside ask price at the time of execution.

7524.name: insideAskSize
7524.desc: Captures the market inside ask size at the time of execution.

7525.name: mmBidPrice
7525.desc: Captures Morgan Stanley's bid price at the time of execution.

7526.name: mmBidSize
7526.desc: Captures Morgan Stanley's bid size at the time of execution.

7527.name: mmAskPrice
7527.desc: Captures Morgan Stanley's ask price at the time of execution.

7528.name: mmAskSize
7528.desc: Captures Morgan Stanley's ask size at the time of execution.

7529.name: orderDisplayDest
7529.desc: Where a quote/order is displayed. Values could be BTRD, Nasdaq, etc.

7530.name: orderDisplayTime
7530.desc: How long quote/order is to be displayed at the OrderDisplayDest

7535.name: BenchmarkPrice
7535.desc: Indicates the benchmark price at the time the execution report is generated. Thus if the benchmark is VWAP, BenchmarkPrice will contain the VWAP price at the time the execution report is generated.

7537.name: OrderReason
7537.desc: Used by MMETL to identify the type of order or execution.

7538.name: MaxShares
7538.desc: Calculated by strategy to decide max qty to trade agent.

7539.name: TradeSchedule
7539.desc: Trade schedule MBA will use to trade order. Consists of a timestamp (in local time) and shares of order to be sent.

7540.name: OpenQty
7540.desc: (1) MBA quantity sent to an opening auction to be traded. (2) Opened interest-related quantity for derivatives.

7541.name: CloseQty
7541.desc: (1) MBA quantity sent to a closing auction to be traded. (2) Closed interest-related quantity for derivatives.

7542.name: QtyDivisorField
7542.desc: In the wave world, sometimes shares are divided wave.

7544.name: CounterPartyTraderID
7544.desc: TraderID of the trader from the client side who is sending the order.

7545.name: bidDirection
7545.desc: Captures the bid direction of the current bid at the time of execution

7548.name: UnconfirmedQty
7548.desc: Used in classic OM to indicate the change of open quantity on a Pending Cancel message. If an order for 1000 shares with 200 filled, 300 open and 500 in pocket is being cancelled, UnconfirmedQty will be -300.

7549.name: UserType
7549.desc: Indicates whether user is internal or external to Morgan Stanley.

7550.name: ImportedFromIBSInd
7550.desc: Indicated if a portfolio and its associated orders were imported into PassportXL via IBS. Set by etsGateway.

7551.name: ProjectedVolume
7551.desc: Projected total volume for a product.

7553.name: ClosingAuctionTime
7553.desc: Closing Time of the Auction.  Used to specify the exact time that the Opening, Afternoon or Closing Auction closes.  Note, this may also be used elsewhere to specify the opening time of the Closing Auction (MOC).

7554.name: OpeningAuctionTime
7554.desc: Opening Time of the Auction. Used to specify the exact time of the Opening, Afternoon or Closing Auction (eg 0845, 1215, 1600, 1630). Note, this may also be used globally to specify the time of the OpeningAuction.

7555.name: NoBins
7555.desc: Number of bins in a distribution.

7556.name: BinNumber
7556.desc: Holds the bin number that a fill belongs to. There are 42 bins in total. Bin0 is for the open auction, and bin40 is for the close auction.

7557.name: VolumeSchedule
7557.desc: Holds the bin number and order quantity for each bin. Delimited by ':'. Example: 7557=33=96:34=100:35=106:36=115:37=129:38=140:39=236:40=78:

7558.name: affiliatedInd
7558.desc: Indicates whether client is an affiliate of Morgan Stanley

7559.name: actionReason
7559.desc: Used by MMETL and set to the same value as tag 7537.

7560.name: PercentOfVolume
7560.desc: Instruction to trading engine specifying the amount of the order executed be a percent of the total volume traded for that security. Represented as a decimal number between 0 and 1.

7561.name: StartRefPrice
7561.desc: Price (double or ap, bp, mp) from which strategy will start working customer order.

7562.name: PriceStepSize
7562.desc: What price step size to use while working customer order

7563.name: OrdSubType
7563.desc: Within regular ordTypes (e.g.Mkt) define type that will instruct strategy how to execute the order.

7565.name: OMOwnerID
7565.desc: Captures information on which order manager (i.e. OM) managed the order. Usually set by order manager to the order manager's client address.

7566.name: OmVID
7566.desc: VersionID for portfolio, block, and order messages. Tag is only on UPR messages. Tag should be incremented from 0 for every report OM sends back to clients/fixRouter

7567.name: RiskBookingCurr
7567.desc: Booking currency for positions updated in risk (ompk).

7568.name: futureTradeAccount
7568.desc: Place holder for future account between tradeXL and gateway

7569.name: MinorCurrencyInd
7569.desc: Indicates if a price is quoted in minor currency (e.g. GBX) or major currency (e.g. GBP).

7570.name: ExternalUserInd
7570.desc: Indicates if order is coming from internal or external user.

7573.name: OrigTraderID
7573.desc: Previous traderID. In Asia, it is used to carry the traderID of the synthetic order.

7574.name: PendingOrderQty
7574.desc: Used in classic OM on UPR messages to indicate the unconfirmed change of quantity of a Portfolio Order. It is the order quantity on Pending New, less leaves quantity on Pending Cancel, add target quantity less the current quantity on Pending Replace.

7575.name: BookingLoc
7575.desc: Location where order is going to be booked.

7577.name: origClientClOrdID
7577.desc: The client's previous version of clOrdID

7578.name: initClientClOrdID
7578.desc: The client's first version of clOrdID

7579.name: exchangeLineID
7579.desc: The firmID (mnemonic) for DOT orders. The exchangeLineID+orderID (BranchSeqNo) uniquely identifies MS orders at DOT.  Also used for Euronext and SGX.

7580.name: clientConnectionID
7580.desc: Identify which physical fix connection/user it came from (i.e. we can have multiple client connections per client ID).

7581.name: TCSTestOrderID
7581.desc: Test OrderIDs used for testing OM with TCS.

7582.name: execIsAutoXInd
7582.desc: Indicates whether an execution was auto executed at DOT.

7598.name: BOATInitSystemUTI
7598.desc: Reference trade report identifier used on trade report amends (set by BOAT)

7599.name: BOATSystemUTI
7599.desc: Unique trade report identifier (set by BOAT)

7680.name: ExternalOTCInd
7680.desc: OTC trade as defined by an external vendor or system such as BrainTrade.

7779.name: OrigClFixRouter
7779.desc: This tag is used to specify which fix router a cdfix router should forward executions back to. (FixRouter that clients connect to)

7901.name: ExecutingParticipantID
7901.desc: Code for the ISE Market Maker to whom an order is being directed.

7902.name: MSWatchAlertID
7902.desc: Unique identifier within the context of MSWatch assigned to an business alert sent to an external client.

7903.name: MSWatchAlertName
7903.desc: Human readable name for an alert sent by MSWatch to an external client, e.g. "52WeekHigh", "OrderCanceled" etc.

8000.name: SelfMatchPreventionInstruction
8000.desc: Indicates a cancel instruction when self match prevention is triggered

8001.name: AccountProfile
8001.desc: IDEM Exchange specific tag to indicate whether the account profile is of a Hedger or Speculator. || SHFE Exchange specific tag to indicate whether trade intention is for Arbitrage, Speculate or Hedge.

8010.name: FractionalCleanUpOrder
8010.desc: Tag used to distinguish regular way Fractional orders (8010=N) vs EOD Clean-Up order (8010=Y)

8011.name: Recon
8011.desc: Echo-back of ClOrdID (Tag 11), often used for BO reconciliation by Participant

8013.name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
8013.desc: Specifies the types of regulatory trade publication. Used in MIFID2 for "waiver indicator" in accordance with articles 4 and 9 of Regulation (EU) 600/2014.

8014.name: TradePriceConditions
8014.desc: Flattened version of tag 1839 - an MMT level 3.6 tag which identifies the conditions associated with a given trade price. Space delimited - takes multiple values.(Used in MIFID2).

8015.name: OrderAttributeTypes
8015.desc: Order attribute types - typically regulatory indicators. 8015=5 - Used for MIFID2 purposes to denote that an order is coming from an order placer that is an SI on the product the order is placed on. Seek TRA-BA advice before use.

8016.name: TradingVenueRegulatoryTradeID
8016.desc: Holds the trading venue transaction identification code (TVTIC)

8023.name: ReportedJurisdictions
8023.desc: The reported jurisdictions are those that the trade has been or will be reported to. Required to also use TradeReportingIndicator(2524)=6 (Trade has been or will be reported).

8070.name: DIOITargetContraFirm
8070.desc: The contra firm who has selected our directed IOI and traded against it.

8181.name: ChiXTRptType
8181.desc: Category of CHI-X Australia trade report under the Market Integrity Rules.

8901.name: BIDSSponsoredFirmEnabled
8901.desc: Indicates whether the sponsor relation between the subscriber and the specified sponsored firms are to be enabled or disabled.

8902.name: NoBIDSSponsoredFirms
8902.desc: Number of repeating fields for BIDSSponsoredFirm

8903.name: BIDSSponsoredFirm
8903.desc: Repeating field indicating the sponsored firm who relation with the subscriber will be enabled or disabled

9001.name: FidessaUserID
9001.desc: Identifies the Fidessa trader user identifier. This is the value that the trader uses to log on the Fidessa product suite.

9005.name: TRCountryOfRegister
9005.desc: Trade report country of register. This specifies the country of register for a specified tradable instrument.

9006.name: PDUnrealizedMtdPnL
9006.desc: Position download unrealized profit/lose figure. Previously known as PDUnrealisedMtdP&L

9007.name: PDRealizedMtdPnL
9007.desc: Position download realized profit/lose figure. Previously known as PDRealisedMtdP&L

9011.name: TRTradeTime
9011.desc: Trade report trade time (non UTC) ( in GMT )

9012.name: FidessaBrokerage
9012.desc: Brokerage cost?s associated with a trade.ormation than in brokerageType (9034)

9017.name: FidessaExecTransType
9017.desc: Fidessa extended version of ExecTransType. This is used to handle cancel versions of cancel/correct trades.

9018.name: FidessaSysID
9018.desc: Used to identify external Fidessa compatible systems.

9020.name: TRMarketSegCode
9020.desc: LSE trade report market segment code. A code which uniquely identifies a specific LSE trading area.

9023.name: TRMarketInd
9023.desc: LSE trade report dissemination indicator. Indicates whether a trade report is disseminated to the market over the broadcast interface.

9024.name: TRMessageRef
9024.desc: LSE trade report reference id. This is used to allow matching of sent and received trade reports.

9025.name: TRTradeTypeInd
9025.desc: LSE trade type indicator. This indicates the type of the trade which has occurred.

9026.name: TRTradeCode
9026.desc: LSE trade report trade code. A code assigned by the LSE to uniquely identify executed trades.

9027.name: TRPartCodeBuy
9027.desc: LSE trade report participant code. The participant code of the participant on the buy side of the trade.

9028.name: TRPartCodeSell
9028.desc: LSE trade report participant code. The participant code of the participant on the buy side of the trade.

9029.name: FidessaBargainConditions
9029.desc: Codes indicating the conditions agreed between the two participants at the time of trading.

9031.name: FidessaDontCare
9031.desc: Fidessa don?t care flag. This indicates that the trade is not of interest to the Fidessa system.es. Note the fraction may be greater than, equal to or less than 1. (Note tag # was reserved in FIX 4.1, added in FIX 4.3)

9032.name: TRDealingCapacity
9032.desc: LSE trade report dealing capacity. This is used by the exchange to determine whether a participant has acted in an agency or principle capacity.

9033.name: TRConvertedPriceInd
9033.desc: LSE trade report converted price indicator. Indicates whether the price and currency entered on a trade report is the price or currency in which the transaction was dealt.

9037.name: FidessaReportStatus
9037.desc: Fidessa trade report status. This indicates if a trade as successfully reported.

9039.name: FidessaOrigClientID
9039.desc: Fidessa original client reference. This is the unique transaction identifier (UTI).

9041.name: ExchangeOrderID
9041.desc: Identifier for a received order as assigned by the external destination, e.g. an Exchange. Not guaranteed to be unique.

9042.name: reportedToExchInd
9042.desc: Whether the execution has already been trade reported

9043.name: FidessaVersionModes
9043.desc: Indicates the style of trade versioning.

9046.name: FidessaBookTransferType
9046.desc: Details the type of book transfer.

9047.name: FidessaProductScopeInd
9047.desc: Indicates if this trade is in scope for trades completion.

9051.name: OrigTransCondition
9051.desc: conditions on the previous version of a trade

9054.name: FidessaBrokageType
9054.desc:
How the brokerage is calculated
more information than in brokerageType (9034)

9055.name: TCSCInstrumentInd
9055.desc: TCSC flag on the Fidessa instrument

9057.name: OrigContributorRef
9057.desc: contributor ref of the previous version of this trade

9107.name: BuyBrokerNumber
9107.desc: Used to capture the Buy side broker code of an executed trade, provided by the Mexican Stock Exchange.

9109.name: SellBrokerNumber
9109.desc: Used to capture the Sell side broker code of an executed trade, provided by the Mexican Stock Exchange.

9118.name: CancelReason
9118.desc: Code to identify reason for cancel.

9128.name: Tolerance
9128.desc: Maximum allowed delta [variation] for a message's numerical attributes, can be used when a message is being compared. The unit of tolerance is captured in 9129.

9129.name: ToleranceUnit
9129.desc: Unit of Tolerance Value (e.g. %, $), with tolerance defined as tag 9128.

9130.name: BarrierStyle
9130.desc: Style of a barrier for a Barrier option.

9131.name: BarrierLevel
9131.desc: Price of the underlying at which the option comes in existance or ceases to exist for a Barrier option.

9132.name: BarrierDirection
9132.desc: Designates the direction in which the Barrier needs to be crossed to activate the option.

9133.name: BarrierStartDate
9133.desc: The date the price monitoring starts for a Barrier option.

9134.name: BarrierEndDate
9134.desc: The date the price monitoring ends for a Barrier option.

9137.name: BarrierLevel2
9137.desc: Level of the second barrier for double barrier options.

9138.name: BarrierRebate2
9138.desc: Rebate for the second barrier for double barrier options.

9140.name: ExchDispOrdInstr
9140.desc: Trader's display instruction to the exchange.  value sent to exchange may be different depending the venue. This tag will capture raw value received from client

9202.name: ISESpecialOrdType
9202.desc: Specific to ISE Exchange. Specifies the special order type.

9205.name: ISETradeType
9205.desc: ISE Options Exchange proprietary. Specifies the trade type as recognised by ISE.

9225.name: MessageID
9225.desc: Fix message tag for Post Trade business-String Identifies message to receiving system.

9403.name: OffsetPrice
9403.desc: Offset or minimum price improvement value from the current Bid or Offer.

9416.name: ExtendedExecInst
9416.desc: Extended instructions for order handling on exchange trading floor.

9471.name: NoTransactionCosts
9471.desc: Number of "Transaction Costs" related attributes as defined by an external vendors or systems such as BrainTrade.

9472.name: TransactionCostType
9472.desc: Type of the transaction cost. Used in NoTransactionsCosts

9473.name: TransactionCostCode
9473.desc: The cost code attributed to a particular transaction cost from an vendor or external system. E.g. BrainTrade.

9474.name: TransactionCostRate
9474.desc: Transaction cost rate - Used in repeating group NoTransactionCosts

9476.name: TransCostAmt
9476.desc: Used to denote the transcation cost associated with 9473.

9477.name: TransactionCostCurrency
9477.desc: The ISO code for the currency of the transaction cost.Used in repeating group NoTransactionCosts

9515.name: PrimaryMktInd
9515.desc: Indicates that this order should only be traded on the primary market.

9516.name: offExchangeInd
9516.desc: Indicates if a fill was executed on or off the exchange.

9529.name: ETCPartyIdentification
9529.desc: /NAM/MORGAN STANLEY ASSET MGMT. ETC BLOCK ACCOUNT

9581.name: EtcChargeType
9581.desc:
Charge Type
e.g. PTM Levy, Client Commission etc

9596.name: ClientFreeField1
9596.desc: First "Client Free Field" as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

9597.name: ClientFreeField2
9597.desc: Second "Client Free Field" as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

9604.name: ConnStatus
9604.desc: Indicates the connection status (up or down) of the destination specified by RouterConnName (9606) that a router is sending this message to.

9605.name: RouterConnMode
9605.desc: Indicates the connection mode that a router should use when sending messages the destination specified by RouterConnName (9606).

9606.name: ConnName
9606.desc: Specifies the destination in terms of the connection name that a router is sending this message to.

9721.name: rrNumber
9721.desc: Registered Representative number: represents salesman/group for commission; all digits but can start with 0 (char5)

9730.name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
9730.desc: Indicates whether the exchange holds orders from matching

9783.name: MarketMakerIndicator
9783.desc: Indicates whether MS is a market maker for the symbol, for prop orders only.

9784.name: SuppressFaxTelex
9784.desc: Previously known as Suppress Fax Telex

9882.name: CboeFeeCode
9882.desc: Specific fee code associated with execution

9906.name: PartyApplication
9906.desc:
Holds the Bloomberg application name. 
This tag is used only for an interface with Bloomberg. NOT TO BE PERSISTED. If persistence is required, another tag needs to be defined (PLAT-5910).

9938.name: ClearingHandlingType
9938.desc: Clearing handling type as defined by an external vendor or system e.g. BrainTrade.

9999.name: DestinationInd
9999.desc: Determines the downstream destination for outgoing messages from Booker/M1

10564.name: aggCrossAction
10564.desc: AggCrossAction indicates the combination of CrossActions applied to the executions of an Agency order that has been crossed. This tag is used to drive a HK Levey calculation.

10565.name: ShopInd
10565.desc: It indicates whether an order should be shopped (ie should salestraders contact their clients in an effort to fill the other side of the order)

10566.name: CptOrderID
10566.desc: This specifies the order id of the other order that a client order crossed with.

10567.name: OROwnerID
10567.desc: to trace to which OR at the plant the order went without relying in naming conventions on independent separate tag

10574.name: P2FuturePrefix
10574.desc: Future prefix is an attribute on future products that helps make routing decisions. For e.g. certain products will be routed to 'GLOBEX' based on this attribute. It's a field in P2 table P2future.

10575.name: tradeGrsExecPrnAmt
10575.desc: This Stores an additional principal field for executions, the Traded Currency Gross Executed Principal.

10576.name: MdExch
10576.desc: Preferred market data exchange for retrieving real time price data. Contains values from the dfExch field for markets where there are direct feeds. If there is no direct feed, the mdExch field will contain values from the rtExch field.

10577.name: ScalePrice
10577.desc: A factor to multiply real-time prices by converting them to the unit currency (preferably obtained from filter). Otherwise, set to the default value, based upon the exchange.

10578.name: ScaleVolume
10578.desc: A factor to multiply real-time volumes that convert to units (shares, for example) traded.Initially set to the default value, based upon the exchange.

10579.name: ParValue
10579.desc: ParValue. This is an existing P2 attribute. Description is yet to be decided in P2 website

10581.name: UseOpenAuctionInd
10581.desc: Define strategy behaviour in all regions. Clients want to set parameter that will tell strategy to NOT send slices to opening (market on open or limit on open) auction.

10582.name: UseCloseAuctionInd
10582.desc: Define strategy behaviour in all regions. Clients want to set parameter that will tell strategy to NOT send slices to afternoon close auction.

10583.name: UseAftnAuctionInd
10583.desc: Define strategy behaviour in all regions. Clients want to set parameter that will tell strategy to NOT send slices to afternoon open auction.

10584.name: BPNetInitialCash
10584.desc: Total cash amount held as part of the portfolio initially (before trading starts). Having a non zero value in effect shifts all bounds by this amount.

10590.name: ActReportAs
10590.desc: Whether the ACT Report is for a MarketMaking or OrderEntry execution

10591.name: ActShortSaleInd
10591.desc: Is the ACT report for a short sell?

10592.name: TRptContraBkrCapacity
10592.desc: The capacity of the counterparty for the ACT report

10593.name: TrptTransactTime
10593.desc: The TransactTime of the execution that was ACT reported. This is different than ActReportTime which is the time the report went out. ( in GMT )

10594.name: errorLkClOrdID
10594.desc: The field is used to link two EOs, specifically the client side EO to the Error EO where the Error EO is created when an execution from a regularly traded EO is moved to an error/firm account.  The value is the InitialClOrdID of the client EO.

10595.name: MinGuarantdFillInd
10595.desc: Used to indicate if Minimum Guaranteed Fill should be set on TSX (Toronto stock exchange) Order Request messages.

10596.name: RelLimitName
10596.desc: Relative Limit Index/Sector Name (most likely RIC of the index/sector)

10597.name: RelLimitValue
10597.desc: Relative limit value of the index or percent change from the beggining of the order

10598.name: RelLimitType
10598.desc: whether the Relative Limit Value is Absolute or Percentage

10599.name: RelLimitSecurityIDSource
10599.desc: Indicate what type of security ID is being specified (RIC, P2Issue, Symbol, ISIN, CUSIP, etc).

10600.name: UniversalID
10600.desc: UUId stamped on an initial message that is copied onto every subsequent message in a particular flow.  This allows ETS test to extract test cases consisting of many related messages.

10603.name: MultiLegWithoutNotionalInd
10603.desc: Used to denote a leg of a synthetic product in cases where the notional can not be processed, is not present or can not be derived.

10604.name: VerbalConfTime
10604.desc: The time that a confirmation of trade was verbally confirmed by FID Ops to the client. Sometimes, depending on client, the ClientNotice also needs to be verbally confirmed with another client contact, and this is done by FID CSG. ( in GMT )

10605.name: VerbalConfUser
10605.desc: The name of the FID Ops user who verbally confirmed the trade to the client.  Sometimes, depending on client, the ClientNotice also needs to be verbally confirmed with another client contact, and this is done by FID CSG.

10606.name: VerbalConfStatus
10606.desc: The status of the verbal confirmation of the trade by FID Ops to the client.  Sometimes, depending on client, the ClientNotice also needs to be verbally confirmed with another client contact, and this is done by FID CSG.

10607.name: OMRReportID
10607.desc: This is a reference used by FID for reporting purposes.  The reference will identify the transactions in FID Allocator and BigMac

10608.name: priceValueType
10608.desc: Identifies the type of price it is

10610.name: priceDisplayFormat
10610.desc: States the format that the Price should be displayed in - allows decimal price to be shown as fractional price.

10611.name: YieldPrice
10611.desc: The Price of the bond or security in Yield units e.g. a bond may have a yield of 2.50%

10612.name: inEtsDBOnlyInd
10612.desc: Indicates whether this entity is eligible for enrichment or not in TC. TC will derive and stamp (and overwrite if sent by upstream). Used in Athena to determine whether to write to ST_CONTRACT or not.

10613.name: TRptSeqNo
10613.desc: An integer that represents an ETR's position in a sequence of ETRs.

10614.name: TRptSubType
10614.desc: An integer that represents the type of ETR (ExchangeTradeReport).

10615.name: BidTradeType
10615.desc: This is to represent the type of the trade.

10616.name: SoleBookrunnerInd
10616.desc: Indicates if Morgan Stanley was the sole bookrunner for the deal of which this trade is a part.

10617.name: SyndicateType
10617.desc: SyndicateType declares the type of syndicate trade

10618.name: IPOInd
10618.desc: This will be used to determine if an Allocation can legally be sent to an 098 destination account.

10619.name: IndiaExchID
10619.desc: ID sent to Exchange in execution orders, required by both BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) and NSE (National Stock Exchange).

10620.name: MAPIN
10620.desc: ID sent to Exchange in execution orders, required by both BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) and NSE (National Stock Exchange).

10621.name: UCC
10621.desc: ID sent to Exchange in execution orders, required by both BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) and NSE (National Stock Exchange).

10622.name: NSESettlementID
10622.desc: settlement type, required by NSE only.

10623.name: BSEOrderType
10623.desc: whom the order is for, required by BSE only.

10624.name: TWEAccountNumber
10624.desc: It is by Taiwan regulations that all execution orders must be sent with exchange account attached.  This allows exchange to distinguish between domestic and foreign investors, and applies different rules to foreign investors.

10626.name: RootPortfolioID
10626.desc: This tag shows/sends linkage information between portfolios. It is the same thing as RootClOrdID, except it is used to create linkage between different portfolios.

10629.name: TMDParentType
10629.desc: It identifies the parent message type of a TMD message in the long string format used by TMD, i.e. Order instead of O or 4.

10631.name: LitPOVExcludeSize
10631.desc: Exclude all the prints in Lit venues above this number for POV constrained.

10632.name: IntOMStatusChgInd
10632.desc: Indicate whether a message originated from the exchange or was internally generated by the OM. If OM generates message, this tag will be present and have a int value (1); for all exchange/external messages, this tag will be absent or have a int value (0).

10633.name: Depository
10633.desc:
This indicates through what agent the client desires to settle a particular trade
either through the local Canadian agent (Royal Bank of Canada) or through the US Depository Trust Company

10634.name: BPBoundCcy
10634.desc: Indicates the currency of the balanced portfolio bounds.

10635.name: ClOrdMarginType
10635.desc: This allows the AccountType (which is input in DDI by salesperson) to flow through TC into the downstream systems. It will be interpreted in the Atlas backbriding and a TAPS AccountType derived.

10636.name: KoreaBulkOrderInd
10636.desc: Used to differentiate between Bulk orders and Non Bulk orders.

10637.name: testType
10637.desc: Indicates that this is a test message and provides information on the specific type of test that it has been used for e.g. whitebox

10638.name: nominalValueRaw
10638.desc: It will be used to  hold the Contract Multiplier which is passed down from OMW on the Executions and ETS Allocator for the Allocations.

10639.name: ClInstrFreeText
10639.desc: It will be used to to capture non-conventional client instructions

10640.name: AutoEngOrdInd
10640.desc: Indicates when an Order has been created by or sent from an automated trading engine.

10641.name: verifiedUserID
10641.desc: User that has been impersonated by a support user.

10642.name: TraderVolatility
10642.desc: A number that represents the trader's volatility number for where they want to trade this product. It is a measure of the fluctuation in price of an option's underlying instrument. Expressed as an integery.

10643.name: ActCancelType
10643.desc: Used in all requests to cancel a trade report on ACT. Specifies the type of cancel. Either a regular cancel or a break.

10644.name: ActMMGiveupBkr
10644.desc: Used in a AGU (Automated Give Up) trade report to ACT.Identifies the contra broker when the contra broker is MM and Morgan Stanley is OE.

10645.name: ActOEGiveupBkr
10645.desc: Used in a AGU (Automated Give Up) trade report to ACT.Identifies the contra broker when the contra broker is OE and Morgan Stanley is MM.

10646.name: ActReportType
10646.desc: Used by trading engines to tell TRG how to report the trade.TRG uses this to determine whether or not it should report on the behalf of the contra broker,clear against the contra broker, or not clear at all.

10647.name: ClientFixQty
10647.desc: It reflects the quantity at the PortfolioOrder and PortfolioBlock levels which is in accordance with the FIX spec behavior for the quantity at the EO level.

10648.name: MinGuarantdFill
10648.desc: Is used to specify the minimum guaranteed fill for exchanges that support it.

10649.name: CxlWLeavesMsgType
10649.desc: Indicates what type of messages MBA will send clients upon Cancel after onClose time with MOC/LOC slices out to the street.

10651.name: ClOrdCaptureMethod
10651.desc: This is  used in booking of DMA/STATARB flow via TC

10652.name: PCIWouldPrice
10652.desc: Is Used to support the Price Capture strategy order type.Indicates the price capture (PC) strategy 'I would price'.

10653.name: PCDecisionPrice
10653.desc: Used to support the Price Capture strategy order type. Indicates the price capture (PC) strategy 'decision price'. That is the price I am prepared to trade to after participating in all order book volume (see PCIWouldPrice).

10654.name: TRptTradeTypeInd
10654.desc: This is used in the message from TRG to OR, to indicate the type of trade whichas occurred. It is known as the 'LSE trade type indicator'

10655.name: TRptPartCodeBuy
10655.desc: Required to identify to the LSE the participant code on the buy side of the trade.

10656.name: TRptPartCodeSell
10656.desc: Required to identify to the LSE the participant code on the sell side of the trade.

10657.name: TRCvtdPriceInd
10657.desc: Need this tag to indicate to the exchange whether the price and currency entered on a trade report is the price or currency in which the transaction was dealt.

10658.name: TRptMechanism
10658.desc: This is a mandatory tag on the outgoing message to the exchange, need to know method by which trade was reported

10659.name: TRptClientRefID
10659.desc: This is a mandatory tag on the outgoing message to the exchange, used to uniquely identify the trade report

10660.name: TRptTransCondition
10660.desc: This tag will only be used for Trade Reporting purposes

10662.name: softDollarType
10662.desc: Indicates the reason for an order being not eligible for getting soft credit. Current data(post-2011) uses valid values 4, 5, 6.

10664.name: offShoreInd
10664.desc: Indicator of the offshore client's trade. i.e. it is  some bool value (Y/N)

10665.name: CPLinkID
10665.desc: This will be the unique reference linking a pair of committed principal (CP) orders that form a market making quote.

10666.name: TransEventType
10666.desc: Indicates the trade type, for example, a strategy trade.

10667.name: NegotiatedRefPrice
10667.desc: The reference price as agreed at the time of negotiation with a client.

10668.name: NegotiatedRefTime
10668.desc: This is a reference Time (in GMT)that has been negotiated with the client. Use case examples: GTC transactions, ICE on-exch crosses

10669.name: AssocFirmLocSource
10669.desc: This would be passed in to risk fill engine on client buy orders, to represent the locate source that RFE should populate on the firm side sell order that gets created if the firm side is selling short.

10670.name: EnableBlkCrossInd
10670.desc: It Indicates that client would like to participate in block crossing.  AKA - I would if I could.

10671.name: PCPriceType
10671.desc: Specifies the units of the existing fields PCDecisionPrice,PCIWouldPrice.  The possible values are 'bps','abs', which correspond to price relative to arrival price in basis points, and absolute price respectively.

10672.name: DMAClientType
10672.desc: Distinguishes fact on the fix msg which could be used to derive the category of a DMA client. TC uses this as a Halo driver to determine the appropriate sales credit code for a client.

10673.name: ReparentLinkID
10673.desc: Used to facilitate automatic reparenting of Sales Side Execution Orders to Exchange Side Execution Orders.

10677.name: BrokerQuote1
10677.desc: Captures other broker quotes for PK and OB symbols. As per NASDAQ rules, it is required to capture other broker's Level2 Quotes when PK and OB stocks are traded.

10678.name: BrokerQuote2
10678.desc: Captures other broker quotes for PK and OB symbols. As  per NASDAQ rules, it is required to capture other broker's Level2 Quotes when PK and OB stocks are traded.

10679.name: BrokerQuote3
10679.desc: Captures other broker quotes for PK and OB symbols. As  per NASDAQ rules, it is required to capture other broker's Level2 Quotes when PK and OB stocks are traded.

10680.name: mktMakerOrdInd
10680.desc: This field will unambiguously indicate whether an execution order is due to market making activity or not

10681.name: relatedPrice
10681.desc: The Related Price element on the Execution TMD will contain the alternative price, i.e. if the Price element holds the Yield price then the Related Price element will hold the Decimal price.

10682.name: relatedPxValueType
10682.desc: States the units that the Price is in i.e. is it the Price per share, the percentage of Par etc.

10683.name: SettlPrinAmtPreAdj
10683.desc: This is the principal amount before the inflation adjustment  is made.

10684.name: FxLocation
10684.desc: This describes the booking location for the underlying FX on an out of currency trade

10687.name: CtrlGrpAuthUser
10687.desc: This is to capture the name of the Control Group Approver who approved the riskfill of a restricted name(override).

10688.name: toBeSupersededInd
10688.desc: Indicates this entity is expected to be superseded. Example:OMW creates a temporary EO for immediate trading, but this EO is later superseded by the true customer EO. Child EOs of the initial EO have extra restrictions upon them until the true EO arrives.

10691.name: indicativePendingRegRptInd
10691.desc: This Fill is indicative until it has been trade reported and/or the 'real' Fill is given by the Exchange. The true execution time will be updated and available through TRG and/or when the Exchange has sent.

10692.name: AllocExecLkApp
10692.desc: For executed price allocations - link to the application of the execution fill. (denormalisation)

10693.name: AllocExecLkAppLoc
10693.desc: For executed price allocations - link to the application location of the execution fill.(denormalisation)

10694.name: AllocExecLkInEnTime
10694.desc: For executed price allocations - link to the Initial Entry Time of the execution fill. (denormalisation)

10695.name: AllocExecLkPrmRefID
10695.desc: For executed price allocations - link to the PrimaryRefID of the execution fill. (denormalisation)

10696.name: adrType
10696.desc: The P2 field adrType from P2ADR entity. This is present on products with issueType=ADR and indicates the type of ADR (eg adrType=GDR).

10697.name: PxReactRiskFactor
10697.desc: Indicates urgency level as prices approaches or going away from the Price React trigger Price (10652).

10698.name: fundOperationCode
10698.desc: From A2, Type of Trust Bank Fund as specified by the first system (20-Tokkin, 21-Tokkingai etc.).  Also for use in MOF Tokkin

10699.name: BlkCrossLimitPrice
10699.desc: The price which the order to be crossed should not breach

10700.name: OrderAggUUId
10700.desc: UUId to aggregate/group together a group of client pre-allocated orders into one order for trading

10701.name: bookingSelectComCo
10701.desc: MS company code that identifies the Firms legal entity for purposes of order allocation booking

10702.name: attachFixMsg
10702.desc: A string containing a fix message with the SOH delimiter character replaced.

10703.name: HoldDuringUncrossingInd
10703.desc: To indicate that orders should be held during uncrossing period (where they would otherwise be rejected).

10704.name: ClientGroupID
10704.desc: This is the ID that a client will use to group orders together or group allocations together.

10705.name: AllowedCrossType
10705.desc: Indicates the type of cross permissable.

10706.name: riskFillProgramStrategy
10706.desc: Provides the program strategy for the Firmside execution on the client order for DPTR.

10707.name: poolOrdActionType
10707.desc: Indicates if  an order is being received by the pool i.e client execution order being added (IN) or being sent(OUT) from the pool to the street.

10708.name: PredictdEffectivTm
10708.desc: The Predicted (or calculated) effective time for an entity

10709.name: waveUUId
10709.desc: The unique identifier (UUID) applicable to a collection of type "wave"

10710.name: PreAllocInfoGroup
10710.desc: To capture the pre trade allocation info on client order and stamp it on the Portfolio order.  So that it can be be passed through for allocation.

10711.name: riskfillReasonCode
10711.desc: A code that provides details on the underlying reason as to why a riskfill order was requested.

10712.name: MatchingTime
10712.desc: The time (GMT) that sales and trading independently entered trades match.  Important in the FID business process.

10713.name: RiskfillReasonText
10713.desc: Supplemental free text description to RiskfillReasonCode (10711).

10714.name: ClearingFundID
10714.desc: Clearing Fund ID number used to communicate with external parties.

10715.name: AgencyCumPct
10715.desc: Percentage (out of 100) of the filled quantity of this order that come from Agency Fills (LastCapacity = 1 or 2).

10716.name: PrincipalCumPct
10716.desc: Percentage (out of 100) of the filled quantity of this order that come from Principal Fills (LastCapacity = 3 or 4).

10717.name: AgencyAvgPx
10717.desc: Average Price of the underlying fills of this order that are Agency Fills (LastCapacity = 1 or 2).

10718.name: PrincipalAvgPx
10718.desc: Average Price of the underlying fills of this order that are Principal Fills (LastCapacity = 3 or 4).

10719.name: OMRReportIDLeg1
10719.desc: OMRReport Id for related omnibus leg trade

10720.name: OMRReportIDLeg2
10720.desc: OMRReport ID for the related omnibus leg trade

10721.name: OrdOriginationType
10721.desc: Provides further information to help classify trades based on the trade origin.  This is required for compliance.

10723.name: UnderlyingTargetLocationId
10723.desc: The underlying targetLocationId of an order based on the underlying product e.g. used to determine trading location of underlying on ADR

10724.name: OrderSubCapacity
10724.desc: Further defines how MS acts on an order for a given client. E.g NY trading MSIL, the orderCapacity is Agent and the subCapacity is RelatedEntity.

10725.name: HandlingCapacity
10725.desc: to indicate for what purpose, the trading entity is trading the order. E.g. MSIL could execute the trade for its client or trade it for their own prop account.

10726.name: DayTradeDate
10726.desc: The current date in a given order message

10727.name: FromBrokerDlrInd
10727.desc: Indicator to specify that the flow is from a broker dealer.

10728.name: ValueDateOverrideInd
10728.desc: Used to identify that a value date has been overridden from the standard calculated value date.

10729.name: AuthForRestrictedInd
10729.desc: Indication that authorisation has been provided to trade a restricted product

10730.name: OmnibusLegType
10730.desc: The type of each omnibus intercompany leg. Set by TC, indicates the onshore/offshore legs for booking and reporting purposes. Primarily used in Tokyo where it is critical to report onshore legs correctly. (Deprecated - Use LegNum(11797) instead.)

10731.name: ReportingTime
10731.desc: Note that this is also known as ModifierRefTime. To be used for trade reporting the time of execution where the transactTime is not suitable (e.g. ACT reporting of prior ref price trades.  The time will be set in GMT.

10732.name: ClientHoldQuantity
10732.desc: The quantity of a client's order that they have asked to be put "on hold". This will be a portion of the total order quantity.

10733.name: TargetPortfolioName
10733.desc: Every sales order is grouped into a trading portfolio. This is the name of the trading portfolio (on the sales order) that they intend to trade in.

10734.name: ValueDateOverrideType
10734.desc: To distinguish whether a value date override was performed in TradingSystem (Sales-side) versus the Allocating System (Client-side). This is needed for processing only (how valueDate will be populated on the legs in TC CN explosion).

10735.name: GrandParentOID
10735.desc: EntityOID of the grandparent entity (e.g. the grand parent of a CN would be the portfolio)

10736.name: GreatGrandParentOID
10736.desc: EntityOID of the great grand parent (e.g the great grand parent of an allocation would be the portfolio).

10737.name: StrategyRefUUId
10737.desc: Holds the unique reference ID of the strategy used to create this order. The strategy reference is created in an engine when a trader does a 'what if' service call to the engine. If they like the results of the 'what if' then they want to use the exact sa

10738.name: PrintForPrintInd
10738.desc: Print For Print Indicator shows if there is a one to one relationship between street side executions and their client allocations or executions. It is used for OATS reports to show that a 'route' has taken place rather than internal allocation of street f

10739.name: StrategyPxTypeCode
10739.desc: The pricing method as specified by a risk fill engine such as GT, RFE.   TRG uses the field to infer the correct ACTModifierType.

10741.name: ExpiredOrderInd
10741.desc: Indicator to show that the expireTime has elapsed and therefore this order should be considered expired. This tag is derived from comparing the Current Time and the Order's ExpireTime? by a recovery process and is good for one point in time only.

10742.name: NonCommitedCrossedQty
10742.desc: Quantity allocated for crossing, but not yet committed.

10743.name: OrderAggType
10743.desc: Indicator to define whether an order is a client pre-allocated order or an aggregated order.  To help determine the direction on orders that are being aggregated and those that have been aggregated.

10744.name: ReceivedProcessID
10744.desc: Process ID of the receiving process (the sending process will have tag 10556, ProcessOwnerID set).

10745.name: ClShortSellLocateInst
10745.desc: Instructions for short sell locate actions from client. If more than one instruction is applicable to an order, this field can contain multiple instructions separated by space.

10746.name: HoldReason
10746.desc: Reason why an order is on hold. Requested by Market Making desk. Another use case would be soft hold sent from Razer to display in CFM in order to allow clients to update alert status.

10747.name: PUEVInd
10747.desc: Indicator to depict whether a client wants to settle PUEV or not.  Note that an order may be partially PUEV.

10748.name: FuturePrefix
10748.desc: A P2 attribute of a futures product. Used by the OM in the limit checking process to pass to ESE for Aggregation.

10749.name: LegFuturePrefix
10749.desc: A P2 attribute (dfFuture)  of a leg product of a Futures Calendar Spread strategy

10750.name: LimitCheckingCategory
10750.desc: Defines category used in limits checking for client flow.These categories can group together IssueTypes/split them up acording to u/l issue types.E.g. ADRs, GDRs & Stocks all get totalled up together vs a Client's limit, whereas the client may have difffe

10751.name: TWAPNumSlicesReq
10751.desc: The number of slices in a scheduled TWAP order

10752.name: TargetLocOverride
10752.desc: Where the liquidity is greater on an exchange other than that listed, sales need the ability to override the target location.

10753.name: ClipSize
10753.desc: Size of clip to be sent for trading

10754.name: InitiatingSideInd
10754.desc: Used in pairs trading, to control which Leg of the pair will trade first.

10755.name: SpreadToWatch
10755.desc: The prices to be incorporated in the pricing formula for the pair in order to compute a price for the pair that is compared to the Limit price

10756.name: CoverLimitOffset
10756.desc: Offset for spread limit on a buy/sell to cover

10757.name: CxlReplaceIncr
10757.desc: The minimum movement in price that an engine should correct for.  If attempting to work an order & the market moves against you, only adjust the price once the market has moved this much.

10758.name: ShortTickAllowance
10758.desc: Additional flexibility in the limit price of a short sell order in order to achieve a trade on an uptick

10759.name: ClipTimeInterval
10759.desc: The number of seconds to elapse before another Clip Size can be launched, up to a limit of open clips defined by Max # Open Order

10760.name: MaxNumOpenClips
10760.desc: The maximum number of clips that can be open at any time.

10761.name: CoverOrdType
10761.desc: If covering with a buy/sell order, that order should be of a type specified here.

10762.name: LegMinTradeVol
10762.desc: Minimum trade volume for a leg of a spread strategy

10763.name: CoverPriceType
10763.desc: The units relating to the LimitOffset

10764.name: ScaleClipTrigger
10764.desc: If the price of the pair being watched is inside the specified limit price by this amount or more, then the Clip Size is to be modified by a factor specified in Scale Clip Multiplier

10765.name: ScaleClipMultiplier
10765.desc: The factor to apply to the Clip Size value if  the condition specified by Scale Clip Trigger is satisfied.

10766.name: LiquidtyConstraint
10766.desc: The factor to apply to the quantity available on the exchange order book for the cover leg of the order when calculating the quantity of the initiate leg of the order.

10767.name: ClMsDestinationID
10767.desc: Field to hold the original value of MsDestinationID as this value can be changed during the life of an order and some client GUI's require the same value be returned as was originally sent.

10768.name: LegWarningInterval
10768.desc: The length of time (in minutes) before warning of an unfilled cover order.  No value implies no warning!

10769.name: InitCxlAllowance
10769.desc: Flexibility in the limit price that allows initiation before the spread to watch is in limit & allows an order to continue to work once the spread to watch moves out of limit.

10770.name: BrokerAcceptTime
10770.desc: Timestamp to record the time when the Prime Broker has accepted the Give-Up order

10771.name: MaxFXExposure
10771.desc: The threshold at which an FX exposure will be hedged.  Expressed in units of the base currency.  Zero implies that no automatic FX hedge will be performed.

10772.name: clientFlowType
10772.desc: Describes the type of client flow in more detail than SalesBusLine and Sales Capture Method allow.  DMAClientType is a similar type of differentiation specifically for DMA clients.

10773.name: TWAPNumSlicesCalc
10773.desc: This is the number of TWAP slices that the MBA is going to use to generate the TradeSchedule with.It is related to TWAPNumSlices (10571) in that 10571 represents what the User will prefer but this new tag will be what MBA actually uses.

10774.name: ErrorDetailCode
10774.desc: Code to indicate why a message is "broken"

10775.name: TRptDelayPubInd
10775.desc: Used as an indicator to define whether the trade report is eligible for a delayed publication to the exchange.

10776.name: TRptReportType
10776.desc: Used to specify the period in which the trade report occurred; continuous or out of hours.

10777.name: RootFillOrdSubType
10777.desc: The ExecOrderSubType of the Parent ExecOrder (or Order) of the RootFill (ultimate parent) of this Fill

10778.name: WasUpMovementInd
10778.desc: Indicates the up direction of the tick/bid at the time of execution.

10781.name: ValueDateRequestInd
10781.desc: Indicator to identify that the client has requested that the value date be set

10782.name: ThreeQuoteInd
10782.desc: If this indicator is checked, then there should be at least 3 published quotes. Otherwise, the trader has to contact brokers for quotes.

10784.name: LegOddLot
10784.desc: Whether to trade the leg as an odd lot or round lot (used in Pairs trading)

10785.name: TransTmOutsideHalt
10785.desc: To indicate to TRG that the transactTime on a cross was exeucted oustide of a trade halt.

10786.name: MaxFloorSimulateInd
10786.desc: Tag to indicate whether an iceberg order should be simulated or not

10787.name: ClNonStdSettleType
10787.desc: For Non-Standard Settlement, whether the clients desired settlement is shortened or extended

10788.name: OrdRejectResendType
10788.desc: For a rejected order, indicates the type of reject to enable it to be resent.

10789.name: ErrorDetailMessage
10789.desc: Text message providing details of why a message is broken (used in combination with 10774 - errorDetailCode).

10790.name: ErrorDetailSource
10790.desc: Source application or component of the error

10791.name: clientPublicationType
10791.desc: Type of summary confirmation mechanism required by the client.

10792.name: clientPublicationStatus
10792.desc: this will determine whether the trade has been published to downstream systems or not.

10793.name: ClientProfileName
10793.desc: Used by sales as a shorthand for a set of client driven attributes that are used by downstream systems & ops

10794.name: OMRegion
10794.desc: Region where the OMR is situation (e.g. East)

10795.name: MSTransactTime
10795.desc: This field will be populated by the OR which will record the date and time to the millisecond.  This is to compensate for the exchanges that only set the  transaction time with an accuracy of seconds or even minutes.

10796.name: StrategyTypeShort
10796.desc: Products of issueType=STRAT have a subtype called 'sdecode', which distinguishes between switches, future calendar spreads etc.

10797.name: ExtClientFundID
10797.desc: FundID that the client knows - i.e. it is external and not recognised by MS.  FIX DMA systems copy information into this tag from incoming tag 1 and tag 58 depending on the client.

10798.name: ExtClFundIDType
10798.desc: Used in conjuction with tag 10797 - depicts the type of ID

10799.name: BlkCrossOnlyInd
10799.desc: Indicates whether the entire order should be sent for BlkCrossing (and internal crossing) only, ie. no participation on the normal exchanges. This will be used in conjunction with tag EnableBlkCrossInd (10670).

10801.name: ManningParentFillUUId
10801.desc: When a street fill of a principal order triggers the Manning rule, the shares will be allocated first to eligble client orders.  This tag is used to link the client fill with the street fill by persisting it with the FillUUId of the street fill.

10802.name: NotionalPortfOrderID
10802.desc: Before OM assigns a MultiLegID to both a notional leg and the underlying legs, the CDFR process needs to know which underlying legs are linked to which notional orders. The PortfOrderID of the Notional is sent back from OM to CDFR in NotionalPortfOrderID

10803.name: NotionalClOrdID
10803.desc: Before OM assigns a MultiLegID to both a notional leg and the underlying legs, the CDFR process needs to know which underlying legs are linked to which notional orders. The ClOrdID of the Notional is sent back from OM to CDFR in NotionalClOrdID on underly

10804.name: NoErrorDetails
10804.desc: Number of repeating elements in the ErrorDetails repeating group

10805.name: ErrorDetailID
10805.desc: Holds the unique ID to identifiy each Error instance in an ErrorDetail repeating group

10806.name: ErrorDetailDrivers
10806.desc: The fixtag numbers that are the cause of the error (and which may/may not be overriden by a user in the GUI

10807.name: ErrorDetailUpBound
10807.desc: Holds upper boundary value for soft and hard errors

10808.name: ErrorDetailLoBound
10808.desc: Holds lower boundary value for soft and hard errors

10809.name: PreClosePercentage
10809.desc: Trading instruction to indicate the percentage, expressed as a decimal number between 0 and 1, of the order to be traded outside of the closing auction.  It is most relevant for Close benchmark orders for GT.

10810.name: DomesticInvestorID
10810.desc: Indicates a client as domestic investor instead of a foreign investor, which is useful for setting up tradeview group to restrict view access for non-Korea ops user.

10811.name: TRptBkrAgrOverride
10811.desc: Indicates an override to the defualt trade reporting agreements brokers have with the firm.  For example order to MBA require by default "All" four agreements (9A,9B,QSR,and AGU), but orders to MMETL may want to override this to be "No agreements" when th

10812.name: LimitCancelInd
10812.desc: Clients will use this trading instruction tag to indicate to MBA that they want their limit order cancelled when the limit price becomes non-marketable.  If tag is not set, the default is N.

10814.name: SpreadB2BSwap
10814.desc: Spread is the number of basis points above or below the standard financing rate applied to a  swap. The number of basis points to be applied to the financing of any linked internal swaps trades.

10815.name: DivEntitlementLead
10815.desc: Percent of dividends to be accrued on a swap trade.

10816.name: DivEntitlementB2B
10816.desc: Percent of any dividends to be accrued on any linked internal swaps trade.

10817.name: SimulatedOrdType
10817.desc: A repeating tag indicating the type of simulation that has occurred on this order, valid values include those of OrdType (tag 40) plus some extras.

10818.name: LegDestAccount
10818.desc: Tag to identify the trading account of a leg. Individual legs in a multileg product can have individual accounts associated with them (based on issueType). e.g. optionAccount, futureAccount.

10819.name: QuantityPrecision
10819.desc: Quantity rounding precision needed for fractional quantities.

10820.name: SSValidationLevel
10820.desc: This is the level that short sell validation is being applied for. For usage in the short sell locate management system (SSLM)

10822.name: GrandParentClOrdID
10822.desc: Holds the previous hop's parent ClOrdID for use in rootClOrdID by downstream engines when OM doesn't send the sliced hop to ETSDB in the amend simulate scenario.

10823.name: P2ExchStrategyCode
10823.desc: The P2 ExchangeStrategyCode associated with this MarketID in P2.

10824.name: PCConstVolumeInd
10824.desc: Works in conjunction with PCPriceType, PCIWouldPrice, PCDecisionPrice tags in the PriceCapture strategy. Indicates user doesn't want to change the impact level of the order until it hits the PCIWouldPrice (normally impact level gradually bumped up).

10825.name: AggOrderStatus
10825.desc: Holds the order status of the aggregated execution order on execution reports for the original execution orders.  Need to know when the aggregated execution order is complete so that fills can be released to the client.

10826.name: exContractCode
10826.desc: Represents the p2 filed clearing code.  Used as a driver for rounding in TC/Vista.

10827.name: CrossCategory
10827.desc: Derived from a number of business attributes, ie. orderCapacity, orderSubCapacity, etc. and is used by crossing engines to determine the ordering and priority of orders when considered for crossing.

10828.name: ArrivalPxTopUpInd
10828.desc: Optional tag used with ArrivalPrice.  When set,  MBA will adjust the tradable OrderQty based on the volume in the market.  When there is more volume, the OrderQty will be adjusted upwards, and when there is less volume it will be adjusted downwards.

10829.name: PrimaryCoverageUserID
10829.desc: UserID of the salesperson who usually covers this client.  The "Client's Primary Sales Coverage User's unix UserID" (PrimaryCoverageUserID for short).

10830.name: UnroundedPrice
10830.desc: The true price of the allocation before any client specific rounding rules or exchange specific clearing price rounding rules have been applied.

10831.name: TradingBenchmark
10831.desc: Used by risk traders to specifiy a different benchmark than the client's benchmark (in 7505) for the GT engine to use to trade out of a position.

10832.name: TradingEffectiveTime
10832.desc: Used by risk traders to specifiy a different EffectiveTime than the client's EffectiveTime (in 168) for the GT engine to use to trade out of a position.

10833.name: TradingExpireTime
10833.desc: Used by risk traders to specifiy a different ExpireTime than the client's ExpireTime (in 126) for the GT engine to use to trade out of a position.

10834.name: TRptCounterPtyTypeCode
10834.desc: Four character SWX identifier for counterparty type (e.g. exchange counterparty, securities trader).

10835.name: TRptOrderAggInd
10835.desc: Indication of whether the order or other transaction input to which this is attached represents an amalgamation or aggregation of orders from several of the member's discretionary clients.

10836.name: SubContraBroker
10836.desc: Represents the broker on the opposite side of the trade when the primary contrabroker is a central counterparty. Only required for those markets in which we need such details.

10837.name: FC3SequenceID
10837.desc: Used by FID to identify FC3 eligible allocations.

10838.name: ElectronicRef
10838.desc: Used by FID to identify whether an allocation is processed electronically or not.

10840.name: SimulatedOrdPrice
10840.desc: Price of the underlying order that is used to simulate another order type (e.g. limit price if simulating market order). Used when exchanges can not handle certain order types, ie. market orders are sent out as limit orders. Related to tag 10817.

10841.name: TRptExchSubDestID
10841.desc: Trade Report's Exchange Sub-Destination ID is the tradereporting reporting system within one exchaneg, eg the Euronext trading platform has 3 plaforms (2 of which TRG can send trade reports to).

10842.name: TRptExchSide
10842.desc: Side of the trade (values are exchange/platform specific).

10843.name: TRptExchCapacity
10843.desc: Exchange specific field describing the capacity on the original order. (On Euronext, numeric values are for TCS platform; characters for NSC platform.) There is no overlap in values for the two Euronext platforms.

10844.name: HedgeLkTNLID
10844.desc: Holds the client's TNLID on the swap order. This information is needed by the minerva engine to pass to MBA, so that MBA can trade the order correctly.

10845.name: ManningParentFillExecID
10845.desc: When a street fill of a principal order triggers the Manning rule, the shares will be allocated first to eligble client orders.  This tag is used to link the client fill with the street fill by persisting it with the execID of the street fill.

10846.name: salesCaptureReason
10846.desc: Underlying reason why client has submitted an order to Morgan Stanley.

10848.name: OrigMSInstruction
10848.desc: Original value of the MSInstruction before an amend request.

10849.name: AuthForSoftLimitOverrideDetail
10849.desc: Confirmation that the soft limit was overridden.  A trader/sales person will re-type the override price, quantity, or a notional value

10850.name: MostRecentOrderSlicePrice
10850.desc: Holds the (limit) price of the most recent order slice.

10851.name: EarlyReleaseInd
10851.desc: Indicator showing whether a trader requested that an advert be sent out early (i.e. before it hits the default value threshold)

10852.name: ImmediateAdvertiseInd
10852.desc: Whenever the advert receives fills, it will check for certain tags on the fills and based on the values on these tags, it will decide whether to immediately advertise. The relevant tags are 48, 6, 53.

10853.name: DVDGatherKey
10853.desc: Unique identifier for grouping related allocations across client notices for daily volume discount commissions calculation.  Its value is a unique string composed of trade facts.

10855.name: AvgPxPostRnd
10855.desc: Field contains rounded average price of all executions received.  Salesperson needs this price to report to the client when a trade is executed for multiple days and client needs to know the average price of the order over the execution period.

10856.name: BlkDayAvgPxPostRnd
10856.desc: Field contains rounded average price of the executions received on that day. Salesperson needs this price to report it back to the client (used at Block level).

10857.name: BlkSettlDayAvgPxPostRnd
10857.desc: Field contains rounded average price in settlement currency of the executions received on that day. Salesperson needs rounded price in settlement currency to report it back to the client. (When settlement currency is different then traded currency).

10858.name: MinQtyCap
10858.desc: Optional tag that caps the MinQty for crossing to a client specified value.  Used in conjunction with MinQty (tag 110) and MinCrossPercentage (tag 7355).  Tag 110 will be the lower bound and Tag 10858 will be the upper bound with tag 7355 in the middle.

10859.name: PriceStabilizationTradeInd
10859.desc: Indicator to show this order has been placed to produce trades that stabilize the price of a new issue.

10860.name: SystexSubAccount
10860.desc: Taiwanese vendor system specific field used to hold client sub-account information. This is used in the file generated by SOPA sent to client that contains the executed trade details.

10861.name: TRptClearingInd
10861.desc: Set by upstream systems to tell trade reporting systems whether to attempt to clear this trade. If 10861=Y, TRG will use ClearingInstruction (577 external) or ActClearingType (10228 internal) to show clearing type it has determined to do downstream of TRG

10862.name: TRptParentOID
10862.desc: The Trade Report's Parent Executions' EntityOID. This is a repeating field as the Trade Reports may have many parent Executions.

10863.name: DestOwnerID
10863.desc: Identifies the person at the destination who accepts responsibility of ownership for the order.

10864.name: FeeRelatedInformation
10864.desc: Free text provided by the exchange and containing the Fee Schema

10865.name: AllowPartialCancelRestateInd
10865.desc: Indicator set by CDFR to instruct OM whether to allow/generate partial cancel restate reports. Tag will also be used by OM to decide whether to apply the reduction in quantity so that reports after the partial cancel restate will have the reduced quantity

10866.name: BMECounterparty
10866.desc: Code of the counterparty in BME

10867.name: SideBySideInd
10867.desc: Used to indicate if sales trader is able to get permission from the client to trade alongside their order. If not set, then permission was not requested by the sales trader.

10868.name: AuctionInst
10868.desc: Indicates on an order, the specific auction to be used so that when the session starts, the order may be released to that auction.

10869.name: SoapListeningAddress
10869.desc: The soap listening host and port of a process expecting a reply via SOAP (eg Razer when talking to CFM)

10870.name: MassAction
10870.desc: Indicates the type action being described by a MassAction message.  The MassAction API in used by Razer, CFM, FlowTOM, and OMWPGroupManager.

10871.name: BarUniqueClOrdID
10871.desc: A combination of several tags used to create a more unique ClOrdID in BAR. For day orders this SenderCompID(49)+ClOrdID(11)+TradeDate(75) or for GTC order this is SenderCompID(49)+ClOrdID(11). This tag is only used by BAR, CDFR and Razer.

10872.name: BarUniqueOrigClOrdID
10872.desc: A combination of several tags used to create a more unique OrigClOrdID in BAR. For day orders this SenderCompID (49)+OrigClOrdID(41)+TradeDate(75) or for GTC order this is SenderCompID(49)+OrigClOrdID(41). This tag is only used by BAR, CDFR and Razer.

10873.name: SSTickCheckInd
10873.desc: Directive for Trading Order Manager (TOM) process to do a short sale tick check or not.

10875.name: SalesCreditRate
10875.desc: Identifies the rate that is used to calculate the sales credit amount

10876.name: IntDeskContactDtl
10876.desc: Provides contact information for an order that is routed to the market making system that is automatically routed on without trader intervention. This is to enable the market making system to identify a human contact for addressing any related issues.

10877.name: DOTSpecialistFeeInd
10877.desc: Indicates whether the DOT specialist fee is applicable to a trade.

10879.name: ResidualBalanceAmt
10879.desc: Stores the residual balance amount.  Used for clearing only clients trading US Futures products that trade in fractional prices.

10880.name: BarClientSessionID
10880.desc: This field is needed so that cdfr can decide which portfolio the order belongs in.  BAR has a notion of a clean up time, agreed on with the clients, and the sessionID will indicate which orders are in a common period.

10882.name: ApplicableRegRule
10882.desc: Indicates that Stock Restriction Rules need to be identified on the order e.g. Rule 144, 145, S3, etc.

10883.name: ExchangeMember
10883.desc: MS Identifier used to access an external destination.

10887.name: IndexDivScalePrice
10887.desc: The dividend scale price for an index product

10888.name: IndexTradePrice
10888.desc: Trade price for a given index product

10889.name: IndexShares
10889.desc: Number of shares in an index product (note: Shares on P2 table IndexComp).

10890.name: IndexMdSymbol
10890.desc: Md Symbol relating to an index product.

10891.name: IndexDivisor
10891.desc: Divisor associated with an index product (note: Divisor on P2 table Index).

10892.name: IndexScalePrice
10892.desc: Scale price associated with an index product

10893.name: IndexCurrency
10893.desc: Currency for a given index product (Note: relates to P2 IndexComp field Currency).

10894.name: OMSAccountMnemonic
10894.desc: Needed for 'Swap Customer' field in OMS. This is to store the account name of a hedged trade.

10896.name: TempClOrdID
10896.desc: TEMPORARY TAG for Passport to populate ClOrdID (tag 11) value.

10897.name: TempOrigClOrdID
10897.desc: TEMPORARY TAG for Passport to populate OrigClOrdID (tag 41) value.

10898.name: CreditApprovalUser
10898.desc: Kerberos id of credit approver. Required when trades have collateral requirements and credit exposure.

10899.name: BlkCrossWindowValue
10899.desc: Indicates the value associated with BlkCrossWindowType. This will limit the quantity sent to BlkCrossing.

10900.name: MSMsgVersion
10900.desc: Describes the set of minimum fields that will be present in this message

10901.name: FillUUId
