10901.desc: Unique ID for a fill against an order. Stays the same across clones of the Fill message by different systems. 23char Universaly Unique Identifier generated by MSUUID library running in legacy mode.

10902.name: FillRId
10902.desc: Revision number of a Fill. Retained on all clones of the Fill as ExecReports are sent back through ETS environments.

10903.name: FillVId
10903.desc: Version number of a Fill. Retained on all clones of the Fill as ExecReports are sent back through ETS environments.

10904.name: FillOwnerOrderUUId
10904.desc: OrderUUId of Owner of the Fill (the first Order that get the Fill). Retained on all clones of the Fill

10905.name: OrderOwnerProcessId
10905.desc: ProcessId of the process owning the Order state

10906.name: MsgProcessId
10906.desc: ProcessId of the process sending the message

10907.name: EventUUId
10907.desc: Unique identifier for a particular business event or action. The same event could cause new versions of multiple entities.

10908.name: ParentOrderRId
10908.desc: Identifies the parent of this Order's OrderRId.

10909.name: ParentOrderVId
10909.desc: Identifies the parent of this Order's OrderVId.

10910.name: ParentOrderUUId
10910.desc: Identifies the parent of this Order's OrderUUId.

10911.name: TradeMsgUUId
10911.desc: Unique identifier in trades processing for the message. Internal Unique Identifier (UUID).

10912.name: TradeMsgRId
10912.desc: Revision number in trades processing for the message.

10913.name: TradeMsgVId
10913.desc: Version number in trades processing for the message.

10914.name: OrderUUId
10914.desc: Unique identifier in trades processing for the message. Internal Unique Identifier (UUID).

10915.name: OrderRId
10915.desc: Revision number in trades processing for the message.

10916.name: OrderVId
10916.desc: Version number in trades processing for the message.

10917.name: BlkCrossWindowType
10917.desc: Indicates the way in which we limit the quantity that will go into BlkCrossing.

10918.name: AllowRoundToLotSize
10918.desc: Determines if the quantity of the client order can be amended to round it down to the nearest full lot size.

10919.name: TransLegModel
10919.desc: Indicates which model was used by Trades Completion processing to break up the parent message into multiple underlying omnibus legs.

10920.name: OmniLegPrefixID
10920.desc: Indicates what the common entityPrimaryRefID prefix is for the legs that were generated. Each separate leg gets a unique 'post-fix'.  Applied in Trades Completion processing.

10921.name: AllocAlgorithm
10921.desc: The algorithm employed in the allocation process.

10922.name: TRptExchOffExchInd
10922.desc: Off-Exchange contract indicator for Trade Reporting

10923.name: MultiDayAutoGenType
10923.desc: Indication for OM on how to treat an autogen request for a multi-day order on the next day (i.e. second day onwards).

10924.name: MultiDayFutMSDestID
10924.desc: Provides the destination that the OM should route the order to on the 'next day' for a multi-day order.  If this tag is not present on day 2 (onwards), OMS will use the value of tag 7201 as the destination.

10925.name: OrdDayAvgPxPostRnd
10925.desc: Field contains rounded average price of the executions received on that day. Salesperson needs this price to report it back to the client (at Order level)

10926.name: OrdSettlDayAvgPxPostRnd
10926.desc: Field contains rounded average price in settlement ccy of the executions received on that day. Rounded price in settlement ccy is required to report it back to the client.(When settlement ccy is different then traded ccy)-(at Order level).

10927.name: IOIIndicativeSize
10927.desc: If the type of IOI is "Indication", then the IOIIndicativeSize tag will be populated with S, M, or L, and the IOIShares tag will not be present. If the type of IOI is "Detailed", then the IOIShares will have a numeric value, and the IOIIndicativeSize.

10928.name: IOIType
10928.desc: Identifies the type of an IOI. This field will be used to identify whether an IOI is an Indication vs Detailed.

10929.name: IOIVID
10929.desc: Major version of the IOI to be cross referenced.

10930.name: IOIUUId
10930.desc: Unique identifier for an Indication of Interest (IOI).

10932.name: IOILogicalId
10932.desc: Unique identifier for a logical IOI.  (Note that one logical IOI may result in several physical IOI's being sent out).

10933.name: ExtMSSendingTime
10933.desc: The time that a 35=D (single order) message was sent externally.  This is set by the OR.

10934.name: IOIPhyMsgCount
10934.desc: The number of physical IOI's generated from one logical IOI.

10935.name: OrigClOrdSide
10935.desc: The side as per the original client instructions.

10936.name: TRptTransSize
10936.desc: JASDAQ specific indicator of the relative size of a transaction.

10937.name: PendingPriceDtmInd
10937.desc: The price on this fill is pending determination e.g. Trader stopping customer at a particular price

10938.name: MSQuoteRecTime
10938.desc: The date/time that a given market center quote was received by MS

10939.name: QuoteConditionType
10939.desc: Describes the condition type of a market data snapshot quote.

10940.name: MDSnapshotUUId
10940.desc: Unique identifier for a market data snapshot.

10941.name: SelfExclusionLkOID
10941.desc: The reference id of an order that was sent to market and received no response (used on market data snapshot).

10942.name: PreAllocAccount
10942.desc: The client account number relating to a pre-allocated order.

10943.name: SyndicateDealType
10943.desc: Identifies the type of syndciate deal taking place.

10944.name: SyndicateID
10944.desc: Unqiue ID for linking Syndicate entities together. Remains constant on a per syndicate deal basis

10945.name: SyndCoMgrInd
10945.desc: Indicates if a message comes directly from/to a co-manager or not. Syndicates business-line specific.

10946.name: SGXAccountID
10946.desc: This field communicates the client's account on the Singapore Stock Exchange being used by the executing broker. The field can also be used to communication the client's trading account as required by the exchange.

10947.name: SyndUnderwritePct
10947.desc: Underwriting percentage expressed as a decimal. The total amount of a syndciate deal that MS underwrites.

10948.name: CommApplicableInd
10948.desc: Identifies whether or not a trade attract commissions or not. Used in cases where TC cannot derive the commission automatically.

10949.name: ExchTraderID
10949.desc: The trader identification as provided, known and registered by the exchange itself.  This may be a number or a name.

10950.name: SyndicateDealName
10950.desc: Name given to a syndicate deal. This stays constant and is visible to other members of the syndciate throughout the life of a deal.

10951.name: TRptShortSellType
10951.desc: Indicates the type of short sell transaction for trade reporting purposes.

10952.name: SelfExclusionLkApp
10952.desc: The application of an order that was sent to market and for which we received no response (RegNMS)

10953.name: SelfExclusionLkAppLoc
10953.desc: The application location of an order that was sent to market and for which we received no response (RegNMS)

10954.name: SelfExclusionLkInEnTime
10954.desc: The initial entry time (date/time) of an order that was sent to market and for which we received no response (RegNMS)

10955.name: SelfExclusionLkPrmRefID
10955.desc: The entityPrimaryRefID of an order that was sent to market and for which we received no response (RegNMS)

10977.name: ParentOrderRelType
10977.desc: Describes the type of relationship represented by the ParentOrderUUId link field in THOR. It is used to show the difference between regular linkages and others e.g. Hedge linkage etc.

10978.name: CATSQuoteRejectReason
10978.desc: CATS specific tag to hold QuoteRejectReason set by CATS. Equivalent to QuoteRejectReason but CATS specific

10979.name: CATSOrdRejReason
10979.desc: CATS specific tag to hold OrdRejectReason set by CATS. Equivalent to OrdRejectReason but CATS specific

10980.name: CATSQuoteAckStatus
10980.desc: CATS specific tag to hold QuoteAckStatus set by CATS. Equivalent to QuoteAckStatus but CATS specific

10981.name: CATSQuoteRequestType
10981.desc: CATS specific tag to hold QuoteRequestType set by CATS. Equivalent to QuoteRequestType but CATS specific

10985.name: NMSISOType
10985.desc: Describes the type of "ISO - InterMarketSweep" order.  Used for RegNMS.

10986.name: mktQuoteCenter
10986.desc: Identifies market center that is quoting and marks the beginning of each repeating group.

10987.name: mktQuotePartCode
10987.desc: Identifies participant that entered the quote

10991.name: TaiwanBulkOrderInd
10991.desc: Indicator if client would like to trade Taiwan (TW) orders as bulk or non-bulk. Used as a failover for KoreaBulkOrderInd, so if it is not present on the message, it will try to get it from TaiwanBulkOrderInd.

10992.name: TRptExchOffExchangeInd
10992.desc: Off-exchange contract indicator. Indicates the origin of contract.  Set up for Milan Trade Reporting.

10993.name: DisplayPrice
10993.desc: Price expressed in fractional format in string, not 32nd format. e.g. 100 11/64.

10994.name: AutoTraderActionInd
10994.desc: Set on Trader Amend Accept message to indicator to the OM to flow the action onto the trading system from sales system.  Set by etsBroker.

10996.name: PUEVSettleType
10996.desc: This attribute identifies which type of settlement the client prefers for their German security trades.  It is unique to the German market.

10998.name: DeliveryMechanism
10998.desc: The mechanism employed in block trade confirmation and allocation e.g. Trade Express, Oasys Domestic

10999.name: ETCEligibleInd
10999.desc:
Indicates whether or not a message is eligible for routing to an electronic trade confirmation system (ETC).
Indicates whether a company uses electronic confirmations.

11001.name: ActionableIOIInd
11001.desc: Indicates whether or not the IOI (Indication of Interest) is actionable

11013.name: TbsTradeFlowSector
11013.desc: source of trade - for outages detail on where it is (tag49 is business group)

11015.name: TbsUniqueID
11015.desc: TBS Unique id: $37:+$17:+[BorS]:+$55:+$60 Formed by concatenating these fields. Product code may be derived from a different field for one or two 'awkward'  exchanges.

11017.name: ClAggregatorType
11017.desc: Specifies the client option as to whether pre-allocate or not, i.e. if aggregator can be used to aggregate orders.

11018.name: madridMarketType
11018.desc: Madrid Exchange specific field giving an order type description, it is required for aggregation and settlement purposes

11019.name: MktUnitQtyFactor
11019.desc: Factor to turn the number of units into a nominal position (convertible bonds)

11020.name: TbsInitExecID
11020.desc: identifies the original TBS executionID involved in the claiming process

11021.name: NoTbsInitExecID
11021.desc: Number of TbsInitExecID in message LFR group count

11022.name: MktPrcFactor
11022.desc: Factor to convert an absolute price into a percentage of nominal price (convertible bonds)

11028.name: breakPricePrincipal
11028.desc: Principal price for BN500 Break Charges.

11029.name: breakQuantityPrincipal
11029.desc: Principal quantity for BN500 Break Charges.

11030.name: ETCOverwriteInd
11030.desc: Indicates whether block trade data confirmed via an ETC mechanism has been manually overwritten by a CSG representative.

11031.name: ClientReportStatus
11031.desc: When an order is filled or partial filled, a Sales Trader reports the executions to the client verbally by telephone or by FIX message. Then, the Sales Trader marks the order as 'reported' in OMW and this sets the value of the ClientReportStatus tag.  Not

11032.name: BlkCrossMinSize
11032.desc: Indicates the minimum size allowed to send into Block Crossing (dark liquidity).

11033.name: RFQUUId
11033.desc: Unique identifier assigned by morgan stanley to a Client's Request For Quote.  Set because the standard RFQReqID (tag 644) in Fix is not guaranteed unique.

11034.name: RelatedCrossLkUUId
11034.desc: A unique identifier (UUID) to provide linkage between sets of crossed executions.

11035.name: TaxApplicableInd
11035.desc: Identifies whether or not a trade attract taxes or not. Used in cases where TC cannot derive the taxes automatically.

11036.name: IWantEnabledInd
11036.desc: Indicates if the user wishes to have the order cross in the lit market.

11037.name: IWantLimitPrice
11037.desc: Indicates the maximum aggressive price in which the order can IOC the lit market if IWantEnabledInd=Y

11038.name: IWantMaxQty
11038.desc: Indicates the maximum quantity allowed to IOC the lit market at any given time

11039.name: IWantMinQty
11039.desc: Indicates the maximum quantity allowed to IOC the lit market at any given timeIndicates the maximum quantity allowed to IOC the lit market at any given time

11040.name: IWantRetryDelay
11040.desc: Indicates the minimum number of seconds that must pass before we can IOC the lit market again.

11041.name: NonStdSettlDateInd
11041.desc: This indicates if the settlement date is non-standard as per market convention. Note this does not relate to exchange settlement.

11042.name: QuoteUUId
11042.desc: Unique identifier assigned by Morgan Stanley to a Quote. Set because the standard QuoteID (tag 117) in Fix is not guaranteed unique.

11043.name: CancelAfterAuctionInd
11043.desc: Where an order isn't filled in the auction, indicates the whether or not the order should be valid in the continuous trading period. If set to "Y", the engine will pull the order if it has not been filled.

11044.name: MSOrderVisibilityType
11044.desc: Used to indicate visibility/non-visibility and sometimes visible i.e whether an order can go to a Dark Liquidity Pool or not.

11045.name: MSPoolCrossPriceLimit
11045.desc: Trading systems send this tag to Pool in order to limit how aggressive Pool can become. The tag is required for all limit orders sent to Pool.

11046.name: MSPoolCrossCalcPrice
11046.desc: This field is set by Pool to indicate what Pool price it calculated from the inputs. Pool sets this tag to show how aggressive it became for the order. This looks to just be the normal Executed price (tag 31) when a fill is created by a cross in Pool.

11047.name: MSPoolCrossDiscretion
11047.desc: This is a formula that describes how much more aggressive than "PoolBasePrice" or "Price" the Pool price can be.

11048.name: MSPoolCrossBasePrice
11048.desc: This is the basis of the Pool price. Pool will calculate the Pool price by adding an optional discretion amount to this price.

11049.name: MSPoolOrderType
11049.desc: This tag shows how MS Pool treats the order that could not be crossed.

11050.name: NoIOIVendors
11050.desc: The number of repeating groups of IOI Vendor DestinationID codes (tag 10010) and  IOIPhyMsgCounts(10934).  Used by IOI messages.

11051.name: BlkCrossMaxSize
11051.desc: Specifies the maximum amount allowed to send into dark liquidity at any given time. Used by Block Crossing Dark Liquidity Pools.

11052.name: IWantMaxNumRetry
11052.desc: Used by the IWant strategy to specify the number if times we can retry sending an IOC slice out into the lit market.

11053.name: GenerateExecutedPriceOmniLegInd
11053.desc: Indicates that an average price clientNotice should/should not be exploded into executed price omni legs

11054.name: ClientFillReleaseStrat
11054.desc: Describes when the fills from trading activity (eg the antihedge risk order) should be released/propagated back to the original customer order. Used for aggregation of client fill reports.

11055.name: HolidayCalendar
11055.desc: The applicable MS Calendar used as the holiday calendar when calculating the ValueDete (SettlementDate).  This is a 3 char code listed in the MSCalendar libruary of mstk.

11056.name: AutoGenRejOrdInd
11056.desc: Indicator for autogen orders to determine whether the order is cancelled if the EO is rejected by downstream processes/systems

11057.name: HireiHaibunType
11057.desc: This field contains an indication of the type of "hirei-haibun" matching as performed by the TSE/OSE/JASDAQ exchanges.

11058.name: EBrokerQuote1
11058.desc: Captures the electronic broker quotes for PK and OB symbols. As per NASDAQ rules, it is required to capture other brokers Level2 Quotes when PK and OB stocks are traded.

11059.name: EBrokerQuote2
11059.desc: Captures the electronic broker quotes for PK and OB symbols. As per NASDAQ rules, it is required to capture other brokers Level2 Quotes when PK and OB stocks are traded.

11060.name: IWantBasePrice
11060.desc: Indicates the market data attribute to use as the base price for an IWant order. This will be used to calculate a price for the IWant order. The price will be IWantBasePrice + an offset specified by the client.

11062.name: QuoteVId
11062.desc: The version number of a Quote.

11063.name: IWantOffsetType
11063.desc: Provides the type of offset to apply to the price generated for an IWant order.

11064.name: AutoGenUserActionMode
11064.desc: Indicates the User Action Mode of the AutoGen PortfolioOrder. Is set by the OM and used by GUI to take further Action at PortfOrder level.

11065.name: ClRptSvcProcessID
11065.desc: Contains the Client Reporting Service (usualy CD FixRouter) Process ID (HOST:PORT).  Similar to OMOwnerID (7565) and ProcessOwnerID (10556), this tag will denote the host:port of the CDFR that the P-B-O originated from.  It will be used to route to the ap

11066.name: MDSeqNo
11066.desc: Sequence/tick number of market data associated with an event at a particular point in time. Specific to the IED Analytical Database (TDDB).

11067.name: RestrictCheckedInd
11067.desc: Indicates whether the order has been checked by the Restriction List Service (for restricted Products).

11068.name: ConvertSecIDforRiskInd
11068.desc: Indicator to determine whether conversion is required to map tag 9505 to  tags 48/55 to enable risk update.

11069.name: OrigClHandlCapacity
11069.desc: Retains the original Handling Capacity (i.e. for what purpose the trading entity is trading the order  of the counter party) of the order.

11070.name: OrigClOrdSubCapacity
11070.desc: Retains the orderSubCapacity of the original order where the orderSubCapacity is how MS acts on the order for a given client.

11075.name: CS2BuyFirmID
11075.desc: Holds the NYSE Crossing Session II buy side firm ID

11076.name: CS2Ind
11076.desc: NYSE Crossing Session II website reporting indicator

11077.name: TransBreakdownInd
11077.desc: Indicates whether the Allocation has been broken down to circumvent the maximum limitation of amount. (E.g Fedwire has a $50 million limitation).

11078.name: OnetoOneAllocInd
11078.desc: Indicates whether there is a one-to-one relationship between ClientNotice to Allocation, signifying client has only one account.

11079.name: PreAllocatedInd
11079.desc: Indicates whether the Order has been pre-allocated or not.

11080.name: STPOverrideInd
11080.desc: Indicates whether the Order has been manually processesed.

11081.name: SideOverrideInd
11081.desc: Indicates when a trader overrides the side of the trade.

11082.name: SideOverrideReason
11082.desc: Indicates the reason for the side override.

11083.name: BlkCrossBasePrice
11083.desc: Holds a value indicating the which market data attribute to use as the base price for a Block Crossing order.  This is used in the calculation of the order price.

11084.name: BlkCrossOffsetType
11084.desc: Holds a value indicating what type of offset to apply to the base price generated for a Block Crossing order.

11085.name: IBSBackBridgeInd
11085.desc: An indicator to show that flow sholud be backbridged to IBS, even once it is migrated onto TC/Vista

11086.name: CalSprNrLegTransTm
11086.desc: Used by the CalendarRollExecution engine to indicate the execution time of the near leg

11087.name: CalSprFrLegTransTm
11087.desc: Used by the CalendarRollExecution engine to indicate the execution time of the far leg

11088.name: CalSprNrLegPrice
11088.desc: Used by the CalendarRollExecution engine to indicate the price of the near leg

11089.name: CalSprFrLegPrice
11089.desc: Used by the CalendarRollExecution engine to indicate the price of the far leg

11090.name: EngineName
11090.desc: Engine name(requested for the QuantP TDDB)

11091.name: EngineVersion
11091.desc: Engine version (requested for the QuantP TDDB)

11093.name: Process
11093.desc: Reflects the process name found within an application or system.

11097.name: India5pctCheckInd
11097.desc: Indicator to show whether the India 5% check rule has been overriden by a sale trader

11098.name: SwapCorpActChkInd
11098.desc: Indicator to show whether the Swaps corporate action check rule has been overriden

11099.name: BicVenue
11099.desc: The BIC code of the Venue (required for MiFID in europe).Indicates partyID for FID where partyIDSource=B and partyRole=Principal.

11100.name: AsiaBookerRouting
11100.desc: String description of the destinations that this message should be routed to by the Asia Booker Infrastructure, e.g. "-OMPK_Y-DEFAULT_ETSDB_Y-KOREA_ETSDB_Y-RAZER_TC_Y".

11101.name: AggUnit
11101.desc: Used to indicate aggregation unit of a particular prop account. The account to aggregation unit mapping is defined by RCG (risk control group). It is stored in A2 and RCG databases.

11102.name: PSPCSwapsOrderQty
11102.desc: This is the quantity for the Swaps part of the Part Cash Part Swap order, with a Related Qty Class Type =4(Swap Qty).

11103.name: PSPCCashOrderQty
11103.desc: This is the quantity for the Cash part of the Part Cash Part Swap order, with a Related Qty Class Type =5(Cash Qty).

11104.name: PTScope
11104.desc: Describes a specific version of the Program Trading rollout e.g. 1b, 2a

11105.name: EngineActionReason
11105.desc: The Reason the Engine made the trading decision/evaluation that it did (requested for Viper)

11106.name: EngineLocalTimestamp
11106.desc: Timestamp in local time that the engine either received this message, sent another message or did an internal action. (requested for the QuantP TDDB)

11107.name: SQAdjustInd
11107.desc: Tokyo specific tag used to indicate whether or not to apply SQ (Special Quote) adjustments to an order

11108.name: ActTradeDetail
11108.desc: Transaction information for ACT trade reporting (note split from modifier code for RegNMS)

11109.name: ActSettlementType
11109.desc: Indication of the type of settlement for ACT trade reporting (note split from modifier code for RegNMS).

11110.name: NMSExemptionReason
11110.desc: Used in ACT trade reporting - Indicates why RegNMS exemption has been applied to a given transaction.

11111.name: TCInstanceID
11111.desc: This is the region that the trade is intended to be processed in TC. It is derived by TradeDirector from a look-up on fields AppLoc, OrderCapacity, IssueType, Currency, and potentially other drivers. It cannot be overridden by upstream applications.

11112.name: ActExtendHrsOrSold
11112.desc: Extended hours or sold information for ACT trade reporting (note split from modifier code for RegNMS)

11113.name: PartSynthAggUUId
11113.desc: UUId to aggregate together the orders which were part of a single customer order, but had been broken into sub-orders as part of the order was a synthetic product and part of the order was a regular cash order.(eg.Used in Minerva for Part Cash Part Swap)

11114.name: PartSynthAggType
11114.desc: Indicates the type of the synthetic break up of the customer order.

11115.name: NeedFXHedgeInd
11115.desc: Indicates whether an order needs to do FX hedging

11116.name: ExchBidOfferID
11116.desc: Exchange specific identifier for a bid (sent as part of a quote message).

11117.name: ExchOfferOrderID
11117.desc: Exchange specific identifier for an offer (sent as part of a quote message).

11119.name: IntentionUUId
11119.desc: Intentions are non-binding sets of potential trading instructions, similar to unrouted Orders.  IntentionUUId is the primary ID of an Intention.  ETSDB stores Intentions in the EtsOrder table with 10350=Intention, THOR has an Intention table.

11120.name: ParentIntentionUUId
11120.desc: Intentions are non-binding sets of potential trading instructions, like unrouted Orders.  ParentIntentionUUId is the link from a real Order to an Intention. ETSDB stores Intentions in EtsOrder with 10350=Intention, THOR has an Intention table.

11121.name: WaveName
11121.desc: Name of a Wave (not guaranteed unqiue) as set by the Trader via the GUI. For Programs trading.

11122.name: WaveDescription
11122.desc: Description of a Wave as set by the Trader via the GUI. For Programs trading.

11123.name: PreCloseStartTime
11123.desc: Effective start time for pre-trading an order outside of the closing auction. It is most relevant for Close benchmark orders for GT. It is expressed in UTC (also known as GMT).

11124.name: PreCloseEndTime
11124.desc: Effective end time for pre-trading an order outside of the closing auction. It is most relevant for Close benchmark orders for GT. It is expressed in UTC (also known as GMT).

11125.name: BlkCrossPrice
11125.desc: The actual normalized price for Block Crossing (Dark Liquidity) slices to be sent out to market.

11126.name: IWantPrice
11126.desc: The actual normalized price for IWant slices to be sent out to market.

11127.name: poolUUID
11127.desc: The unique identifier (UUID) applicable to a pool.

11128.name: poolVID
11128.desc: VersionID for the pool. Incremented for any change in composition of the pool.

11129.name: NMSOPRExemption
11129.desc: Indicates why Reg NMS exemption is being applied to a given transaction.

11130.name: OriginatingSubRegion
11130.desc: Used in multi-environment/cross-region trading to specify the origin of the request.  Note that there may be multiple equivalent environments per region therefore this is more granular than OriginatingRegion (7337)

11131.name: PercentOfAuction
11131.desc: For a tragetClose benchmark order, holds a user defined value that represents the percent of Closing/Opening auction.

11133.name: WaveDestinationGroup
11133.desc: Provides the destination context (higher level of granularity than DestinationID) for a group of orders belonging to a wave, e.g. Engines, Exchange, etc.

11134.name: NMSCleanupModel
11134.desc: Instructs NMSCrosser how to execute the cleanup.

11135.name: NMSCleanupAccount
11135.desc: Supplies principal account (format is alpha-numeric account codes) to use for cleaning up.

11136.name: NMSMinimumQty
11136.desc: This tag instructs the NMSCrosser engine that it must fill an order with the quantity specified in NMSMinimumQty or more, otherwise reject the trade. Valid values: 0 and +ve integers

11137.name: ExtraFirmRisk
11137.desc: Optional parameter that instructs exchange or consuming application to reject the order if we need to cleanup more than specified amount of risk (specified in terms of number of shares).

11138.name: LateReportInd
11138.desc: Flag set by the Trader to indicate a late trade (the execution was not trade reported within 90 seconds).

11139.name: TraderDoneInd
11139.desc: Indicates how OM should treat the EO after the Trader has DFD.

11141.name: TradingSection
11141.desc: Identifies a logical group of symbols that each order needs to know in GT, MBA, and SORT. This is similar to sector classification, but Trading section could span across several sectors which indexes(like Russel) use.(for e.g for Russell trades it is R1-A

11142.name: PreTradeParticipationRate
11142.desc: For a targetClose benchmark order (7505=TargetClose), this tag is optionally used to indicate the participation rate of the pre-traded quantity, i.e. how early any pre-traded quantity will start trading.

11143.name: softDollarEligInd
11143.desc: Indicates if the Execution is eligible for soft-dollar credit.

11144.name: BTRptPublishTime
11144.desc: In the event of a trade with delayed publication, this is the time when the trade will be published. For non-delayed trade, this time is assigned by BOAT when receiving and publishing the trade.

11145.name: BTRptPublishTrdInd
11145.desc: Indicates whether a trade is published or not on BOAT. It can also be used when amending private information of a trade to suppress publication of amended trade.

11146.name: BTRptPxDiffReason
11146.desc: Reason why the trade price differs from the market price. Must be used in conjunction with BTRptPxDiff.

11147.name: BTRptRefVersion
11147.desc: For an amended Trade Report, contains the Id and version of the previous cancelled Trade Report. Used by BOAT.

11148.name: BTRptVersion
11148.desc: The version of a Trade Report. Must be unique per Id for the same TradeReportSystem. Used by BOAT.

11149.name: CommissionLevel
11149.desc: Free text description of the commission that will be paid for this trade.

11150.name: BTRptPxDiffInd
11150.desc: If the price of the trade differs from current market price, this flag will be set to true, E.g. VWAP trades will have this set to true. Used by BOAT.

11151.name: LastManualApp
11151.desc: Gives the last manual system, i.e. application with human intervention, to process an Order.

11152.name: DeltaInstruction
11152.desc: Free text description of how the delta quantity will be executed.

11153.name: BTRptOrigDestID
11153.desc: Where a Trade or a Trade Report is cancelled, contains the Trade Report System (RptDestinationID - 10149) previously reported to. Used by BOAT.

11154.name: BTRptOverrideDlyInd
11154.desc: Indicates if a Trade Report should be overriden and be published immeditately although it is eligible for delayed publication (itself, potentially indicated by TRptDelayPubInd - 10775).

11155.name: Kappa
11155.desc: Ratio of change of price for a 1% change in volatility.

11156.name: NotionalValue
11156.desc: Notional value of the RFQ from a client. Ref price * contract size * quantity

11157.name: BTRptPxQtyReviewedInd
11157.desc: Indicates if the LastPx and LastQty have been reviewed by the contributor and should not be subject to validation from BOAT where there is a known divergence from market.

11158.name: SellShortQty
11158.desc: Specifies the facilitated short sell quantity for the order.

11159.name: Volatility
11159.desc: Measure of extent to which the price of the underlying asset will vary between now and the derivative expiry.

11160.name: Delta
11160.desc: Ratio of change of price of the underlying asset to corresponding change of price of the derivative.

11161.name: ExcelImportedInd
11161.desc: Identifies an allocation that has been entered into FIDAllocator via a Excel spreadsheet upload process.  This will be used by reporting metrics

11162.name: MSPoolORGroup
11162.desc: Used to hold the group of ORs that MSPool will send a pooled order to.

11163.name: ConstantScaleInd
11163.desc: Determines for MBA if the pricing scale is generated as a sliding scale or a constant scale.

11164.name: LowerScalePrice
11164.desc: For MBA, when the user wants to amend the order, this is the lower Scale point price at which the far price must be at or less in order to amend to the LowerScaleAmends.

11165.name: LowerScalePxType
11165.desc: For MBA, this determines if the LowerScalePrice (11164) is absolute or relative to the current midpoint price.

11166.name: LowerScaleAmend
11166.desc: For MBA, when the LowerScalePrice (11164) has been reached on the far side, then we will amend the specific tags to this on the order

11167.name: UpperScalePrice
11167.desc: For MBA, when the user wants to amend the order, this is the upper Scale point price at which the far price must be at or above in order to amend to the UpperScaleAmends.

11168.name: UpperScalePxType
11168.desc:
11168 = UpperScalePxType
For MBA, this determines if the UpperScalePrice (11167) is absolute or relative to the current midpoint price.

11169.name: UpperScaleAmend
11169.desc: For MBA, when the UpperScalePrice (11167) has been reached on the far side, then we will amend the specific tags to this on the order.

11170.name: SideBySideMSApprvr
11170.desc: Evidence that the receiving desk approves that an order with order protection can be routed to them.  When this order arrives at the desk this will cause all open principal orders of the same side and product to be immediately cancelled.

11171.name: RFQVId
11171.desc: The version number of an RFQ.

11172.name: GroupRFQUUId
11172.desc: Uniquely identifies a set of RFQs belonging to a single FIX QuoteRequest.

11173.name: RFQOwnerProcessId
11173.desc: ProcessId of the process owning the RFQ state.

11174.name: ConversationUUId
11174.desc: Uniquely identifies a set of RFQs and/or Quotes belonging to the same 'conversation' between the Client and Morgan Stanley.

11175.name: MassQuoteUUId
11175.desc: Uniquely identifies a set of Quotes belonging to a single FIX MassQuote.

11176.name: QuoteOwnerProcessId
11176.desc: ProcessId of the process owning the Quote state.

11177.name: QuoteSetUUId
11177.desc: Unique identifier assigned by Morgan Stanley to a QuoteSet (within the context a FIX MassQuote message). Set because the standard QuoteSetID (tag 302) in Fix is not guaranteed unique.

11178.name: BusinessLostReason
11178.desc: Specifies the business reason why a Quote or RFQ was lost (rejected by client).

11179.name: ExpirationDateType
11179.desc: Categorises a derivative product based on when its expiry date is. Used for trading limits, where there can be a different limit for derivatives expiring in the near future to those expiring further in the distance.

11180.name: ClntConversationID
11180.desc: Client identifier for a set of RFQs and/or Quotes belonging to the same 'conversation' between the Client and Morgan Stanley. Unlike ConversationUUId (tag 11174), this is not garuanteed unique.

11181.name: AdmittedToTradingInd
11181.desc: Specifies whether the share has been admitted to trading on a regulated market in the EEA. Each RM will provide the list of shares admitted to trading on it.

11182.name: DayCountCode
11182.desc: FID1 Code describing the day count rules for Accrued Interest calculation.

11183.name: AssociatedListingInd
11183.desc: Whether or not the product is also listed outside of EEA

11184.name: CFIGroup
11184.desc: Holds the CFI Group(Classification of Financial Instruments) code (ISO 10962 standard) from P2.

11185.name: CFICategory
11185.desc: Holds the CFI Category(Classification of Financial Instruments) code (ISO 10962 standard) from P2.

11186.name: CFIAttribute1
11186.desc: Holds the first CFI Attribute(Classification of Financial Instruments) code (ISO 10962 standard) from P2.

11187.name: CFIAttribute2
11187.desc: Holds the second CFI Attribute(Classification of Financial Instruments) code (ISO 10962 standard) from P2.

11188.name: CFIAttribute3
11188.desc: Holds the third CFI Attribute(Classification of Financial Instruments) code (ISO 10962 standard) from P2.

11189.name: CFIAttribute4
11189.desc: Holds the fourth CFI Attribute(Classification of Financial Instruments) code (ISO 10962 standard) from P2.

11190.name: EEARegMarketInd
11190.desc: Whether or not the exchange is an EEA member.

11191.name: SIBRefNumber
11191.desc: SIB-CODE (securities investment board reference number) for a trading account.

11192.name: PrimaryTradeType
11192.desc: Describes the various types of primary trades (i.e. before the product is open to the market).

11193.name: DerivRefPx
11193.desc: The reference price of a derivative's underlying security. Should be used in conjunction with DerivRefPxClassTyp (11194).

11194.name: DerivRefPxInstrTyp
11194.desc: Specifies the class of instrument that a derivative's reference price (DerivRefPx (11193)) corresponds to.

11195.name: BclearPublishXInd
11195.desc: Trader's indication of whether to publish to the street a cross submitted to Liffe's Bclear API.

11196.name: ManningUUID
11196.desc: For communication between the MMTrader and ets/manning process for passing on the UUID of the notification message.

11197.name: ManningQuantity
11197.desc: This tag will be used for communication between the MMTrader and ets/manning process to pass a notification message with the manning recommended/unused quantities.

11198.name: hdmUpdTime
11198.desc: KDB Datetime used by HDM to store the date when it updates a message within Viper.

11199.name: IWantMaxCrossType
11199.desc: Represents percentage or absolute max IWant quantity cap

11200.name: RootOrderMgmtSystem
11200.desc: The SalesMgmtSystem of the ultimate parent of this Order. Uses same valid values as SalesMgmtSystem (10486).  If SalesMgmtSystem is not set on the root order, then the value in OrderMgmtSystem should be passed through in this tag instead.

11201.name: MicCode
11201.desc: The default MIC code of the primary listing of the product from p2 (micLastMkt is the real execution venue)

11202.name: LimitAuthUser
11202.desc: Kerberos ID of user who approved/rejected the order in an order limit checking system

11203.name: LimitAuthTime
11203.desc: Date and time an order was approved/rejected in an order limit checking system (related tag LimitAuthUser)

11204.name: AggSalesOrdInd
11204.desc: Indicates if a Sales Order is eligible for aggregation. Used where some Orders must be reported and allocated using executed price and therefore are not suitable for aggregation.

11205.name: RootOrderUUId
11205.desc: The OrderUUId (Order unique identifier) of the ultimate parent of this Order when regular parent-child linkage is traversed. Regular parent-child linkage refers to 10910(parentOrderUUID) with 10977(ParentOrderRelType) equals to R(or null).

11206.name: OrderAggOddLotQty
11206.desc: The aggregated number of odd lot shares originating from the sale order(s).

11207.name: RootOrderVId
11207.desc: The OrderVId of the Order's ultimate parent (the 1st Order in the chain, or the 1st after aggregation/pooling).

11208.name: RootOrderBusLineID
11208.desc: The value of the original Order's OwnerBusinessLine (10152) (please also see this tag for the list of valid values).

11210.name: EurexITXInd
11210.desc: Indicates if this is a Request for Cross (ITX) - a specialised RFQ for the Eurex Exchange.

11211.name: ExchCrossType
11211.desc: Describes the type of cross being submitted to a market, specific to a particular Exchange.

11212.name: FairValueRelative
11212.desc: Ratio of fair value to ref price

11213.name: BidPriceRelative
11213.desc: Ratio of bid price to ref price

11214.name: AskPriceRelative
11214.desc: Ratio of ask price to ref price.

11217.name: EquivListedMDSymb
11217.desc: MDSymbol for listed equivalent of an OTC product, used to get market data.

11219.name: BlockStopQty
11219.desc: Details the quantity of an Order (amount of capital) that the firm is committing on a trade and that the Sales Trader communicates to the client. Used with BlockStopPrice (11220).

11220.name: BlockStopPrice
11220.desc: Details the price at which capital is commited on a trade and that the Sales Trader communicates to the client. Used with BlockStopQty (11219).

11221.name: QuoteSetVId
11221.desc: The version number of a QuoteSet.

11222.name: AcceptInst
11222.desc: Further specifies how OM should process an Accept GroupAction (7225=AC).

11223.name: ConversionAgtType
11223.desc: Specifies the type of agent responsible for carrying out the conversion between two securities, e.g. ADR vs. ORD.

11224.name: ApprovedLocateQty
11224.desc: Number of shares approved by stock lending (EFS) for the locate code (tag 7341 MarginLocateCode).

11225.name: TradeDateOverride
11225.desc: Tag to copy the T+1 trade date in manual fill scenarios when the order has been traded on the evening session, and original TradeDate is set to T+0.

11226.name: RealTimeExecInd
11226.desc: Indicating to show whether the user would like to receive real-time executions or not.

11227.name: ActualPctVolume
11227.desc: Indicates the actual percentage of volume the order represents. Represented as a decimal number between 0 and 1.

11228.name: BlkCrossCumQty
11228.desc: Indicates the quantity of the order executed in dark liquidity pools for a specific order.

11229.name: IWantCumQty
11229.desc: Indicates the quantity executed in the visible market, yet not considered part of the benchmark (IWant executions).

11230.name: PctVolumeStat
11230.desc: Indicates order performance in relation to the percent volume constraint.

11231.name: PeriodVolumeSofar
11231.desc: Indicates the volume of the order traded from the start of the order till now with limit price and exclusion size restrictions.

11232.name: OSEEvnSessEnbldInd
11232.desc: Indicates those clients enabled for OSE Evening Session. THIS TAG IS DEPRECATED, PLEASE USE 11748 INSTEAD.

11233.name: FirstExecTransTm
11233.desc: The transactTime of the first execution of a client's order to be recorded on the trade confirmation.

11234.name: FirstExecTmAtPxLev
11234.desc: The transactTime of the first execution of a client's order at that price level.

11235.name: LastExecTmAtPxLev
11235.desc: The transactTime of the last execution of a client's order at that price level.

11236.name: poolRemovalInd
11236.desc: Indicates when an order is being removed from the pool.

11237.name: poolActionTime
11237.desc: Time when an order is joining or leaving the pool.

11239.name: ClientSuggestedPx
11239.desc: On an RFQ message (35=R), allows a client to give an indication to the trader of the price at which they'd like to be quoted. If the price is nowhere near what the trader would quote, they can reject the RFQ.

11240.name: QuoteOnTheWireTime
11240.desc: A type of expiry time for a Quote whereby during the 'on the wire time', any orders placed by before the end of this period are guaranteed to be filled.

11241.name: MSReceiveTime
11241.desc: Indicates the time the order request messages was received at MS.

11242.name: TSETradeReasonCode
11242.desc: Identifies the reason for doing a "Named Counterpart Cross" with another broker, as required by TSE.

11243.name: AggLevelType
11243.desc: Describes at which level aggregation happens.

11244.name: BXSVWAPCaptureMetric
11244.desc: Specifies the difference between the BXSIntevalVWAP (11244) and actual VWAP captured, i.e. a guide as to the performance of the Engine. Difference / IntervalVWAP as a percentage of basis points.

11245.name: BXSTargetCompletionRatio
11245.desc: Percent of order to be completed at a particular time.

11246.name: BXSRealisedCompletionRatio
11246.desc: Percent of order that has been completed at a particular time.

11247.name: BXSExchangeOpenSlices
11247.desc: Comma separated list of <Qty>@<Price> of the Engine sliced orders that are open on the Exchange.

11248.name: OrderSuspendQty
11248.desc: Identifies the quantity of a Sales Order to be placed on-hold.

11249.name: MSPoolDecMDSeqNo
11249.desc: Sequence/tick number of market data associated with the point in time at which MS Pool made the decision to cross two orders. (This is different to the time that Pool actually crossed them, where MDSeqNo (11066) can be used).

11250.name: BXSSubscriptionKey
11250.desc: Concatenated key of several FIX tags from internally in the Engine. Used to publish information about Orders back to the client application via Filter.

11251.name: MSPoolDecisionTime
11251.desc: The time at which MS Pool made the decision to cross two orders, which is different from the time Pool actually crossed them.

11252.name: ErrorLkOID
11252.desc: Used to link an Error EO to its parent order. The Error EO is created when an Execution to reparented to an error/firm account. The value is the EntityOID of the parent EO.

11253.name: SalesCostCentre
11253.desc: The Cost Centre of the Sales Person. Used by FID.

11254.name: OrderDisplayInstr
11254.desc: The display instruction set by an order entry system specifying how an order should be displayed on a particular exchange.

11255.name: SourceOrderID
11255.desc: The OrderID (37) first assigned by Morgan Stanley to an incoming Client Order. Will be the same for subsequent slices of that Order.

11256.name: insideAskVenue
11256.desc: Captures the market that has the inside (best) ask price at the time of execution

11257.name: insideBidVenue
11257.desc: Captures the market that has the inside (best) bid price at the time of execution

11258.name: ExchSolicitRptInd
11258.desc: Indicates whether the OR can identify the appropriate destination to route an incoming message from the Exchange to.

11259.name: ClRestBusCode
11259.desc: Indicates message is related to restricted client business (i.e. Prime Brokerage) and only those with approved access can view the data associated with this message.

11261.name: VolumeTrajectory
11261.desc: Contains the volume trajectory curve for the order. Format = node,node Where node := time/[01]=quantity.

11262.name: ReserveOrderQty
11262.desc: Indicates order quantity that is not scheduled by an engine to trade.

11263.name: VolPredictionSrc
11263.desc: Indicates whether Mean Daily Volume(MDV) or dynamic Volume Projection(VP) was used as a volume source for the Mid-Point ,Close or POV constrained orders.

11264.name: ClRestateCapacity
11264.desc: Indicates the client's capacity for handling restate messages.

11265.name: CrossingTrajectory
11265.desc: Contains the crossing trajectory curve for the order. Format = node,node Where node := time/[01]=quantity.

11266.name: RescheduleRequestedInd
11266.desc: Indicates whether MBA or TED needs a reschedule.

11267.name: VSProblemID
11267.desc: Indicates the unique VS problem ID for downstream tracking.

11268.name: NoOrdersInAmend
11268.desc: Indicates how many orders are part of an amendment in a collection of orders.

11269.name: AuctionQty
11269.desc: Open quantity at open, close and intraday auctions.

11270.name: portfolioStratType
11270.desc: Designates which the strategy type to use by a Portfolio Strategy Engine.

11271.name: VolProjectionSrc
11271.desc: Describes the source of volume projection for the order.

11272.name: SrcSidePerspectiveInd
11272.desc: Indicates that Side attribute is populated from the perspective of the Source.

11273.name: ReparentCount
11273.desc: Counts the number of time this Order has been reparented, i.e. it is incremented by one each time the Order has a different parent.

11274.name: ClientCustomField1
11274.desc:
Field to hold client-specified attribute. Used specifically by Passport API to add custom fields to Order object. 
For B2C markets, this provides customer information to the dealer.

11275.name: ClientCustomField2
11275.desc: Field to hold client-specified attribute. Used specifically by Passport API to add custom fields to Order object.

11276.name: ClientCustomField3
11276.desc: Field to hold client-specified attribute. Used specifically by Passport API to add custom fields to Order object.

11277.name: ClientCustomField4
11277.desc: Field to hold client-specified attribute. Used specifically by Passport API to add custom fields to Order object.

11278.name: ClientCustomField5
11278.desc: Field to hold client-specified attribute. Used specifically by Passport API to add custom fields to Order object.

11279.name: SnappedBasketPrice
11279.desc: The calculated price of a basket at the time of Portfolio creation, i.e. the 'snapped' index price.

11280.name: MultiDayExecQty
11280.desc: Cumulative executed quantity of a multi-day order

11281.name: MultiDayAvgPrice
11281.desc: Average price of cumulative executions for a multi-day order

11282.name: BasketIndexQty
11282.desc: Notional quantity of a basket, as being represented by a portfolio, e.g. 200 units of the ftse.lder.

11283.name: PackedPortfMdSymb
11283.desc: The internally mapped portfolio for the case of ETFs, e.g. isf.l maps to iftse.bids. Mapping is contained in P2PackagedPortfolio.

11284.name: ConditionalTrajectory
11284.desc: Contains the trajectory curve eligible to cross. This will typically be the total order trajectory minus any block cross quantity and crossing trajectory.

11285.name: MaxCrossDuration
11285.desc: Indicates the length of time (in seconds) over which an order will receive fills. TCE will round this number down so that the duration snaps to a bin boundary.

11286.name: ConditionalQty
11286.desc: Expresses the total quantity available to cross, in the case of non-trajectory based liquidity providers.

11287.name: EngineAmendReason
11287.desc: Indicates the amendment reason processed by the trading engine.

11288.name: PrefiguredInd
11288.desc: Used by FID to indicate that this figuration has been prefigured by a frontend system. (This is usually done where the interest or amortisation amounts are slightly different to those calculated by a customer.  They can't be derived automatically so the n

11289.name: SliceID
11289.desc: ID of a slice as known by the parent order. Used to action the slices via the parent in Etsflow

11290.name: SORTPassiveSlicePricing
11290.desc: Used by SORT to determine the relative price of passive slices. Contains three components (colon delimited) - Base:Offset:Type, e.g. far:20:bps

11291.name: OrigTradingAccount
11291.desc: The original trading account of a principal execution, which will be copied to CounterPartyAccount for the purposes of OMPK only, which requires Execution reparenting to be modelled as a swing (it doesn't recognise 20=2).

11292.name: UniqueRefKey
11292.desc: To uniquely identify the order across a chain of processes.

11293.name: IndiaSeriesID
11293.desc: India specific code for the classification of securities on the exchange

11294.name: POVExcludeVolOutsideLimPxInd
11294.desc: Trader specified indicator to determine if an order should only include volume within a limit price. The volume is used to calculate percentage of volume for volume limit orders. Related tag 44(Price).

11295.name: ErrorDetailStatus
11295.desc: Describes the status of an alert raised where an Order has been held for breaching trading limits or trading restrictions.

11296.name: TradeProcessingLoc
11296.desc: This is the region that the trade is intended to be processed in TC. It is derived from a look-up on fields AppLoc, IssueType , Currency, and potentially other drivers. Cannot be overridden upstream; only derived by a scoping component i.e. TD

11297.name: OptHedgePxType
11297.desc: Code to represent the price type used for OptHedgePx (10353). Previously known as 'VolaRefPxType'.

11298.name: OMType
11298.desc: To specify the type of OM, such as FlowOM, Classical OM, FlowTOM

11299.name: IWantMaxSliceQty
11299.desc: Indicates the maximum quantity allowed to IOC the limit market for each individual slice. Different than IWantMaxQty which deals with total order quantity.

11301.name: NMSISOClientData
11301.desc: This tag supplies client system specific data that NMS Crosser will stamp on ISO order it creates.

11302.name: IndiaCommAmtPerShr
11302.desc: The commission amount per share for India's 'ns' and 'bo' Exchanges. Calculation is Commission Rate * Average Price. Commission rate takes into account commission, service tax and education cess.

11303.name: IndiaContractNo
11303.desc: The Contract Note Number is an identifier for the contract note, an exchange-regulated single confirm which acts as a legal document. There is one contract note and one contract note number for every allocation, which is specific to the India market.

11304.name: IndiaSettlementNo
11304.desc: India specific trade date representation for NSE and BSE, e.g. 2007001 (NSE), 0708001 (BSE)

11305.name: IndiaNoDelivSettNo
11305.desc: India specific next trade date after the no delivery settlement period for NSE and BSE, e.g. 2007001 (NSE), 0708001 (BSE)

11306.name: LeggingRisk
11306.desc: LeggingRisk is the risk related to the cost of aligning a basket back to the original weighting of assets in the event of cancel.

11309.name: ListIDExistsInd
11309.desc: Indicates whether this Order has a ListID (66) populated or not, i.e. if this is a list or non-list trade.

11310.name: extClientStrategy
11310.desc: Strategy instructions as used by an external client's own internal engine/s

11311.name: AllocSide
11311.desc: The side for the non-base currency in FX.

11312.name: ReapplyMktRulesInd
11312.desc: Indicates if the OM is reapplying market rules after an order is held and released by CFM/ILM.

11314.name: ChargeStampedBy
11314.desc: Identifies the system responsible for populating the commission rate. Note that this is not necessarily the same as the rule system that calculates the value.

11315.name: MassQuoteEntryUser
11315.desc: Identifies the person or process who created the version of the entity (but does not necessarily own it) for a MassQuote entity.

11316.name: MassQuoteEntryTime
11316.desc: Time when the business event occurred in DDI application (in GMT) for a MassQuote entity.

11317.name: QuoteSetEntryUser
11317.desc: Identifies the person or process who created the version of the entity (but does not necessarily own it) for a QuoteSet entity.

11318.name: QuoteSetEntryTime
11318.desc: Time when the business event occurred in DDI application (in GMT) for a QuoteSet entity.

11319.name: IndiaCPCodeNSE
11319.desc: The Custodial Participant Code that represents the Client's account with the custodian. This CP code is specific to the India market, default is NSE Exchange.

11320.name: ClOptExerciseType
11320.desc: Indicates the client preference to exercise options for cash vs stock. Previously known as 'ClDeliveryInstr'.

11321.name: RootOrderAggUUId
11321.desc: Unique identifier linkage field used to capture the ultimate parent's OrderAggUUId (10700) for this this chain of Orders.

11322.name: BBSymbol
11322.desc: External product identifier (Bloomberg code). Valid values from XRVendorData table in P2

11323.name: ResidualPriceInd
11323.desc: Indicates if a current open slice has a less aggressive price compared to the price on the position.

11324.name: PSAllocInstr
11324.desc: Contains multiple allocation instructions (e.g account, quantity, price,percent) in MIX tags, to be only used by Program Sales and Vista.

11325.name: FXTradeType
11325.desc: The type of FX trade.  Absence of value stamped on this field is interpreted as 'spot'.

11327.name: FixingDate
11327.desc: The date a non-deliverable FX forward is closed out.

11328.name: BasketCashQty
11328.desc: BasketCashQty-Indicates the cash component of the products( e.g swaps, indexes) of the basket.

11329.name: BasketCashCcy
11329.desc: Indicates the currency of the cash component of the basket.

11330.name: IssueToBaseRate
11330.desc: FX multiplier rate for how Issue currency relates to Base currency, e.g. CHF to USD

11331.name: SettleToBaseRate
11331.desc: FX multiplier rate for how Settlement currency relates to Base currency, e.g. EUR to USD

11332.name: BreakdownShellInd
11332.desc: Indicates whether an Execution or ExecutionLeg has been subject to the FedWire breakdown process, i.e broken down into an ExecBreakdown or ExecLegBreakdown respectively.

11333.name: SIBEPutThroughInd
11333.desc: Indicates whether or not a trade is a 'put-through' i.e. a trade on SIBE (Madrid exchange) that tells the central counterparty about a change in ownership

11334.name: MSPoolClientCertInd
11334.desc: Indicates whether this DMA client has consented to participate in MS Pool

11335.name: OrigSettlementType
11335.desc: Describes the original method of payment (i.e. SettlementType (10063) before it was changed).

11336.name: BSEMarketType
11336.desc: BSE Exchange specific field giving an order type description. Required for confirms, settlements and exchange reports.

11337.name: ExternalClientOMS
11337.desc: Specifies the Order Management System that an external client uses (where applicable) for DMA flow.

11338.name: ExchRoutingStrat
11338.desc: Will be used to provide the exchange with explicit directions as to how their order should be routed.

11339.name: SORTTriggerCond
11339.desc: User input for SORT order Morpheux strategy trigger condition. If the condition is resolved to true, the appropriate strategy will be applied to the order.

11340.name: IndiaCPCodeBSE
11340.desc: The Custodial Participant Code that represents the Client's account with the custodian. This CP code is specific to the India market, BSE Exchange.

11341.name: BasketSubscription
11341.desc: Filter subscription to get basket price. Used for basket swap hedging with a limit price constraint.

11342.name: BasketLimitPrice
11342.desc: Limit Price to be applied to basket. Used for basket swap hedging with a limit price constraint.

11343.name: FilterPxSubscTyp
11343.desc: For Filter subscriptions to Market Data, describes the type of price required.

11344.name: SMECode
11344.desc: Marks an order as Short Marking Exempt, which can be set by MSET clients and passed along to Canada venues or set by internal MS trading applications.

11345.name: AmendRejectTags
11345.desc: Pipe delimited list of tag=value pairs that caused an amend reject from the Exchange.

11346.name: IndiaErrRelinkInd
11346.desc: Indicates on the Fill/Execution that a client order has been reparented to a different client or prop order. This happens specifically for the India market if the client doesn't accept the price but is not allowed to buy/sell the same security on the same

11347.name: LastWaveState
11347.desc: Delimited list of tag=value pairs that present the previous state of a wave.

11348.name: TradingAutoRouteInd
11348.desc: Set by the trading system on an order to specify auto-routing, i.e. all components of an order are automatically generated and it is sent out for execution immediately and automatically.

11349.name: IWantBetaEnableInd
11349.desc: Indicates enabling of the dynamic beta IWant Limit Price adjustments feature in the MBA engine.

11350.name: IWantBetaRefSymbol
11350.desc: The reference symbol that is used to determine the price movement in computing dynamic beta IWantLimitPrice feature in the MBA engine.

11351.name: IWantBetaValue
11351.desc: The beta magnification and direction factor applied to Ref symbol price movement for the dynamic beta IWantLimitPrice feature in the MBA engine. A beta of zero is invalid. Beta can be positive or negative.

11352.name: SSReleaseReason
11352.desc: Reason code to show why a short sell order was released.

11353.name: GiveUpNotGoneInd
11353.desc: Indicates that this give-up has not been accepted by the receiving Broker.

11354.name: OrderQueueInd
11354.desc: Indicates that this Order has been routed from Sales to Trading, but has not yet been released by the Engine because the market is not yet open or the Trading system is not yet available.

11355.name: BXSStratTriggerID
11355.desc: Unique Id for each strategy entry in a repeating group for SORT's Morpheux order type.

11356.name: BXSNoStratTriggerID
11356.desc: Number of strategy entries in SORT's Morpheux order type

11357.name: SORTTrigStratType
11357.desc: Execution strategy to be used when the associated trigger condition is satisfied in SORT's Morpheux order type. The strategy will be internally validated against the list of registered strategies for the process.

11358.name: BXSMIActionType
11358.desc: Text description of manual action taken by a user that caused the engine to send a new slice to the market or amend an existing slice. In combination with EntryUser, this tag is used for record keeping (in case of an amendment, the updated parameters are

11359.name: BXSClosingPeriod
11359.desc: Number of seconds before the order end time where the engine should enter a 'closing' phase (start crossing the spread to complete the order). The value may be 0 indicating that there should be no closing period (the order may not complete in this case).

11360.name: BXSPreClosePeriod
11360.desc: Number of seconds before the closing period where the engine should put all remaining quantity out at the best price. The value may be 0 in which case there will be no pre-closing period.

11361.name: QuoteContractMultiplier
11361.desc: Specifies previosuly quoted ratio or multiply factor to convert from contracts to shares e.g. 1.0, 100, 1000, etc. Applicable For Fixed Income, Convertible Bonds, Derivatives, etc. Note: If used, quantities should be expressed in the nominal amt, e.g. con

11362.name: QuoteOptHedgePx
11362.desc: Previously quoted price to be used in the option hedging trade.

11363.name: QuoteOptHedgePxType
11363.desc: Code to represent the price type used for QuoteOptHedgePx (11362).

11364.name: QuoteClOptExerciseType
11364.desc: Indicates the previously quoted client preference to exercise options for cash vs stock.

11366.name: QuoteDeltaInstruction
11366.desc: Previously quoted free text description of how the delta quantity will be executed.

11367.name: QuoteDeltaQty
11367.desc: Previously quoted delta to be used for hedging the option trade.

11368.name: QuoteEncodedSecurityDescLen
11368.desc: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) QuoteEncodedSecurityDesc (11369) field.

11369.name: QuoteEncodedSecurityDesc
11369.desc: Previously quoted encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the SecurityDesc field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the SecurityDesc field.

11371.name: BasketMarginType
11371.desc: Describes the type of margin for a basket of stock. (Use 10147=MarginType for a single stock).

11372.name: SalesTraderFilterCode
11372.desc: Sales and Trader person self-defined code used to represent themselves. One person can have multiple codes depending on how their orders are handled and in which region.

11373.name: SORTPegScaleType
11373.desc: Type of scaling to apply to pegged order quantities for the pegged scaling algorithm.

11374.name: SORTPegScaleMaxOffset
11374.desc: Upper price to apply the pegged scaling algorithm to. Contains number of ticks away from current trading price. Expected value something like "5" or "10".

11375.name: SORTPegScaleMinOffset
11375.desc: Lower price to apply the pegged scaling algorithm to. Contains number of ticks away from current trading price. Expected value something like "5" or "10".

11376.name: SORTPegScaleMaxPct
11376.desc: Percentage of quantity to send to exchange at best price for the pegged scaling algorithm. Contains percentage (between 0-100) to send at upper price.

11377.name: SORTPegScaleMinPct
11377.desc: Percentage of quantity to send to exchange at worst price for the pegged scaling algorithm. Contains percentage (between 0-100) to send at lower price.

11378.name: HedgePortfolioID
11378.desc: Links a synthetic swap order to its corresponding hedge's portfolio. Used by an OWMD swap to point to a Batman PortfolioID (i.e. the Batman internal ID for a group of orders).

11379.name: PriMktSymRenameInd
11379.desc: Indicates that the market symbol of this product has been automatically changed from a secondary market to its primary market.

11380.name: IndiaErrorLkExecID
11380.desc: Specifc to India reparenting scenario where a client order is reparented to a different client or a prop order. This links the new Execution on the reparented order back to the now cancelled Execution on the original client order via its InitExecID.

11381.name: IndiaErrorLkOID
11381.desc: Specifc to India reparenting scenario where a client order is reparented to a different client or a prop order. This is the EntityOID of the new parent EO that the original client order is pending reparenting to, which the Exchange (e.g. NSE) has not yet

11382.name: OrdCapContextTNLID
11382.desc:
Indicates the TNLID of the entity on whose perspective the Order Capacity is set. 
(e.g if tag 47 is set on the perspective of MSCS then the value of this tag will be TNL00138889)

11383.name: TradingPxBandInd
11383.desc: Strategy instruction to indicate whether or not trading price band limit should be applied on the order, outside of which engine will suspend trading. It will only resume trading when it has received the admin command and will not automatically un-suspend

11384.name: TradingPxBandNearValue
11384.desc: Gives the near value of the trading band when TradingPxBandInd (11383) is set to "Y".

11385.name: TradingPxBandFarValue
11385.desc: Gives the far value of the trading band when TradingPxBandInd (11383) is set to "Y".

11386.name: SessionNetwork
11386.desc: The physical provider of a FIX connection

11387.name: SessionVendor
11387.desc: The reseller/biller vendor of a FIX connection

11388.name: MSPoolDecAskPrice
11388.desc: The market data ask price for a security as used by the Pool Engine at decision time.

11389.name: MSPoolDecBidPrice
11389.desc: The market data bid price for a security as used by the Pool Engine at decision time.

11390.name: MSPoolDecAskSize
11390.desc: The market data ask size for a security as used by the Pool Engine at decision time.

11391.name: MSPoolDecBidSize
11391.desc: The market data bid size for a security as used by the Pool Engine at decision time.

11392.name: RelatedQtyType
11392.desc: States the units that the RelatedQuantity (15135) is in.

11393.name: AdvertiseInd
11393.desc: Indicates if and how trades to AUTEX, Reuters or Bloomberg should be advertised via Adverts service.

11394.name: TSEEvnSessEnbldInd
11394.desc: Indicates those clients enabled for TSE Evening Session. THIS TAG IS DEPRECATED, PLEASE USE 11748 INSTEAD.

11395.name: TradeGrossExecPx
11395.desc: The Gross Executed Price in the Traded currency. Any trading fee is included but this price does not include tax (NetPx) or Tax+Commision (NetNetPx).

11396.name: PoolSubDestID
11396.desc: The dest/book ID used to idenify the sub destination for the order coming into the pool.

11397.name: PreAllocChgAllowedInd
11397.desc: Indicates whether change to order grouping in pre-allocation is allowed by sales, i.e. if the sales order does not has fills and has not been sent to the Trading system.

11398.name: DisableLegacyCopyUp
11398.desc: Used by the order manager to disable copy forward of value of tag 126 and 168 if clients amend message drops these tags.

11399.name: AggregatorTagKey
11399.desc: Holds aggregation instructions per client, by identifying the FIX tags used to aggregate the order. E.g. 14-44-38 would aggregate by cumQty, price and orderQuantity. Can also hold an XML representation in the MIX format. The key is usually a default set,

11400.name: TransientOrderInd
11400.desc: Indicates where an order needs to link to it's grandparent rather than it's parent.

11401.name: VWAPStartTime
11401.desc: The VWAP start time specified by a Trader to an order that will be used as an attribute for Time VWAP calculations.

11402.name: PriorListID
11402.desc: Contains the previous day's ListID (66) for muliday orders, where aggregation can be different each new day.

11403.name: AggregatorKeyID
11403.desc: The unique identifier for the set of FIX tags making up an AggregatorKey (11399).

11404.name: OriginLkTradingEO
11404.desc: Linkage to the EntityOID (10001) of the nearest TEO (i.e. EO with ExecOrdSubType(10416)="Trading") in a Flow-based trading chain. E.g. if the chain consists of TEO-TEEO-EEO, then this tag on the TEEO, EEO and their Executions will point to the TEO at the

11405.name: ScaleHighBenchmark
11405.desc: The MBA benchmark the client desires when the far price reaches their scale high limit.

11406.name: ScaleLowBenchmark
11406.desc: The MBA benchmark the client desires when the far price reaches their scale low limit.

11407.name: MSPoolOrdHeldType
11407.desc: Describes if/why an order was held in the Pool Engine.

11408.name: ExchangeForType
11408.desc: Describes the method used to unwind an existing derivative position or initiate a new one.

11409.name: LSEAuctionRuleInd
11409.desc: Indicates whether the trading application will predetermine which market order type to be used in an LSE auction, or whether the OR needs to default the market order type on behalf of the trading application.

11410.name: PrevProcessingApp
11410.desc: The immediately previous application that did processing on this order. Note that this is not necessarily the same as OriginLkApp (10412) if that process's messages do not reach ETSDB/THOR. As such, this tag should not be used for linkage purposes.

11411.name: OpsTrdEntryRsnCode
11411.desc: Describes the operational reason for entering/amending a trade, usually using the Manual Trade Entry (MTE) application.

11412.name: BXSOptimizationID
11412.desc: Engine-generated identifier for each successive portfolio optimization (a.k.a BranchID). These optimizations occur each time a trading schedule is updated. The portfolio from BXS's perspective is either a wave or collection of orders with same account and

11413.name: AggregatorDyKeyEnt
11413.desc: An entry as part of an AggregatorKey (11399) set that can be dynamically populated with instructions allowing for custom pre-aggregation.

11414.name: LastSubDestID
11414.desc: Sub destination of lastDestinationID (10492) (could be different from the intended subDestination specified on the order).

11415.name: ExchIgnoreWarningLevel
11415.desc: Specifies the warning level that can be ignored and allow OR to force (resubmit) the order to the exchange. Warning level is calculated by an ETI market rule to check the order price against the last bid/traded price and the exchange-allowed bid range.

11416.name: BuyMarginType
11416.desc: Describes the type of margin of the buy side for a single stock. Note this is only for crossing orders where Side = "Crossed".

11417.name: SellMarginType
11417.desc: Describes the type of margin of the sell side for a single stock. Note this is only for crossing orders where Side = "Crossed".

11418.name: AllowKoreaShortSellInd
11418.desc: Indicates on a per client basis if they are enabled to short sell orders on the Korea market.

11419.name: SrcCrossOrRiskInd
11419.desc: Identifies the source/first/ultimate Execution resulting from a cross or a risk fill. In a chain of orders, it will not be stamped on cloned Executions.

11420.name: NonTrdOrdOddLotQty
11420.desc: The aggregated number of odd lot shares originating from the sales order(s) that are non-tradeable. Used with OrderAggOddLotQty (11206) which gives the quantity that is tradeable.

11421.name: SoftChargeRate
11421.desc: This is the soft dollar rate that will be applied to a given charge.Temporary tag for TC to be able to get around repeating group processing.

11422.name: SoftChargeFormula
11422.desc: Indicates Soft Dollar Charge Formula.Temporary tag for TC to be able to get around repeating group processing.

11423.name: AdvisoryChargeRate
11423.desc: This is the advisory charge rate that will be applied to a given charge.Temporary tag for TC to be able to get around repeating group processing.

11424.name: AdvisoryChargeFormula
11424.desc: Indicates Advisory Charge Formula.Temporary tag for TC to be able to get around repeating group processing.

11425.name: ETFCrtOrRedeemInd
11425.desc: Indicates if this order is to create or redeem an Exchange Traded Fund (ETF)

11426.name: SoftLimitPrice
11426.desc: A soft limit price as specified by the client for this Order.

11427.name: TradingOrdCopyInd
11427.desc: Indicates that this market side order is an exact clone (including its OrderID) of an incoming order - could be from sales or another trading system. Currently only applicable to the MMETL model.

11428.name: EnableScalingInd
11428.desc: Order instruction to the MBA trading engine to allow scaling of benchmark, POV, IWIIC etc. when marketdata changes by some value. The details of what to scale, when to scale etc. will be pre-agreed with the client.

11429.name: LastPricePrecision
11429.desc: Indicates number of decimal places to be used for executed price (LastPx (31))

11430.name: LegCalculatedCcyLastQty
11430.desc: Quantity of this leg for the non-base currency in FX, e.g. in Quote dialog. See Quantity (53) for description and valid values.

11431.name: AllocCalculatedCcyLastQty
11431.desc: Quantity to be allocated to specific sub-account for the non-base currency in FX. See Quantity (53) for description and valid values.

11432.name: ClDestAmendAction
11432.desc: Action for an OM to take upon a client's request to amend the destination of their order.

11433.name: RICCode
11433.desc: A Reuters Instrument Code, or RIC, is a ticker-like code used by Reuters to identify financial instruments and indices.

11434.name: ClNYSEMemberInd
11434.desc: Indicates whether or not this brokerdealer client is a member of the NYSE.

11435.name: ClSwapScopeType
11435.desc: Indicates whether this client is configured for swaps flow or not.

11436.name: LegAllocCalculatedCcyLastQty
11436.desc: Quantity of this leg to be allocated to specific sub-account for the non-base currency in FX. See Quantity (53) for description and valid values.

11437.name: LegText
11437.desc: Free format text related to this individual leg (multileg security).

11438.name: LegAllocSide
11438.desc: The side of this individual leg for the non-base currency in FX.

11439.name: LegAllocText
11439.desc: Free format text related to this individual leg allocation (multileg security).

11440.name: CrossFXSpotSplitInd
11440.desc: Indicates whether or not to split a cross FX spot trade (i.e. where a trade does not involve USD, such as EUR/GBP, this indicates whether to split into EUR/USD and GBP/USD).

11441.name: SecLendingID
11441.desc: Identifier used by Securities Lending for who is making the request via SSLM. More granular than TNL level, e.g. at the desk level. Can be within MS or clients.

11442.name: ParentSliceID
11442.desc: ID to track the parent slice of the order, when it has been amended. Required for busting when original order has more than one slice within the OM.

11443.name: CheckIPOEligibilityInd
11443.desc: Indicates whether to perform IPO elibigility validation to a particular account or TNL.

11444.name: SecLendingRate
11444.desc: Indicates the interest rate that is charged to the client by Security Lending for Stock Loan Borrow.

11445.name: SecLendingRateType
11445.desc: Indicates the rate type for Security Lending.

11446.name: AggPxPostRnd
11446.desc: Rounded price on TC Execution Aggregation.

11447.name: ClientSrcIPAddress
11447.desc: The network device's IP address used by the client to send a message.

11448.name: FXClientReqPipsInd
11448.desc: Indicator set by the client that they use FX forward points in the pips format (i.e. not decimal), and hence require a pips conversion factor be specified in ScalePrice (10577) in messages sent to them that state forward points in decimal.

11449.name: LegBidForwardPoints
11449.desc: Bid F/X forward points of this leg, added to spot rate. May be a negative value.

11450.name: LegOfferForwardPoints
11450.desc: Offer F/X forward points of this leg, added to spot rate. May be a negative value

11451.name: IWantBetaInitialBasePrice
11451.desc: Provides input to compute the initial IWant beta limit price and reference snap price. Used by MBA team for Offset module for IWant feature. e.g "mp" mid-point price "ap" use ask price.

11452.name: IWantBetaInitialOffsetType
11452.desc: Indicates the Offset type to be applied to IWantBetaInitialBasePrice

11453.name: IWantBetaInitialOffsetValue
11453.desc: Indicates the initial offset that is applied to the IWantBetaInitialBasePrice (11451) in computing the IWantBeta Initial Limit price.

11454.name: NoRptClientClOrdID
11454.desc: Number of RptClientClOrdID (11455) entries in a repeating group.

11455.name: RptClientClOrdID
11455.desc: One of possibly many external client's identifier values for an order (i.e. part of a repeating group of arbitrary client IDs). Must be used with NoRptClientClOrdID (11454) and RptClientClOrdIDType (11456).

11456.name: RptClientClOrdIDType
11456.desc: Specifies the type/name of identifier for this RptClientClOrdID (11455) entry.

11457.name: NoLegRptClientClOrdID
11457.desc: Number of LegRptClientClOrdID (11458) entries in a repeating group.

11458.name: LegRptClientClOrdID
11458.desc: One of possibly many external client's identifier values for the order leg (i.e. part of a repeating group of arbitrary client IDs). Must be used with LegNoRptClientClOrdID (11457) and LegRptClientClOrdIDType (11459).

11459.name: LegRptClientClOrdIDType
11459.desc: Specifies the type/name of identifier for this LegRptClientClOrdID (11458) entry.

11460.name: ClSwapGiveUpInd
11460.desc: Stamped on all messages sent by an external client to indicate that any of their swaps flow is to be given-up and will not be allocated by MS.

11461.name: ProratedFillPrinQty
11461.desc: The principal quantity that was executed on a risk basis and prorated across this ClientNotice or Allocation.

11462.name: ProratedAgencyQty
11462.desc: The total agency quantity that was executed and prorated across this ClientNotice or Allocation.

11463.name: ProratedRisklessPrinQty
11463.desc: The principal quantity that was executed on a riskless basis and prorated across this ClientNotice or Allocation

11464.name: WaveTransactTime
11464.desc: The transaction time that this wave was created. In the case of aggegated orders, it is the transaction time of the first wave.

11465.name: AggFirstExecTransTm
11465.desc: For an aggregated order, specifies the transaction time of the first Execution on any of the component aggregate orders.

11466.name: AggLastExecTransTm
11466.desc: For an aggregated order, specifies the transaction time of the last Execution on any of the component aggregate orders.

11467.name: AggLastFillQty
11467.desc: For an aggregated order, specifies the quantity filled of the last Execution on any of the component aggregate orders.

11468.name: AutoProcZeroPxInd
11468.desc: Indicates that some automated processing of this zero-price trade can happen downstream to aid STP, e.g. its netAmount could automatically be set to 0.01 to allow a TAPS entry to be made instead of raising an event.

11469.name: WaveReleaseTime
11469.desc: The time that a wave is released to the market. Note this can be different to the time the wave was created, WaveTransactTime (11464).

11470.name: LiffeExPitTradeKey
11470.desc: Password field for LIFFE Asset Allocation trades and Professional Trades. It identifies a match with the other half trade that is submitted separately.

11471.name: LiffeExPitTradeType
11471.desc: Specifies the type of a new trade placed on LIFFE from a set of values given.LIFFE spec refers to this field as WholesaleTradeType.

11473.name: ClearingSysOrderID
11473.desc: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the Clearing System used.

11474.name: NoLegAllocRptClientClOrdID
11474.desc: Number of LegAllocRptClientClOrdID (11475) entries in a repeating group.

11475.name: LegAllocRptClientClOrdID
11475.desc: One of possibly many external client's identifier values for the order leg allocation (i.e. part of a repeating group of arbitrary client IDs). Must be used with NoLegAllocRptClientClOrdID (11474) and LegAllocRptClientClOrdIDType (11476).

11476.name: LegAllocRptClientClOrdIDType
11476.desc: Specifies the type/name of identifier for this LegAllocRptClientClOrdID (11475) entry.

11477.name: MktSideCompanyCode
11477.desc: For the sales/client side being booked, this specifies the Company Code entity that traded the order on the market side.

11478.name: OrigClientID
11478.desc: The previous ClientID if the order has been sliced and the ClientID changed.

11479.name: CompositeMDSymbol
11479.desc: Composite MD Symbol that Filter uses for fragmented markets.

11480.name: StagedQty
11480.desc: Quantity of the order which has been validated to be released to the market. (for eg Batman uses to stage a wave which slices a portion of the portfolio order)

11481.name: GTCFirstExecTransTm
