11481.desc: The transactTime of the first execution across multi-days of a client's GTC order to be recorded on the trade confirmation.

11482.name: VWAPEndTime
11482.desc: The VWAP end time specified by a Trader to an order that will be used as an attribute for Time VWAP calculations.

11483.name: EurexTransactionID
11483.desc: Identifier assigned by the Eurex exchange that is unique and stamped on each order and its associted fills, or common across orders and their associated fills that are involved in a cross. (I.e. the same ID is on each ExecutionReport ack for an order).

11484.name: ExchHoldCancelInd
11484.desc: Indicates for an Order on an Exchange subject to an amend request to decrease quantity whether there would still be some remaining or not.

11485.name: ExchRjctReplaceInd
11485.desc: Indicates whether replace (order modification) requests will be rejected from sending to the Exchange/Broker or not.

11486.name: ExchPxSanityChkInd
11486.desc: Specifies that a check should be done before the order is sent to the Exchange/Broker that its price lies within a calculated reasonable range.

11487.name: EurexSuppQteCnfInd
11487.desc: Specifies if the sending of quote confirmation broadcast will be suppressed after entry or deletion of quotes.

11488.name: ConversionRelID
11488.desc: Unique ID common to all entities relating to conversion trade, e.g. ordinary stock into ADR.

11489.name: OrderTranslatedFromEOUUId
11489.desc: Where an Order was generated as a result of translating an existing ExecutionReport (EO) message, this specifies on the EO the UUId to use for the translated Order.(aka ACDCParentOrderUUId)

11490.name: ClientMktRuleType
11490.desc: Specifies the market rule that should be applied to this client.

11491.name: EEARegulatedMktInd
11491.desc: Indicates that this product is regulated by the European Economic Area.

11492.name: MSPoolOrdHoldInst
11492.desc: Specifies the client's instructions on how a Crossing Pool should handle the order in terms of passing it through the Pool, holding it in the Pool, and pulling it back from an Exchange into the Pool.

11493.name: HKStampDutyInd
11493.desc: Indicates whether this order should be subject to Hong Kong Stamp Duty payment, as decided by TSG when there is an underfill or overfill business scenario and some quantity is moved to/from risk.

11494.name: LNFHandler
11494.desc: Identifies Local-N-Foreign application's handler which will take care of the message. This tag is needed so that multiple multicast groups can be collapsed into one.

11495.name: PnLAccount
11495.desc:
P&L Account number for general ledger that any profit/loss are paid in/out of, e.g. for Sales Revenue reporting.  It has different usage on different levels: Block: Indicative.  Allocation: actual commission & Block override.
 Execution: for Broker trade

11496.name: GTCInitEntryTime
11496.desc: EntryTime of the first version of a GTC entity.

11497.name: AgyPropMktMakerInd
11497.desc: Indicates whether MS is a market maker for the symbol, for both agency and prop orders.

11498.name: OrigClSecurityID
11498.desc: The original SecurityID that the client sent in for the case of fragmented markets where internally we switch from secondary identifiers to their primary market identifier. See SecurityID (48) for description.

11499.name: OrigClIDSource
11499.desc: The original IDSource that the client sent in for the case of fragmented markets where internally we switch from secondary identifiers to their primary market identifier. See IDSource (22) for description and valid values.

11500.name: OrigClSymbol
11500.desc: The original Symbol that the client sent in for the case of fragmented markets where internally we switch from secondary identifiers to their primary market identifier. See Symbol (55) for description.

11501.name: OrigClExDestination
11501.desc: The original ExDestination that the client sent in for the case of fragmented markets where internally we switch from secondary identifiers to their primary market identifier. See ExDestination (100) for description.

11502.name: OrigClMarketID
11502.desc: The original MarketID that the client sent in for the case of fragmented markets where internally we switch from secondary identifiers to their primary market identifier. See MarketID (7319) for description.

11503.name: Level1ConvFactor
11503.desc: A factor to multiply real-world prices and convert them into Level 1 format (for securities quoted in the OTC Bulletin Board Service)

11504.name: ClPartFillDiscardInd
11504.desc: Indicates whether or not to discard/throttle sending all partial fill messages back to the client.

11505.name: BuyOrderCapacity
11505.desc: Describes the OrderCapacity of the buy side. Note this is only for crossing orders where Side = "Crossed". Please see OrderCapacity (47) for description and valid values.

11506.name: SellOrderCapacity
11506.desc: Describes the OrderCapacity of the sell side. Note this is only for crossing orders where Side = "Crossed". Please see OrderCapacity (47) for description and valid values.

11507.name: IdemCrossCounterParty
11507.desc: Mandatory for IDEM cross order requests where ExchCrossType (11211) = E [External InterBank cross]. It identifies the other party for the cross order.

11508.name: IdemCrossTradeType
11508.desc: Identifies the type of cross trade to be placed with IDEM and is mandatory for all cross orders.

11509.name: NoTraderAuthorisedMarkets
11509.desc: The number of entries in the TraderAuthorisedMarkets repeating group, which maps the issueType/mdExch and destinations that a Trader is allowed to send orders to. Contains IssueType (7324), MdExch (10576), MSDestinationID (7201).

11510.name: KoreaProgramInd
11510.desc: Korea regulations state that basket orders that are 14 names of less (9 for KQ) should be flagged as 'single' rather than 'program' to the Exchange.

11511.name: TradingAutoRouteQty
11511.desc: The amount of an order (absolute quantity or percentage) that should be auto-routed (indicated by TradingAutoRouteInd (11348) = Y).

11513.name: AltDayCumQty
11513.desc: Alternative DayCumQty for a single specific market if there a multiple listings for a product.

11514.name: AltDayCumQtyMkt
11514.desc: The specific market applicable to this AltDayCumQty (11513).

11515.name: AltDayAvgPx
11515.desc: Alternative DayAvgPx for a single specific market if there a multiple listings for a product.

11516.name: AltDayAvgPxMkt
11516.desc: The specific market applicable to this AltDayAvgPx (11515).

11517.name: InsideAskTime
11517.desc: Captures the time of the inside ask price.

11518.name: InsideBidTime
11518.desc: Captures the time of the inside bid price.

11519.name: ClMinFXSpotIncr
11519.desc: The client specified minimum increment for FX spot price that they can be quoted on (can vary on currency pair and client). This can be different to the market pip for that currency pair.

11520.name: ClMinFXFwdIncr
11520.desc: The client specified minimum increment for FX forward price that they can be quoted on (can vary on currency pair and client). This can be different to the market pip for that currency pair.

11521.name: DealSource
11521.desc: Refers to where the deal is created. Additional flags in the message indicates if the deal is internal and if the trade is the leg or reference in the deal.

11522.name: MajorCurConvFactor
11522.desc: Factor used to convert from minor to major currency for Price (44). Setup for TC use.

11523.name: FXPipSize
11523.desc: The smallest price change that this exchange rate (currency pair) can make.

11524.name: MultiDayTrdReportedPx
11524.desc: TradeReportedPrice (10137) but spanning multiday cumulative price and quantity.

11525.name: MultiDayCommission
11525.desc: Commission (12) but spanning multiday cumulative price and quantity.

11526.name: EncodedPendingReplaceAmendedTags
11526.desc: Encoded tag (e.g. MIX, as specified in MessageEncoding (347)) describing what tag/values have changed and are pending acceptance from the user. Used in a pending replace message.

11527.name: FirmSideMarginType
11527.desc: In the case of this client order where the Trader decides to risk fill based on inventory sold on margin themselves, this specifies the margin type for the firm.

11528.name: EncodedPendingReplaceAmendedTagsLen
11528.desc: Must be set if EncodedPendingReplaceAmendedTags(11526) field is specified and must immendiately precede it.

11529.name: SAMarketType
11529.desc: Sao Paulo Exchange specific field to indicate the market type of the trade, it is required for exchange and clearing fees.

11530.name: GTCLastExecTransTm
11530.desc: The transactTime of the last execution across multi-days of a client's GTC order to be recorded on the trade confirmation.

11531.name: IndiaClTypeAmdInd
11531.desc: Indicates that India Operations have changed the Client Type of this order.

11532.name: IndiaTrdCodeAmdInd
11532.desc: Indicates that India Operations have changed the Trading Code of this order.

11533.name: ProgramsIWIICLitEnabledInd
11533.desc: Indicates if the user wishes to have the order crossed in the lit market for a Programs IWant lit order.

11534.name: ProgramsIWIICLitBasePriceType
11534.desc: Indicates the market data attribute to use as the base price for a Programs IWant lit order. This will be used to calculate a price for the IWant order. The price will be IWantBasePrice + an offset.

11535.name: ProgramsIWIICLitPriceCalcType
11535.desc: Tells us if the incremental/decramental part of the price is cents per share, basis points or ticks for a Programs IWant lit order.

11536.name: ProgramsIWIICLitPriceCalcOffset
11536.desc: Holds the value of price offset for a Programs IWant lit order (in the form of either ticks or basis ponts). If order price = tp +2t, 11536=2.

11537.name: ProgramsIWIICLitLimitPrice
11537.desc: Indicates the maximum aggressive price for a Programs IWant lit order in which it can IOC the lit market if ProgramsIWIICDarkEnabledInd (11533) = Y.

11538.name: ProgramsIWIICDarkEnabledInd
11538.desc: Indicates if the user wishes to have the order crossed in the dark market for a Programs IWant dark order.

11539.name: ProgramsIWIICDarkBasePriceType
11539.desc: Indicates the market data attribute to use as the base price for a Programs IWant dark order. This will be used to calculate a price for the IWant order. The price will be IWantBasePrice + an offset.

11540.name: ProgramsIWIICDarkPriceCalcType
11540.desc: Tells us if the incremental/decramental part of the price is cents per share, basis points or ticks for a Programs IWant dark order.

11541.name: ProgramsIWIICDarkPriceCalcOffset
11541.desc: Holds the value of price offset for a Programs IWant dark order (in the form of either ticks or basis ponts). If order price = tp +2t, 11541=2.

11542.name: ProgramsIWIICDarkLimitPrice
11542.desc: Indicates the maximum aggressive price for a Programs IWant dark order in which it can IOC the dark market if ProgramsIWIICDarkEnabledInd (11538) = Y.

11543.name: LegTraderBasePrice
11543.desc: The reference price that the Trader quoted to the Sales person. This should not be visible to the client. This price minus the executed price is the margin that Sales get on the trade. Applicable to the Leg level.

11544.name: LegTraderBasePriceType
11544.desc: Indicates whether the LegTraderBasePrice (11543) was auto or manually generated.

11545.name: SingleHopInd
11545.desc: Indicates that this order has only one hop associated with it, i.e. it is not sliced or routed onto another OM.

11546.name: LimitLeavesQty
11546.desc: Quantity to be used for limit checking. Flow OM stamps this tag with the value of OrderQty (38) minus CumQty (14) on all incoming 35=[DG] messages. This value is used instead of leavesQty (151) because 151 is not updated until after an Amend Request (35=G

11547.name: TradingOrderSSLocateReqd
11547.desc: Internally used by Programs, to capture user preference to get Short Sale locates for the Trading Order (TEO) before slicing.

11548.name: SSSideCheckInd
11548.desc: Indicates whether or not to bypass checking whether or not the order placer owns the stock they want to sell for this order or not (i.e. result of this check would otherwise determine if side is sell or short sell).

11549.name: DeskLongInd
11549.desc: Indicates whether the desk is already long the stock for a sell order received and can therefore bypass a short sell locate check.

11550.name: BasketTNLID
11550.desc: The TNL ID used for display purposes for a basket, where individual TNLs of the constituent orders could be different.

11551.name: TWCaptureMethod
11551.desc: Taiwan specific filed required by regulator that describes how an order was captured (the logic that defines the value is different to SalesCaptureMethod (10365)).

11552.name: NegotiatedCrossID
11552.desc: A common ID (can be user entered text, so not guaranteed unique)across two orders routed to a crossing system instructing that they should be crossed together. For external crosses, i.e. on-exchange, then ExchOrdCrossID (10466) also needs to be set.

11553.name: SuppressedEntityLkID
11553.desc: Linkage to an internal entity that is suppressed from being sent anywhere external of the process using it, i.e. it is invisible to all outside components.

11554.name: PassportPegPrice
11554.desc: Used by Pegged order to determine the relative price to follow.  Contains 3 components: pegBase, pegOffset, pegType. Specifically for Passport usage - there is also a PegPrice (15030) that is for Engine usage.

11555.name: TWAPSlicePeriod
11555.desc: The time in seconds between slices for TWAP order.

11556.name: DMAToDeskType
11556.desc: Specifies where the client has given permission for their DMA orders to be visible to a Morgan Stanley desk.

11557.name: SSOrderSplitInd
11557.desc: Indicates that a portion of this sell short order can be split out into a sell long order. This is based on the Agg Unit position, i.e. whether any of the security is held in inventory.

11558.name: PropTradingStrategyType
11558.desc: Specifically for prop orders. Specifies the internal trading strategy to be used, but other systems may need to know about too, e.g. ILM will set up limits based on this.

11559.name: ClBypassLocateReqdInd
11559.desc: Indicates on a per client basis that they are allowed to bypass a naked short sell check in the case where they have not specified LocateReqd (114). They already have agreement with the BU that it's the Sales Trader's responsibility. Required by TK compli

11560.name: MarketMakingExecID
11560.desc: Identifies the Market Making Execution's InitExecID that this Hedge Order is for.

11561.name: FXOrderUUId
11561.desc: Identifies the out-of-currency order that this FX currency hedge is associated with via its OrderUUId.

11562.name: SORTPostDisplayInstr
11562.desc: This tag is used to determine whether the engine should post a 'display passive' order to the exchange for the given strategy.

11563.name: SORTPxImprovEligInd
11563.desc: Specify if the order is eligible for price improvement.

11564.name: ReqPxImprovType
11564.desc: Specifies the type of price improvement (PI) requested for an exchange-bound order.

11565.name: ProgramsBookingTree
11565.desc: Specifies for programs flow whether allocation happens on the OMWP or PS hop (Vista in-scope). Note that this is a TEMPORARY tag and will be decomissioned when all flow is migrated to allocation from PS.

11566.name: CounterPtyLocateSrc
11566.desc: Specifies the LocateSource (10315) for the counterparty's order

11567.name: LastReleasedLimitQty
11567.desc: Specifies the quantity of the previous version of an order that was released by a limits checker. This is used as a benchmark to determine whether an amend is more or less aggressive than the original order or previous amend.

11568.name: LastReleasedLimitPrice
11568.desc: Specifies the price of the previous version of this order that was released by a limits checker. This is used as a benchmark to determine whether an amend is more or less aggressive than the original order or previous amend.

11570.name: SAInstrumentGroupPhase
11570.desc: Bovespa instrument group phase at the trading moment.

11571.name: SAInstrumentStatusPhase
11571.desc: Bovespa instrument phase on the trading moment.

11572.name: ApplyCancelInd
11572.desc: Indicates that a non-solicited internal cancel (e.g. CFM, ASG, etc.) was applied to a client order ("client-outs") and any resulting firm risk position needs to be appropriately traded out and handled

11573.name: BenchmarkGUIKey
11573.desc: This is the GUI-recognised value that describes the benchmark used

11574.name: StrategyGUIKey
11574.desc: This is the GUI-recognised value that describes the strategy used

11575.name: PendingPriceMoreStrictInd
11575.desc: On a pending message (150=E), this indicates that the client is requesting to make the order price more strict. The trader should be aware that if the replace is accepted, the limit price could potentially be breached.

11576.name: AutoTrdOutOrdDuration
11576.desc: The time the auto tradout order is live before being automatically cancelled (seconds)

11577.name: AutoTrdOutRepriceSchedule
11577.desc: The frequency of reprices for an auto tradeout order. Comma separated seconds (i.e. 3,5,7,10....)

11578.name: AutoTrdOutRepriceFactor
11578.desc: Total factor across all reprices for an auto tradeout order in bps, (i.e. if AutoRepriceFactor is 10bps and there are 10 reprices then each reprice will increase the price by 1bp)

11579.name: SORTRecPxImprvType
11579.desc: Specifies the type of price improvement (PI) for an order received by SORT.

11580.name: LocalSSBorrowType
11580.desc: Extension of the official FIX tag LocateReqd (114), which has whatever locate information sent from client. Indicates on a per client basis how short sell orders being handled on locate. Previously named "HKSSBorrowType" but expanding to all markets.

11581.name: NoFXGatewayTimestampEntries
11581.desc: The number of FX Gateway Timestamp Entries in this repeating group

11582.name: FXGatewayTimestampEntryEventType
11582.desc: The type of event an FX Gateway is recording a timestamp for, for the purposes of checking latency

11583.name: SalesCommissionOverrideInd
11583.desc: Indicates that the default value for ChargeRate (10042) or ChargeFormula (10054) for a Sales commission has been manually set/overridden by a Sales system, e.g. if the Sales person has negotiated with the Client to define a bespoke commission.

11584.name: OrdPricePrecision
11584.desc: Specifies the number of decimal places to be used for the price (44) of an order.

11585.name: CrossingGUIType
11585.desc: Specifies the GUI used to send an order to be crossed. Used for routing purposes where the backend needs to know the type of GUI used. Note this is a temporary tag and will be decommissioned one all flow is on the new XMAN infrastructure.

11586.name: AMAuctionPxPct
11586.desc: Specifies how aggressive an Engine should be with its pricing when sending an order to the am (morning) auction. The value is a percentage that is applied to some market data field to calculate the price the Engine will use.

11587.name: PMAuctionPxPct
11587.desc: Specifies how aggressive an Engine should be with its pricing when sending an order to the pm (afternoon) auction. The value is a percentage that is applied to some market data field to calculate the price the Engine will use.

11588.name: ClsAuctionPxPct
11588.desc: Specifies how aggressive an Engine should be with its pricing when sending an order to the closing auction. The value is a percentage that is applied to some market data field to calculate the price the Engine will use.

11589.name: ShortSellFillInd
11589.desc: Indicates that this fill is attributed to a short sell order.

11590.name: SnappedPositionQty
11590.desc: Specifies the position quantity aggregated across all accounts in an AggUnit for a particular symbol.

11591.name: OrdSchedulePxSensitivity
11591.desc: Used by BXS Scaling TPOV, ArrivalPrice, and Price React strategies for influencng the aggressivenes of an order's schedule.

11592.name: ClBypassLocateSourceInd
11592.desc: Indicates on a per client basis that they are allowed to bypass a naked short sell check in the case where they have not specified LocateSource (10315). They already have agreement with the BU that it's the Sales Trader's responsibility. Required by TK co

11593.name: AutoAckOMInd
11593.desc: Indicates that the OM that owns this Order's state is enabled for auto-acknowledgement functionality

11594.name: PrimaryMkt
11594.desc: Specifies the RIC of the primary market for this product.

11595.name: BenchmarkInd
11595.desc: Indicate whether the fill message came from MBA.

11596.name: ClExchCrossMember
11596.desc: Specifies the Exchanges that this brokerdealer client is a member of for the purposes of crossing in those markets. Can have multiple values (space delimited) if the client is a member of more than one Exchange.

11597.name: NotifyFXRateToSalesInd
11597.desc: Indicates that the FX rate or amendment to an existing FX rate for an out-of-currency trade should be passed back to the sales system.

11598.name: SellBuyFundingRatio
11598.desc: Ratio that specifies how much will be spent on the buy side for each dollar raised from selling. e.g. a portfolio has 1 MM on buy and 1 MM on sell, 50% funding ratio, engine will complete the sell orders, complete 50% of the buys, and leave 0.5 MM of cash

11599.name: CashBalancePenalty
11599.desc: Weight of the penalty incurred when cash position deviate from target for the strategy. It's in the unit of bps per hour, e.g. if Penalty=5, holding excess cash of $1000 for an hour will cost $50 in the objective function.

11600.name: ShortOrderQty
11600.desc: Specifies the proportion of this order's quantity that is available for short sell (as opposed to long sell).

11601.name: OrigShortOrderQty
11601.desc: Previous ShortOrderQty (11600) before the Order was amended.

11602.name: BXSOCRptsLastHopInd
11602.desc: Set by BXS-OC to instruct the upstream trading system, e.g. PT, Jupiter, etc. not to report its final hop to Booker. Instead, BSX-OC will report the final hop 'on behalf of the trading system.

11604.name: PrincipalValue
11604.desc: Principal is the amount on which the issuer pays interest, and which, most commonly, has to be repaid at the end of the term of the fixed income product.

11605.name: SelfMatchPreventionID
11605.desc: Allow MSET clients (executing firms) to send an SMP ID for us to then pass to (CME) exchange on orders to prevent on exchange self crossing using exchange-side tag(7928). In Asia, orders with same ID will not be matched in JP KAIX dark venue.

11606.name: RedemptionValue
11606.desc: Redemption value of trades is the price at which the issuing company may choose to repurchase a fixed income security before its maturity date.

11607.name: TempLegSwapType
11607.desc: Indicates the leg type of a swap

11608.name: ShortSellCumQty
11608.desc: The quantity of the short sell portion of an order, that has both sell and short sell components, that has actually been executed. Used by BXS-OC.

11609.name: NoTimesOrdAmended
11609.desc: Indicates the number of times an order has so far been amended during its lifecycle.

11610.name: CrossRoundUUId
11610.desc: Common UUId to identify the set of orders involved in a crossing round (defined as a number of crossing iterations within a crossing engine for a given set of parameters).

11611.name: CrossRuleName
11611.desc: Refers to a name of a crossing rule in the Pool Crossing Library. Used internally in CAFE.

11612.name: CrossingMatrixColExt
11612.desc: Refers to a column in the crossing matrix which is used for algorithmic crossing logic.Used internally in CAFE.

11613.name: CrossRoundStartTime
11613.desc: The start time of the Cross round.

11614.name: CrossRoundEndTime
11614.desc: The end time of the Cross round.

11615.name: CrossPxTypeCode
11615.desc: Indicates the type of crossing price (i.e whether VWAP or MidPoint) for a particular crossing session. Used internally in CAFE.

11616.name: BXSRootOrderUUId
11616.desc: The OrderUUId (Order unique identifier) of the toplevel order that is received by the BXS engines.

11617.name: IntCrossOnlyType
11617.desc: Client instruction that this order must only be executed internally by Morgan Stanely in a crossing engine (i.e. not sent to an outside market), and if applicable, the specific crossing engine to use.

11618.name: LatestCancelTime
11618.desc: The latest time that an Engine will accept and attempt an Order Cancelation instruction.

11621.name: TCTradeCombinedVId
11621.desc: Combination of TradeMsgVId and TradeMsgRId to give a single version Id for a Trade: (VID * 1000)+ RID.

11622.name: ParentTCTrdCombVId
11622.desc: Identifies the parent of this Trade's TCTradeCombinedVId. E.g. an ExecLeg Trade's parent is the Exec.

11623.name: LastReleasedLimitOrdType
11623.desc: OrderType (40) of the previous version of an order that was released by a limits checker. Used as a benchmark to determine if an amend is more/less aggressive than the original order or previous amend. Any change in orderType is seen as more aggressive.

11624.name: OrdIntExternalType
11624.desc: Classifies if an Order is Internal (default), External Incoming, External Outgoing or Both External Incoming & Outgoing.

11625.name: HideClientIdInd
11625.desc: Indicates that the client should be blanked out on the Sales or Trading application GUI, so that they are anonymous to the Sales Person or Trader. Note that ClientID and TNL will still be on the message - it's only hidden on the GUI.

11626.name: ExtBkrFillInd
11626.desc: Indicates that this order will be executed, cleared and settled by an external broker and/or clearing agent. It is only being passed through MS infrastructure for books and records purposes.

11627.name: IgnoreLimitType
11627.desc: Indicates which limit checks should be ignored by Limit checking mechanism (etsLimits) e.g. Liquidity, Quantity, Value, etc.

11628.name: OrdTradeReportedPx
11628.desc: The TradeReportedPrice (10137) but can be used on ExecutionReport messages as opposed to UPR messages. Contains post rounded day average net price.

11629.name: OrdMultiDayTrdReportedPx
11629.desc: The MultiDayTrdReportedPx (11524) but can be used on ExecutionReport messages as opposed to UPR messages.Contains post rounded multi-day average net price.

11630.name: OrdSettlNetAmtPostRnd
11630.desc: The OrdSettlNetAmtPostRnd (10045) but can be used on ExecutionReport messages as opposed to UPR messages.

11631.name: HedgeLkClientID
11631.desc: Holds the ClientID on the swap hedge order.

11632.name: LimitDriverHash
11632.desc: A coded representation (hash value) that represents those FIX tags which are used to drive limits checking.

11633.name: RepublishFromTCToFOInd
11633.desc: Specifies the region that TC should republish the message to upstream for FO processes. If no region specified, then TC should not republish the message at all. Note: This is not a real indicator tag.

11634.name: SOAPHandlerID
11634.desc: Handler ID for sending SOAP requests between applications. e.g. for an Engine passing to a GUI. ID format may vary, it is based on the specific application's requirements.

11635.name: ShortSellGroupId
11635.desc: A logical grouping of prop trading accounts as defined by the BU that Stock Loan will assign locates to.

11636.name: ReuseLocateOnHedge
11636.desc: For a short sell swap synthetic order, this indicates an agreement by the client to transfer a locate that they already have or will obtain to MS for reuse in our corresponding short sell hedge orders. Previously named "HedgeLkLocateInd".

11637.name: SyntheticSubType
11637.desc: Provides further granularity on the type/categorisation of synthetic, as specified in SyntheticType (10350).

11638.name: SwapPositionChkType
11638.desc: Indicates if a swaps position check (i.e. that the client's position against their order would be negative) has been overridden by the Sales Trader or is not required to be done at all.

11639.name: SORTUseRelativePxInd
11639.desc: Indicates that the GUI should send SORTRelPxIndexBase (15126), SORTRelPxOffset (15127), SORTRelPxIndexVar (15128) and SORTRelPxBase (15130) parameters to the SORT engine for the Relative Price Adjuster strategy to update the price based on the relative pr

11640.name: KoreaClAggInd
11640.desc: Indicates for a non-bulk order in the Korea market whether aggregation is allowed for this client.

11641.name: ContingencyOrdID
11641.desc: Usedvto link the contingent order to another order. The value is ClOrdID of the order that the contigent order must be linked to.

11642.name: TaiwanClAggInd
11642.desc: Indicates for a non-bulk order in the Taiwan market whether aggregation is allowed for this client.

11643.name: OffShoreFundInd
11643.desc: Indicates for this fund whether it is offshore or onshore.

11644.name: IntendedExecRole
11644.desc: Indicates whether this order intends to access liquidity or provide liquidity.

11645.name: SORTRoutingModel
11645.desc: Describes the routing model that SORT will use as part of its overall strategy.

11646.name: NoMarketSyntheticTypeMap
11646.desc: The number of entires in the MarketSyntheticTypeMap repeating group, which maps for a particular MDExch whether we want to trade cash or enter into a swap contract for orders for products listed there. Contains MdExch (10576), SyntheticType (10350).

11647.name: SwapPositionChkResult
11647.desc: Result of the Swap Business's pre-trade Swap Position Check (SPC).

11648.name: SwapPositionChkBucketID
11648.desc: The BucketID is used by Swap Business's pre-trade Swap Position Check (SPC). The BucketID is the holder of the swap position to be checked against.

11649.name: OrigSwapPositionChkBucketID
11649.desc: The OrigBucketID is used by Swap Business's pre-trade Swap Position Check (SPC). In the case of a datra entry error where the trader has to move an order to a different bucket, e.g. change from sythetic order to cash order, this holds the original BucketI

11650.name: OrigPositionEffect
11650.desc: PositionEffect (77) of the previous Order where a slice or replace has occured.

11651.name: OrigSyntheticType
11651.desc: SyntheticType (10350) of the previous Order where a slice or replace has occured.

11652.name: SwapPositionChkUpdateType
11652.desc: The SwapPositionChkUpdateTypeis used by Swap Business's pre-trade Swap Position Check (SPC). It is used by a client process to specify the type of position updates to use within SwapPositionManager.

11653.name: IndiaCommsSTTInd
11653.desc: For trades done on the India market, this indicates whether Security Transaction Tax has been included as part of the commission charge.

11654.name: OrdAutomationInstType
11654.desc: A request instruction that indicates to a system the sender's preferences for order automation. Used in conjunction with OrdAutomationProfile(11655) and OrdAutomationStatusType(11656).

11655.name: OrdAutomationProfile
11655.desc: Free text name of the order automation scheme to apply, which determines the specific matching criteria and the steps that would be automated. Used in conjunction with OrdAutomationInstType(11654) and OrdAutomationStatusType(11656).

11656.name: OrdAutomationStatusType
11656.desc: Indicates whether the order followed an order automation scheme or not. Used in conjunction with OrdAutomationProfile (11655) and OrdAutomationInstType (11654).

11657.name: NVEnableBlockInd
11657.desc: Indicates that NightVision or NightOwl should interact with block crossing liquidity pools (e.g. AQUA, BLX, PIPELINE, PULSE).

11658.name: B2DPortfolioRatio
11658.desc: The proportion of a synthetic basket to fill the client with, dependent on the proportion of hedging currently done. E.g. if the basket was only 50% hedged, then we might only want to fill the client with 40% of the synthetic basket. Known as the optimal

11659.name: B2DPortRisk
11659.desc: Monetary value of the diffence of synthetic basket filled to client vs. the value of the hedge, i.e. the outstanding risk. Known as the B2D cleanup portfolio risk.

11660.name: B2DPortTotCost
11660.desc: The expected cost of hedging the remaining risk of a B2d cleanup portfolio (as per B2DPortRisk (11659)).

11661.name: B2DPortCostProfile
11661.desc: The expected cost of hedging the remaining risk of a B2d cleanup portfolio on a per security basis (comma delimited set of values). The total is the B2DPortTotCost (11660).

11662.name: B2DLastRecalcTime
11662.desc: The last time a B2D calculation was done. (Results stamped in B2DPortfolioRatio (11658), B2DPortRisk (11659), B2DPortTotCost (11660), B2DPortCostProfile (11661)).

11663.name: B2DNextRecalcTime
11663.desc: The next time a B2D calculation will be done. (Results stamped in B2DPortfolioRatio (11658), B2DPortRisk (11659), B2DPortTotCost (11660), B2DPortCostProfile (11661)).

11664.name: B2DCalcInclLockedInQty
11664.desc: The portion of a basket hedge sent to the market which cannot be cancelled and is not gauranteed to be filled, but needs to be included as part of a B2D calculation, (as per B2DLastRecalcTime (11662)).

11665.name: B2DCalcReqdInd
11665.desc: Indicates whether client would want periodic update of B2D basket

11666.name: RatioType
11666.desc: Specifies the type of ratio used in RatioQty (319).

11667.name: TradePricePostRnd
11667.desc: Post-rounded gross price in traded currency.

11668.name: SettleNetPxPostRnd
11668.desc: Post-rounded netnet price in settlement currency

11669.name: TradePricePreRnd
11669.desc: Pre-rounded gross price in traded currency

11670.name: SettlPricePreRnd
11670.desc: Pre-rounded gross price in settlement currency

11671.name: TradeReportedPricePreRnd
11671.desc: Pre-rounded net price in traded currency

11672.name: SettlReportedPricePreRnd
11672.desc: Pre-rounded net price in settlement currency

11673.name: TradeNetPxPreRnd
11673.desc: Pre-rounded netnet price in traded currency

11674.name: SettleNetPxPreRnd
11674.desc: Pre-rounded netnet price in settlement currency

11675.name: TradeReportedAmtPostRnd
11675.desc: Net amount post-round in traded currency

11676.name: SettleReportedAmtPostRnd
11676.desc: Net amount post-round in settlement currency

11677.name: SettlePrnAmtPreRnd
11677.desc: Principle amount pre-round in settlement currency

11678.name: TradeReportedAmtPreRnd
11678.desc: Net amount pre-round in traded currency

11679.name: SettleReportedAmtPreRnd
11679.desc: Net amount pre-round in settlement currency

11680.name: TradeNetAmtPreRnd
11680.desc: NetNet amount pre-round in traded currency

11681.name: SettleNetAmtPreRnd
11681.desc: NetNet amount pre-round in settlement currency

11682.name: TotalFeesPostRnd
11682.desc: Total value of all fees and levies applicable to this trade (excludes taxes and commissions), post-round.

11684.name: TotalTaxesPostRnd
11684.desc: Total value of all taxes applicable to this trade, post-round.

11686.name: BXSLatestOptimizationID
11686.desc: Indicates the latest BXSOptimizationID(11412) when input parameters are amended.

11687.name: SkipVolumeErrorRescheduleInd
11687.desc: Instruction to MBA engine whether to skip the volume error reschedule step.

11688.name: ThicSubscriptionKey
11688.desc: Key used by the engines to subscribe to the THIC plant.

11689.name: InPeriodVSFallbackModeInd
11689.desc: Instruction to MBA engine whether to use fallback algorithm.

11690.name: POVLockedPeriodVolume
11690.desc: For an order this tag indicates the quantity accumulated in the time period between the point of time when the order was placed and when it was amended.

11691.name: POVNoneEligibleQtyInstruction
11691.desc: Indicates the eligibility of an order for POV(Per Cent Of Volume) strategy.

11692.name: LastTotalPOVTargetBeforeReset
11692.desc: The total (PeriodVS * pov) before reset of thic key due to POV(7560) Amends.This is used by Limit Order Model(LOM) in MBA.

11693.name: LastTotalPeriodVSBeforeReset
11693.desc: The total PeriodVS before reset of thic key due to POV(7560) Amends.This is used by Limit Order Model(LOM) in MBA.

11694.name: MBASliceType
11694.desc: Indicates the MBA strategy which resulted in the fill.e.g Auction, IWant, BlockCross, Finisher

11695.name: AuctionLeavesCurve
11695.desc: Indicates the leaves curves for the auction e.g open, intraday and close auctions.

11696.name: SnapTotalOpenPositionQty
11696.desc: The total open position for all unfilled orders (across different markets, including internal destinations) with the same symbol and side, for today.

11697.name: SubMSDestinationID
11697.desc: Refers to the sub MS/internal destination, i.e. more granular that MSDestinationID (7201).

11698.name: PrevReturnAddress
11698.desc: Incoming connection name to which message should be returned to for the immediately previous application.

11699.name: TradingAutoRouteOrdType
11699.desc: Specifies the OrderType (40) of the slices where the order is auto routed.

11701.name: AllowAmendType
11701.desc: Specifies when and under what conditions an order can be amended.

11702.name: ExtInfrastructureInd
11702.desc: Indicates that this order did not use Morgan Stanley infrastructure to route to the market. The first time we see the order is in a manual trade entry / drop copy.

11703.name: BypassEngineInd
11703.desc: Indicates on order should bypass downstream engine logic.

11712.name: AuctionLeavesQty
11712.desc: The quantity of an order "locked-in" to an auction and has not been executed.

11713.name: B2DPortfolioDefinition
11713.desc: Describes the portfolio used in the Best-to-Deliver basket calculation. Comma separted MarketID-Quantity pairs.

11714.name: B2DFinalCalcInd
11714.desc: Flag to highlight the last update available for  the B2DPortafolioRatio (11658)

11719.name: BXSB2DForceEvenSlice
11719.desc: Force an even slice for POV constrained orders that were sent to BXS by the Jupiter engine.

11721.name: IssueCurrency
11721.desc: ISO code for the primary currency of the product, as defined in P2.

11722.name: MBASliceCategory
11722.desc: Instruction to MBA on how aggressively to trade the order for a specific strategy.

11723.name: EnableHoldRejectInd
11723.desc: Indicates whether to enable holding of rejected orders from being sent to the client.

11724.name: AvailableLocateQty
11724.desc: Number of remaining shares approved by stock lending (EFS) for a locate code (tag 7341 MarginLocateCode) or group of locates via a SSLM-defined aggregation (tag 11580 ShortSellGroupId).

11725.name: LSEOverrideCapacityToRPInd
11725.desc: For this Order being sent to the LSE, indicates that OR should override the capacity to be riskless principal.

11726.name: TransDate
11726.desc: Date of Execution/Order creation. Note specifically that time should not be included in this tag.

11727.name: ExchangeContractCode
11727.desc: An internal instrument identifier used by a given exchange. It's used as one of the concatenation of fields that make up the Alternative Instrument Identifier (AII) as specified by MIFiD to identify exchange-traded derivatives.

11728.name: introBroker
11728.desc: Broker who introduces a relationship to the firm and earns a transaction fee on all subsequent activity.

11729.name: LastScheduleTime
11729.desc: The time when the last trajectory scheduling update occured. Used by BXS-OC TWAP strategy.

11730.name: LastScheduleVolumeSeen
11730.desc: The period volume seen (trades in the market) at the time of a reschedule. Used by BXS-OC TWAP strategy.

11731.name: DayTradeQty
11731.desc: Total difference of buy and sell of the day allocated to the same client and same security. E.g. Buy 30 and Sell 20, then DayTradeQty is 10. Used for Brazil.

11732.name: DayTradeQtyType
11732.desc: The type used for quantity in DayTradeQty(11731).

11733.name: BXSDisallowVPReschedules
11733.desc: Controls whether or not an algo order can reschedule due to changes in Volume Predictions.

11734.name: InternalAckInd
11734.desc: Indicates when an Order has been acknowledged internally by EtsFlow in order to cancel it due to loss of connectivity to an Exchange. Known scenarios are for Admin Apply Cancel and Cancel-in-place

11735.name: SwapCurrencyType
11735.desc: Indicates the currency type for this synthetic swap, based on listed currency, valued currency and settled currency.

11736.name: UniqueExecIDAndExecRefIDInd
11736.desc: Indicates that the ExecID (17) and ExecRefID  (19) are guaranteed to be unique on the Execution.

11737.name: ClFigurationOnFIXType
11737.desc: Specifies whether the client requires figuration information provided to them on the FIX acknowledgment message, and if so, which attributes are required.

11738.name: aggregatedMsgType
11738.desc: Indicates the underlying message type of the trades that form the Aggregation message.

11739.name: EffektenmatcherInd
11739.desc: Indicates that this trade on the Swiss market went through the Effektenmatcher Broker.

11740.name: TradingAutoRouteBasePriceType
11740.desc: Specifies the BasePriceType (7321) of the slices where the order is auto routed.

11741.name: OTCDealID
11741.desc: Specifies the DealID of the OTC contract related to this trade, as recognised by the lifecyle management system of that OTC Deal.

11742.name: LocalMktRegChkInd
11742.desc: Indicates that this Order has successfully passed the necessary regulatory checks required before trading on the Local Market.

11743.name: TradedBySalesTraderInd
11743.desc: Indicates that this Order will be traded by the SalesTrader him/herself, as opposed to being handed to a Trader.

11744.name: NoFXLnkEntries
11744.desc: Number of entries in the FXLnk repeating group (fxLnkRefID(10401);fxLnkRefIDType(10402)).

11745.name: MsgRetryInd
11745.desc: Indicates that this message is a retry of a previous message that has been sent.

11746.name: LimitBreachInd
11746.desc: Indicates whether the account limit to provide riskfills has been breached or not.

11747.name: DisableAggressivePxInd
11747.desc: Indicates whether the engine is prohibited from pricing aggressively (i.e. cross the spread or further) or not.

11748.name: EvnSessEnbldInd
11748.desc: Indicates that the client in enabled for the Evening Session.

11749.name: PxScalingFactor
11749.desc: The price scaling factor for Arrival Price algorithm in BXS. A value of 2 means 2 notch of urgency per 1SD move. Must be a value from 0.50 to 3.0.

11750.name: PxScalingSymmMode
11750.desc: Indicates how to adjust the level of urgency internally within the Arrival Price algorithm in BXS.

11751.name: PxScalingPxRef
11751.desc: Tag to reference for the price used in the standard deviation calculation for price scaling in Arrival Price algorithm in BXS.

11752.name: FXTradingAccount
11752.desc: Trading account to be used for a related FX order

11753.name: OrderAggCount
11753.desc: The number of orders that are part of this aggregation

11754.name: SWXRptTrdConfirmInd
11754.desc: Indicates whether or not to report a Trade Confimration from the SWX Exchange to downstream booking infrastructure.

11755.name: AcceptAmendOnNoChangeInd
11755.desc: Instruction to an engine not to reject an amend request even where the pre-defined set of instruction tags have not changed, which would normally result in the amend being rejected by the Engine.

11756.name: ITCRegisterNo
11756.desc: Registered number for an Investment Trust Company (ITC), specific to the Korea market.

11757.name: OnExchCrossPrice
11757.desc: The price that an on-exchange cross was executed at (can be different to the executed price on the Fill given to the client).

11758.name: PairsQtyConstrainInd
11758.desc: For a Pairs order, that tag indicates whether or not the notional Order has a limit (either value or quantity) associated with it.

11759.name: BXSBasePriceType
11759.desc: Holds the type of base price for an Order. Used in the "NextAuction" strategy.

11760.name: BXSPriceCalcType
11760.desc: When translating reference prices such as poc + 4c (poc-Primary Official Close Price, c-cents per share), tells us if the incremental/decramental part of the price is cents per share, basis points or ticks. Used in the "NextAuction" strategy.

11761.name: BXSPriceCalcOffset
11761.desc: Holds the value of price offset (in the form of either ticks or basis points as per BXSPriceCalcType(11760)). Used in the "NextAuction" strategy.

11762.name: StopOrdTriggerInd
11762.desc: Indicates that this stop order has been triggered and has become a market order or limit order.

11763.name: SwapHedgeInd
11763.desc: Indicates that this principle order is a Morgan Stanley hedge to a client originating synthetic swap

11764.name: CounterPtyLocateInd
11764.desc: Specifies the LocateReqd(114) for the counterparty's order

11765.name: CounterPtyTNID
11765.desc: Specifies the TradingNameID(10321) for the counterparty's order

11766.name: CounterPtyTNLID
11766.desc: Specifies the TradingNameLocID(10197) for the counterparty's order

11767.name: CounterPtySecLendingID
11767.desc: Specifies the SecLendingID(11441) for the counterparty's order

11768.name: MDStreamCompID
11768.desc: The CompID of a streaming price session.

11769.name: ChargeFormulaType
11769.desc: Indicates the type of commission applicable to a client - flat or banded and their derivatives.

11770.name: ClCashCheckInd

11953.desc: Indicates that this is a client order that has been submitted early and should be routed to an MBA instance that is set-up for this.

11954.name: ClSAEnabledInd
11954.desc: Indicates whether this client is entitled to trade on the San Paulo Bovespa Exchange or not.

11955.name: ETFIssuerAccount
11955.desc: The ETF Issuer account to be used where the ETF product and its component underliers are from different jurisdictions (and thus use differerent accounts).

11956.name: ScaleLowPOVType
11956.desc: The POV type the client desires when it reaches their scale low limit.

11957.name: ScaleHighPOVType
11957.desc: The POV type the client desires when it reaches their scale high limit.

11958.name: ClServiceProviderMnemonic
11958.desc: Client identifier for the MSET Messenger (Service Provider) flow. Unique code for a single client, irrespective of their jurisdiction.

11959.name: P2CCPMemberId
11959.desc: Maps to the P2 field "CCPMemberId", which describes whether the Product of this Order is eligible to be centrally cleared.

11960.name: ETFIgnoreFXSwing
11960.desc: Instruction to ICEMAN to ignore FX swings for a specific ETF Deal.

11961.name: SORTChartsPxProfile
11961.desc: Specifies the price profile to use for SORT's Charts strategy, e.g. Aggressive, Moderate_Aggressive, Passive, etc.

11962.name: AmdOrdLmtOverride
11962.desc: List of limit checks that should be overidden if that order is amended by the Trader (i.e. they have choosen to approve these limit breach/s themselves).

11963.name: PrevLimitAlertUUId
11963.desc: Uniquely identifies the AlertUUId associated with the previous version of this Order where a limit was breached

11964.name: KRCloseAuctionType
11964.desc: Korea has rules on pre-reporting for Orders sent to the Closing Auction on Option Expiry Day. This tag specifies the actions Engines should use to comply with these requirements.

11965.name: ClCxlImStopTrigInd
11965.desc: Indicates whether the client wants the stop order to be cancelled by the engine if the stop price triggers immediately.

11966.name: SORTRelPxAdjusterType
11966.desc: The client specifed adjuster used for pricing orders relative to in RBE's Relative Price Adjuster strategy.

11967.name: CHAGGCrxAggInd
11967.desc: Indicates if an order is eligible for aggregation and crossing in relation to the CHARTS strategy.

11968.name: AuthForFacilRestrictedInd
11968.desc: Indication that authorisation has been provided to trade a restricted product for the facilitating firm-side order associated with this client order.

11969.name: FacilRestrictedInd
11969.desc: Indicator to specify whether symbol is a restricted symbol for the facilitating firm-side order associated with this client order.

11970.name: AggPrinFXPctQty
11970.desc: Specifies the percentage of the total quantity of underlying agency Executions are the result of an FX transaction for this Allocation. Set when 11913=[Y,M]

11971.name: PreferencedMarketMaker
11971.desc: Specifies the preferred market maker to interact with on option exchanges

11972.name: WaveGroupUUId
11972.desc: Unique identifier used to group together a set of different waves (where each wave is identified via its WaveUUId(10709)).

11973.name: MSPoolCrossDomain
11973.desc: An interface for client to describe a flow type that the order belongs to. MSPOOL will refer this tag with other tags (e.g. 11973 vs. 13213) of two orders to determine the eligibility of crossing between these two orders.

11974.name: QuoteSalesCreditCalc
11974.desc: Used to support the sales credit override during the quoting process. Identifies which one of a number of pre-existing formulae will be used to calculate the sales credit, based on a variable number of criteria (desk, product, etc.).

11976.name: CommentText
11976.desc: Text associated to this comment (identified via its CommentUUId(11975))

11977.name: TRptParentVID
11977.desc: Specifices the version of the parent Execution entity of this Trade Report

11978.name: BuyBackInd
11978.desc: Indicates that this agency order is a buy back trading Treasury stock.

11979.name: RootOwnerId
11979.desc: The OwnerID(10018) of the ultimate parent of this Order, i.e. the first order in a chain of order.

11980.name: CommMgmtEligibleType
11980.desc: Specifies how the client's trades are calculated to be soft dollar eligible.

11981.name: CommMgmtClExecutionPref
11981.desc: Specifies the client's preference as to how their CCA/CSA eligible trades should be executed.

11982.name: CommMgmtAgreementStatus
11982.desc: Indicates the status of the CCA/CSA agreement.

11983.name: SORTIndustrySource
11983.desc: Used by SORT's Relative Price Adjuster strategy. For the security being tracked, this maps to the P2 field "IndustrySource", which decribes the classification assigned to categorize the type of business conducted by the firm.

11984.name: ARESEventID
11984.desc: Common ID stamped by the ARES application on all entities created or modified by a user or system action in the application.

11985.name: TRptLocation
11985.desc: Specifies the region that this trade report applies to

11986.name: AuthForFacilRestrictedRsn
11986.desc: Reason Morgan Stanley Controllers authorised a restricted trade for the facilitating firm-side order associated with this client order

11987.name: SORTIndexMDSymbol
11987.desc: Specifies which index to use to track against for some of the BXS strategies, eg Relative Price Adjuster, Price Scale, etc.

11988.name: ExpectedDividend
11988.desc: The market's future expectation for the next dividend payment for the stock. Specified by companies in the Mexican market as part of their listing where it's known as a 'coupon'.

11989.name: PartialFXQty
11989.desc: For a out-of-currency order that has an FX rate associated with it, this specifies the portion of the total order quantity that the change-of-cost FX was applied to

11990.name: OTCStratAsListedInd
11990.desc: For a notional OTC Strategy, this indicates that the component legs of the strategy should be traded using listed products.

11991.name: RootOrdPlrMSCompNm
11991.desc: Specifies the Morgan Stanley Company Name who first (the "root") handled the request of the Order Placer (i.e. for the client or MS prop entity, and this could be as an agent for them).

11992.name: OrdRecvMSCompName
11992.desc: Specifies the Morgan Stanley Company Name that is receiving this particular order.

11993.name: IntendedExecBroker
11993.desc: Identifies the executing broker that this order is intended for. (Actual should go into ExecBroker(76)).

11994.name: GUISessionId
11994.desc: Identifier assigned by a GUI for a single session.

11995.name: BrokerMPID
11995.desc: Specifies the Market Participant ID (MPID) used by a broker

11996.name: PSPCPGGiveUpQty
11996.desc: This is the quantity for the GiveUp part of the Part Cash Part Swap Part GiveUp order, with a Related Qty Class Type =7(Other).

11997.name: ORAppLogicalGroup
11997.desc: Specifically for internal use by OR as a means to group applications under one name, according to their own logic, to aid efficient processing around text comparison in rules.

11998.name: BXSExecuteAtStartLots
11998.desc: Client specified number of lots that the Engine should execute directly on the market straight away, without applying the strategy used for the remaining quantity of the order.

11999.name: MnlInterventionInd
11999.desc: Indicates that this DMA order has undergone Manual Intervention within Morgan Stanley. The reason for Manual Intervention can be found in BXSMIActionType (11358).

12001.name: ClMarketMakerInd
12001.desc: Indicates whether client is a market maker for the symbol.

12002.name: TWAPStartTime
12002.desc: The TWAP start time specified by a Trader to an order that will be used as an attribute for Time TWAP calculations.

12003.name: TWAPEndTime
12003.desc: The TWAP end time specified by a Trader to an order that will be used as an attribute for Time TWAP calculations.

12004.name: TWAPQtyPct
12004.desc: Percent of the order qty to be used for TWAP.

12005.name: BenchmarkCalcReqdInd
12005.desc: Indicates whether trader would want to perform Benchmark calculations on the basket.

12006.name: ProgramsPinnedBasketInd
12006.desc: Indicates whether the basket is "pinned" or marked to be re-loaded in the Programs environment each morning for tracking purpose.

12007.name: RelPxTargetVolume
12007.desc: Client specified max daily volume of trading they would want to hit for this basket or stock, used for relative price trading. Format is float indicating a percentage. Used independently of an Engine's Relative Price Strategy, hence different tag.

12008.name: RelPxOffsetValue
12008.desc: The offset value used in setting a new limit price of an order for relative price trading. Format is a float indicating offset from the index. Used independently of an Engine's Relative Price Strategy (SORTRelPxOffset(15127)), hence different tag.

12009.name: RelPxIndexName
12009.desc: The client specifed index used for pricing orders relative to for relative price trading. Format is Index Identifier (RIC). Used independently of an Engine's Relative Price Strategy (SORTRelPxIndexType(11966)), hence different tag.

12010.name: SORTAvgQueueForCaptureAndPegInd
12010.desc: RBE engine uses this tag to identify if it should use average queue size to calculate capture qty and peg qty instead of historical data for AsiaOwl strategy.

12011.name: SORTPcOfAvgQueueToLeaveOnCapture
12011.desc: Percentage of average queue size AsiaOwl should leave on the queue after capturing.

12012.name: SORTPcOfAvgQueueToPeg
12012.desc: Percentage of average queue size AsiaOwl should peg on near side.

12013.name: SORTQueueLevelsToLook
12013.desc: Queue levels AsiaOwl looks while calculating average queue size.

12014.name: BRManualMatchRsnCode
12014.desc: Reason for manually matching during the reconciliation of Exchange-provided Fills to our own internal representation.

12015.name: MMETLAccountMnemonic
12015.desc: Human-readable mnemonic used by MMETL Engines that maps 1:1 with Trading Account.

12016.name: CommMgmtCommStructure
12016.desc: Identifies commission structure for the CCA/CSA agreement.

12017.name: CommMgmtBaselineRate
12017.desc: For CM eligible trades (Process Code 81=1), this is the threshold commission rate used. If All In rate is below base line rate, default CM and Morgan Stanley Advisory (MSA) to 0. Used for the CCA/CSA agreement.

12018.name: CommMgmtMSAllInExecRate
12018.desc: Used in the CCA/CSA agreement for front end GUI display purpose only, gives the Sum of Execution + Morgan Stanley Advisory (MSA) rate.

12019.name: CommMgmtAcctEligCommStructure
12019.desc: To identify special treatment on commission charges by TNL when the account is not eligible. Used for the CCA/CSA agreement.

12020.name: SORTLadderTicks
12020.desc: Specifies the spacing of ticks used in SORT's Ladder Allocator strategy.

12021.name: SORTLadderLevelNumber
12021.desc: Specifies the number of slices (levels) used in SORT's Ladder Allocator strategy.

12022.name: ConvertToMarketID
12022.desc: For conversion trades, e.g. ORDs, DRs, ADRs, etc. this specifies the MarketID of the product being converted to.

12023.name: TradingIdeaId
12023.desc: Reference to the identifier for a research-driven trading idea, e.g. as used by the TIDE system.

12024.name: MaxFloorPct
12024.desc: Maximum quantity (as a percentage of order quantity) within an order to be shown on the exchange floor at any given time.

12025.name: OrdPlcrMSCompName
12025.desc: Specifies the Morgan Stanley Company Name that is placing this particular order.

12026.name: ClHedgeLkOID
12026.desc: Links this client (agency) cash order back to their correspodning synthetic order.

12027.name: ClHedgeLkOpenClose
12027.desc: Holds the original synthetic client's OpenClose(77) value on the swap order. This information is passed to the hedge order and used in Stock Loan to update positions in the inventory system.

12028.name: ConvertGTCToDFDInd
12028.desc: Indicates whether or not to convert end of day GTC messages to done for day.

12029.name: ETFRouteToTrdingTm
12029.desc: Time that the ETF Deal was approved and routed to be traded with the Issuer.

12030.name: CommentEntryTime
12030.desc: Specifies the time the comment was first entered (Format is a UTCTimestamp. YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS)

12031.name: ClBypassBOCInd
12031.desc: Indicates on a per client basis how to deal with the Beneficial Ownership Check(BOC).

12032.name: IntendedOpenClose
12032.desc: Indicates the intended value of OpenClose(tag77) for an order.

12033.name: POVValidityInd
12033.desc: Indicates to the engine whether or not to use the POV value in Tag 7560, in situations where market data is not reliable.

12034.name: BDClientMPID
12034.desc: The Market Participant ID (MPID) for the executing counterparty of the trade aka the Retail Broker Dealer MPID.

12035.name: cocOmniCommFormula
12035.desc: Change of Cost omni commission formula (chargeSubtype 64). Required on ExecutionReport messages where repeating group of charges is not supported.

12036.name: cocBrokerCommRate
12036.desc: Change of Cost broker commission rate (chargeSubtype 62). Required on ExecutionReport messages where repeating group of charges is not supported.

12037.name: cocBrokerCommFormula
12037.desc: Change of Cost broker commission formula (chargeSubtype 62). Required on ExecutionReport messages where repeating group of charges is not supported.

12038.name: cocTaxRate
12038.desc: Change of Cost tax rate(chargeSubtype 63). Required on ExecutionReport messages where repeating group of charges is not supported.

12039.name: cocTaxFormula
12039.desc: Change of Cost tax formula (chargeSubtype 63). Required on ExecutionReport messages where repeating group of charges is not supported.

12040.name: cocOmniCommRate
12040.desc: Change of Cost omni commission rate (chargeSubtype 64). Required on ExecutionReport messages where repeating group of charges is not supported.

12041.name: ExecChargeRate
12041.desc: This is the execution charge rate that will be applied to a given charge.Temporary tag for TC to be able to get around repeating group processing. Maps to chargeSubType=367, chargeType=3.

12042.name: ExecChargeFormula
12042.desc: This is the execution charge formula that will be applied to a given charge.Temporary tag for TC to be able to get around repeating group processing. Maps to chargeSubType=367, chargeType=3.

12043.name: ExternalBrokerAccount
12043.desc: Account that MS/Client has opened with an external broker (i.e. the account the broker would use themselves to recognize MS/Client)

12044.name: ClLDPairingInst
12044.desc: Client instructions on how their listed derivative orders are paired together up to allocated quantity.

12045.name: IndiaExchIDOverride
12045.desc: Specifies the IndiaExchID(10619) at the Execution level when it's different to the value at the Order level. Required due to an anomaly in the 'Flow' infrastructure, whereby can only override at either Order or Execution levels (not both).

12046.name: CancelMnlIntExchSlicesInd
12046.desc: Indicates whether or not to cancel open manual intervention Exchange slices when a 35=G[Order Cancel/Replace];18=S[Suspend] amend request is received. Similar to CancelExchSlicesInd(11834), but specifically for just those slices happened due to manual int

12047.name: ETFStockReplacedWithCashInd
12047.desc: Indicates that this stock order has been replaced by cash as part of an ETF issuance transaction.

12048.name: RemovePositionEffectInd
12048.desc: Indicates that the PositionEffect(77) is potentially set incorrectly by the client on this message, and it should be removed and re-dervied for the purposes of allocation.

12050.name: OrigSenderSubID
12050.desc: Retains the SenderSubID(50) that was sent in by the client and/or set on messages inbound from the client.

12051.name: AllowSSHedgeInd
12051.desc: Indicates that the client (via MS) is allowed to leverage onshore borrowing to facilitate the MS hedging of their short sell swaps order (e.g. MSIP or MSPS borrows from other Taiwan Brokers stock to hedge the swap).

12052.name: SSExemptEligibleInd
12052.desc:
Indicates whether an order is eligible to be considered for exemption from Short Sell restictions(SEC 

RegSHO rule 201). Exemption reason is stored in SSExemptReason(10322).

12053.name: AggregationDestType
12053.desc: Specifies the systems where aggregation can be enabled.

12054.name: SORTRiskChkRefPx
12054.desc: The reference price (e.g., tp) recorded in RBE for the risk check when an order comes in. It is used to check if the price on sliced orders by RBE is within the range or not. (e.g., 5% movement from the reference price).

12058.name: OrderSeqNumChannel
12058.desc: For a system architecture where multiple components generate order sequence numbers (OrderSeqNum(7329)), this specifies which component (AKA. "channel") is generating the sequence for this order.

12059.name: ExchAnonymousOrdInd
12059.desc: Indicates whether the Exchange allows the order to be traded as anonymous

12060.name: OrigExecEntityOID
12060.desc: Identifies the orginating street side execution's EntityOID from which the execution is created e.g. the EntityOID on the pro-rated executions identified the pooled order street fills. This is required by compliance.

12061.name: CacheResultInd
12061.desc: Indicates whether the result of a calculation (which calculation specified in CacheResultType (12062)) can be cached for reuse, or whether it must be recalculated each time.

12062.name: CacheResultType
12062.desc: Specifies the type of calculation that can or cannot be cached for CacheResultInd (12061).

12063.name: ClConnCurr
12063.desc: Currency code that the Fills associated with this Order should be priced in on the client's connection to MS.

12064.name: ClConnCurrFXRate
12064.desc: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the Order's Fills' prices from Currency to ClConnCurr.

12065.name: ClConnCurrFxRateCalc
12065.desc: Specifies whether or not ClConnCurrFXRate should be multiplied or divided.

12066.name: CommodTrdStrategy
12066.desc: Specifically for commodity trades. Specifies the internal trading strategy that was used, but other systems may need to know about too, e.g. TC.

12067.name: P2SeriesPrefix
12067.desc: Series prefix is an attribute on option products that helps make routing decisions. It's a field in P2 table P2option.

12068.name: hedgeLkOwnerID
12068.desc: Carries the ownerID of the synthetic order

12069.name: PriceClLimitCapInd
12069.desc: Indicates that this order's price is capped at the client's limit.

12070.name: QtyClLimitCapInd
12070.desc: Indicates that this order's quantity is capped at the client's limit.

12071.name: SoftChargeRatePct
12071.desc: This is the soft dollar rate that will be applied to a given charge, expressed in percentage terms against the All-in rate.

12072.name: AdvisoryChargeRatePct
12072.desc: This is the advisory charge rate that will be applied to a given charge, expressed in percentage terms against the All-in rate.

12073.name: CommMgmtProgramID
12073.desc: The client's commission account number on the Firm's General Ledger.

12074.name: CommMgmtCreditType
12074.desc: Instruction on the eligible quantity to use for Commission Management charges.

12075.name: CounterPartySSExemptReason
12075.desc: Indicates reason for ShortSell exemption for the counterparty associated with OtherMarketSide(7261)=SSE.

12076.name: BMVCrossDoyQty
12076.desc: For Mexico Stock Exchange, this is the number of shares desired to share with other market participants on the sell ("doy") side of a cross.

12077.name: BMVCrossTomoQty
12077.desc: For Mexico Stock Exchange, this is the number of shares desired to share with other market participants on the buy ("tomo") side of a cross.

12078.name: CommMgmtRenovatedPathInd
12078.desc: Indicator to identify CCA(Client Comm.Arrangement in NA) or CSA(Comm. Sharing Agreement in EU) clients which have been migrated to the renovated Commission Management platform.

12079.name: BXSScalingTPOVRef
12079.desc: Specifies the kind of reference price for the engine to use for scaling TPOV orders (i.e. MBABenchmark(7505)=TargetPOV)).

12080.name: BMVProductIndustryType
12080.desc: Describes the industry that this order's product belongs to. Specific only to Mexico Stock Exchange.

12081.name: ClTaxLotId
12081.desc: Specifies the client's tax lot Id associated with this order and/or allocation instruction.

12082.name: EverOutOfCurrencyInd
12082.desc: Indicates if this order has ever been out-of-currency at any point during its lifecycle, i.e. across any of its versions.

12083.name: PairsProLimitPolicy
12083.desc: Specifies the formula used to price a pair product, used by the pairs engine algorithm.

12084.name: PairsLimitOffsetRatio
12084.desc: Specifies the ratio offset factor used by the pairs engine algorithm to calculate limit prices for either of the pair legs.

12085.name: BypassInvAllocChkInd
12085.desc: Indicates that the swaps Inventory Allocation Check should be bypassed for this order.

12086.name: CrossDiscoveryRestrictionType
12086.desc: For crossing discovery - i.e. identifying crossing opportunities before order execution - specifies which parties are allowed to share the information.

12087.name: ORSyncUrgencyLevel
12087.desc: Instruction from SORT to PHASOR(a.k.a OR) whether or not to hold back an order slice from sending to the exchange.

12088.name: SORTEnablHammerInd
12088.desc: Indicator to specify whether or not to enable the hammer strategy a.k.a synctake to synchronize its slices.

12089.name: HIREEligibleType
12089.desc: Specifies whether the trade is HIRE act (a.k.a Hiring Incentives to Restore Employment) eligible or not. Applicable to trades pertaining to foreign investors including offshore funds on equity swap contracts.

12090.name: ReportToFIDRiskInd
12090.desc: Indicates the requirement to report to the Fixed Income Risk Manager, e.g. Swaps Trading System (STS).

12091.name: EngRiskCorrelationInst
12091.desc: Instruction to an engine in terms of a correlation that is to be maintained to manage the risk in filling the various symbols in a basket order.

12092.name: OMValidationObject
12092.desc: The object representing the validation that needs to be made available as part of a request message so it be used later by other parts of the system. Currently used within the ATOM process and contains a serialized object representing the enrichments to b

12093.name: ClShortDurationOrdInd
12093.desc: Indicates to Engines that the client has instructed that this is a short duration order and therefore it should not be held for (relatively) long periods in any one liquidity source (length of time varies depending on the Engine and config).

12094.name: ClPlusBillableType
12094.desc: For clients on a "plus billable" commission arrangement, specifies the type of plus billable applied.

12095.name: ClOrdRiskChkTokenId
12095.desc: For use when an external client uses Morgan Stanley libaries, e.g. Speedway 2.0, to perform risk checking on their orders and replaces, this captures the token the library generates to authenticate the risk check has taken place.

12096.name: BMVExecutionID
12096.desc: Mexican Stock Exchange execution number identifier. This identifier is used across stock exchange platforms in Mexico. It is different to the ExecID (17), which is also generated separately by the Exchange connectivity component.

12097.name: BMVEventTime
12097.desc: Mexican Stock Exchange official date and time for each of the events (orders, amendments, cancellations, executions, etc.) generated between broker dealers and BMV.

12098.name: ProcessInternalReportInd
12098.desc: Indicates that this report has been generated internally by the current OM managing the Order.

12099.name: LimitManagerScopeInd
12099.desc: Indicates whether this message is in or out of scope for routing to a limits manager.

12100.name: AllocationBlockID
12100.desc: Identifier for an AllocationBlock. To be populated only by Vista/Vega.

12101.name: AllocationBlockVID
12101.desc: Version number of the AllocationBlock.To be populated only by Vista/Vega.

12103.name: IWouldDarkMaxCross
12103.desc: Maximum value of quantity to be sent to Dark Pool for "IWould" strategy.

12104.name: DirectedBrokerageClTNLID
12104.desc: For Directed Broker (AKA 'Broker in a Box') flow, specifies the TNLID of the client who submitted the order to that Directed Broker.

12105.name: RecapProgramID
12105.desc: Identifies the client's Recapture Program accural account number on the Firm's General Ledger.

12106.name: msctvmInvestorCode
12106.desc: Represents a Brazilian client/investor code as issued by the Bovespa stock exchange. It has a 1-to-1 mapping with an MSCTVM client account.

12107.name: OrigMBABenchMark
12107.desc: The orignal value of MBABenchmark(7505) prior to it being changed.

12108.name: OrigSORTOrdType
12108.desc: The orignal value of SORTOrdType(15001) prior to it being changed.

12109.name: CFMReleasedPxQtyInd
12109.desc: Indicates that this order has been released by CFM and the price or quantity out-of-range check should be bypassed.

12110.name: GUIMsgVisibilityType
12110.desc: Instruction to a GUI as to whether this message should be displayed or not.

12111.name: MSPoolRecPxImprvType
12111.desc: Specifies the type of price improvement (PI) for an order received by MSPool.

12112.name: AutoMaxFloorInd
12112.desc:
Indicates to an engine or OM whether it should automatically apply a maxFloor 
when there is no maxFloor specified on the incoming order.

12113.name: PairsLimitOffsetCash
12113.desc: Specifies the cash offset factor used by the pairs engine algorithm to calculate limit prices for either of the pair legs.

12114.name: PairsLimitOffsetDividend
12114.desc: Specifies the dividend offset factor used by the pairs engine algorithm to calculate limit prices for either of the pair legs.

12117.name: PairsLimitOffsetCommType
12117.desc: Specifies the commission offset type used by the pairs engine algorithm to calculate limit prices for either of the pair legs.

12118.name: PairsLimitOffsetCurrInd
12118.desc: Indicates whether pairs engine algorithm requires currency normalization to calculate limit prices for either of the pair legs.

12119.name: PairsLimitOffsetComm
12119.desc: Specifies the commission offset factor used by the pairs engine algorithm to calculate limit prices for either of the pair legs.

12120.name: MorpheusStartStrategyKey
12120.desc: This is the GUI-recognised value that describes the starting strategy used within the overall Morpheus strategy.

12121.name: MorpheusEndStrategyKey
12121.desc: This is the GUI-recognised value that describes the ending strategy used within the overall Morpheus strategy.

12122.name: SSLMSysVersion
12122.desc: Specifies which version of the Short Sell Locate Management (SSLM) system the client short sell order would be verified against.

12123.name: ETFFees
12123.desc: Specifies the creation or redemption fees associated with an ETF deal.

12130.name: LadderSessionUUID
12130.desc: Unique Identifier for a session that has been opend in Hadron. A session defines the common state that can be applied to a number of ladder-collections.

12131.name: LadderCollectionUUID
12131.desc: Unique Identifier for the ladder collection

12132.name: LadderCollectionVID
12132.desc: Version number of the ladder collection

12133.name: LadderPriorityType
12133.desc: Priority of orders placing where there's a conflict e.g., when there are single option marke marking and option spread orders, single option MM orders would be in higer priority.

12134.name: LadderExecBehaviorType
12134.desc: Instruction on the behaviour in response to order filled event.

12135.name: NoLadderProductEntries
12135.desc: Number of ProductEntry in the Ladder

12136.name: NoLadderRungEntries
12136.desc: Number of Rungs entry for a given side of given product in a LadderCollection request

12137.name: LadderStatus
12137.desc: Indicates the overall status of the LadderCollection request

12140.name: AltLastCapacity
12140.desc: Specifies the lastCapacity value from other legal MS entity perspective when the value is different from lastCapacity(29) which is set from the executing MS entity perspective.

12141.name: AltLastCapacityCxtType
12141.desc: Indicates the MS legal entity on whose perspective AltLastCapacity(12140) is set.

12142.name: SliceQtyType
12142.desc: The type of value to be used for SliceQtyRatio(12143) when determining the quantity of order to be sent out, e.g. "TOTAL".

12143.name: SliceQtyRatio
12143.desc: Specifies the ratio of the quantity type (tag 12142) to be used when determining the quantity per order across a group of orders to be sliced out, e.g. "1" is 100% of the specified Type.

12144.name: MinCrossDuration
12144.desc: Used between NV and Cafe. Indicates the minimum length of time (in seconds) that an order would like to participate a cross round.

12145.name: CrossQty
12145.desc: This tag represents the crossing quantity used in MSLX crossing engine.

12146.name: CrossRoundDuration
12146.desc: This tag represents the length of the cross round of the participating order (in min) at MSLX engine.

12147.name: FXOoCExecutionBandType
12147.desc: Specifies the type for FXOoCExecutionBandValue(12148), either absolute or relative.

12148.name: FXOoCExecutionBandValue
12148.desc: For an out-of-currency order that has associated FX orders to remove the FX exposure, this specifies how often to create an FX for each band of executed notional. Can be relative or absolute, as specified in FXOoCExecutionBandType(12147).

12149.name: LadderRungEntryUUID
12149.desc: Unique identifier for the rung of a given product in a LadderCollection request.

12150.name: LastCustomStrategyName
12150.desc: The actual value of CustomStrategyName(11799) applicable to the Fill.

12151.name: ExchMemberType
12151.desc: Describes if a client is eligible for discounted exchange fees based on exchange membership status. The membership information is housed in A2, which during TC processing, has logic applied to determine if a particular trade is eligible for the discount.

12152.name: OrderTranslatedFromEOInd
12152.desc: Indicates that this Order was generated as a result of translating an existing ExecutionReport (EO) message. E.g. it should not be persisted in Athena as an Order, just use to determine the linkage to AllocationBlock.

12153.name: OwlPingDarkInd
12153.desc: Indicator to send short duration order for the initial slice, when the order is marketable and is being routed to a dark venue.

12154.name: OwlEnableBreatheInd
12154.desc: Indicator to enable the Breathe feature in Owl.

12155.name: OwlUseBreatheDestInd
12155.desc: Indicator to send the order to configured 'Breathe' destination instead of holding in a Pocket, when the order is in Breathe state.

12156.name: OwlBreatheHiThreshold
12156.desc: Specifies the percentage at which the order should go in to Breathe state if our executed volume exceeds this percentage of interval volume.

12157.name: OwlBreatheLoThreshold
12157.desc: Specifies the percentage at which the order should un-breathe if our executed volume falls below a certain percentage of interval volume.

12158.name: OwlBreatheInResponseToLitOnly
12158.desc: Indicator to exclude the executed volume from non-Lit markets for Breathe calculations.

12159.name: OwlBreatheTimeout
12159.desc: For a given order, specifies to clear the Breathe state irrespective of volume participation if the current time is more than a certain time since it went in to the Breathe state. Ex: 10s, 2m.

12160.name: OwlBreatheMktMoveInThreshold
12160.desc: Price threshold at which to clear the 'Breathe' state, if the market has moved in by a certain percentage or basis points since the order entered in to the Breathe state. Ex: 10bps

12161.name: OwlActiveTakePctQty
12161.desc: Percentage of available quantity to take from Lit market when the order is marketable. Range: 0-1

12162.name: OwlActiveTakeType
12162.desc: For a marketable order, specifies the type of action that that Owl will take.

12163.name: OwlActiveWaitTime
12163.desc: Indicates the wait time for the order to rest in dark pools before taking liquidity from lit market. Ex: 30s, 1m

12164.name: OwlActiveWaitTimeDeviation
12164.desc: Indicates the Random time deviation used for randomizing the wait time before going to lit market. Ex: 30s, 1

12165.name: ClPreOpenRejectOrdInd
12165.desc: Indicates the client's preference for their order to be rejected before market open. The default behavior of the system(e.g., Razer) is to queue orders and release when market opens rather than reject.

12166.name: BrokerDealerFlowInd
12166.desc: Indicates that this order is Broker Dealer flow.

12167.name: ClCorrectionFillDiscardInd
12167.desc: Indicates whether or not to send the corrected fills (other than Price or Qty corrections) back to the client.

12168.name: ClPriceScalingType
12168.desc: For BXS engine orders, contains the type of price scaling specified by the client.

12169.name: BXSClEnableStarterInd
12169.desc: Indicates the client's opting for an aggressive execution strategy and disregarding the price for executing a small quantity (e.g. 100 shares). This is done by enabling the strategy to cross the spread for a small quantity at effective time.

12170.name: CounterPtyExchAccount
12170.desc: In the case of a cross, this specifies the other side's account which they hold with the Exchange. E.g. for Taiwan, all orders must be sent with Exchange account attached for both sides, even when internally crossed.

12171.name: DomesticInvestorInd
12171.desc: For Korea and Taiwan markets, indicates whether this order is placed by a domestic investor. Blank value implies it's a foreign investor.

12172.name: RevenueRiskPct
12172.desc: Specifies what percentage of Executions used for this Allocation where "risk priced" from a revenue reporting perspective, i.e. the client was quoted a price for which the Trader was obliged to fill them at. Based on logic involving RiskFillReasonCode and

12174.name: BookRiskInSettlementCurrInd
12174.desc: Indicates that the price should be sent to the risk system, e.g. OMPK, using the settlement currency instead of the trading currency.

12175.name: BypassPxRangeChkInd
