12175.desc: Indicates that this order should bypass the default price range check in the market rule.

12176.name: ALPExecInd
12176.desc: Indicates that this trade was executed on an Alternative Liquidity Pool, e.g. MSPOOL. Required for trade reporting to SEHK.

12177.name: AggLimitCheckScopeInd
12177.desc: Indicates whether this order is in or out of scope for a buy/sell  aggregate limit check.

12178.name: NegotiatedIssueType
12178.desc: Describes the category of product used during a pre-sales pricing workflow, e.g. for RFQ flow. The product will not exist in P2 at this time until its full terms have been agreed and entered.

12179.name: BXSAllocatedBenchmarks
12179.desc: Where an order is sliced, with each slice having a different benchmark, this tag specifies the benchmark used and respective quantity for each of the slices. Concatenated in the following form, e.g. RBETWAP:1000,VWAP:2000

12180.name: LiffeProfTrdRoleType
12180.desc: Specifies whether the Trader sending this Liffe Prof Trade is an Initiator or a Reactor.

12181.name: RevenueRptBus
12181.desc: Business categorization of the order for revenue reporting purposes.

12182.name: AggRevenueRptBus
12182.desc: Business categorization of the block for revenue reporting purposes - aggregrated from the order level.

12183.name: DistanceUnit
12183.desc: Sets the user defined distance unit for Urgency Scaling (BXSOCUrgencyScaling)

12184.name: DistanceUnitFloor
12184.desc: Sets the floor of the distance unit (BXSOCUrgencyScaling)

12185.name: DistanceUnitCap
12185.desc: Sets the cap on the distance unit (BXSOCUrgencyScaling)

12188.name: BetaType
12188.desc: Type of Beta to be used (BXSOCUrgencyScaling)

12196.name: UseDynamicTPOV
12196.desc: Should the TPOV Benchmark be Dynamic (BXSOCUrgencyScaling)

12197.name: BXSLeggingRisk
12197.desc: Simple interface to drive the legging risk strategy (BXS)

12198.name: ImpactLimitType
12198.desc: The type of impact checking. 0 = Total (bps) impact of executed quantity plus mark to market of unexecuted quantity. 1= Realized (bps) impact of executed quantity.  2= Mark to market (bps) impact of unexecuted quantity using current prices. (BXSOCBasketLi

12199.name: ImpactLimitValue
12199.desc: The maximum impact you are willing to allow. Units of this value are as per Impact Limit Type (presently all impact limit types are measured in bps (BXSOCBasketLimit)

12200.name: CashBalanceMode
12200.desc: Simple interface to drive the cash balance strategy(BXSOCCashBalance)

12201.name: AnchorPOVBasedTarget
12201.desc: POVBasedTarget locked due to change in this THIC subscription where this THIC subscription is the one communicated by 11688 ThicSubscriptionKey

12202.name: NVCAFETrajectoryCrossRoutingType
12202.desc: Used to control NightVision routing to CAFE for trajectory crossing.

12203.name: SliceADVCapRatio
12203.desc: Specifies the ratio of each products ADV20(avg daily volume of last 20 days) which is used as a cap for calculating the slice for each products order quantity. e.g 0.05 of ADV20 of a product.

12204.name: SliceMinNumLots
12204.desc: Specifies the minimum quantity of a slice in units of lots.

12209.name: ClBuyToCoverPreserveInd
12209.desc: Indicates that this client has agreed with Swaps Desk that shares bought with their buy to cover orders can be preserved and used for subsequent short sell orders.

12210.name: ExecBuyToCoverPreservedInd
12210.desc: Indicates that this Execution is for a "buy-to-cover" order and shares with this execution have been preserved for a subsequent short sell order.

12211.name: BDOpenClose
12211.desc: For Broker Dealer flow, indicates whether the resulting position after a trade should be an opening position or closing position.

12212.name: TransitionCurrency
12212.desc: Specifies the transition currency to use when an FX has to trade through an intermediate currency in the middle. E.g. for a GBP-EUR FX, might want to use two FXs using USD transitional currency: GBP-USD and USD-EUR.

12213.name: BSEAvgPx
12213.desc: Calculated average price of all Fills from BSE on this Order

12214.name: NSEAvgPx
12214.desc: Calculated average price of all Fills from NSE on this Order

12215.name: BSECumQty
12215.desc: Total number of shares filled from BSE on this Order.

12216.name: NSECumQty
12216.desc: Total number of shares filled from NSE on this Order.

12217.name: TransitionCurrFXRate
12217.desc: Specifies the FX rate to use for the TransitionCurrency (12212).

12218.name: ClBypassOddLotHoldInd
12218.desc: Indicates the client's preference to bypass holding their odd lot orders in CFM for account managers to release.

12219.name: DirectToSORTInd
12219.desc: Indicates that this Order was routed directly to the SORT Engine, and was not sent through any intermediate Engines, e.g. BXS.

12220.name: ClientFixPortNumber
12220.desc: The FIX listening host and port of a process used for the client's FIX address.

12221.name: ParentOwnerId
12221.desc: The OwnerID(10018) of this Entity's parent, i.e. the hop before.

12222.name: NotionalMarketID
12222.desc: Provides the Market ID of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow).

12223.name: HidePortfolioFromGUI
12223.desc: Specifies a concatenated list of users (separated with ":") whose preference is for their GUI not to display the given Portfolio (i.e. hide it).

12224.name: OrdIndicativeFillReqdInd
12224.desc: Indicates that this Order should be acknowledged and indicatively filled, before being corrected when the real acknowledgement/fill is received.

12225.name: ClientInstrFileName
12225.desc: Specifies a file name from a client that contains trade and allocation instructions for this order.

12226.name: PoseidonTradeUUId
12226.desc: Unique identifier for a swaps trade entered in Poseidon - required for Vista to communicate back to Poseidon.

12228.name: SORTClPrefPassiveDests
12228.desc: When SORT is not able to fully fill an Order in its first choice of market, this specifies the client's choice of alternate "passive" markets to use instead. Comma-delimited list of destination names.

12229.name: SalesAmendReason
12229.desc: Specifies the reason for Sales amending an Order in the Sales system.

12239.name: ClipSizeType
12239.desc: Specifies the format in which ClipSize(10753) is represented.

12240.name: AggUnitPositionStopQty
12240.desc: Specifies the integer quantity of the agg unit position when the customer order is stopped in order to provide an indicative price back to the customer. Represents an agreement that the client will get that price or better.

12241.name: CashStrikeType
12241.desc: The type of price (e.g. VWAP, OPEN, CLOSE, etc.) to be used when locking-down ("striking") the price of a Program's Portfolio of Orders. Set along with StrikeTime (443).

12242.name: BXSFinishOrderInd
12242.desc: Instruction to BXS Engine to "finish" the order if it's not fully filled according to the desired benchmark, i.e. cross the spread with residual quantity.

12243.name: ClipSizeReferenceSide
12243.desc: When using a dynamic ClipSize(10753), specifies which side to use.

12244.name: NonStdSettlDateAmdInd
12244.desc: Indicates that the settlement cycle has been amended post-execution.

12245.name: PositionKeeperUpdateProcess
12245.desc: Hostname rocname of the OM process updating the Position Keeper, e.g. OMPK.

12246.name: RootOrderInd
12246.desc: Indicates that this Order is the root, i.e. the first in a chain where RootOrderUUId=OrderUUId.

12247.name: OTCWrapperType
12247.desc: Specifies the type of legal wrapper that describes the financial product used to wrap the exotic structure.

12248.name: OTCStructurerId
12248.desc: Identifies via his/her kerberosID the person responsible for structuring the associated OTC Deal.

12249.name: SORTAggressiveSlicePricing
12249.desc: Used by SORT to determine the pricing limits for the aggressive slice. Contains three components (colon delimited) - Base:Offset:Type, e.g. far:20:bps

12250.name: SingleLimitChkProcess
12250.desc: Identifies the process owner (host:port) that applied the limit check.

12251.name: ContraActOrderID
12251.desc: The Branch Sequence Number (10230=ActOrderID) for the counterparty of this Trade. Set when ActClearingType(10228) = [0GZ].

12252.name: ClOneSideTradingType
12252.desc: the client's instruction that if any order for the same symbol which has the opposite side to an order previously sent by them should be rejected.

12253.name: HedgeLkCommentField
12253.desc: Holds the CommentField (9709) on the hedge side of a synthetic swaps order, i.e. this will be a comment from the client available on the Firm hedge.

12254.name: TraderReportToCS2InstrType
12254.desc: Trader instruction to report this order as part of a group (level specified in the valid values) instead of individually, i.e. via CS2 as opposed to TRG.

12255.name: ClMarketDepthInst
12255.desc: the market depth specified by the client for the engine to queue orders.

12256.name: PairsName
12256.desc: Human entered and readable name to identify the two orders used in pairs trading. For a unique identifier, use PairsUUId(12257).

12257.name: PairsUUId
12257.desc: Unique identifier used in pairs trading to identify the two orders involved in the pairs strategy.

12258.name: BSEDayAvgPx
12258.desc: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

12259.name: BSEDayFilled
12259.desc: Indicates the number of fills from the BSE exchange.

12262.name: TCFigurationID
12262.desc: Unique identfier returned by the TC Swift process for each response of figuration data.

12266.name: NSEDayAvgPx
12266.desc: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

12267.name: NSEDayFilled
12267.desc: Indicates the number of fills from the NSE exchange.

12269.name: ReportedCommValue
12269.desc: Total commission amount from TC. If a value is entered in MFILL window, then the MFILL value will supersede the TC value.

12271.name: SettleTotalCommAmount
12271.desc: It is the ReportedCommValue(12269) in settlement currency.

12274.name: ShortSellStatus
12274.desc: Used by Korean,Taiwanese and Hongkong exchanges to indicate whether we need Short Sell locates for this client or not.

12275.name: AROID
12275.desc: Unique identifier in trades processing for the message.

12276.name: ARVID
12276.desc: Major version of the entity to be cross refed.

12277.name: ClAllowTrajectoryCrossInd
12277.desc: Client instruction that they allow for the the participation of their order in trajectory crossing. Assume default value of "Y".

12278.name: MBAObtrdRoutingType
12278.desc: Instruction for where MBA should route OBTRD (Order Book Trading) orders to.

12282.name: OriginLkSalesEO
12282.desc: Linkage to the EntityOID (10001) of the nearest SEO (i.e. EO with ExecOrdSubType(10416)="Sales") in a Flow-based trading chain.

12283.name: ETFDefaultValDate
12283.desc: Default settlement date to use for an ETF's underlying securities.

12284.name: BXSGlobalPortfolioInd
12284.desc: Instruction that this order should be routed to the global BXS-OC instance.

12285.name: LifecycleType
12285.desc: Describes the origin life cycle event that resulted in the creation of this trade or RFQ. e.g. This RFQ was entered in order to 'unwind' an existing position, or to 'Roll' a position that is about to expire.

12286.name: OriginalContracts
12286.desc: The original number of contracts in a previous trade, that this RFQ is unwinding.

12287.name: OriginalNotionalUsd
12287.desc: The original notional of a previous trade, that this RFQ is unwinding.

12288.name: TXDealState
12288.desc: XML Blob that has the OTCDB Booking state. Used to provide context when rebooking/life cycle events in RFQ.

12289.name: EnforceMinQtyInd
12289.desc: Reject the order if it is for a small quantity. This indicator is set on the basis of the client. Small quantity is defined by the downstream process.

12291.name: TradingPortfolioSource
12291.desc: Specifies the mechanism that was used to specify the set of orders used in trading (specified as a portfolio group).

12292.name: SealsReactionType
12292.desc: Seals Reaction type, for example POV.

12293.name: SealsSignalDriverOne
12293.desc: Seals engine signal driver one as determined by seals team.

12294.name: SealsSignalDriverTwo
12294.desc: Seals engine signal driver two as determined by seals team.

12295.name: SealsSignalDriverThree
12295.desc: Seals engine signal driver three as determined by seals team.

12296.name: SealsSignalDriverFour
12296.desc: Seals engine signal driver four as determined by seals team.

12297.name: SealsSignalDriverFive
12297.desc: Seals engine signal driver five as determined by seals team.

12298.name: SealsSignalDriverSix
12298.desc: Seals engine signal driver six as determined by the seals team.

12301.name: SwapHedgeType
12301.desc: Where SwapHedgeInd(11763)=Y, this tag further defines the scenario resulting in the hedge being created, i.e. what type of swaps hedge this order is for.

12302.name: FXCurrencyFlipInd
12302.desc: Indicates that the incoming FX order has had its currency-pair 'flipped' to represent the order in the opposite direction (i.e. trading currency becomes settlement currency, side and quantity change).

12303.name: RiskFillResidualClQtyInd
12303.desc: Indicates that any outstanding residual quantity for the client order should be risk filled.

12304.name: SORTUseMktOnCloseInd
12304.desc: Instruction to SORT to invoke Funari-like behaviour (40=I), i.e. execute the order's residual quantity at market price during close.

12305.name: ClLastMktType
12305.desc: Specifies the format that should be used in LastMkt (30) tag returned to the client

12306.name: FXCurrFlipLkOID
12306.desc: Links this FX Order to its parent Order where the currency pair has been "flipped" (i.e. side, quantity and rate change to represent the equivalent FX Order in the opposite direction).

12307.name: CompoQuanto
12307.desc: Specifies the type of compo (composite) or quanto (quantity adjusting) option used for this instrument.

12308.name: StrikingTimeType
12308.desc: Specifies when the striking time applies to this instrument.

12309.name: VontobelUnitCalc
12309.desc: Convention for unit calculation used for specifying the instrument in Vontobel Deritrade transactions.

12310.name: AsianCalcType
12310.desc: Specifies the type of calculation to use for an Asian option.

12311.name: NoAsianDates
12311.desc: Number of entries in an AsianDates repeating group.

12312.name: AsianDate
12312.desc: Date on which Underlying price/s (close) is monitored for an Asian option.

12313.name: UnderlyingStrikeValueType
12313.desc: Method used to calculate the underlying strike price for an Option.

12314.name: BarrierValueType
12314.desc: Method used to calculate the Barrier level (9131 = BarrierLevel) for a Barrier option.

12315.name: BarrierMonitoringStyle
12315.desc: Method used for monitoring a Barrier option.

12318.name: BarrierRebateValueType
12318.desc: Method used to calculate the rebate (9135 = BarrierRebate) for a Barrier option.

12319.name: BarrierValueType2
12319.desc: Method used to calculate the second Barrier level (9137 = BarrierLevel2) for a Barrier option.

12320.name: BarrierStyle2
12320.desc: Style of the second barrier for double Barrier options.

12321.name: BarrierDirection2
12321.desc: Designates the direction in which the second barrier needs to be crossed to activate the option for double Barrier options.

12322.name: BarrierRebateValueType2
12322.desc: Method used to calculate the second rebate (9137 = BarrierLevel2) for a double Barrier option.

12323.name: UnderlyingDecimals
12323.desc: Number of decimals to which strikes, barriers and underlying price should be rounded for options.

12324.name: UdlQtyCalc
12324.desc: Convention for calculation underlying quantity out of face value for options.

12325.name: CombiPriceType
12325.desc: Method used to calculate the CombiPrice(12326) for a combination of option instruments priced and traded together.

12326.name: CombiPrice
12326.desc: Price for a combination of option instruments priced and traded together.

12327.name: Seekparameter
12327.desc: Defines which parameter is the unknown for options.

12328.name: QuotedValueQteType
12328.desc: Indicates whether a quoted price is an indication or tradable.

12329.name: UdlMinTradeVol
12329.desc: The minimum trading volume for the underlying security.

12330.name: UdlMaxTradeVol
12330.desc: The maximum trading volume for the underlying security.

12331.name: UdlMaxStrikingDate
12331.desc: Max Offset added to current trading day until the last possible striking can take place. Omitted, if only strking 'at market'/now is possible.

12332.name: UdlMinMaturity
12332.desc: Min Offset added to current trading day until the first possible maturity.

12333.name: UdlMaxMaturity
12333.desc: Max Offset added to current trading day until the last possible maturity.

12334.name: ORScaleFactor
12334.desc: Specifies the price scaling factor that the OR would use to communicate with flowOM. This factor is different per product. Used only when ScalePrice (10577) is not set by upstream.

12335.name: OwlPingDarkDuration
12335.desc: Client specified duration to ping the dark venue when OwlPingDarkInd(12153) = Y.

12336.name: AggExchangeAccount
12336.desc: Where a number of client orders with individual ExchangeAccounts(7302) are aggregated, this allows for the setting of an ExchangeAccount separately on the outgoing aggregate order.

12337.name: PAIRSPerfLimitReferencePrice
12337.desc: The reference price to use for Pairs trading using Performance Spread policies.

12338.name: BookingOrderUUId
12338.desc: OrderUUId to use for a synthesised 'Booking' EO.

12339.name: CloseAuctionRptType
12339.desc: Indicates the type of reports for orders sent to the Closing Auction on Options Expiry Day in Korea.

12340.name: BOCRejectPrice
12340.desc: Captures the rejected price by BOC to determine a new price for retry

12341.name: SORTSkipPrimaryInd
12341.desc: Indication to the SORT Engine that the primary market should not be included for the liquidity seek for this order, e.g. so as not to breach LSE's minimum order size threshold.

12342.name: MakeTicketInd
12342.desc: Indicator from the GUI that this entity is newly created as a result of a "make ticket" request, e.g. a new UPR is created to which an EO is reparented from a previous 'dummy client' UPR.

12343.name: PendingCrossCurve
12343.desc: OC to CAFE Communication protocol. This is the trajectory of the pending crossing round.

12344.name: ClDisableMBXCrossingInd
12344.desc: Client instruction to disable their order being crossed specifically in MBX (a legacy crossing engine).

12345.name: GUIGenericAccount
12345.desc: Placeholder tag for a GUI to stamp an account irrespective of the scenario (e.g. agency, prop, risk, deriv etc.). The OM is then responsible for copying this value into the appropriate account field used in communication with other processes/downstream.

12346.name: SSPriceCheckInd
12346.desc: Indicates whether or not to bypass Short Sell price check (i.e fill price must be above short sell order price). Short Sell price check rule is not required for crossing scenarios.

12347.name: ClMSCustodianInd
12347.desc: Indicates whether MS is the custodian of the shares for the client on a per order basis.

12348.name: CommMgmtVId
12348.desc: Version number in trades processing for the commission management adjustment message.

12349.name: TotalCrossCurve
12349.desc: CAFE to OE Communication protocol. This is the trajectory detailing all crosses CAFE has done plus any pending rounds.

12350.name: UserRequestType
12350.desc: This tag will be stamped on 35=UR message to indicate the purpose the the message.

12351.name: UpdateORState
12351.desc: Indicates whether during the Multiday order reconciliation, OR should overwrite it's existing state with the one specified in the recovery-reconciliation message(35=UR;12185=M).

12352.name: ClCommMgmtOrdQty
12352.desc: Portion of the client order that should be managed as part of their CSA (Commission Sharing Agreement) - aka soft dollar - expressed as a number of shares.

12353.name: LastMarketTradeAttr
12353.desc: Identifies additional trade attributes associated with particular markets at the fill level. Uses same valid values as MarketTradeAttr(10378). This field will primarily be used to calculate certain exchange fees.

12354.name: PriceScaleType
12354.desc: Specifies the particular scale used for a price.

12355.name: OrigLastMkt
12355.desc: The original value of LastMkt(30) before it was changed.

12356.name: FXAggregationType
12356.desc: Specifies how FX trades should (or should not) be aggregated before being routed downstream for booking.

12357.name: ForceRouteToVista
12357.desc: Override the normal booking model and route this message to Vista. Used by Booker.

12358.name: BXSQRExperimentWaveId
12358.desc: Human-readable identifier used to group orders in either the control set or the experimental set, belonging to a single quantitative research experiment (both sets have same SliceID(11289)).

12359.name: TCIsCascadableInd
12359.desc: Indicates whether a trade can be cascaded in TC, allowing the cascades to pass the TC Age Limit rule set if trade date > 90 days.

12360.name: OTCProductVId
12360.desc: Version of an OTC product (where IDSource(22)=162). The product template can be updated at various stages with new product parameters. The versionID (as determined by the TX ProductService / OTCDB) controls this versioning.

12361.name: ExchangeCumQty
12361.desc: Total number of shares filled from exchange on this order excluding shares filled from internal destinations such as MSPOOL.

12362.name: EvaluationUUId
12362.desc: Common identifier across a group of orders relating to the same decision made by a trading Engine.

12363.name: ContraPnLAccount
12363.desc: P&L Account number for execution commission paid out to an executing broker. It has different usage on different levels: Block: Indicative. Allocation: actual commission & Block override.

12364.name: AggTNL
12364.desc: Where a number of client orders with individual TradingNameLocID(10197) are aggregated, this allows for the setting of a TradingNameLocID separately on the outgoing aggregate order.

12365.name: AggClientID
12365.desc: Where a number of client orders with individual ClientID(109) are aggregated, this allows for the setting of a ClientID separately on the outgoing aggregate order.

12366.name: SSOrdTypeCheckInd
12366.desc: Indicates whether or not to bypass Short Sell Order Type check (i.e a market order is restricited to trade for short sell in Japan). Short Sell ordType check rule is not required for ROR orders.

12367.name: GTCRenewalTime
12367.desc: The time (in UTC) when "Good Till" Renewal happens on a native GTC order. Used to set InitEntryTime whenever the database needs to model the native GTC as multiple day orders.

12368.name: BXSLOWProblemUUId
12368.desc: Unique ID for each BXSOC slice (AKA "Problem") that BXSOE LOW (Limit Order Worker) works on.

12369.name: BXSLOMViewerUUId
12369.desc: Unique ID that BXSOE LOW (Limit Order Worker) uses to update LOM (Limit Order Model) Viewer in terms of identifying a particular trajectory data and executing status.

12370.name: BXSLOWDecisionTimestamp
12370.desc: Time of each slice that BXSOE generates (AKA "Decision Time").

12371.name: InvAllocResultType
12371.desc: Specifies the result of the swaps Inventory Allocation check for this order

12372.name: ApplyLimitCheckInd
12372.desc: Indicates that this order needs to have a limit check applied (e.g. ETSLIMIT).

12373.name: CPFId
12373.desc: Links this order to a corresponding CPF (Controlled Product Framework) Id, which identifies the structured product it belongs to. CPF Id is stored in OTCDB.

12374.name: THClShareConvertInd
12374.desc: Specifically for Thailand cash market. Indicates client instruction that the order should be converted from local shares to foreign shares (assuming liquidity permits).

12375.name: LastDarkVenue
12375.desc: Specifies the last dark venue the Order was routed to, irrespective of whether the order ultimately got further routed and filled, e.g. on-exchange cross.

12376.name: TRptHoldReportDuration
12376.desc: Time that TRG should hold the report for before reporting.

12377.name: ProcessRunTimeEnvType
12377.desc: Indicates what type of running time environment this order is being handled by.

12378.name: BXSMdExch
12378.desc: Specifies what kind of market data the BXS Engines (e.g. BXS-OC/OE) are using. Maps to BXS_STAT's column and used by GUI visualizers to draw the market data curve.

12380.name: NotionalOrderQuantity
12380.desc: Provides the quantity (38) of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow).

12381.name: NotionalOrderType
12381.desc: Provides the order type (40) of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow).

12382.name: NotionalOrderPrice
12382.desc: Provides the price (44) of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow).

12383.name: NotionalStepUpPrice
12383.desc: Provides the step-up price of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow). StepUpPrice used specifically for ISE Orders.

12384.name: NotionalBrokerPct
12384.desc: Provides the broker percent of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow). BrokerPct used specifically for ISE Orders.

12385.name: TickValue
12385.desc: A market's tick value is the cash value of one tick (one minimum price movement).

12386.name: FXBookingAccountType
12386.desc: Specific to FX Order Management which is not connected to TC to derive accounts. Used to indicate to the FX Booking component which account to use.

12388.name: OrdPlrSalesCapMtd
12388.desc: For a trade given-in to Morgan Stanley to settle and clear, specifies the mechanism used to submit orders to the Broker who executed the Order (i.e. the give-up Broker). Uses same valid values as SalesCaptureMethod(10365).

12389.name: SORTBestPrimaryMktQuote
12389.desc: Records the price of the best untaken quote on the primary Exchange for the security at the time SORT made the decision to trade (on a different market).

12390.name: BXSSlicePlacementTime
12390.desc: The time that a BXS slice is created or replaced, in GMT format, used to pass to Quantitative Research (QR) library for optimization processing.

12391.name: OwnerIDType
12391.desc: Specifies the role of the person who owns the current version of the entity (as identified in OwnerID(10018)).

12393.name: BXSClBypassHighLowComplete
12393.desc: Client instruction for BXS (TED) to bypass high/low complete behaviour.

12394.name: OrderRejectInstrType
12394.desc: Instruction from an upstream component that performs checks that the Engine receiving this Order should reject it for the reason specified in the code.

12396.name: ClAlgoStartPrice
12396.desc: Client instruction for start price, sent on incoming order to define a custom algorithm.

12397.name: ClAlgoEndPrice
12397.desc: Client instruction for end price, sent on incoming order to define a custom algorithm.

12398.name: ClAlgoIncrement
12398.desc: Client instruction for pricing increment, sent on incoming order to define a custom algorithm.

12399.name: ClDirectedOrderDeskInd
12399.desc: Client instruction that this order should be directed to a specific desk.

12400.name: InitExchClOrdId
12400.desc: Value of the first version of exchClOrdID(10550) for this Order.

12401.name: ReconcileWithExchInd
12401.desc: Instruction to OR whether to reconcile with Exchange by sending and receiving order status messages or just simulate reconciliation by generating successful response.

12402.name: IWouldDarkMaxLookaheadTime
12402.desc: This tag is to control how long (in seconds) IWouldDark can lookahead to calculate the quantity in dark venue. Used for BXS's IWouldDark strategy.

12403.name: IWouldDarkMaxBoundQty
12403.desc: This tag is uesd to control how much quantity are allowed to trade in TED, the rest quantity will be sent to dark venue. Used for BXS's IWouldDark strategy.

12404.name: ClConnCurrFXQty
12404.desc: Order quantity as specified in ClConnCurr as opposed to the currency used internally within the plant.

12405.name: CabinetOptionInd
12405.desc: Indicates whether an option is traded out of the money and hence has an invalid price from the exchange (e.g 999999) also known as Cabinet Options.

12406.name: IWouldDarkMaxCrossQty
12406.desc: The max quantity that an IWould order can send to POOL in total. Used for BXS's IWouldDark strategy.

12407.name: IWouldDarkMaxCrossPct
12407.desc: The max percentage of an IWould order that it can be crossed in POOL. Used for BXS's IWouldDark strategy.

12408.name: IWouldDarkMinCrossQty
12408.desc: The minimum quantity that POOL should cross. Used for BXS's IWouldDark strategy.

12409.name: MIRequestUUId
12409.desc: Unique identifer (UUId) for a user's manual intervention request.

12411.name: BXSClLOWInst
12411.desc: Client instructions for customizing parameters for BXS VWAP LOW benchmark strategy, e.g. the weight of ticket costs, the tolerance on falling behind, etc.

12412.name: DarkCumQty
12412.desc: Total quantity filled on an order that was executed on a dark pool

12413.name: BXSEveningSessionInd
12413.desc: Indicates to BXS Engine that this Order participated only in the Evening Session

12414.name: NativeExchPrice
12414.desc: Price of the Fill as given by the Exchange, i.e. without any scaling logic applied.

12415.name: ClClientFlowType
12415.desc: Describes the type of flow from the perspective of the client who is submitting the order to Morgan Stanley (i.e. not how we describe the flow, which would be ClientFlowType(10772)).

12416.name: SalesBasketValue
12416.desc: Total USD value of a Sales Basket (same PortfolioID(7275)) for a Programs list.

12417.name: SalesBasketNoOrders
12417.desc: Number of Orders in a the Sales Basket (same PortfolioID(7275)) for a Programs list.

12418.name: ClValueDateInst
12418.desc: Client instruction at the order level as to what settlement date they would like for Fills on that order.

12419.name: ClValueDateMtdInst
12419.desc: Client instruction at the order level as to what settlement date method they would like for Fills on that order.

12420.name: OrderProtectInd
12420.desc: Client preference for what level of protection they want for this order has under FINRA's Manning Rule.

12421.name: RBERejectRsnOverrideInd
12421.desc: Instruction to RBE to override a failed check (as specified in RBERejectRsnType(12423)) and execute the order anyway.

12422.name: CancelIfNotImmediatelyCrossedInd
12422.desc: Indication to a crossing engine that unless the Order is scheduled (crossed) immediately, it should not be queued for later re-evaluation but rather cancelled back to the requestor.

12423.name: RBERejectRsnType
12423.desc: Reason that RBE Engine rejected or cancelled an order.

12424.name: EncodedSalesCoverage
12424.desc: Encoded representation of Sales client coverage infomation in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding field.

12425.name: EncodedSalesCoverageLen
12425.desc: Byte length of encoded EncodedSalesCoverage(12424) field.

12427.name: NotionalExContractCode
12427.desc: Provides the exContractCode(10826) of the Notional Order associated with this Leg Order (for multileg flow).

12428.name: TWAPTotalSliceQty
12428.desc:
The total sliced quantity in a scheduled TWAP order. E.g. if request is for 10 slices and quantity 10
, then 10 TWAP slices of quantity 1 each would be generated.

12429.name: EngineDestHardRejectInd
12429.desc: When an Engine receives a rejection for an Order sliced to a particular destination, this tag indicates that the Engine should not reconsider sending further slices for that order to the same destination.

12430.name: BXSTailPincherThreshold
12430.desc: Specifies the tail pincher percentage (value between 0 and 1) for BXS to use.

12431.name: PositionResidualType
12431.desc: Defines a position's behavior around residual quantity when a slice is created or replaced.

12432.name: OrderMarketabilityType
12432.desc: Indicates whereabouts in the market this Order is currently priced at.

12433.name: CrossPointClientEligibleInd
12433.desc: Indicates whether the order is eligible for automated liquidity.

12434.name: BXSIndicAuctionnOpenCapInd
12434.desc: Indicates to apply indicative auction volume cap logic for opening auction in BXS strategies.

12435.name: OrigSalesBusLine
12435.desc: The previous SalesBusLine(10152) before it was changed e.g TC booker normalizes the original SBL value for Halo and this tag will be used to capture the original value before modification so as to aid reports such as OEDM.

12436.name: CrossingRoundConclusionRsnCode
12436.desc: Specifies the reason code why a crossing Engime terminated a crossing round earlier than scheduled.

12437.name: LDExecChargeComm
12437.desc: This is the LD execution commission.Temporary tag for Vista to be able to get around repeating group processing. Maps to chargeSubType=292, chargeType=3.

12438.name: LDExecChargeFormula
12438.desc: Charge formula to use alongside LDExecChargeComm(12437). Same valid values as ChargeFormula(10054). Temporary tag for Vista to be able to get around repeating group processing.

12439.name: OrderProtectOverrideInd
12439.desc: Indicates that Trader has overriden FINRA's Manning Order Protection rule on a client order (OrderProtectInd(12420)=Y) and has created and routed a prop/facilitation order.

12440.name: OrderProtectOverrideRsn
12440.desc: Reason for Trader overriding FINRA's Manning Order Protection rule on a client order (OrderProtectOverrideInd(12439)=Y).

12446.name: OptionExpiryPeriodType
12446.desc: Identifies what period of time this option expires on.

12447.name: ContactClientInd
12447.desc: Indicates that the client for this Order should be directly contacted either before its execution (Sales person "call before") or after its execution (Trader "call after").

12448.name: IWantMaxPct
12448.desc: The maximum percentage of quantity RBE can send into the lit market to execute aggresively

12449.name: AccruedInterestChargeAmount
12449.desc: Represents the accrued interest on a reverse convert as a charge. Temporary tag for Vista to be able to get around repeating group processing. Maps to chargeSubType=165, chargeType=13.

12450.name: AccruedInterestChargeFormula
12450.desc: Charge formula to use alongside AccruedInterestChargeAmount(12449). Same valid values as ChargeFormula(10054). Temporary tag for Vista to be able to get around repeating group processing.

12451.name: RootOrderID
12451.desc: The OrderID(37) of the first (root) Order in a chain of linked order slices.

12452.name: InitListID
12452.desc: The first version of ListID(66) on a sequence of related messages, e.g. the initial ListID given in the first 35=E ListOrder message.

12453.name: ProductDeliveryCode
12453.desc: Product grouping attribute used for settlement, based on the product's country of issue and settlement location (international or domestic). Data source is P2.

12454.name: SmartQtyInst
12454.desc: Instruction to any downstream Engine to specify the minimum Fill quantity that should be used, either as a notional amount or number of shares, including the currency used (i.e. value is alphanumeric). Has to be parsed internally by the Engine.

12455.name: IntendedExecBrokerGroup
12455.desc: Identifies the executing broker group that this order is intended for. (Actual should go into ExecBroker(76)).

12456.name: DivSwapStartDate
12456.desc: For dividend OTC swaps, this specifies the date when the swap begins to pay out

12457.name: GrossDivSwapPct
12457.desc: For dividend OTC swaps, this specifies the percentage of the dividend that is paid out to the client.

12458.name: LastExchRoutStrat
12458.desc: The ExchRoutingStrat(11338) that actually got applied at the Fill level.

12459.name: SFEFillInterval
12459.desc: Instruction to Synthetic Fill Engine (SFE) for the time interval in seconds that it should send fills at.

12460.name: MSETProgramTradingInd
12460.desc: Indicates that this Order is considered part of a Program Trade by the MSET desk. Definition of MSET PT flow is a wave of N orders being sent in at the same time. The threshold is 15 orders and a 1 minute time interval

12461.name: ATSOrderSeqNumber
12461.desc: Sequence number that determines the time priority of an order in an ATS. To comply with Finra Rule 4554B: add Unique Sequence Number (/ Per Symbol) on all reports out of POOL

12462.name: PTOverfillAccountProfile
12462.desc: Specifies the Account Profile for the OM to use when an overfill scenario occurs. Used specifically by Programs Trading and maps to A2 entry.

12463.name: DarkOrLiteFillVenue
12463.desc: Indicate the fill is from a dark venue or a lite venue, routed as part of IWould or IWant strategies

12464.name: EGUSAgreementId
12464.desc: Agreement Id set-up in the EGUS third-party system for managing give-up agreements between brokers.

12465.name: CancelOrHoldInd
12465.desc: To indicate if the unfinished order should be cancelled back or held and fill manually

12466.name: AggLegListingCurr
12466.desc: Specifies the currency that ICEMAN will use on a final aggregated leg it generates, when it aggregates together trades that are in restricted currency.

12467.name: OTCDealLifeCycleEventType
12467.desc: Specifies the lifecycle event that happened on an OTC Deal that resulted in this trade being processed and booked via TC.

12468.name: BXSPositionType
12468.desc: When an Execution occurs outside of the normal schedule within the BXS set of components, this tag describes the type of position event that occured so that the upstream engines can properly adjust their frame of reference.

12469.name: IWouldDarkMinCross
12469.desc: Minimum value of quantity to be sent to Dark Pool for "IWould" strategy

12471.name: BXSScalingTPOVAbsPrice
12471.desc: The absolute price to use when BXSScalingTPOVRef(12079)=8 [Absolute]

12472.name: BXSUseMktOnCloseInd
12472.desc: Instruction to the BXS Engine to use a market order type in the closing auction.

12473.name: BXSUseOptimizedTWAPInd
12473.desc: Instruction to the BXS Engine when trading a TWAP strategy, which version of TWAP benchmark to use.

12474.name: PoolSmartMinQty
12474.desc: Instruction to MSPool only to specify the minimum Fill quantity that should be used, either as a notional amount or number of shares, including the currency used (i.e. value is alphanumeric). Has to be parsed internally by the Engine.

12475.name: SourceTopic
12475.desc: For multicasting infrastructure, specifies the source topic which sent the message. Used by Velocity for 29West.

12476.name: DestinationTopic
12476.desc: For multicasting infrastructure, specifies the destination topic which the message is intended for. Used by Velocity for 29West.

12477.name: OwlActiveAggressiveness
12477.desc: Instruction from client to specify how aggressive they want the Owl medium urgency order to be.

12478.name: AccountShortCode
12478.desc: A short code for a client account. Maps to A2 database's A2Account.shortCode.

12479.name: FXTraderMnemonic
12479.desc: Shorthand non-kerberos identifier for a Trader used internally within FX processes and GUIs.

12482.name: ViperFillScopeInd
12482.desc: Determines whether or not the fill has already been written to the Viper database

12483.name: SSLocateLevelType
12483.desc:
Specifies at which level the process acting on this message should perform a locate check on.
Valid values: P = Doing locate validation at Position; S = Doing locate validation at Slice (Order); N = Locate validation does not apply on this process.

12484.name: IOIRecommededInd
12484.desc: Indicates a recommendation that IOIs should be sent off the back of this order.

12485.name: IOIRecmdDecayStratType
12485.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), specifies a decay strategy to be used.

12486.name: IOIRecommendedPOV
12486.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), specifies a PercentOfVolume to be used.

12487.name: IOIRecommendedComments
12487.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), specifies addition comments to include on the IOI.

12488.name: IOIRecommendedQtyType
12488.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), specifies which quantity type to use on the IOI.

12489.name: BXSIntendedAuctionQty
12489.desc: Dynamically calculated quantity that BXS Order Executor (BXS-OE) has open on an auction and is reported to the BXS Order Schedular (BXS-OC).

12490.name: BXSOutActionQty
12490.desc: Total cumulative quantity that BXS Order Executor (BXS-OE) got filled in an auction at the time it expired or was cancelled.

12491.name: FXInternalDestType
12491.desc: Specifies for FX flow the allowed destinations an order can be executed on.

12492.name: SORTExclQuotes
12492.desc: A comma separated list of destinations SORT should exclude getting market data quotes for. Not applicable to RegNMS protected destinations, e.g. ignored if in the list. This is an instruction that is sent by Client.

12493.name: PrevLastShares
12493.desc: Previous quantity of a fill that is referred by execRefID(19) - to be used in cancel/correct scenarios.

12494.name: PrevLastPx
12494.desc: Previous price of a fill that is referred by execRefID(19) - to be used in cancel/correct scenarios

12496.name: BXSFixedIntervalInd
12496.desc: Instruction to BXS for any strategy to release orders using a fixed time interval.

12497.name: UnderlyingRefPrices
12497.desc: A comma delimited list of <product=reference price> pairs for the underlying products of an option leg/s for a structured product.

12498.name: RFQCompetingDealers
12498.desc: When Morgan Stanley receives an RFQ (Request For Quote), this specifies the number of other brokers in competition for the trade.

12499.name: IOIRecommendedInst
12499.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), provides additional reasons to qualify IOI use.

12500.name: P2LastMIC
12500.desc: MIC code to use for P2 product lookup where there are multiple possible execution venues.

12501.name: HALORoundingRuleId
12501.desc: Gives the Rounding Rule Id used in HALO for the figuration calculation used for this Order/Fill.

12502.name: HALORoundRuleName
12502.desc: Gives the Rounding Rule Name used in HALO for the figuration calculation used for this Order/Fill.

12503.name: AuctionID
12503.desc: Specifies the id associated with the auction that this exchange slice is intended for. Value would be a number in the range from 0 to 10.

12504.name: LDTradeType
12504.desc: Indicates the LD (Listed Deriv) trade type.

12505.name: PositionCalcType
12505.desc: Indicates if a CashMovement msg from TC to LD VM( Listed Deriv Variation Margin) calc engine is an initialized message with existing position using OTE calc method or not. This is to migrate existing open position in LD systems to renovated VM model.

12506.name: CashAccrueRealised
12506.desc: Indicates if an account is Accrued or Realized for Variation Margin.

12507.name: CashMovementSource
12507.desc: Indicates what is the source of CashMovement message

12508.name: StrikeMatchOrdLimitPx
12508.desc: Additional minimum limit price for a Strike Match buy order or maximum price for a Strike Match sell order. E.g. as used by Xetra.

12509.name: ClAcceptUndisclosedOrdInd
12509.desc: Client instruction as to whether they are prepared to accept an undisclosed order as counterpart to their order.

12510.name: GUIEnteredExpireTimeTZ
12510.desc: Specifies the timezone for the GUI to use for ExpireTime(126) (can be different to the timezone the OM uses).

12511.name: GUIEnteredEffectiveTimeTZ
12511.desc: Specifies the timezone for the GUI to use for EffectiveTime(168) (can be different to the timezone the OM uses).

12512.name: SidebySideMSApprvrReqInd
12512.desc: Indicator that approval is required before routing this order to another desk because to comply with order protection rules the other desk would cancel all open principal orders in the same product and side.  The approval is stored in 11170.

12513.name: Gamma
12513.desc: Denotes the rate of change of Delta(11160) in response to the underlier price movement.

12514.name: RefOptionPx
12514.desc: Initial Option BasePrice provided by the client for OptionDelta Adjust strategy.Strategy adjusts limit price of the option realtime to changes in market price of underlier.

12515.name: RefSpotPx
12515.desc: The underlier reference price optionally provided by the client for OptionDelta Adjust strategy corresponding to the DeltaAdjBasePx (12514).

12516.name: DeltaAdjustUnderlierMaxPx
12516.desc: The upper limit of the DeltaAdjustUnderlierBasePx(12515) optionally provided by the client for OptionDelta Adjust strategy. Depending on the client preference this will be some percentage of the arrival price.

12517.name: DeltaAdjustUnderlierMinPx
12517.desc: The lower limit of the DeltaAdjustUnderlierBasePx(12515) optionally provided by the client for OptionDelta Adjust strategy. Depending on the client preference this will be some percentage of the arrival price.

12518.name: LimitChkLiquidProductInd
12518.desc: Indicates an assessment by Risk and Trading Desk's that this product is considered by them to be liquid. Used to determine limit checking parameters.

12519.name: AxeId
12519.desc: Identifer for an Axe (the interest a person or trader shows in buying or selling a security).

12520.name: OTCDBIssuanceDtlUUId
12520.desc: Reference Id (UUId) to OTCDB's IssuanceDetails field which holds issuance details for the Deal relating to this Order.

12521.name: LMERollingPromptType
12521.desc: Identifies the type of Rolling Contract to be used for this London Metal Exchange (LME) Order.

12523.name: BXSScalingTPOVPriceRange
12523.desc: The price scale range (0 to 1) from reference price as specified in BXSScalingTPOVRef(12079)

12524.name: CounterpartyForeignInvestorID
12524.desc: The Investor Id of the counterparty of this order for foreign investors trading on Korea or Taiwan markets

12525.name: IOIRecommendedQty
12525.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), specifies a recommended quantity to use (when IOIRecommendedQtyType(12488)=3)

12526.name: PairsNotionalOrderId
12526.desc: Strictly internal to Pairs Engine. The Id will be used for application to locate the PairsNotionalOrder within the application.

12527.name: HybridOrdInd
12527.desc: Indicates that this Order's Fills can be allocated as a combination of swap, give-up or cash.

12528.name: CorporateActionDesc
12528.desc: Description of the Corporate Action taking place. The type of Corporate Action can be specified in CorporateAction(292).

12530.name: PassTheBookInd
12530.desc: Indicates that this Order has been "passed on" and ownership transferred from a Desk in one region to a Desk in another region.

12532.name: allegedTradeReportInd
12532.desc: Indicate that this trade report is alleged(unsolicited) from exchange or external venue.

12533.name: exchTradeReportOID
12533.desc: Unique identifer of a Exchange Trade Report(35=UETR) message.

12534.name: exchTradeReportVID
12534.desc: Version number of a Exchange Trade Report(35=UETR) message.

12535.name: AltCrossRef
12535.desc: The alternative cross reference which will be sent to Australia Stock Exchange for the crossing report. Cross Reference is a referenceID that stands for a client and is used to identify trades on exchange terminal and IRESS(3rd party vendor system).

12536.name: BXSIntendedFinalDest
12536.desc: Indicate the final destination within distributed engine plant (BXSOE|MBA|TED) decided at BXS-OC level

12537.name: LMERingCode
12537.desc: Defines trading session at LME. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12539.name: LMEPriceType
12539.desc: Describes pricing type (Average, Current or Historic). Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12540.name: LMEVenue
12540.desc: Describes how order is placed (BASIS RING, OTC, RING, SELECT, TELEPHONE). Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12541.name: LME4WayAgreement
12541.desc: Applicable to TRANSFER SEND and TRANSFER RECEIVE trades only, indicates whether the LME agreement required for metal swaps has been completed. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12542.name: LMEVolatility
12542.desc: Value entered in Duke for Options describing volatility. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12543.name: LMEIsTapo
12543.desc: Indicates whether contract is Traded Average Price Option (based on LME Monthly Average Settlement Price). Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12544.name: LMECarryCount
12544.desc: Count indicating the number of legs in the carry. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12545.name: LMECodeDiff
12545.desc: Defines how the price is calculated (time of published price) + spread. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME).

12546.name: BlockOrderInd
12546.desc: Indicates that this order is considered a block order for the particular market it's being executed on.

12547.name: TRptPrice
12547.desc: Gives the price used on the trade report sent to the Exchange or Regulator.

12548.name: TRptCurr
12548.desc: Gives the currency used on the trade report sent to the Exchange or Regulator. This attribute applies to TRptPrice (12547).

12549.name: IWouldLitPassiveInd
12549.desc: Enables additional functionality of posting a passive order in the order book at the I would limit when using BXS's IWouldInLit strategy (IWantEnabledInd(11036)=Y).

12550.name: OutofSequenceInd
12550.desc: Indicates to the downstream system that this particular message is delivered out of sequence so that the downstream system can handle it accordingly.

12551.name: SORTAccessAltOnAuction
12551.desc: Client instruction to SORT Engine that order can access alternative venues when Auction/Special Quote happens

12552.name: ViperOrderScopeInd
12552.desc: Determines the linkage and whether or not the order messages have been written to the Viper database

12553.name: BXSAuctionParticipationRate
12553.desc: Where BXS-OE deviates from an auction schedule, BXS-OC needs to pass down the scheduled auction participation rates to BXS-OE so it knows how to execute accordingly.

12554.name: FXMnlInterventionType
12554.desc: Enumeration to describe a manual user action applied to an FX order, e.g. via a SOAP call. Used by ICEMAN.

12555.name: ClServiceTypeInst
12555.desc: Client instruction at the Order level as to what the clientServiceType(10425) of its Fills should be.

12556.name: ApplicationAllowedCrossType
12556.desc: Describes the applications/systems that should be allowed to cross orders with one another in a crossing Engine, other crossing venue, pass through, etc

12557.name: NoMSNotionalLegSides
12557.desc: Number of MSNotionalLegSide repeating group instances

12558.name: MSNotionalLegSide
12558.desc: For products with multiple notional legs, this represents the side of a notional leg (where that notional in turn also has its own legs).

12559.name: ClClOrdReceiveTime
12559.desc: For Brokers routing their agency flow for execution and/or clearing to Morgan Stanley, this specifies the time that the Broker received the order from their client.

12560.name: IOIRecommendedOrdActionInd
12560.desc: For an IOI recommendation (IOIRecommededInd(12484)=Y), specifies when an Action is taken on the IOI Settings for an Order.

12561.name: LMEMonthlyRICCode
12561.desc: This field would contain the Reuters Monthly RIC code. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME). Maps to ReutersMonthly in P2.

12562.name: LME3MonthSymbol
12562.desc: This field would contain the Direct 3 Month rolling symbol. Specific to London Metal Exchange (LME). Maps to Direct3mo in P2.

12565.name: ValidationReqInd
12565.desc: Indicates that this Order has been invalidated by the Order Manager and requires human action to re-validate it and make it available for trading again.

12566.name: LastValidatedTime
12566.desc: Gives the timestamp of when the most recent validation action was performed on this order (see ValidationReqInd(12565)).

12567.name: NVEnforceClPegInd
12567.desc: Indicates that the Exchange does not support pegging specified in ExecInst(18) and NightVision should use (ExchPegType(12568)) as specified by the client instead.

12568.name: ExchPegType
12568.desc: Where an Exchange does not support the use of pegging via ExecInst(18), this allows the client to specify the equivilent internal parameter to NightVision.

12569.name: GTCEntryTime
12569.desc: InitEntryTime of the parent GTC/GTD order on simulated child day order.

12570.name: ExchAnonymousSymbolInd
12570.desc: Indicates whether the Order for a particular symbol can be reported to the Exchange Tape as anonymous (i.e. the fact that MS traded is hidden).

12571.name: EBEALegSide
12571.desc: Temporary tag to overcome a limitation in EBEA with passing other values of LegSide(624) except "1" or "2". Gives the side of an individual leg (for a multileg security) but with additional range of values, specifically short sell or short sell exempt.

12572.name: TradeReportVID
12572.desc: Version number of this trade report.

12573.name: UpstmOverrideInEtsdbOnlyInd
12573.desc: Upstream indicator for Sales and Trading OMs/TDs (application teams) to override the way in which InEtsDBOnly(10612) is set before it reaches Booker Plant and TC.

12574.name: AltAggExecCapacity
12574.desc: Specifies an alternative AggExecCapacity value from other legal MS entity perspective when the value is different from aggExecCapacity(10209) which is set from the executing MS entity perspective.

12575.name: AltAggExecCapacityCxtType
12575.desc: Indicates the MS legal entity on whose perspective AltAggExecCapacity(12574) is set.

12576.name: HedgeLkIssueType
12576.desc: Holds the IssueType(7324) of the parent synthetic order on child hedge orders. Has the same valid values as 7324.

12577.name: BXSLocked
12577.desc: QR Position API quantity that is in flight at the start of a transaction - used in the generation and tracking of a tradeplan

12578.name: BXSOCOutAuctionQty
12578.desc: QR PositionAPI out quantity of a completed auction in the Volume Scheduler frame of reference which has been communicated to the Limit Order Worker (format -

12579.name: BXSOCIntendedAuctionQty
12579.desc: QR Position API intended quantity of an auction in the Volume Scheduler frame of reference which has been communicated to the Limit Order Worker (format - "auctionID:qty:Price")

12580.name: BXSOCExcludeAllQty
12580.desc: QR Position API exclude all quantity in the Volume Scheduler frame of reference which has been communicated to the Limit Order Worker

12581.name: BXSOCExcludeBmkQty
12581.desc: QR Position API exclude from benchmark quantity in the Volume Scheduler frame of reference which has been communicated to the Limit Order Worker

12582.name: BXSOCPovNonEligibleQty
12582.desc: QR Position API POV non-eligible quantity in the Volume Scheduler frame of reference which has been communicated to the Limit Order Worker

12583.name: TXAllocationSplit
12583.desc: Custom XML field with the breakdown of a bulk / collated RFQ into the individual client splits for the TX booking.

12585.name: MinCrossCurr
12585.desc: Specifies the currency to value the cross in for MinCrossValue(12586).

12586.name: MinCrossValue
12586.desc: Specifies the minimum value of a cross for this order in the currency set in (MinCrossCurr(12585)).

12587.name: AvgTradeNetAmtPreRnd
12587.desc: Calculated average netnet (inclusive of tax + commission) amount pre-rounded in traded currency of all fills on this order.

12590.name: BXSScheduleThreshold
12590.desc: Specifies the allowed banding for BXS Engine to track the trading schedule. E.g. 0.1 means the Engine is allowed to trade 10% ahead or behind schedule. Float between 0-1.

12591.name: OTCProductType
12591.desc: Specifies what this RFQ product is from a discrete list of values of internal MS OTC product types that are maintained in OTCDB's product service.

12592.name: AmendToHedgeInd
12592.desc: Where an amend happends to a synthetic order or trade, this indicates that only the associated hedge of that synthetic should be updated, not the synthetic itself.

12593.name: DynamicAlgoGUIFixTags
12593.desc: For a system implementing a custom, dynamic, user-defined strategies, specifies a pipe-delimited list of FIX tags used to control the GUI's state.

12594.name: DynamicAlgoGUIValues
12594.desc: Pipe-delimited list of values for the FIX tags specified in DynamicAlgoGUIFixTags(12593).

12595.name: DynamicAlgoGUIStateInfo
12595.desc: Pipe-delimited list of state information for the FIX tags specified in DynamicAlgoGUIFixTags(12593).

12596.name: ChkTradeHaltInd
12596.desc: Instruction from the GUI to OM to check the TradeHalt check/warning for the Order. Based on symbol.

12597.name: ChkOptionOpenCloseInd
12597.desc: Instruction from the GUI to OM to check the Open/Close position for the Order. Based on AggUnit Positon in the US.

12598.name: FillOwnerProcessID
12598.desc: Specifies the process (host:port) that created and owns this Fill.

12599.name: IntraProcessSendingTime
12599.desc: Nanosecond resolution timestamp to indicate the sending time of the messages - in integer format and used for internal process latency measurements

12600.name: IntraProcessReceivingTime
12600.desc: Nanosecond resolution timestamp to indicate the receiving time of the messages - in integer format and used for internal process latency measurements

12601.name: ExchLastCapacity
12601.desc: Gives the LastCapacity(29) set by the external Broker/Exchange where it gets changed coming back into MS infrastructure, i.e. by OR.

12602.name: AuctionQtyRestateInd
12602.desc: Indicator to tell if this response message contains locked auction qty and want to be passed back to upstream.

12603.name: RetailPoolClientCertInd
12603.desc: Indicates whether this client has consented to participate in Retail Pool (RPOOL)

12604.name: CS2ReportExecTime
12604.desc: The execution time of paired program trading cross transactions submitted to the NYSE Crossing Session facility a.k.a. "Crossing Session 2"

12605.name: JupiterTpovRelaxRatio
12605.desc: Specifies how much Jupiter can relax the POV target on slow trading names in a TPOV basket. Numeric value greater than or equal to 1. Used for Jupiter's TPOV Benchmark.

12606.name: JupiterLeggingMaxDiff
12606.desc: Specifies a best-efforts constraint on how far ahead the most aggressive name can be from the slowest trading name in a Jupiter TPOV basket. Numeric value between 0 and 1 (inclusive). Used for Jupiter's TPOV Benchmark.

12607.name: PartitionName
12607.desc: Specifies which Athena database partition Booker should route this message to.

12608.name: OrderExpiryActionType
12608.desc: Action to take when an order is expired (ExpiredOrderInd(10741)=Y)

12609.name: DBMsgSourceType
12609.desc: To help with Athena Front Office rollout. Specifies whether the message originated from Front Office (migrated flow) or TC (non-migrated flow).

12610.name: SalesTrdrComments
12610.desc: Comments from a Sales Trader relating to this Order.

12611.name: BXSMinPOV
12611.desc: Specifies the minimum percentage of volume to be used in all benchmark strategies by BXS-OC (Order Controller).

12612.name: CS2ReportUUId
12612.desc: Unique identifier for a CS2 report submission.

12613.name: CS2ReportVId
12613.desc: Version Id for this CS2 report submission.

12614.name: SORTTrailingStopPrice
12614.desc: Absolute value to be used relative to the market price to dynamically adjust the stop price by specified value if the market is moving in favorable direction. Used by SORT's Stop Order strategy.

12615.name: ContingentOrdUUId
12615.desc: Unique identifier generated for a contingent order.

12616.name: EncodedContingentOrdDetails
12616.desc: Contains details and structure of contingent orders resulting from a 'One Cancels the Other' (OCO) Order, encoded in MIX XML.

12617.name: ETFOrderFillPctLN
12617.desc: Percentage of the summed underlying products filled for an ETF Order in London.

12618.name: ETFOrderFillPctHK
12618.desc: Percentage of the summed underlying products filled for an ETF Order in Hong-Kong.

12619.name: ETFOrderFillPctTK
12619.desc: Percentage of the summed underlying products filled for an ETF Order in Tokyo.

12620.name: ETFOrderFillPctNY
12620.desc: Percentage of the summed underlying products filled for an ETF Order in New York.

12621.name: ETFErrorStatusCode
12621.desc: Code to describe an error that has occured with an ETF Deal workflow.

12622.name: BasketCashFXRate
12622.desc: FX rate to use if the cash component of a basket is in a different currency (BasketCashCcy(11329)) to the notional product.

12623.name: ContingencyOrderInd
12623.desc: Indicates this Order is part of a contingent group, i.e. either a child contingent Order or a parent Order that children are contingent on.

12624.name: KoreaOrderPlacer
12624.desc: The user or system that the Korean Stock Exchange recognises as its 'client', i.e. order placer. Set independently on new, amends and cancels to the order. Used to set IPAddress by OR.

12625.name: PassTheBookTarget
12625.desc: Where an Order gets passed from one Desk to another to take on execution responsibility for (PassTheBookInd(12530)=Y), this specifies the intended target desk. Value is an LDAP email group.

12626.name: ManualFillExecBroker
12626.desc: Used by Carbon GUI to pass the ExecBroker value to ATOM.

12627.name: ManualFillDestID
12627.desc: Used by Carbon GUI to pass the Filled by destination ID(11813).

12628.name: BVSPFillTransType
12628.desc: Bovespa Exchange specific field to indicate how the trade happened. This information is required to be sent on the client confirmations.

12629.name: PartitionMod
12629.desc: Number to be used for a modulus calculation on the number of database partitions. Used as an input to mapping to a PartitionName(12607).

12630.name: TransferDate
12630.desc: Date at which the market data will be used in transferring a client's position onto Morgan Stanley Books. Used by Listed Derivatives for ultimately generating cash movements.

12631.name: PartitionIndex
12631.desc: Stores the result of modulus calculation (PartitionMod(12629)) to provide the index of the Athena database partition, used to lookup IndexToPartitionRuleSet in Halo to determine where the message is intended to be persisted. Maps to a PartitionName(12607)

12632.name: GlobalBasketInd
12632.desc: Indicator of whether or not this order is part of a basket being traded globally.

12633.name: ETFNetNetMarkup
12633.desc: The markup or markdown in bps on the price of the ETF to include taxes and creation/redemption fees (i.e. to form the net net price).

12634.name: TradingBookingModel
12634.desc: Booking model to be used for an etsFlow client order element. Set by OM Router (part of OM Farm) and copied into 10282 by OM if it is a trading order.

12635.name: SliceBookingModel
12635.desc: Booking model to be used for an etsFlow exchange/internal slice. Set by OM Router (part of OM Farm) and copied into 10282 by OM if it is an exchange/internal slice order.

12636.name: OMPKAccountRegion
12636.desc: The OMPK region the account was originally setup for.  This is used in Carbon flow, where GUI reads this field from DB and will pass along on the request to Atom, where it will use this tag to determine which ompk region it needs to do account position lo

12637.name: CommMgmtClAccount
12637.desc: Client account to use as an identifier for accural of soft dollar commissions.

12638.name: OwlBreatheInclDest
12638.desc: A list of destinations where SORT Owl should post liquidity when in the breathe state. The list is set by the client and represents the destinations where they want an order to be represented.

12639.name: GroupDesi
12639.desc: Four digit code that maps a Sales Desk to a client at a high level. Used by FID and PWM.

12640.name: BXSPortfolioOverlayUrgency
12640.desc: Specifies the urgency level imposed on the entire portfolio. Used by BXSOC MSPort order aggregation strategy.

12641.name: BXSPortfolioOverlayWeight
12641.desc: Specifies the weight we will put on portfolio overlay risk. 1 - PortfolioOverlayWeight is the weight put on the individual order level risk. Value between 0 and 1 (inclusive). Used by BXSOC MSPort order aggregation strategy.

12642.name: BXSClCloseConstraintType
12642.desc: Client instruction for BXS POV strategy how to handle a residual on closing, i.e. if AutoPOV will be applied, and a residue will be accepted.

12643.name: TraderSolicitType
12643.desc: Specifies a request/agreement made by a sales trader to/with other trading desk for soliciting with a client.

12644.name: PxLimitBreachActType
12644.desc: Action to take if a client's price limit is reached/breached.

12645.name: ISECustomerOrFirm
12645.desc: ISE-specific version of CustomerOrFirm(204) with different valid values. Set by Sales person on GUI and passed to OM/OR, to stamp in 204 to send to ISE.

12646.name: EncodedClientData
12646.desc: Set of encoded (specified in MessageEncoding(347), e.g. Base64) miscellaneous FIX tag-value pairs sent to/from Morgan Stanley to external client.

12647.name: RBEAggressionModel
12647.desc: A client instruction to engine (RBE) indicating how and when to execute in the market.

12648.name: BXSPortfolioOverlayClientScale
12648.desc: Contains the scaling specified by the client that will then be applied to the portfolio level to manage portfolio risk. Used by BXSOC MSPort order aggregation strategy.

12649.name: UltimateUnderlyingSymbol
12649.desc: The ultimate underlying symbol for a strategy - e.g for an option spread strategy, this would show 'yhoo' when the legs are yahoo buy put 105, yahoo sell call 110 and yahoo stock.

12650.name: DestTraderGroupID
12650.desc: Specifies the trader group at the destination who can view orders when orders are routed from one desk to another desk.

12651.name: ChironClOrdUUID
12651.desc: a unique identifier(UUID) to identify a client order request and its execution reports in Chiron(new CDFR process) - sent back by downstream OMs - it the same across notional and legs for multileg orders.

12652.name: DefaultChargeRate
12652.desc: The chargeRate prior to being overridden

12653.name: DefaultChargeFormula
12653.desc: The chargeFormula prior to being overridden

12655.name: DefaultRuleVID
12655.desc: The charge ruleVID prior to being overridden

12656.name: DefaultChargeCategory
12656.desc: The chargeCategory prior to being overridden

12657.name: DefaultStartChargeBand
12657.desc: The start chargeBand prior to being overridden

12658.name: DefaultEndChargeBand
12658.desc: The end chargeBand prior to being overridden

12659.name: BXSClReverseHighLowComplete
12659.desc: Client instruction for BXS (TED or BXS-OE)  to enable reverse high/low complete behaviour - when the market has the worst price - the engine will slice out the whole of the remaining quantity

12660.name: OrderHoldInstrRsnCode
12660.desc: Instruction from an upstream to hold an order for the reason specified in the code.

12661.name: SORTEnableNShotIOC
12661.desc: Instruction for SORT/OWL engines to activate multiple rounds of IOCs to be sent to multiple destinations for each IOC order from client

12662.name: SalesTrdrConversationCode
12662.desc: Guidance from Sales to Trading on how to handle a sales order. Individual fills under a given order could assume different values based on how the trader handled the order.

12663.name: OptNetPx
12663.desc: Used to display total net price of the option portion of the strategy. Example: leg 1: Buy five Calls for at 1.3per option and leg 2 buy one Call at .26 cents per share. The total option cost would be 6.76 (5*1.3 + 1*.26).

12664.name: extClSalesCreditRate
12664.desc: the external sales credit rate as a percentage that the institutional client wants applied to the quote - this is the sales credit that the institutional client wants from their client which will be included in the price we're providing.

12665.name: ClAggExecID
12665.desc: Stores the ExecID of the client side aggregated Execution of which the constituent execution is a part of

12666.name: BXSSkipRejectTrapInd
12666.desc: Indicates whether to skip reject trap in RBE and forward the reject message back to client if a rejection happens too close to the the close auction. Otherwise trap the rejection in RBE (soft reject) and let the trader make the decision

12667.name: SuppressRFQAlertInd
12667.desc: Indicator that determines whether or not to suppress alerts when replaying / recovering RFQs into the RFQ system.

12670.name: GlobalRoutingSuppressType
12670.desc: Indicates the type of execution report messages that needs to be blocked from flowing back to the global routing infrastructure.

12671.name: StrikePxKnownLegInd
12671.desc: Indicates whether or not the strike price of this leg is known in an Options multileg strategy.

12672.name: IntendedSliceType
12672.desc: Indicates the intended slice types of outgoing orders, to help facilitate better handling of the order downstream.

12673.name: PairsClCxlReplaceRequestType
12673.desc: For Pairs engine, specifies the type of cancel or replace request placed by the client.

12674.name: AuthorizerUserID
12674.desc: Kerberos id of user providing authorization for action e.g amending an allocation.

12675.name: ClNameCumQty
12675.desc: Total number of shares filled under the client's own name.

12676.name: ClNameAvgPx
12676.desc: Calculated average price of all fills done under the client's own name. Also used in the client order summary of Execution Aggregation Service in OMWP to display average price of fills which have been reported to the clients.

12677.name: MSNameCumQty
12677.desc: Total number of shares filled under Morgan Stanley's name.

12678.name: MSNameAvgPx
12678.desc: Calculated average price of all fills done under Morgan Stanley's name.

12679.name: IntroBrokerCapacity
12679.desc: Capacity of Allocation from the perspective of the introducing broker - this is required because we send confirms to the underlying client on behalf of the introducing broker. Assumes the same valid values as aggExecCapacity(10209).

12680.name: CashBalanceBoundsBpsInd
12680.desc: For the BXS Cash Balance strategy, indicates whether or not the bounds are in bps or in dollar values, as specified by the clients. The bounds themselves are set using BPNetUpBound1 (10477) and BPNetLowBound1 (10475).

12681.name: NotionalExecutionPrice
12681.desc: Provides the price (44) of the Notional Execution associated with this Leg Execution (for multileg flow).

12682.name: TradeAsBasketInd
12682.desc: Indicates whether the orders need to be traded as part of a basket or as a single name order.

12683.name: ConnSuppressAlert
12683.desc: Indicates the "connection down" status of the destination specified by RouterConnName (9606) is made intentionally, alert should be suppressed.

12684.name: SwapTradeSubType
12684.desc: Indicates the sub-type of swaps trade.

12685.name: QuotedPriceType
12685.desc: Indicates the type of the quote price - for example clean price.

12686.name: CrossRequestType
12686.desc: Specifies the type of cross request for the given order so that the downstream crossing engine can treat the order appropriately.

12687.name: ClReverseMakerTakerStratInd
12687.desc: Used to identify if the client wants to participate in a strategy that posts orders on reverse maker-taker destinations

12688.name: SubApplication
12688.desc: An identifier that indicates which sub-system within an Application generated/handled an order. This additional level of detail is used by ETRM to sub-categorize flow for application of trading risk limits.

12689.name: BXSOpenAuctionQtyFractionInd
12689.desc: Indicates to the BXS engine whether the BXSOpenAuctionQty(12690) is an absolute quantity or a fraction of the order quantity.

12690.name: BXSOpenAuctionQty
12690.desc: The open auction quantity value to be used by the BXS engine - it can be either an absolute value or a fraction -based on the value specified in BXSOpenAuctionQtyFractionInd(12689).

12691.name: BXSCloseAuctionQtyFractionInd
12691.desc: Indicates to the BXS engine whether the BXSCloseAuctionQty(12692) is an absolute quantity or a fraction of the order quantity.

12692.name: BXSCloseAuctionQty
12692.desc: The close auction quantity value to be used by the BXS engine - it can be either an absolute value or a fraction -based on the value specified in BXSCloseAuctionQtyFractionInd(12691).

12693.name: BXSMorningAuctionQtyFractionInd
12693.desc: Indicates to the BXS engine whether the BXSMorningAuctionQty(12694) is an absolute quantity or a fraction of the order quantity.

12694.name: BXSMorningAuctionQty
12694.desc: The morning auction quantity value to be used by the BXS engine - it can be either an absolute value or a fraction -based on the value specified in BXSMorningAuctionQtyFractionInd(12693).

12695.name: BXSIntraDayAuctionQtyFractionInd
12695.desc: Indicates to the BXS engine whether the BXSIntraDayAuctionQty(12696) is an absolute quantity or a fraction of the order quantity.

12696.name: BXSIntraDayAuctionQty
12696.desc: The intra day auction quantity value to be used by the BXS engine - it can be either an absolute value or a fraction -based on the value specified in BXSIntraDayAuctionQtyFractionInd(12695).

12697.name: BXSAfternoonAuctionQtyFractionInd
12697.desc: Indicates to the BXS engine whether the BXSAfternoonAuctionQty(12698) is an absolute quantity or a fraction of the order quantity.

12698.name: BXSAfternoonAuctionQty
12698.desc: The afternoon auction quantity value to be used by the BXS engine - it can be either an absolute value or a fraction -based on the value specified in BXSAfternoonAuctionQtyFractionInd(12697).

12699.name: SORTForcedDest
12699.desc: indicate the destination SORT forces to route the order to, ignoring the variables SORT should take into consideration like market data

12700.name: ParentOrderQty
12700.desc: This holds the orderQty(38) of the parent order - useful when the parent order was sliced.

12701.name: FXOverrideExecutedRate
12701.desc: The FX rate the trader wants to use to override the auto calculated FX rate attributed to a portfolio of securities (e.g. Basket, Index, ETF etc) for a given currency - applies to the executed portion only.

12702.name: FXOverrideNonExecutedRate
12702.desc: The FX rate the trader wants to use to override the auto calculated FX rate attributed to a portfolio of securities (e.g. Basket, Index, ETF etc) for a given currency - applies to the non-executed portion only.

12704.name: OverrideSwapSettlCcyChkInd
12704.desc: Indicates that we should skip the swaps settlement currency check.

12705.name: DisablePassivePxInd
12705.desc: Indicates whether the engine is prohibited from pricing passively (i.e. whether the engine should cross the spread all the time) or not.

12706.name: TagToRound
12706.desc: Denotes the fix tag which contains the value to be rounded - eg. 44 in this tag would indicate that tag 44 should be used as the input to the rounding service

12707.name: RoundingMethod
12707.desc: Denotes the rounding method to be applied to the tag in TagToRound(12706)

12708.name: RoundingAmount
12708.desc: Denotes the precision of the rounding to be applied to the tag in TagToRound(12706)

12709.name: RoundingResult
12709.desc: The result of rounding the tag in TagToRound(12706)

12710.name: BMFTradedRelatedPrice
12710.desc: For BMF executions coming down with a price in the "rate" format, when TC does the conversion to the actual Brazilian price for booking, it copies the original rate price into this field.

12711.name: VSPositionContext
12711.desc: Used to keep a consistent frame of reference between all engines participating in the generation and execution of trade schedules. Communicates the quantities used by the scheduler and the type of reschedule.

12712.name: VSContinuousTrajectory
12712.desc: Communicates a "continuous trading only" trajctory to simplify the tracking of all downstream systems. This will store the trajectory we want to track during OBTRD.

12713.name: IOIBlotterNaturalInd
12713.desc: A natural IOI that has been sent before receiving a customer order

12714.name: DestinationOMProcessAdminAddress
12714.desc: The admin address of the order manager process that the order message is sent to.

12715.name: DestinationProcessListenAddress
12715.desc: the listen address of the process that the order message is sent to.

12716.name: RFQImportFile
12716.desc: When performing a batch RFQ upload/import this contains the file path to an excel template that is to be uploaded/imported.

12717.name: OTCBookingModel
12717.desc: Contains the booking model to be used for a particular OTC trade. For example, on Deritrade flow a trade can be booked either in LN or NY each having a different booking model.

12718.name: EquityDerivativeProductCategoryCode
12718.desc: Supplementary categorization of the type of equity derivative product - primarily focussed on how the product is handled from a listing/clearing point of view - important for reporting purposes

12719.name: OTCDBApprovalID
12719.desc: Reference ID to OTCDB which holds the pre-trade approval details for the deal (Quote Request/Quote). Each deal has its own bespoke product/termsheet associated with it.

12720.name: IWouldLOWLookAhead
12720.desc: Used to determine the Offset time to apply to the startIWouldCrossWindowTime.

12721.name: IWouldRepriceInterval
12721.desc: Specifies interval in seconds between reprices.

12722.name: CartmanBookingScenario
12722.desc: Scenario used by Cartman to describe how to execute each leg for issuer bookings and segregation bookings.

12723.name: TrajectoryCrossMaxPOV
12723.desc: Instruction to trajectory cross engine (eg. CAFE) specifying the amount of the order quantity allowed for trajectory crossing as a percent of the volume traded for that security.  Represented as a decimal number between 0 and 1.

12724.name: FXHedgeAccount
12724.desc: Account used to hedge FX exposure - for example as part of the Auto FX hedge project

12725.name: SalesPrice
12725.desc: Agreed gross price between the Sales desk and MS Client.  This price does not include trading, commission, and tax fees.

12726.name: BrazilZZRuleImpactedAllocationID
12726.desc: Identifies the allocation that needs to be amended as a result of the Brazilian Ze com Ze (ZZ) rule requiring MS to cancel part of an execution.

12727.name: AggUnitPrePositionInd
12727.desc: Indicates the clients sell order will be used in the calculation of the Agg Units net position for a given security. This is used for guaranteed business in which a client sell order will be filled by the firm thus allowing the firm to include it in Agg u

12728.name: VerbalOrderReason
12728.desc: Determines if the principal order will be used to provide client with a Risk fill or Riskless fill. (Also know as  VerbalTOBOrderReason)

12729.name: VerbalPrimaryRefID
12729.desc: Stamps the entityPrimaryRefID of the principal firm used to faciliate risk fill(s) on client order. Also called VerbalTOBPrimaryRefID.

12730.name: VistaMaterialChangeInd
12730.desc: Indicates there is a material change in an allocation or execution relative to a previously sent version which requires processing again by Vista.

12731.name: verbalAllocatedQty
12731.desc: This will be used to indicate how many shares of the verbal order have been allocated to a client order.

12732.name: HedgeAccount
12732.desc: Contains the hedge account details - for example a Swaps hedging account.

12733.name: UseTradingAtLastSessionInd
