12733.desc: Define strategy behaviour in all regions. Clients want to set parameter that will tell strategy to NOT send slices to TradingAtLast session.

12734.name: LastStartTradePrice
12734.desc: Contains the last price (vwptp, tp, etc) at the start of trading a wave (i.e. trading starts at 10am, this can be used to contain the vwptp at 10am). Similar concept to LastTradePrice (7352) but for the price at the start of trading.

12735.name: ViperRoutingDomain
12735.desc: The domain used in determining the viper instances a message is routed to

12736.name: FXExecuteAt4pmRate
12736.desc: Instruction on an FX order to execute using the London 4pm FX rate

12737.name: SplitType
12737.desc: Description of the type of revenue split.

12738.name: SplitRrNumber
12738.desc: RR (Registered Representative) number - represents salesman/group for commission/revenue.

12740.name: SplitPercentage
12740.desc: Percentage of revenue associated with the revenue split.

12741.name: PrevGiveupInd
12741.desc: Holds the previous giveup indicator (tag 7332) to identify amends and to help perform correct account derivation.

12743.name: PrevExpireDate
12743.desc: The previous ExpireDate(432) value prior to it being changed on the same entity.

12744.name: CrossRegionPairsType
12744.desc: Specifies the type of cross region pairs. (e.g. EU_AP - Europe and Asia pairs). This tag is used in order to determine routing to an appropriate region's pairs engine in case of cross-region pairs orders.

12745.name: RollOverToEvnSessInd
12745.desc: To indicate that an open order can be rolled over from day session to evening session for trading.

12746.name: QARoutingInd
12746.desc: For messages where this tag is set, it contains the details for the where the particular message should be routed to in QA.

12747.name: FrenchFTTExemptInd
12747.desc: French Financial Transaction Tax Exemption Indicator.

12748.name: PrimarySplitInd
12748.desc: Indicator on revenue split to show that this is primary split - this is the revenue split that is passed downstream from TC.

12749.name: RFQFundingSpread
12749.desc: Captures that cost of funding as component of the final price for retail structured products.

12750.name: RFQRequestDueBy
12750.desc: Deadline for when bespoke RFQ pricing needs to be completed.

12751.name: ExpectedRFQTradeDate
12751.desc: Date when the bespoke RFQ trade is expected to execute.

12752.name: SwapRestrictedTradeInd
12752.desc: Indicates whether the swap synthetic order has been marked as 'Restricted' that no one should be able to unwind it.

12753.name: AllocClientClOrdID
12753.desc: Specifies clOrdID(11) on the allocation message(35=J) that is sent from client to MS. The value can be different from ClientClOrdID(7576) if client sends different tag 11 value on an allocation from an order.

12754.name: AmendmentSourceCode
12754.desc: Code to indicate whether amendment of execution or portfolioOrder was initiated by client or MS - used as part of fees calculation.

12755.name: InternalPriceCapInd
12755.desc: Identifes if an Order has had its price capped by an internal system/process and specifies the process/system.

12756.name: BonafideErrorType
12756.desc: Specific reason for using the bonafide (un-intentional) error exemption. Only applicable when 11129=BE.

12757.name: ViperRTExtraObjects
12757.desc: Indicates the list of tables into which Viper Real Time must insert a new entry. The entries are created by mapping the other tags of the fix message to the columns of the VIPER database schema.

12758.name: ViperRoutingUUId
12758.desc: Used by Viper to help ensure that all child orders/fills and evaluations are sent to the same instance of Viper.

12759.name: NetBuySellQuantity
12759.desc: For a given client this represents the netted quantity of buy and sell trades on the same day i.e. total buys quantity minus total sells quantity.

12760.name: MsgDestinationProcessId
12760.desc: The id of the process that a message is sent to.

12761.name: verbalAllocatedAvgPx
12761.desc: The average price of the fills allocated to the client order from the verbal order.

12762.name: ManualExecInd
12762.desc: This tag indicates manually applied executions by net admin due to an outage

12763.name: RelatedSymbol
12763.desc: Specifies the related symbol. RelatedSymbolType(12764) should be specified if this is set.

12764.name: RelatedSymbolType
12764.desc: Identifies the type of RelatedSymbol(12763). Required if RelatedSymbol is specified.

12765.name: AllInRate
12765.desc: The All-In Rate for spread over Treasuries. Rate used in charging customers for accepting banker's acceptances, consisting of the discount interest rate plus the commission. Expressed in percentage

12766.name: LegAllInRate
12766.desc: The AllInRate (12765) on the spread leg for spread over Treasuries switches and butterflies.

12767.name: LegYield
12767.desc: The yield on the bond hedge for spread over Treasuries. Yield refers to the interest or dividends received from a security and is a percentage based on the investment's cost, which can be its current market value or its face value.

12768.name: SkipReRouteInd
12768.desc: Indicates that the orders that it is stamped on should not be re-routed. For example, order sent to LSE, should not be re-routed to Autex to get filled.

12769.name: PendingVID
12769.desc: Attribute on new, replaced and cancelled messages told the versionID of the associated pending message that may be dropped.

12770.name: PBExecAccountID
12770.desc: Legacy client specific execution account used to identify clients by PB operations and for reporting purposes.  Prior to PB trades following the standard TC execution/allocation booking model, trades were booked against this account.

12771.name: SpreadLimit
12771.desc: max spread value expressed in pips or absolute value (depending on spread type)

12772.name: SpreadLimitType
12772.desc: Is used to specify how the spread limit (12771) is to be interpreted

12773.name: TradingRateQuantity
12773.desc: The quantity you are able to trade per unit time.

12774.name: TradingRateInterval
12774.desc: The time interval over which you are constrained to trade this quantity (Tag 12773) in seconds

12775.name: ExDestContinent
12775.desc: Identifies the continent of the order's execution destination

12776.name: SwapRestrictedReleaseDate
12776.desc: The date when the SwapRestrictedTradeType (12752)  has been set from Y to R to release the restricted trade

12777.name: FlowType
12777.desc: Identifies upstream flow. Example usage: FACL trading engine to make various crossing decisions based on FlowType value which will be dervied from pre-determined logic

12778.name: MsgFinalDestinationProcessId
12778.desc: The host:port of the final destination instance. eg. Used by VPool router to stamp the host/port of the vPool instance the message will target.

12779.name: MessageSize
12779.desc: The actual message size, in bytes

12780.name: FXResidualInd
12780.desc: Indicates whether there is a residual FX amount that needs to be cleaned up. This is with reference to the auto FX hedging feature which may result in residual FX amounts.

12782.name: SalesRiskQty
12782.desc: Sales trader specified quantity to automatically risk fill

12783.name: SalesRiskPrice
12783.desc: Sales trader specified price to automatically risk fill

12784.name: JupiterHedgeStrat
12784.desc: The type of strategy to use for the portion of the basket that cannot be traded.

12785.name: NonTradableNotionalToShare
12785.desc: Contains the amount of notional as a percentage of the share amount that is not tradable.

12786.name: BypassRiskCheckType
12786.desc: Indicates whether this order should bypass the specified risk check or not.

12787.name: RPIOrderPxOffset
12787.desc: When SORT/NightVision sends RPI(Retail Price Improvement) orders to NYSE/AMEX, it needs to specify how much to price improve (in USD e.g. 0.0030).  The value contained in this tag is the offset determined by the RLP (Retail Liquidity provider).

12789.name: BXSShiftOrderExpireTimeInd
12789.desc: instruction to engine to enable behaviour to shift the expire time of order and it's associated slices from the usual default market close time to an earlier time (configured in the engine)

12790.name: ChargeCategory
12790.desc: Identify how LD charges should be processed by downstream systems (CMG)

12791.name: BRPreMatchExecID
12791.desc: EntityOID of the manual fill applied to customer order. This will be stamped in BORA on the street side executions linking streetside to manual fill.

12792.name: EnableRPIOrderInd
12792.desc: Controls whether algos (eg. NightVision/NightOwl/SORT) participate in NYSE/AMEX's Retail Liquidity Program by providing hidden liquidity using RPI orders (Retail Price Improvement).

12793.name: BXSSuspendStatus
12793.desc: This tag identifies the current suspend/masking status and reason of a BXS order. BXS engine uses this tag to communicate suspend business logic with upstream systems

12794.name: IndonesiaTradingID
12794.desc: Trading ID (a.k.a ComplianceID) that is supplied on an order sent to Indonesia exchange. It is derived from SID(Single InvestorID) that is the single identity owned by investor, issued by KSEI(Central Depository).

12795.name: TenorValue
12795.desc: Used in FX and Commodoties Orders and Executions to identify the tenor of instrument, as part of product definition. SettlDate might be derived according to this tag. It's internal equivalent of user-defined tag 6215 from FIX standard.

12796.name: RejectOrdOnAggLimitBrchInd
12796.desc: Indicates whether or not to hard reject orders on aggregate limit breaches.

12797.name: SalesBlockUUId
12797.desc: ID to group front office orders into a SalesBlock for front office system usage.  This is not an allocationBlock ID and will not be used by Vista.

12800.name: DealerQuoteResponseInd
12800.desc: Indicator to convey whether dealer can respond to the quote request or not

12801.name: DealerQuoteSendInd
12801.desc: Indicator to convey whether dealer can send a quote

12802.name: DealerRequoteInd
12802.desc: Indicator to convey whether dealer can refresh the previous quote or not

12803.name: CustReqQuoteType
12803.desc: Customer Request Quote Type which identifies Customer action

12804.name: B2CVenueBookNameList
12804.desc: Venue maintains a list of all the quote requests for a specific security and assign a book name to each customer quote request transaction. Multiple books are separated by the '-' character.

12805.name: B2CCustPrefDlrTraderList
12805.desc: Customer creates a list of all the allowed/preferred traders (from a dealer) from whom the customer wants to receive the trade inquiry. Multiple userids are separated by the '-' character.

12806.name: B2CDealerResponseTimeout
12806.desc: For B2C markets this is a timeout restriction placed by the customer/venue on the dealer to respond back.

12807.name: B2CDealerNewQuoteInterval
12807.desc: For B2C markets, this is the number of seconds that the dealer has to quote the initial inquiry (restriction for the dealer)

12808.name: B2CCustQuoteRespInterval
12808.desc: For B2C markets, this is the number of seconds that the customer has to respond to a dealer's quote  (except for the first quote)

12809.name: B2CCustConfirmInterval
12809.desc: For B2C markets, this is the number of seconds that the customers HIT/LIFT is firm at the dealer and can therefore be accepted

12810.name: B2CCustConfirmReQuoteInterval
12810.desc: For B2C markets, this is the number of seconds that the dealer has to re-quote the inquiry after the CustConfirmInterval period has timed out

12811.name: B2CQuoteLifeTimeInterval
12811.desc: For B2C markets, this is the number of seconds from receipt of the TRDREQ message, in which the dealer's initial quote will time out at the customer, if the customer takes no action

12812.name: DealerVenueSetupType
12812.desc: This is to define trade settings for reports to identify priority at the venue

12813.name: NoOfDealersForQuoteReq
12813.desc: This indicates the number of dealers customer has sent a quote request.

12814.name: NoAllocAccounts
12814.desc: Number of tickets/accounts required for the trade

12815.name: CustBidAskInd
12815.desc: Indicates whether this is a customer bid/ask trade

12816.name: B2CPricingTier
12816.desc: Customers pricing tier for click-to-trade inquiry

12817.name: B2CClickToTradeInd
12817.desc: Indicates that the inquiry was generated from the dealers click-to-trade executable levels.

12818.name: B2CSwitchRiskType
12818.desc: For B2C markets, this tag identifies the Switch risk characteristics

12819.name: B2CProductSpreadPx
12819.desc: For B2C markets this is the spread (price) between the different prodct type such as BFLY, Benchmark, Swtich etc.

12820.name: B2CDealerPricingFeedSpreadID
12820.desc: For B2C markets, this is the Spread ID received on the Dealers pricing feed

12821.name: IRSSwitchType
12821.desc: Interest rate swap Switch types. Describes the various combinations of B2C product types

12822.name: QuoteReqNegotiationType
12822.desc: Identifies what type of quote request is being sent by the customer

12823.name: NoB2CQuoteEntry
12823.desc: Count Tag for B2CQuoteEntry Repeating Group

12824.name: EndDateAdjConvention
12824.desc: Instruction which defines the end date adjustment convention

12825.name: AllocationInd
12825.desc: Indicates whether a company will provide allocations or not

12826.name: B2CClearingMemMnemonic
12826.desc: For B2C markets this identifies the acronym of clearing house member, which is part of the clearing firm

12827.name: B2CCmpndInd
12827.desc: Indicates whether floating leg of the trade is compounding or not

12828.name: B2CCmpndFrequency
12828.desc: Payment frequency of compounded leg, for basis trades. This is identified in number of times per year. Ex: '4' represents every 3 months

12829.name: B2CCmpndPmtMethod
12829.desc: Payment method of compounded leg, for basis trades this is ISDAFLAT

12830.name: B2CDealerAccount
12830.desc: Dealer account or acronym for the company affiliation

12831.name: B2CCompositeQuote
12831.desc: For B2C markets this is the composite quote at the time of quote request

12832.name: RFQPricePrecision
12832.desc: Maximum number of decimal places to be used for RATE in the RFQ messages

12833.name: QuoteDecimalPxFactor
12833.desc: QUOTE PRICE/RATE Restriction that it should be a multiple of the value specified

12834.name: AdjustedEffectiveDate
12834.desc: This is the effective date of the trade adjusted to the nearby business day if the effective date falls on a holiday

12835.name: UnAdjustedEffectiveDate
12835.desc: This is the un-adjusted (actual) effective date of the trade

12836.name: AdjustedMaturityDate
12836.desc: This is the maturity date of the trade to the nearby business day if the maturity date falls on a holiday

12837.name: IRSEndOfMonthInd
12837.desc: Interest Rate Swap End of Month indicator. This indicates that the trade should roll on the last business day of the month.

12839.name: IRSDurationNoMnths
12839.desc: Number of months in the tenor (0,3,6,12,24, 48, 60, etc.) for Interest Rate Swaps

12840.name: IRSDurationNoDays
12840.desc: Number of calendar days in the tenor (0, 7, 14, 21,etc) for Interest Rate Swaps. If the tenor is less than 1 month. If tenor is 1 month or longer, this will be zero

12841.name: B2CMyCouponInd
12841.desc: For B2C markets this indicates whether the trade is "My Coupon" or not

12842.name: IRSPaymentDay
12842.desc: An agreement of when to pay the interest rate for Interest Rate Swaps. Example: 1- 31, EOM or IMM

12843.name: B2CVenueSalesPersonID
12843.desc: For B2C markets this represents the login name of the primary salesperson assigned to the customer requesting the trade

12844.name: B2CVenueSalesPersonName
12844.desc: For B2C markets this represents the Sales Person Name

12846.name: B2CElectronicConfirmSys
12846.desc: System/Vendor which is electronically confirming the trade. Example: Tradeweb, None etc

12847.name: B2CFeeType
12847.desc: For B2C markets, this is the basis for calculating customer execution fee. Example: RATE, SPREAD

12848.name: B2CCustExecFee
12848.desc: For B2C markets, this is the customer execution fee calculated based on FeeType change

12849.name: B2CProductGroup
12849.desc: Indicates the product type for B2C Market

12850.name: B2CCompositeSpread
12850.desc: For B2C markets, this is the composite spread contributed by the dealers for an dollar swap benchmark trade or off benchmark spread

12851.name: PBResponseStatus
12851.desc: The Prime Broker's response status to a quote request

12853.name: PBService
12853.desc: The Prime Broker Services offered to the Dealer by 3rd Party to a quote request

12854.name: B2CQuoteMarkup
12854.desc:
The signed amount by which the dealers quoted level was changed, before showing it to the customer, in order to include the customer execution fee. 
For inquiry quoted on RATE, the level quoted by the dealer can be calculated RATE-QTMRKUP. For inquiry qu

12855.name: B2CVenueDealerFee
12855.desc: For B2C markets this is the Fees charged to the dealer by the Venue for customer execution

12856.name: NoB2CQuoteIRSLegEntry
12856.desc: Count Tag for B2CQuoteIRSLegDetails Repeating Group

12857.name: B2CCouponPmtFrequency
12857.desc: For B2C markets, this is the frequency of payments for purchased coupon. A coupon payment on a bond is a periodic interest pmt that the bondholder receives during the time between when the bond is issued and when it matures.

12858.name: B2CAccuralAdjConv
12858.desc: Accrual Period Business Day Adjustment Convention

12859.name: B2CPmtDayAdjConv
12859.desc: This tag identifies if IRSPmtDay is being adjusted

12860.name: B2CResetDateAdjConv
12860.desc: For B2C markets, this is the adjustment instruction on the Reset Date (the date a swap`s periodic payment terms are established)

12861.name: B2CDayCountBasis
12861.desc: For B2C markets this Indicates the manner in which the days in both the month and the year are to be counted for interest payments and accruals

12862.name: IRSFloatingRateRef
12862.desc: Identifies the reference point for floating rate of the Interest Rate Swaps

12863.name: IRSResetDays
12863.desc: This identified the day on which floating interest rates are re-calculated

12864.name: B2CFrontStubDate
12864.desc: For B2C market this is the date after which the net interest is payable. "Front stub" or the interest period at which no interest is received

12865.name: B2CAdjFrontStubDate
12865.desc: For B2C markets this is the  front stub date of nearby business day if the Front Stub Date falls on a holiday

12866.name: TRSYCompositeAsk
12866.desc: Composite ask price for the TRSY leg of an DSWP benchmark trade

12867.name: TRSYCompositeBid
12867.desc: Composite bid price for the TRSY leg of an DSWP benchmark trade

12868.name: TRSYCompositeMid
12868.desc: Composite mid price for the TRSY leg of an DSWP benchmark trade

12869.name: WhenIssuedBondInd
12869.desc: This indicates if the Bond is a 'WhenIssued' Bond or not

12870.name: B2CTradeType
12870.desc: For B2C markets, this identfies the  type of product (also referred as trade)

12872.name: VelocityScopeInd
12872.desc: Set by an application to indicate to next process or subsequent processes that a request should be routed to a Velocity destination.

12873.name: OrigTradeRefID
12873.desc: This is the unique Trade Reference ID used when the customer sends AORD(all Limit order) or ARFQ (All RFQ) requests.

12874.name: QuoteLifeCycleID
12874.desc: This is the unique identifier for RFQ life cycle

12875.name: UniqueLifeCycleIDInd
12875.desc: Indicator that the RFQLifeCycleID is not unique for the trade date and product and that OrigTradeRef should be used as the unique identifier

12876.name: B2CResponseType
12876.desc: For B2C markets this describes the response type from the dealer, customer or the venue

12877.name: B2CTraderName
12877.desc: For B2C markets this will identify the Trader Name (and not just the ID), which will be sent to the exchange

12878.name: B2CContactTraderName
12878.desc: For B2Cmarkets this identifies the Trader Name whom to contact

12879.name: B2CTradeReportType
12879.desc: For B2C markets this indicates the type of trade report

12880.name: B2CTradeDoneInd
12880.desc: For B2C markets this indicates if the Trade is done or not

12881.name: B2CIsTradeDoneAway
12881.desc: For B2C markets this indicates if the Trade is done away with another dealer

12882.name: B2CIsTradeCovered
12882.desc: For B2C markets this indicates if the trade was covered i.e. we lost the deal to the other dealer

12883.name: B2CTradeCoverPrice
12883.desc: For B2C markets this indicates the Cover Price for the covered trade.

12884.name: B2CQuoteEntryID
12884.desc: For B2C markets, this is the unique QuoteEntry/Trade ID for the specific B2CProductGroup(12849)

12885.name: B2CSpreadSwitchQuoteEntryID
12885.desc: For B2C markets, this identifies the B2CSpreadSwitchQuote Repeating Group ID used as start tag

12886.name: B2CSwitchID
12886.desc: This identifies the members of the same spread for spread/spread switch trades as each spread contains one TRSY and one DSWP legs.

12887.name: YieldWithCommission
12887.desc: This is the calculated Yield including commission, in percentage.

12888.name: AllInPrice
12888.desc: The All-In Price for Treasuries is the clean price adjusted for commission and index ratio in the case of TIPS (Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities)

12889.name: MultiLegSeqNo
12889.desc: For Fixed Income multi leg products, this tag identifies the index number/integer sequence number of the leg

12890.name: B2CDealerMidPx
12890.desc: For B2C markets, this tag identifies the calculated dealer mid price of the instrument

12891.name: B2CCustClearanceInd
12891.desc: For B2C markets, this tag indicates if the customer has pre-clearence for the trade

12892.name: StopPxLimitFactor
12892.desc: For a Stop Loss/Limit (40=3/4) order, this tag identifies price (bid/offer) factor to determine whether the Stop Px (99) has been reached

12893.name: B2CFloatResetInterval
12893.desc: For B2C markets this is the frequency with which the floating leg rate is recalculated

12894.name: B2CBICCode
12894.desc: Bank Identifier Code are series of codes developed by ISO to identify banks and their branches. These codes are generally only used by financial institutions, to conduct business between banks, such as wire transfers.

12895.name: B2CIndependentAmount
12895.desc: The independent amount is an additional credit support amount that is required over and above the market value of the trade portfolio. The main purpose of the independent amount is to cater for changes in the market value of the trades between collateral

12896.name: B2CUSINamespace
12896.desc: Namespace of the block USI (unique swap identifier) of this leg. Together with the USI identifier this forms a unique Id for this leg. Required by Regulation for all orders

12897.name: B2CUSIIdentifier
12897.desc: Identifier of the block USI (unique swap identifier) of this leg. Together with the USI namespace this forms a unique Id for this leg. Required by Regulation for all

12898.name: IRSRollConvention
12898.desc: Roll Convention determines the reset date of the swap.

12899.name: IRSOptionType
12899.desc: Indicate the type of the Option IRS product

12900.name: B2CDiscountRate
12900.desc: The interest rate that an eligible depository institution is charged to borrow short-term funds directly from a Federal Reserve Bank.

12901.name: DarkPegPrice
12901.desc: Specifies the relative price to follow in Pegged order for Dark Venue. Contains 3 components (colon delimited), pegBase:pegOffset:pegType. PegPrice (15030) is used for a lit primary market in Engine.

12902.name: MidPointPx
12902.desc: This stores the last published price of the underlier e.g stock,index before the order acceptance time

12903.name: MidPointCcy
12903.desc: Specifies the currency associated with MidPointPx (12902)

12905.name: SORTCustomStrategyName
12905.desc: Maps the engine strategy and execution parameters to a name used within SORT ( valid values: free text).

12906.name: BXSReplenishQtyRatio
12906.desc: Percent of order quantity sent to the market that needs to be replenished once partially filled

12907.name: CorporateActionID
12907.desc: Identifies a particular corporate action event that has occurred. The type of which can be found in tag 292.This ID is the event Id stored in the CORPEVENT table in E*.This is NOT the CAVS ID or the 12 caid in the P2 database (13872).

12908.name: StrategyInstanceUUId
12908.desc: Unique identifier of the instance of a strategy that generated the order.

12909.name: StrategyInstanceVId
12909.desc: Version number of the strategy instance that generated the order. The strategy instance being identified by StrategyInstanceUUId (12908)

12910.name: JaguarRootOrderUUId
12910.desc: Unique identifier of the toplevel order that is received by the Jaguar engine

12911.name: NotionalConstraint
12911.desc: The total currency value the client would like to trade (e.g. 1500). Related to NotionalConstraintCurrency (12912).

12912.name: NotionalConstraintCurrency
12912.desc: Currency of the notional eg. USD. Used to define the currency the client would like use for NotionalConstraintValue. This typically will always be different then the security. Used by BXS equity and FX engines.

12913.name: FundingSpreadOverride
12913.desc: Internal Sales override to default FundingSpread (12749) used by AutoPricer.

12914.name: IdeaInd
12914.desc: Indicates this was an internal idea

12915.name: CompetitorPrice
12915.desc: Competing price that won the RFQ.

12916.name: CompetitorSpread
12916.desc: Competing price (as a spread in bips) that won the RFQ.

12917.name: IWouldPriceSubscription
12917.desc: This is the filter key that OC will subscribe to for filter data (typically for prices) for the basket MinPOV feature. Format is symbol.exch.source.type. For example it can be spy.us.1.1

12918.name: IWouldPriceExpression
12918.desc: A mathematical expression with filter fields as variables. If the expression changes from true to false or vice versa then the engine gets a callback and will apply minPOV to the order if the expression is true and remove minPOV is the expression if false

12919.name: IWouldMinPOV
12919.desc: The Min POV that will be used when the IWouldPriceExpression is true.

12920.name: RfqBreakEven
12920.desc: The number at which the RFQ trade is consdiered break even value.

12921.name: RfqPnL
12921.desc: The profit and loss made on the RFQ trade.

12922.name: RfqPricingRefId
12922.desc: A reference to an external set of pricing parameters used to price the RFQ trade.

12923.name: RfqInApproval
12923.desc: States if the RFQ trade is currently in the TMG approval process.

12924.name: RfqIsFavourite
12924.desc: States if the RFQ trade is considered a high priority / important to the global user base.

12925.name: PricingOffInd
12925.desc: Closure reason on RFQ. Indicates that our price is substantially different from our competition.

12926.name: OutPricedInd
12926.desc: Indicates that our competition quoted tighter spread than us.

12927.name: AdditionalSalesCredit
12927.desc: Internal Sales addition to the default SalesCredit (10163) used by AutoPricer.

12928.name: ReOffer
12928.desc: The rate at which the order could be reoffered at to another client/counterparty.

12930.name: JupiterFinisherBasketDeliverThreshold
12930.desc: Specifies the basket to deliver threshold condition that activates the finisher feature.  The finisher allows individual orders to violate the current POV constraint to catch up with the other order in a basket.

12931.name: JupiterFinisherDollarThreshold
12931.desc: Specifies the remaining notional quantity of the order in USD threshold condition that activates the finisher feature.  The total value in USD outstanding on the order.

12932.name: ClAggregatedFillRptInd
12932.desc: Indicates whether or not to send aggregated executions back to the client rather than individual fills on execution report messages.

12933.name: BigMacFillType
12933.desc: Specifies the type of fill for trade processing in bigMac.

12934.name: TraderMarketBlotter
12934.desc: Passes the specific blotter number down to bigMac/C1 for trade processing. Possible values: 81(Manual), 11(Exchange LOC),71, 91, 51 etc..

12935.name: ExecutingBrokerSymbol
12935.desc: A symbol issued to broker-dealers by FINRA for the purpose of identifying broker-dealers also know as MPID/MMID(Market MakerID). This is also used to store same value as contraBroker(375) for exchange fills.

12936.name: MSWatchAlertADV
12936.desc: If the order qty exceeds a percentage of ADV (eg. greater then 2%) an alert is raised to the client.

12937.name: XDUUID
12937.desc: ETSFlow Elements use this tag to register themselves with the ETSApp SOAPManager.  Used to uniquely identify an order to be handled by the given flow element.

12938.name: ClSORTScopeNotionalThreshold
12938.desc: The notional value threshold in USD specified by a client to determine whether an order should be in scope for SORT or not. If an order's notional value is greater than threshold, it'll be routed to SORT.

12939.name: ClAcceptOverFillInd
12939.desc: Indicate whether a client wants to accept an overfill - and therefore systematically whether we should forward the overfill to client

12940.name: SourceAccountSystemRN
12940.desc: Account System Representative Number in A2 for a source account. There are two mainframe systems(ACUA, ACUT) used to create account numbers.

12941.name: DestinationAccountSystemRN
12941.desc: Account System Representative Number in A2 for a destination account. There are two mainframe systems(ACUA, ACUT) used to create account numbers.

12942.name: CcyFixingRate1
12942.desc: Fixing rate for NDF (or left hand side currency fixing rate for crosses), used in conjunction with tag 12943.

12943.name: CcyFixingRate2
12943.desc: Fixing rate for NDF (or right hand side currency fixing rate for crosses), used in conjunction with tag 12942.

12944.name: PassThroughClientClOrdIDToExternalInd
12944.desc: Indicates that when this order is sent out externally (exchange or broker) it should have clientClOrdID tag(7576) copied into an appropriate tag

12945.name: SORTDarkDestList
12945.desc: A list of dark venues where SORT can route an order to. The list is set by the client. 15042(SORTDestList) is used for a lit market.

12947.name: PELinkEventID
12947.desc: The id of the event in upstream system (eg Tribe) that causes the Position Event to be generated

12948.name: BXSIWouldCrossCurve
12948.desc: CAFE to OE communication protocol for IWould-style crossing. This is the trajectory detailing all IWould crosses CAFE has done plus any pending rounds. It is based on tag 12349.

12949.name: BXSIWouldCrossQty
12949.desc: Communicates (principally to viper) the quantity filled for an order from a cross round which came from CAFE's IWould/Trajectory boosting crossing.

12950.name: MarketParticipantType
12950.desc: Classifies the order originator. (eg. Customer, Broker, Firm ..etc).

12951.name: ToBeFilledInMSCP
12951.desc: Indicator for upstream system to hold amendments on the order as it is currently planned that the downstream engine (FACL/MS Crosspoint) will risk fill this order.

12952.name: IWantUseMSPoolBook
12952.desc: Indicates whether the engine should use the MSPool book as well in liquidity search for an IWant order.

12953.name: minPiece
12953.desc: Order quantity must be multiple of minPiece value for convertible bonds

12954.name: minIncrement
12954.desc: Allocations must be multiple of minIncrement value for convertible bonds

12955.name: AllowSalesRiskInd
12955.desc: Allow Sales risk fills to be executed whilst this order is active

12956.name: IWouldPassiveDarkPrice
12956.desc: Indicates the dark price to be used for the order slice being routed.

12957.name: IWouldPassiveLitPrice
12957.desc: Indicates the lit price to be used for the order slice being routed.

12958.name: IsSWCrossDeltaInd
12958.desc: Controls whether the delta cross will use Swapswire (a third party Trade confirmation network) for confirmation by passing it to TX (internal equity derivatives trade capture system) it is specified by sales.

12959.name: ForceRejectInOMInd
12959.desc: If set to Y, will cause the downstream OM to reject the order, with tag 58 set appropriately with the reason for the reject.

12960.name: SSLocateStatus
12960.desc: Controls the European shortsell locate status for the order. If locate is required, then this needs to be overriden in 12961.

12961.name: SSLocateOverride
12961.desc: Provides the mechanism to override LocateStatus set in (12960).

12963.name: StrategyAmendEligableInd
12963.desc: Provides systems upstream of the Engines the ability to amend orders cross strategy. For example amending a VWAP order sent to BXS to a SORT WORK order.

12964.name: HK1MPctMinSnapQty
12964.desc: Used by the HK1M strategy. It specifies the percentage of the minimum order quantity that should be sent as snap.

12965.name: SalesBlockType
12965.desc: Indicate the method used to group orders into a SalesBlock that can be identified via SalesBlockUUID(12797).

12966.name: HK1MEffectiveSpreads
12966.desc: Used by the HK1M strategy. It specifies how spreads algo will use to price aggressively.

12967.name: HK1MSnapMaxMin
12967.desc: Used by the HK1M strategy. It indicates whether the snap price should be limited at max or min of first few snap prices.

12968.name: SalesRiskEligibleInd
12968.desc: Indicates that this order or part of this order is eligible to be risk filled by a sales trader.

12969.name: riskPositionSplitInst
12969.desc: This tag provides instructions to a journalling system about how to split the associated risk position into multiple account movements (journal). Ex: Tag12969= acct1=100,acct2=200,acct3=300

12970.name: PBMoneyMgrID
12970.desc: Client's logical grouping of executions or allocations.  The logical grouping represents a fund.

12971.name: salesRiskIneligibleReasonCode
12971.desc: space-delimited list of codes each of which indicating why this order is not eligible to be risk filled by sales

12972.name: BrokerageCommRateInd
12972.desc: Indicates the relative level of brokerage rate to be charged to a client.

12973.name: ClientISOCountryCode
12973.desc: This tag indicates the country in which the client is domiciled. Expected values are three digit country code (same as ISO Country code)

12974.name: ReRouteOnNotionalValue
12974.desc: Indicates whether specific destination routing needs to be done based on an order's notional value.

12975.name: RFQChannel
12975.desc: Lets users assign an RFQ to a specified channel, which only registered members can view.

12976.name: LaggedLegStrategy
12976.desc: This tag identifies the user intention of a lagged leg (one of the contingent leg is stuck/unexecuted)

12977.name: AggSalesOrdName
12977.desc: A single name assigned to multiple clients. Only stamped on orders when the client agrees to have their orders combined with another client. Example: Client A and Client B requires like orders to be combined before sending to exchange.

12978.name: RequestedRescheduleSeqNo
12978.desc: The number of reschedule requests sent from BXS-OE to BXS-OC per order. A reschedule is a change in the planned trading trajectory based on new market data. The number will be used by post trade reports to analyze trading performances.

12979.name: InternalGeneratedFirmLegInd
12979.desc: Identifies a message belonging to an internally generated firm order.  A process (eg. OR) downstream creates the firm order from a single upstream cross slice.

12980.name: IntendedExecEntity
12980.desc: For Cross regional flow this tag identifies the MS entity which is intended to execute this order

12981.name: ClientText
12981.desc: Specifies Text(58) a client sent, or some other text type field that the client uses.

12984.name: CorpActionCxlInd
12984.desc: An indicator (Y/N) to mark order to be canceled from corporate action check

12985.name: CorpActionCxlReason
12985.desc: This tag identfies the reason for cancel (Tag 12894) which could be cause of an corp action or event that occured after corp action

12986.name: MinPxDiff
12986.desc: Value specifies the minium market price movement (from the moment of last stop price change) to cause a stop price change.

12987.name: TrailingOffsetIncrease
12987.desc: Specifies how much to increase the trailing offset (difference between market price and stop price) every time the stop price changes.

12988.name: BXSNoTradingTimeRange
12988.desc: Instruction from BXSOC to OE or CAFE not to slice the order in the specified time interval.

12989.name: BXSLOWTrackingInst
12989.desc: This tag identifies the method to track trading schedule

13001.name: IRSPayPaymentDate
13001.desc: An agreement of when to pay the interest rate for Interest Rate Swaps. Indicates the date for the pay side of the transaction

13002.name: IRSRcvPaymentDate
13002.desc: An agreement of when to pay the interest rate for Interest Rate Swaps. Indicates the date for the receive side of the transaction

13003.name: IRSExpiredBy
13003.desc: For a failed IRS trade, which party was responsible for the trade expiry

13004.name: B2CCoveredPrice
13004.desc: For B2C markets this tag identifies the best quote received on multi-dealer inquiry among those not traded.

13005.name: B2CClearingModel
13005.desc: For B2C markets this tag identifies the clearing model used for clearing this trade

13006.name: UniqueSwapIdentifier
13006.desc: The USI is a unique identifier assigned to all swap transactions which identifies the transaction (the swap and its counterparties) uniquely throughout its duration. USI has been mandated as part of the Dodd-Frank Act

13007.name: SwapDataRepository
13007.desc: Swap data repositories ("SDRs") are new entities created by the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act ("Dodd-Frank Act") in order to provide a central facility for swap data reporting and recordkeeping

13008.name: B2CCustID
13008.desc: For B2C markets this tag identifies the customer ID provided by the exchange (Ex: Bloomberg)

13009.name: B2CClearingMemInd
13009.desc:
For B2C markets this tag indicates if both the parties, dealer and the client, are members at the CCP.
Yes: when both parties are clearing member at the CCP
No: one of the parties to the trade is not clearing member at the CCP

13010.name: ICEAccountCode
13010.desc: This is a ICE regulatory tag that identifies Account Code

13012.name: ReopenCount
13012.desc: Number of time(s) the security was issued. Value greater than 1 indicates a reopened security.

13013.name: FillAllInd
13013.desc: This tag indicates if the dealer must fill the entire order.

13014.name: IsReinstatedInd
13014.desc: This tag indicates if the order has been reinstated to the dealer for an outstanding unfilled order

13015.name: IsCrxCurrSwitchInd
13015.desc: This tag identifies if an outright trade is part of a cross currency switch

13016.name: OTRInd
13016.desc: On the run (OTR) security or contract is the most recently issued, and hence most liquid, of a periodically issued security. This tag indicates if the security is an OTR

13017.name: DebtAnnounceDate
13017.desc: This tag identifies the date when the company will announce details regarding the debt

13018.name: MisweightRiskInd
13018.desc: This tag indicates if the quantities are misweighted in terms of Risk

13019.name: CallDate
13019.desc: The date on which a bond/security can be redeemed before maturity

13020.name: B2CDealerLocation
13020.desc: For B2C markets, this tag identifies the location (region) of the dealer

13021.name: B2CCustLocation
13021.desc: For B2C markets, this tag identifies the location (region) of the customer

13022.name: B2CDealerTrdAcceptInterval
13022.desc: For B2C markets this tags identifies the number of seconds that the dealer has to accept a trade request.

13023.name: B2CNoForwardMonths
13023.desc: For B2C markets this tag identifies the number of forward months for IRS products

13024.name: B2CIRSRollType
13024.desc: For B2C markets, this tag identifies when IRS product will be rolled to for the next month

13025.name: MinLeavesQty
13025.desc: Minimum quantity to be left unfilled afte a patial fill.

13026.name: B2CBlockTradeInd
13026.desc: Indicates if the trade is considered a block size according to the CFTC rules. If it is, it would be subject to a time delay for public reporting

13027.name: SefTradeInd
13027.desc: Identifies if the trade is done on the Tradeweb SEF and will have SDR (Swap Data Repository) reporting

13028.name: B2CSefState
13028.desc: Indicates whether the order is permitted or required to be executed on a SEF.

13029.name: B2CUSEntityInd
13029.desc: Identifies whether the customer is citizen or domiciled in US.

13030.name: B2CReportParty
13030.desc: The party who is reporting the trade

13031.name: B2CReportPartyLEI
13031.desc: SDR reporting party LEI(Legal Entity Identifier).

13032.name: B2CSalesEnteredInd
13032.desc: Indicates that the sales trader entered  the ticket on the software platform using a Sales Entry Ticket.

13033.name: B2CCcpDirectInd
13033.desc: Indicates whether or not Tradeweb will attempt to submit the trade direct to the clearing location

13035.name: B2CSDR
13035.desc: The Swap Data Repository the trade is being reported to. SDR are entities created by the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act ('Dodd-Frank Act') in order to provide a central facility for swap data reporting and recordkeeping.

13036.name: B2CFirmPriceInd
13036.desc: Indicates that the price is firm

13038.name: QuoteEventTransUUID
13038.desc: Unique identifier for a particular event during a quote transaction.

13039.name: ClientIsUSPersonInd
13039.desc: Is client US person as defined by CFTC. Which include collective investment vehicles - including hedge funds - that are directly or indirectly majority-owned by U.S. persons, or that have their principal place of business in the United States

13040.name: ClientLegalEntityCode
13040.desc: Client Legal Entity Identifier. A unique ID associated with a single legal entity, LEIs allow for consistent identification of parties to financial transactions, facilitating a consistent and integrated view of exposures

13041.name: DealerIsUSPerson
13041.desc: Is dealer US person as defined by CFTC.

13042.name: DealerLegalEntityCode
13042.desc: Dealer Legal Entity Identifier (LEI). The LEI is defined by Financial Stability Board (FSB).

13043.name: CreditCheckStatus
13043.desc: Credit check status provided by SEF (SwapExecutionFacility).

13044.name: DealerDeskID
13044.desc: Swap Dealer desk id. (eg. MS desk id)

13046.name: SecurityMATInd
13046.desc: Security is made available for trading (MAT) on SEF.

13047.name: MSCreditCheckInd
13047.desc:
Indicates whether credit approval has been granted by an upstream internal process.
(This is different than the SEF credit check which is for external approval.)

13048.name: ExtTraderUUID
13048.desc: External TraderID assigned by third party. (eg.  Bloomberg ID Unique per login)

13050.name: ParPx
13050.desc: Represents initial par price of Bond. Required if Price (44) is populated and the order is for a fixed income instrument quoted on discount rate or yield.

13051.name: DiscountParPx
13051.desc: Represents initial par price of Discounted Bond. Required if Price (44) is populated and the order is for a fixed income instrument quoted on percentage-of-par. Its the discount rate quoted in Price (44).

13052.name: ManageabilityInd
13052.desc: Indication whether the order is Managed or Leave. Default value is Leave (1). A leave order is a regular order. Managed orders allow the client to manage the total order interest of an instrument per side. If an order is marked as "Managed", and there alr

13053.name: AutoCxlManOrdSideInd
13053.desc: Auto delete managed orders on the same side if incoming order receives an execution. ADOSA stands for Auto Delete On Successful Aggression. If you agress the market with the ASOSA flag set, any of your existing orders for the same instrument and s

13058.name: OCSOSID
13058.desc: OC echo back the ID restated from OE so that OE knows it is the SOS schedule OE requested (BXS Mini-Guardian)

13059.name: OESOSID
13059.desc: When OE finds catch up is too dangerous, OE Restate a unique ID per order to request scheduled based catchup (SOS) schedule from OC. Used by BXS.

13060.name: SOSCatchupQty
13060.desc: When OE finds catch up is too dangerous, OE restate the catchup quantity that it wants OC to subtract from trajectory. (Used by BXS)

13095.name: TradeCorrectType
13095.desc: Must be present when TradeReportTransType=2 "replace". Indicates whether the correction is a material change, i.e. one that affects the trade economics.

13096.name: SettlCurrNetMoney
13096.desc: Net money converted to the SettlCurrency for this allocation instance. For cross-country Repos this is conversion of EndCash to SettlCurrency.

13097.name: SettlCurrAccruedInterestAmt
13097.desc: Amount of interest accrued converted to the SettlCurrency for this allocation instance. For cross-currency Repos this is conversion of EndAccruedInterestAmt to SettlCurrency.

13099.name: BenchmarkSecurityDesc
13099.desc: Used when the security is traded on spread against benchmark or for repos when the repo rate is a floating rate (PriceType = 6). The description of the benchmark security.

13101.name: AggLimitChkProcess
13101.desc: Identifies the process owner(host:port) that applied the aggregate limit check

13102.name: BrokerRoleCode
13102.desc: Specifies the role of a broker is playing with Morgan Stanley.

13103.name: RFQCompetitiveUse
13103.desc: Indicates if the RFQ is competitive against other banks.

13104.name: AgencyOwnerID
13104.desc: OwnerID of the associated agency order.  (eg. For riskfills of preferreds the firm side is sent down to BigMac. This ownerID is required for booking and generating internal reports in BigMac)

13105.name: CFMRejectAlertLevel
13105.desc: Specifies the level of alert to be raised in CFM as a result of receiving this reject message

13106.name: LegMidPrice
13106.desc: Mid Price to report to client for Dodd-Frank regulations

13108.name: DisableCrossInLockedMarketInd
13108.desc: Specifies if the client would like to cross during a locked market (eg. Bid is equal to Ask).

13109.name: BXSPortfolioSettings
13109.desc: This tag identifies set of MSPORT configurations to be used

13110.name: OrderSubCategory
13110.desc: Tag to be used in conjunction with OrderCategory(7536) to allow for a more granular categorization of an order.

13111.name: OrderMidPrice
13111.desc: Mid Price to report to client for Dodd-Frank regulations at the single order level

13112.name: Distributor
13112.desc: The name of the entity that will be distributing the bespoke product (client name).

13113.name: DistributorTNLId
13113.desc: The TNL Id of the Distributor represented in 13112.

13114.name: Custodian
13114.desc: The name of the entity that will be acting as custodian for the bespoke product (client name).

13115.name: CustodianTNLId
13115.desc: The TNLId of the custodian represented in 13114.

13116.name: DisplayFullQtyInd
13116.desc: Indicates if the entire order slice quantity should be displayed.

13119.name: BookingTNLA
13119.desc: Intermediate TNL Alias used for booking purposes, this may be overriden by sales.

13120.name: ExcludeInteractionHFExchOrdInd
13120.desc: Client has indicated that this order should minimize interaction with high frequency (HF) orders on the exchange.

13121.name: PrevMaxFloor
13121.desc: Indicate previous MaxFloor (111) value after tag 111 has been changed

13122.name: GUIOrderVID
13122.desc: Used to capture the latest version of an Order modified via an application GUI.

13123.name: ParentBookingModel
13123.desc: Set on child order slices to indicate the parent's booking model.

13124.name: PBClientDealID
13124.desc: ID issued by client to identify groups of related trades on their customer reports (eg. specific fund or even basket of stocks).

13125.name: AllocSeqNum
13125.desc: Client issued sequence number used to identify order in which the allocation was sent.

13126.name: DisableEngineRejectTrap
13126.desc: Disables capture by CFM of orders rejected in Engine (default value is N)

13127.name: VoiceElectronicIndicator
13127.desc: The indicator allows clearing firms to identify fees/commissions for orders entered directly by customers vs orders phoned into the desk as well as other order distinctions.  AKA: 'Voice and Direct Identifier'

13129.name: OwlEnableEDGEInd
13129.desc: OWL EDGE offers client who opt in the following: 1. pulling back orders automatically if taking to much liquidity 2. large orders are only partially routed out example 10% slices then remaining fully routed out 3. Maker vs Taker liquidity logic (to obtain

13130.name: ApplyHeadRoomCheckInd
13130.desc: Indicates whether or not to apply the head room check in SORT for the stock conversion in Thailand.

13131.name: ClTradingSessionType
13131.desc: Client instruction to MS to indicate which trading session a particular order is intended for.

13132.name: OversizeOrdQty
13132.desc: Number of shares that an internal process/system (e.g. SORT) augments onto an exchange order.

13133.name: SORTRelPxIndexRefPx
13133.desc: The reference price used in RBE for the ReferencePriceAdjuster strategy. It's used to compare against the index price for RBE to decide the order type/price which is slicing out to the market.

13134.name: BXSStopOrdTriggerPrimaryMktOnlyInd
13134.desc: BXS Stop Order should trigger on price changes on primary market data feed only - as oppose to the default behaviour which is to trigger on price changes on the consolidated market data feed

13135.name: CustomerTypeIndCode
13135.desc: The CTI code (futures) or order origin code (options) distinguishes for whom and/or on behalf of what type of account the order is being placed. The tag can apply to non-futures/options markets.  e.g. TSX Cash

13136.name: DeliveryType
13136.desc: Determines if the security in this trade is physically delivered or is cash settled.

13137.name: OptionLegStrategy
13137.desc: This describes the type of option in this leg of the strategy.

13138.name: LegStrategyCurrency
13138.desc: The currency of the leg of this strategy., eg EUR.

13139.name: NoExoticEvents
13139.desc: Number of repeating exotic event type entries.

13140.name: ExoticEventID
13140.desc: ID referring to the respective Exotic Event.

13142.name: ExoticEventEndDate
13142.desc: For events that span a timeline this signifies the end date of that timeline.

13143.name: ExoticEventType
13143.desc: Identifies the exotic event type which is represented by ExotEventID.

13144.name: ExoticNumValues
13144.desc: The number of exotic product attribute values to follow.

13145.name: ExoticValueType
13145.desc: The type of exotic value attribute (e.g. Payout, Paid Coupon etc).

13146.name: ExoticValue
13146.desc: Contains the exotic attribute value whose type is signified in 13145.

13147.name: NoDocuments
13147.desc: Signifies the number of document references that will be provided.

13148.name: DocumentLink
13148.desc: Holds the reference to where the document is held.

13149.name: DocumentLinkType
13149.desc: Identifies the type of the document reference in 13148

13150.name: DocumentType
13150.desc: Specifies the type of document that is being referenced in 13148

13151.name: CreditRatingAgency
13151.desc: Identifies which credit rating agency provided the rating sent in 255.

13152.name: YearInDaysType
13152.desc: Identifies the way in which a year is represented in days. E.g. ACT/360  vs ACT/365.

13153.name: Guarantor
13153.desc: The name of the party providing guarantees or partial guarantees for the assets, the principal and the interest payments (they require a fee).

13154.name: TraderComments
13154.desc: Comments entered by the trader slicing the order.

13155.name: Callability
13155.desc: Identifies the nature in which the product can be called.

13156.name: MirrorExecutorVenue
13156.desc: Indicates whether a fill was achieved/executed from the primary or secondary intended venue when an order gets mirrored on two different venues.

13157.name: TASProductInd
13157.desc: This tag indiciates if this is a TAS (Trade At Settlement) LD product or result of ops manually re-booking a TAS trade.

13158.name: TASUnderlyingContract
13158.desc: This tag identifies the underlying futures contract for a TAS (Trade At Settlement) product

13159.name: OrderStatusReasonCode
13159.desc: Code to identify reason for an execution report message sent with transaType(20)=3(status).

13160.name: DFDType
13160.desc: Specifies the action which led to a DFD (Done for day) being created.

13161.name: Vega
13161.desc: Denotes an option's sensitivity to changes in the volatility (11159) of the underlying asset.

13163.name: SpecificRiskScale
13163.desc: This tag specifies the Specific Risk scale value that is used to calculate Sepcific Risk from the Barra risk model passed by the upstream client/application. Ex: Used by BXS Optimizer to split the curve for portfolio trading

13164.name: settlPrnAmtPreRnd
13164.desc: Principal amount pre-round in settlement currency

13165.name: TCPortalScopeInd
13165.desc: Indicates if the message will apply new TC Portal/TCSoap logic. This tag will be deco'ed after go live expected EOY 2013.

13166.name: PositionType
13166.desc: Specifies whether the Client Notice results in a position movement.

13167.name: TWAPAutoSliceInd
13167.desc: Indicates to BXS RBE engine to auto calculate slice number for TWAP orders.

13168.name: TWAPMinTradeSizeInd
13168.desc: Indicates to BXS RBE engine to normalize TWAP slice qty by minTradeSize.

13170.name: MaxBehindTPOVPct
13170.desc: Indicate how much percentage the algo can trade within the POV target lower bound . It's always relative to LowerScaleAmend (11166)

13171.name: MaxAheadTPOVPct
13171.desc: Indicate how much percentage the algo can trade within the POV target upper bound . It's always relative to UpperScaleAmend (11169)

13172.name: CommissionProfile
13172.desc: Populated on client flow to allow clients to specify the commision profile intended.

13173.name: BespokeBenchmark
13173.desc: Indicates a bespoke algo engine benchmark to use when trading an order, similar to tag 7505.

13174.name: SORTRelPxRefreshPxThreshold
13174.desc: The threshold used to check whether replace current limit price with calculated new limit price in BXS RelativePriceAdjuster strategy. The threshold is per unit tick size

13175.name: BusCndctCompletedInd
13175.desc: Indicates that the Business Conduct has completed - required for the Dodd-Frank regulations.

13176.name: TWAPAutoNumSlices
13176.desc: The number of slices automatically calculated by TWAPRBE. It is different from TWAPNumSlicesReq(10571) which is specified by the user.

13177.name: CMTAType
13177.desc: Specifies the Clearing Member Trade Agreement (CMTA) Type.

13178.name: DTMInd
13178.desc: Indicates if this is a "Doors to Manual" based routed flow. Doors to Manual is RAZER to TXLOne flow.

13179.name: ProductAvgLife
13179.desc: The average life of a product, such as autocallable, is not always same as its tenor (12795). The average life is affects the price of a product.

13180.name: BXSMsgSrcInd
13180.desc: Identifies BXS as the source application of a message to downstream systems.

13181.name: FacilitationPlanQty
13181.desc: Comma-separated list of price:quantity pairs indicating the quantities Crosspoint plans to facilitate during auction. If the closing price is more aggressive than the specified prices, facilitation will not happen for the corresponding quantities.

13182.name: DiscardCrossBasePriceInd
13182.desc: Indicate whether to copy tag 44's value to tag 11048 for MSPOOL crossing decision. If it's set to Y, discard tag 11048 even if upstream send this value and use tag 44 to detemine crossing price. If it's set to N or NULL, copy tag 44's value to tag 11048.

13183.name: CrossPointAuctionInd
13183.desc: Indicator determines if the order is eligible for CrossPoint interaction during an auction period (eg. close, open, intraday auction).

13184.name: FXTsTriggerPrice
13184.desc: Exact (initial) FX trigger price: will contain the exact inital trigger price (entered by the user) at which the algo will trigger. Once RBE processes this any subsequent/new tirgger values will be reported back to the GUI using the same tag.

13185.name: FXTsDeltaStopPrice
13185.desc: New FX stop price delta: will indicate by how many pips the existing stop price will increase/decrease (sell/buy order).

13186.name: FXTsNextStopPrice
13186.desc: Exact FX stop price: will contain the new stop price if the algo gets triggered.

13187.name: SORTTriggerPrice
13187.desc: This tag identifies the price at which SORT will release client's order

13188.name: BXSDiscretionDuration
13188.desc: The duration (in seconds) over which BXS-OE has discretion over the order and after which BSX-OE has to cross the spread. This tag will be stamped by BXS and passed down to SORT as parameter to guide its trading

13189.name: PriceDelta
13189.desc: Specifies the Price Delta. Can be used for infoirmation going to any Exhcange such as ISE, CBOE, etc

13190.name: RACFId
13190.desc: MSWM tag: RACFId (mainframe ID) of Financial Advisor who submitted order

13191.name: MSWMBrMgrApprovalID
13191.desc: MSWM tag: ID of the MSWM Branch Manager who provided approval for order to be released in order entry manager approval process

13192.name: MSWMApprovalReasonCode
13192.desc: MSWM tag: Reason code provided on order during order entry manager approval process

13193.name: MSWMBrMgrApprovalStatus
13193.desc: MSWM tag: Branch Manager approval status of order in order entry manager approval process

13194.name: MSWMApprovalUserType
13194.desc: MSWM tag: Type of Manager approval in order entry manager approval process e.g. Stock Loan, Branch Manager etc..

13195.name: MSWMBrMgrComment
13195.desc: MSWM tag: Comments from Branch Manager entered in order entry manager approval process

13197.name: MSWMSLMgrApprovalID
13197.desc: MSWM tag: ID of the MSWM Stock Loan Manager who provided approval for order to be released in order entry manager approval process

13198.name: MSWMSLMgrApprovalStatus
13198.desc: MSWM tag: Stock Loan Manager approval status of order in order entry manager approval process

13199.name: MSWMSLMgrComment
13199.desc: MSWM tag: Comments from Stock Loan Manager entered in order entry manager approval process

13201.name: MSWMAcctExecID
13201.desc: MSWM tag: Executive ID on the order - note that this is may be different from the submittedID

13202.name: MSWMGroupID
13202.desc: MSWM tag: Group ID for multiple accounts on an order

13203.name: MSWMMgrFullName
13203.desc: MSWM tag: the full name of the manager involved in the order entry manager approval process

13204.name: MSWMAcctShortName
13204.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies the short name used for an account that is on the order.

13205.name: MSWMOrdSuspendFlag
13205.desc: MSWM tag: Order suspend - indicates that the order is should be suspended for trading, awaiting a manager approval or a locate for short sell locate.

13206.name: MSWMPNS1
13206.desc: MSWM tag: It is used for PNS trailer on the order and popultaed with second trailer on the order.

13207.name: MSWMPNS2
13207.desc: MSWM tag: It is used for PNS trailer on the order and popultaed with second trailer on the order.

13208.name: MSWMPNS3
13208.desc: MSWM tag: It is used for PNS trailer on the order and popultaed with second trailer on the order.

13211.name: BypassEnhancedSpreadCrossInd
13211.desc: Indicates that an order should bypass the enhanced crossing functionality with price spread(crossing orders with different limit prices if they are within a customizable tolerance factor) in Pool.

13213.name: MSPoolNonCrossDomain
13213.desc: Specifies a client's instuction to MSPool that their order/s should NOT be crossed with a certain type of flow, e.g. MM(Market Making), LP(Liquidity Provider).

13214.name: UseIntraDayAuctionInd
13214.desc: Client elects to participlate in the intra-day auction period.

13215.name: BXSRefMarketID
13215.desc: The marketID used to determine the volume and trading hours for corresponding future product. The future product follows the effective/expiry time and VWAP of the cash product specificied in this tag.

13216.name: BXSFinalDestination
13216.desc: Indicates the actual final destination within the BXS engines plant, this is not be confused with 12536 which captures the intended destination only.

13217.name: GUIName
13217.desc: GUI from which the message originates.

13218.name: ParentOrderCumPct
13218.desc: The percentage (cumQty/orderQty) the parent order was filled at the moment it was routed.

13219.name: OTCDBIssuanceDetailsVID
13219.desc: The versionID Related to OTCDBIssuanceDetailsID (12520) represents the Issuance Template used for a particular RFQ.

13220.name: OTCDBBookingModelID
13220.desc: MSUUID that links to an instance of a booking model held in the OTCDB BookingModel Service that is held in tag 12717.

13221.name: SalesDesk
13221.desc: Description of the Sales desk. Used, for example, for routing FlowExotic RFQs. This is not the same as coverage groups.

13222.name: AutoFacilInd
13222.desc: Indicates the trader has specified that this order should be auto-facilitation

13223.name: AutoFacilRatio
13223.desc: Floating point value to indicate the proportion of the EO quantity that should be autofacilitated. If the trader specifies that 12% of an order should be autofacilitated, this value will be 0.12

13224.name: MultiLimitCheckType
13224.desc: This describes the additional Check being performed on top of the normal GLM limit checking. This additional check is usually for regulatory reason like CADMAR (Canadian Market Access Rule).

13226.name: ReshortableSecLendingID
13226.desc: Client secLendingID used to send request to securities Lending desk for reusing Short Sell Locate, sent on a buy back of a short sell

13227.name: FXUpsideCap
13227.desc: This is the max dollar value that will be provided to the client if price improvement is received

13228.name: FXUpsidePct
13228.desc: This is the max percentage amount that will be provided to the client if price improvement is received

13229.name: FXFacilThreshold
13229.desc: This is the principal liquidity (facilitation) threshold, in percentage available on the entire order quantity

13230.name: InvAllocSubscriptionKey
13230.desc: Concatenated key of several order attributes info (eg: ID+exch+src+ordType) from IA. Used to publish info about order slicing plan back to the trader GUI via filter

13231.name: MarketMakerAccountInd
13231.desc: Indicate whether this is a MS Market Making account

13232.name: RootAggLimitChkprocess
13232.desc: Identifies the root process owner (host:port) of an order applied the aggregate limit check

13233.name: PosLimitChkProcess
13233.desc: Identifies the process owner (host:port) that applied the position limit check

13234.name: RootPosLimitChkProcess
13234.desc: Identifies the root process owner (host:port) of an order that applies the position limit check

13236.name: FXOrdStrategyType
13236.desc: Order strategy types used in FX order management systems.

13237.name: HedgingEntity
13237.desc: Denotes the entity, system or application that will be handling the hedging for a given order.

13238.name: ETRVenue
13238.desc: Indicates whether trades are in scope to be reportable to a clearing member/CCP of our choice by the particular exchange/MTF venue stamped.

13239.name: ETFRebookCounter
13239.desc: A numeric value indicating the booking sequence required for ETF and underliers

13240.name: ETFBookingError
13240.desc: A textual information describing booking errors, required for ETF and underlier.

13241.name: ETFSegregationFlag
13241.desc: A textual flag (varchar 4) to identify segregated deals and multiple re-segregations, required for both ETF and underliers

13242.name: ETFPreviousAction
13242.desc: A textual field, describing Trader's/Operations' last successful action on an ETF

13243.name: BidAccount
13243.desc: Holds the account value for the Bid position - values similar to that of tag 1.

13244.name: AskAccount
13244.desc: Holds the account value for the Ask position - values similar to that of tag 1.

13245.name: ReactiveTPOVInd
13245.desc: Indicator used to send TargetPOV orders to a reactive version (RBE TPOV).

13246.name: EnableFXNetting
13246.desc: Indicates that a FX netting feature in a given system/process/application is enabled for a particular trade order.

13247.name: OrderParamRefreshInd
13247.desc: Indicates whether or not a refresh was requested for Order parameters such as price or quantity.

13248.name: IsDoddFrankEligible
13248.desc: A boolean to indicate whether a quote is Dodd Frank eligible and subject to Real-Time Reporting and Business Conduct Rule requirements.

13249.name: IsMidRequired
13249.desc: A boolean to indicate whether a mid price is required. This information is necessary for quotes that eligible for Dodd Frank.

13250.name: IsKeyTermsRqstd
13250.desc: A boolean to indicate whether draft acknolwedgement/key terms was requested by a client for a quote. This information is necessary for quotes that eligible for Dodd Frank.

13251.name: IsScenarioAnalysisRqstd
13251.desc: A boolean to indicate whether scenario analysis was requested by a client for a quote. This information is necessary for quotes that are eligible for Dodd Frank.

13252.name: FXAnonymityPolicy
13252.desc: This tag identifies the FX anonymity policy , which is defined by the FX desk to control the booking of executions in FX booking system.

13253.name: execOrdSubOverrideType
13253.desc: Indicate what execOrdSubType (10416) values should be overriden for a particular OM.

13254.name: DTMUUID
13254.desc: Alternate order identifier that is stamped by the DTM flow element. Used by CFM to reference an order in Razer for DTM related order routing.

13255.name: ClientAllegedID
13255.desc: The ID provided on the clients incoming message e.g. ClientNotice, represents the overall shape of the combined Allocations.

13256.name: ClientAllocationInstID
13256.desc: The ID provided on each clients allocation instruction which ultimately is converted to a MS Allocation message.

13257.name: IRCSmartOrderType
13257.desc: Type of smart order manager to use in the IRC deltamarket.

13258.name: IRCSmartOrderPrice
13258.desc: Pricing hint to the smart order manager in IRC deltamarket (follows same data-type and format as Price(44)).

13259.name: IRCSmartOrderUrgency
13259.desc: Urgency indicator sent to the smart order manager in IRC deltamarket.

13260.name: CPParentOrderCumPct
13260.desc: The percentage (cumQty + onCloseQty/orderQty) the parent order was filled at the moment it was routed, specifically for crosspoint.

13261.name: MSWMAcctEmpCustRelatedInd
13261.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies if the account is employee related

13262.name: MSWMOrderReceiveOwnerID
13262.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies the Id sent by the Order message sender WebTKT

13263.name: MSWMSelfDirectAcctInd
13263.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies if the account on the order is self directed account.

13264.name: MSWMAcctInHandInd
13264.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies that the list of accounts for a multi account order is in broker's hand but not yet entered into the system with the order.

13265.name: MSWMRestrictedStockShortSellInd
13265.desc: MSWM tag: identifies that the sell short order is on a restricted stock. Based on this info the order side is converted into sell short exempt.

13266.name: MWSMThirdPArtyAuthInd
13266.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies that the order is authorized by third party.

13267.name: MSWMBypassConfirmRptInd
13267.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies that the execution is for booking only but Client Confirm is not needed.

13269.name: MSWMDiscretionNotExercisedInd
13269.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies that discretion was not exercised on the order

13270.name: MSWMReceivePVOInd
13270.desc: MSWM tag: Identifies if the order instructions were verbally given to the trader prior to order entry (Per Verbal Order).

13271.name: MSWMSecurityModifier
13271.desc: Security modifier related to the transaction

13272.name: MSWMTrdControlAcctType
13272.desc: Holds information on the type of control account

13273.name: MSWMAcctExecName
13273.desc: Holds the name of the account executive handling the transaction

13274.name: MSWMLongShortType
13274.desc: Provides information on whether an account is allowed margin for a given order

13275.name: MSWMCashMarginType
13275.desc: CashMargin type Provides information on the cash margin for the account related to the order.

13280.name: MSWMCPSAccountClass
13280.desc: Identifies the account class related to the client needing intra day DTC confirms or not

13281.name: BXSSystemFitModelInd
13281.desc: Indicates whether or not BXS should use the System Fit Model to help generate a trading schedule.

13282.name: ClientPosition
13282.desc: Stores the client position currently handled by a system (e.g. Minerva).

13283.name: DeskPosition
13283.desc: Stores the desk's position currently handled by a system (e.g. Minerva).

13284.name: AggressiveSwipeEnableInd
13284.desc: For BXS FX Algo Seeker, this tag indicates if Aggressive Swipe (Grab) feature is enabled.

13285.name: AggressiveSwipePrice
13285.desc: For BXS FX Algo Seeker, this tag identifies the limit price for Aggressive Swipe feature

13286.name: AggressiveSwipeOffset
13286.desc: For BXS FX Algo Seeker, this tag identifies the offset in number of pips for Aggressive Swipe (Grab) feature

13287.name: AggressiveSwipeAnchor
13287.desc: For BXS FX Algo Seeker, this tag identifies the anchor to which the aggressive swipe offset is applied

13288.name: BypassURConversionInd
13288.desc: Indicates that ESTRouter should bypass the conversion logic for 35=UR message and pass the message directly to OR for the reconciliation.

13289.name: BXSBenchmarkTrajectory
13289.desc: Part of the BXS communication protocol. The downstream system needs to know the scheduling benchmark trajectory to prevent OE from trading past the benchmark when handling dynamic auctions.

13290.name: BXSPOVCatchUpRate
13290.desc: Part of the BXS communication protocol. It defines the (volume) rate at which OE can catch up to the benchmark. This value is only used for POV orders only (TargetPOV or LimitPOV).

13291.name: FXDMACharge
13291.desc: The volume based fee that will be applied to quantity executed on ECN

13292.name: FXPrincipalCharge
13292.desc: The volume based fee that will be applied to quantity executed against principal ladder

13293.name: AutoFacilAccount
13293.desc: The account that will be used for autofacilitation. The value here will be comparable to the value in tag 1.

13294.name: autoFacilBasePriceType
13294.desc: The base price type for the facilitation done in association with this wave order.

13295.name: autoFacilPriceCalcType
13295.desc: The base price type for the facilitation done in association with this wave order

13296.name: autoFacilPriceCalcOffset
13296.desc: The price calc offset for the facilitation done in association with this wave order

13297.name: CrossPx
13297.desc: Price on request to crossing engine (e.g. NMSX). Typically used when limit price on cross orders, and requesting cross price are different.

13298.name: CFMReleasedOverFill
13298.desc: Indicates the over fill was released back to the client.

13299.name: TrajectoryCrossResidualCompletionInd
13299.desc: Instruction to trajectory cross engine (ie. CAFE) specifying the engine can schedule "IWould" style crossing using reserved order quantity.

13300.name: NoISOOrdEntries
13300.desc: The count of ISO order entries in this repeating group.

13301.name: ActivityType
13301.desc: High-level category for the sending application: component, or a parent strategy which manages multiple orders. To be used with ActivityExecutorType (13302) to fully classify a particular algorithmic strategy used.

13302.name: ActivityExecutorType
13302.desc: Classification of the algorithm behavior or specific order executor used. Used in conjuction with ActivityType (13301) to give a complete algo classification.

13303.name: RiskFillRequestor
13303.desc: Used by risk fill algorithms to categorise flow for pricing and reporting purposes.

13304.name: autoFacilLimitPrice
13304.desc: The trader enters an explicit facilition limit price for the order, as opposed to entering a price type (e.g. open, near, far)

13305.name: TradeReportUUID
13305.desc: Unique identifier in trades processing for the message. Internal Unique identifier (UUID).

13308.name: NoFillRpts
13308.desc: Number of Fill reports in group

13310.name: NoOrderRpts
13310.desc: Number of Order reports in group

13311.name: MSGenISOInd
13311.desc: Indicates the ISO order went through Morgan Stanley's infrastructure.

13312.name: RFQAlfrescoInstance
13312.desc: Represents the document respositary store for Termsheets attached to an RFQ.

13313.name: CrossPointLadder
13313.desc: Contains the CrossPoint ladder for the order. Format = node,node,_. Where node := price@quantity.

13314.name: IsSECEligible
13314.desc: This field indicates whether an estimated value (13319) for a product (such as a Sec Note) needs to be calculated for the SEC.

13316.name: RiskPreviewType
13316.desc: Indicates if a trade can be sent for a "risk preview/ risk plug" in Risk System (e.g. OMPK, RV etc).

13317.name: CrossPointMaxRiskInd
13317.desc: Cross point has reached max risk tolerance

13318.name: BXSAggressiveQty
13318.desc: The aggressive quantity in an BXS aggressive/passive aggregrated slice

13319.name: SECEstimatedValue
13319.desc: Estimated value of (SEC registered) Structured Notes.

13320.name: discretionExercisedInd
13320.desc: This will indicate if the Financial Advisor decided how to invest the clients funds. As opposed to receiving direct client communication on how to invest.

13321.name: EnableSimulateBehaviorType
13321.desc: Specifies the type of simulation behavior enabled for an order.

13322.name: UnderlyingIssueID
13322.desc: This tag identifies the underlying issue ID as specified in P2 (ulissueID)

13323.name: OrdAutomationInstReason
13323.desc: Free text to capture the reason why OrdAutomationInstType (11654) was selected.

13324.name: ViperRTObject
13324.desc: Indicates the KDB table into which the viper writer (viperrt) process would insert a new entry. The entry is created from mapping the other tags of the fix message to the columns of the VIPER DB schema.

13325.name: PricerParamsOverride
13325.desc: Parameters that should be used to override default values in pricer.

13326.name: ParFXPassivePct
13326.desc: Percentage of passive order quantity sent to ParFX exchange.

13327.name: ParFXAggressivePct
13327.desc: Percentage of aggressive order quantity sent to ParFX exchange.

13328.name: ParFXOversize
13328.desc: Integer from either 0 or 1. Whether over size order.

13329.name: BXSOCVersion
13329.desc: This tag identifies the BXS-OC version which will be passed through hops

13330.name: AntiHedgeType
13330.desc: Describes the type of Anti Hedge being employed and to be used in conjunction with tag 10471 (AntiHedgeID).

13331.name: DBDestinationID
13331.desc: Provides the final database destination of a given messsage

13332.name: EOToOrderInd
13332.desc: Indicates EO should be converted into Order by Vista

13333.name: ContingentChildOrdID
13333.desc: The clOrderID of the contingent order.

13334.name: ContingencyOrdStatus
13334.desc: Order status of the contigent order.  This value will be stamped on the parent (non contingent) order.

13335.name: MorpheusCumQtyOptimizationInd
13335.desc: Indicates whether a cumulative quantity optimization(to send an exact quantity to exchange to reach the threshold before switching to another algorithm) in Morpheus strategy should be used or not.

13336.name: LiquidityChkAutoSliceInd
13336.desc: It's used to instruct engine to slice the order automatically if the order is released from CFM after it's rejected by the liquidity check at beginning.

13337.name: MinervaRoutingDestID
13337.desc: Specifies the MS/virtual destination(e.g., PAIRS) which Minerva needs to route an order to. This tag will be set by an upstream application (e.g., Razer), passd to Minerva and will be used by Minerva to derive the next routing information.

13338.name: OCProcessID
13338.desc: The instance address of the OC process (host:port).

13340.name: EnableSliceReplaceIncreaseInd
13340.desc: Indicator for whether to use ETSFlowActionSliceReplaceIncrease to create new slice or not

13341.name: AlgoProfile
13341.desc: Provides consistent interface for clients across all engines globally.  Standardize the various flavors of trading across all engines inducing SORT, BXS, OWL, NightVision.

13342.name: CrossRoadEligibleInd
13342.desc: Indicates whether the Firm order is eligible for CrossRoad interaction.

13343.name: NMSXPriceTypeCode
13343.desc: The strategy type sent to NMSX to determine the price to cross.

13344.name: OrderSuspendReason
13344.desc: Reports the reason to traders/clients why their order was suspended, it is an attribute of a suspended order and holds an enumerated value.

13345.name: CrossDiscoveryRefPxType
13345.desc: Indicates the type of the price referenced by traders to negotiate a cross discovery opportunity.

13346.name: BXSMinLotOrderInd
13346.desc: Used in BXS OC/OE only. Tag indicates if number of lots are less than certain config number. When the tag=Y, it is min(small) lot order, and should apply new logic. Otherwise(N or empty), the behavior will be the same as the old way.

13347.name: ThrottleRejectType
13347.desc: Type of throttled state between OR and SORT during the reject. Whether only a particular (secondary) order got rejected or the entire OR (with all its session) is throttled.

13348.name: ThrottledDeltaTime
13348.desc: The time to wait until OR will come out of the throttled state. Time in microseconds.

13349.name: ThrottledORCapacity
13349.desc: Message Capacity of OR to send over its sessions. Use in conjunction with ThrottleCapacityTime.

13350.name: ThrottleCapacityTime
13350.desc: This tag indicates the throttled state of OR to Sort. Whether only a particular (secondary) order got rejected or the entire OR (with all its session) is throttled

13351.name: OMPKAccountOverride
13351.desc: Captures the account details required by OMPK

13352.name: AggStateInd
13352.desc: The client order is part of an aggregate

13353.name: CurrentOrderAggUUID
13353.desc: Unique identifier to group client position to aggregated position. Note: OrderAggUUID only links Pre-Agg to Agg.

13354.name: OrderAmendRsnText
13354.desc: Free text field indicating reason(s) why an order has been amended with ExecType = Restated or Replaced.

13355.name: UnrealizedPositionValue
13355.desc: Calculated Open Trade Equity (unrealized gain/loss on open position) by Listed Derivative systems, sent to GLM, so that GLM can perform limit checking on the value.

13358.name: DisallowFurtherSlicingInd
13358.desc: Indicates whether or not the further slicing is allowed on the order. Existing open slices can be still traded but once this tag is set to Y, trader cannot create more slices.

13359.name: BXSTWSSQuotaCancel
