13359.desc: Used within MVEA and BXS hops in terms of Taiwan Short Sell Quota reject ONLY. Clients would like BXS to return the rejections/restates back to Minerva without further retry.

13360.name: ReplaceMsgInd
13360.desc: Indicates if a replace message is already in place. Used to help override pending replace orders.

13361.name: RiskFillResidualQtyRefPx
13361.desc: Reference price for residual qty risk fill request.  Sent back upstream for systems that dont have market data.

13362.name: 2SDLimitCheckRefPxType
13362.desc: Which type of data will be used in BXS to calculate a price limit for 2SD check.

13365.name: HybridLiqAlgoInd
13365.desc: Indicates if order should be executed using internal and external liquidity (Hybrid model).

13366.name: UnallocAggExecQtyCxAsAgent
13366.desc: Unallocated aggregated execution quantity for last capacity cross as agent

13367.name: UnallocAggExecQtyCxAsPrincipal
13367.desc: Unallocated aggregated executed quantity for last capacity cross as principal

13369.name: UnallocAggExecAvgPxAgent
13369.desc: Unallocated aggregated average price for last capacity as agent

13370.name: UnallocAggExecAvgPxCxAsAgent
13370.desc: Unallocated aggregated average price for last capacity cross as agent

13371.name: UnallocAggExecAvgPxCxAsPrincipal
13371.desc: Unallocated aggregated average price for last capacity cross as principal

13372.name: ClientMBABenchMark
13372.desc: The client's version of MBABenchMark, which means it holds the value of tag 7505 a client sends to MS.

13373.name: RFQIsBookedInd
13373.desc: Flag indicates if an RFQ has been booked. For long running issuance projects, RFQs may get booked into TX but still have lifecycle events to follow.

13374.name: VegaNotional
13374.desc: The currency (eg.dollar) value per vega or volatility point.

13375.name: CounterPtyLocateApprvlStatus
13375.desc: The approval state of the (margin) LocateCode on the firm order.  This provides the trader working the client order with visibility of firm locate status.

13376.name: BBSSInd
13376.desc: A flag to indicate whether exchange flow has come via a Broker Booth Support System (BBSS) a handheld device on the exchange floor which facilitates trading. This is something supported by some exchanges such as NYSE.

13378.name: MMETLRandomBucketID
13378.desc: Used to adjust order handling within MMETL, and compare the order buckets against each other.

13379.name: OrigEntryUser
13379.desc: Previous entryUser similar values as held in 7338.

13380.name: IsSEFTrade
13380.desc: This tag is mandatory if the client is a SEF. If this tag is not present, MS will assume that this is not a SEF deal.

13381.name: PriorUSIPrefix
13381.desc: Prior USI (Unique swap identifier) Value - used for SEF

13382.name: PriorUSIValue
13382.desc: Prior USI (Unique Swap Identifier) Namespace - used for swaps execution facility(or any derivative execution facility).

13383.name: ReportingCounterparty
13383.desc: The legal entity identifier (LEI) for trade reporting counterparty. This would be the ID for the counterparty to the trade and required by the trade reporting venue (13390).

13384.name: TransactionRepository
13384.desc: Name of the transaction data repository - this is the external organization (such as DTCC) that will store details of the transaction in question.

13385.name: ClearingVenueID
13385.desc:
This denotes the ID of the legal entity clearing the trade.
(Used for swaps Central CounterParty)

13386.name: ClearingException
13386.desc: Indicates if a trade will not be cleared due to an exception or exemption.

13387.name: QuotingCounterparty
13387.desc: The counterparty to MS with respect to a particular quote for a given contract.

13388.name: IcemanClassOfService
13388.desc: Outlines the different type on FX model used within Iceman. Used specifically for Iceman.

13389.name: PositionResidCxlOverrideInd
13389.desc: This cancel message should only apply to the slice and not the position. This is used when the trader only wants to cancel the slice order and would like to leave the position open for future slicing.

13390.name: TradeReportVenue
13390.desc: This is the venue for which trade reports are sent to and is particularly important for non-listed derivatives products (which traditionally don't have an exchange venue) such as swaps.

13391.name: SEFExecutionTime
13391.desc: UTC timestamp capturing the time that the SEF (Swap Execution Facility) executed the transaction this could differ to own internal transactTime(60).

13392.name: RegLegSettDate
13392.desc: This is the settlement date for a particular leg on a multileg order where the legs can have differing settlement dates. This required for regulatory purposes.

13394.name: SoapTCPAddress
13394.desc: The SOAP TCP listening host and port of the process expecting a reply (eg. Razer talking to Graphite).

13396.name: TheoVal
13396.desc: Theoretical value of a given derivative. Essentially the price that should be paid to breakeven (excluding commisions/fees etc).

13397.name: Theta
13397.desc: Theta measures the sensitivity of the value of a derivative instrument to the passage of time.

13398.name: Rho
13398.desc: Rho measures sensitivity to the interest rate: it is the derivative of the option value with respect to the risk free interest rate (for the relevant outstanding term).

13399.name: UnderlierRefSpotPx
13399.desc: The spot price for the underlying instrument at the time the valuation call is made or more generally the time the market data is requested .

13404.name: BOCTypeByClient
13404.desc: To show client preference for which type or level the BOC will be based on.

13407.name: NotionalOrderCreationType
13407.desc: Indicate the method used to create a notional order of multi-leg security.

13410.name: LegReportingCounterparty
13410.desc: This is similar to 13383 but defined at the leg and is used to support cases where the various legs can have different counterparties.

13411.name: LegTransactionRepository
13411.desc: This is similar to 13384 but at the leg level this is to support cases where the legs can have differing values.

13412.name: MarketMakerFirmAccount
13412.desc: The firm account used to faciliate the client order.

13413.name: ClStampDutyRebateScopeInd
13413.desc: Indicates whether a client is scoped in for stamp duty rebate.

13414.name: ExecStampDutyRebateEligInd
13414.desc: Indicates whether an execution is eligible for stamp duty rebate.

13415.name: DisableDarkPostInOwlInd
13415.desc: Disable the dark post component in Night Owl.

13416.name: SliceCapQtyPct
13416.desc: The order quantity percentage cap on the first leg/slice.

13417.name: InvAllocSystemDetails
13417.desc: Used by RTIM to store information of inventory check status information from the system, e.g., Not enough inventory, Pending SL Approval for inventory allocation check process

13418.name: InvAllocBusinessDetails
13418.desc: Used by RTIM to store information of details provided by traders, compilance or other stock lending for inventory allocation check process

13419.name: InvAllocChkOwner
13419.desc: Stamped OM name who is responsible for IA check to avoid duplicate checks and missing checks

13420.name: SyncAggLimitChkProcess
13420.desc: Identifies the process owner (host:port) that applied the synchronous aggregate limit check.

13421.name: SwingToErrorReasonText
13421.desc: The reason for swinging a fill to error.

13422.name: DeskLocateQty
13422.desc: Specifies the proportion of this order's quantity that is available for short sells from a trading desk perspective as opposed to the client perspective (which is captured in 11600).

13423.name: DeskLocateOnCriPath
13423.desc: Specifies whether or not a desk locate (for short sells) can be done in parallel with the trade execution.

13424.name: GAMAlertID
13424.desc: Stores the GAM (Global Alerts Manager) alert id (UUID), which can be used by other flow elements to manipulate the alerts on GAM.

13426.name: TaxLotGroupID
13426.desc: ID to group multiple molecules for Long Term Short Term Captial Gains Tax Swaps.

13427.name: LTSTCapGainsTaxSwapInd
13427.desc: Indicates if a swap is eligible for Long term Short Term capital gains tax advantage.

13428.name: passiveGiveUpRefID
13428.desc: Provides the giveup account for the client passive option order.  The account it passed to USLO exchange.

13429.name: BsktNotionalAtAvgPxUse
13429.desc: Total notional for a given basket at an average price from the exchange.

13430.name: BsktAvgPxWithoutCostUse
13430.desc: Average price of a given basket before cost

13431.name: BsktAvgPxNetUse
13431.desc: Average net price for a given basket.

13432.name: BsktAvgPxToDeliverUse
13432.desc: Average price of a basket to deliver

13434.name: OptimisticAmendValue

13877.name: IndicativeFxInd

13878.name: PrevQuoteID
13878.desc: Reference to the previous QuoteID (117) that has been replaced.

13879.name: NotionalRestingInd
13879.desc: Indicator for SWAT to handle orders actively or passively.SWAT will wait for the spread to be in / at money and will send all legs as active orders.

13881.name: StopLossTicksAway
13881.desc: Number of ticks away in leg native scale from NBBO allowed to put passive orders.

13882.name: ProblemLegInd
13882.desc: Whether leg is a problem leg or not. Problem legs have less liquidity.  If yes, it may trade this leg first in MSSWAT.

13883.name: PrimaryLegInd
13883.desc: Indicates whether a leg is primary or not. Only one leg can be primary.

13885.name: SyntheticSymbol
13885.desc: The entering symbol of parent synthetic order.

13886.name: SyntheticOrderQty
13886.desc: Order Quantity of the parent synthetic order

13887.name: SyntheticCcy
13887.desc: Currency Code of the parent synthetic order

13888.name: SyntheticLimitPrice
13888.desc: The Limit Price of the parent synthetic order

13889.name: SyntheticFilledQty
13889.desc: The synthetic fill quantity that is derived from the price on the underlying fills.

13890.name: SyntheticFilledPrice
13890.desc: The synthetic fill price that is derived from the price on the underlying fills.

13891.name: PctFilledDMA
13891.desc: The percentage of the fill that is executed as DMA(firm act as agent). This is used to calculated the FX charge (related tags FXDMACharge(13291) and FXPrincipalCharge(13292) - stamped by the engine and passed upstream.

13892.name: CcyPairEligibleCode
13892.desc: Used for currency trading, this code indicates if and how a currency pair can be traded. See values for further description.

13898.name: BXSClIntelliWouldInst
13898.desc: Client instructions for customizing parameters for BXS's intelliWould feature.

13899.name: MorpheusSwitchPxCalcInd
13899.desc: Indicate whether to calculate the switch threshold(tag 11884) using the base relative price(13681), price offset type(13900) and price offset(13901)

13900.name: MorpheusSwitchPxOffsetType
13900.desc: Price adjustment/offset type(measure) assigned by client/trader to calculate the switch threshold(tag 11884)

13901.name: MorpheusSwitchPxOffset
13901.desc: Amount/Quantity to be offset from base price with certain offset type to calculate the switch threshold(tag 11884)

13903.name: BXSCalcOffsetSided
13903.desc: Enables engines to apply passive/aggressive BXSPriceCalcOffset(11761) based on order side

13904.name: QuoteFillReqID
13904.desc: The unique ID used to identify RFE [Request For Execution/Fill] messages.

13905.name: LimitPV01ComptVal
13905.desc: Indicates the PV01 value computed by limits system. e.g. GLM

13906.name: OddLotBrokerRouteInd
13906.desc: Indicates whether an odd-lot order should be routed to a broker via direct OR connection automatically or not.

13910.name: FXCashProductIdentifier
13910.desc: FX trade identification for MultiAsset TC.

13912.name: EncodedNonTradingData
13912.desc: This tag will contain base 64 encoded non-trading data tag value pairs to be persisted as a blob in GTC DB for WM.

13913.name: EncodedNonTradingDataLen
13913.desc: Integer value containing the length of data in the tag EncodedNonTradingData.

13914.name: OverfillSuppressInd
13914.desc: Indicate whether overfill alert can be suppressed. Current case is only for partial execution reparenting in HK and will be removed once long term fix applied in Carbon Atom.

13922.name: CustodialParticipantCode
13922.desc: Participant code of custodian party which is going to be sent to exchange. E.g. Shanghai-Hong Kong stock connect has requirement to send Special Segregated Accounts (SPSA) ID to exchange. Also used in Vista for client allocation purposes.

13923.name: OrdPersistInstrIND
13923.desc: Indicator from trader to Exchange if orders need to stay in the order book after a trading interruption or a technical problem with the trading system. Non-persistent orders are not backed up and are always valid for the particular trading day

13924.name: Fid1ID
13924.desc: Internal identifier populated with product's Fid1ID as defined in product database.

13925.name: CustOrderHandlingInst
13925.desc: Customer order handling instruction from CME.  we receive this information from CME sponsored flow on tag 1031.  tag 13925 is internal tag for 1031 clone

13926.name: SkipCorporateActionInd
13926.desc: Indicates that the Corporate Actions should be skipped for this particular trade

13927.name: TPOVFollowOrderBookInd
13927.desc: Indicator of whether to force a TPOV order in BXS-OE engine to follow the order book when trading.

13929.name: PricingApprovalCode
13929.desc: This represents if  pricing approval request was successful or resulted in an error. The treasury approval for structured products is managed in Warforge and has its own workflow.

13930.name: MarketImpactCriteria
13930.desc: Criteria used to limit the maximum number of requests an OM will send to the market (or next hop) per second. Used to prevent market impact from fat finger or an algo gone wild. Also know as Market Impact Limit.

13931.name: LambdaTypeCode
13931.desc: This tag allows for different types of mappings from the riskFactor(7504) to risk aversion(Lambda).

13932.name: MaxPctMove
13932.desc: Percentage used to derive the Min/Max spot range permitted for delta adjusting the limit price of the option.

13933.name: MaxClipSize
13933.desc: Specifies the maximum size of the order that is sent to the market at each slice.

13934.name: MinClipSize
13934.desc: Specifies the min size of the order that is sent to the market at each slice.

13935.name: UCPKeyType
13935.desc: UCP(Unintentional Crossing Prevention) key that prevents unintentional crossings from matching on AU market. It can be also represented with STP key (Self Trade Prevention) for SG Exchange, and SMP ID (Self Match Prevention ID) on HK Exchange.

13936.name: TicksBehind
13936.desc: This is used by Trading Engine when the Strategy is traded to decide if the order is passive with respect to Bid/Ask. If it is too passive it will not be sent out to external destination for trading.

13937.name: ExpirationDate
13937.desc: Indicates the expiry date of the security. Product level info.

13938.name: ForceEOToOrderInd
13938.desc: Indicates whether to force EO to be converted into Order by Vista

13940.name: CSGComment
13940.desc: Comments by Sales for CSG, these comments help CSG know how to allocate the trade.

13941.name: StrategyStatus
13941.desc: A value to indicate the strategy status, expected values could be active or passive or others.

13942.name: OrderAggregationType
13942.desc: describes the type of aggregation that has occured on the order

13944.name: StrategyRefType
13944.desc: On Reference Spread types only, refer to recurring closing prices or yield.(These values are refreshed overnight hence also referred to as COD (close of day)values.)

13945.name: PostcloseCancelbackIND
13945.desc: Instruct Engines(BXS) not to cancel back orders during postclose.

13946.name: ExecLiquidityCode
13946.desc: Native trade liquidity code from executing venue, must be paired with micLastMarket (10484) for translation.

13947.name: ExecFeeCode
13947.desc: Native fee code value from executing venue. This must be paired with micLastMarket (10484) for translation.

13948.name: BXSTargetCapInd
13948.desc: Use Y to opt-in TargetCap behavior for 7505=TargetClose strategy. The TargetCap behavior prefers no residual to exact percentage of participation.

13949.name: SORTRepegTimeDelay
13949.desc: Time delay randomized from a given time interval for each repeg slice.

13950.name: ExcludeDarkVenue
13950.desc: An upstream system instruction for an order to not interact with any dark liquidity venue.

13951.name: SmartShapeDistributeType
13951.desc: Describes when the fills from trading activity should be released/propagated in trading application GUI for smart shape functionality.

13952.name: OpportunisticInd
13952.desc: Flag to indicate if algo trades can breach the upper and lower bands for percent-of-volume rate, when optimum to do so.Currently used for Edge Algos.

13953.name: BXSStrikeTime
13953.desc: Strike Time for 7505=TargetStrike strategy. This is the specific "interesting time".

13954.name: TiedToStockOrder
13954.desc: An indicator required (for CBOE) for use upon the entry of option orders that are tied to stock.

13955.name: RestingInd
13955.desc: Indicator for SWAT to handle multi-leg orders at leg level actively or passively. SWAT will wait for the spread to be in / at money and will send this leg as active orders.( same as 13879 but at leg level)

13956.name: RoutingProtocolCode
13956.desc: Indicates the routing protocol used for routing instructions. For example, the protocol used between vSORT and vOR.

13957.name: ExpectedUnsolicitedCancel
13957.desc: Indication that this unsolicited cancel is as a result of expected behaviour on the order.

13958.name: RootMultiLegType
13958.desc: Used to indicate the strategy/leg status of a multi-leg security that contains another multi-leg security.

13959.name: RootMultiLegID
13959.desc: Unique ID linking legs of a multi-leg strategy order with the strategy order. Used on orders where RootMultiLegType(13958) = 2 or 3.

13960.name: SettlOffExchangeType
13960.desc: Specifies the type of off vs. on-exchange trades to be supplied for pre-settlement matching and settlement fees. The definition of off vs. on-exchange would depend on the local settlement processing requirement.

13961.name: OrigAdminProcess
13961.desc: The admin address of the message originator.

13962.name: SettlTransferType
13962.desc: Specifies the type of cash or security transfer to be supplied for pre-settlement matching and settlement fees.

13964.name: MBSDSWPPKGInd
13964.desc: Mortgage Backed Securities package indicator YES/NO indication that the trade is part of an MBS/DSWP package. If tag is not present NO should be assumed.

13965.name: BARDomainID
13965.desc: Identifies a RAZER or group of RAZERs BAR can route orders to

13968.name: LegStopPx
13968.desc: Leg stop price. Leg version of tag 99.

13970.name: RemovedTags
13970.desc: The list of tags removed from the a given message such as an Order message.

13971.name: SPCResultType
13971.desc: Specifies the result of the swaps position check (SPC) for the client order.

13972.name: BuyClientParentOrderId
13972.desc: Specifies the parent OrderID in the client order management system to group child orders together that are sent to MS->exchange. This tag is for Buy side in case of crossing scenario in trade reporting.

13973.name: SellClientParentOrderId
13973.desc: Specifies the parent OrderID in the client order management system to group child orders together that are sent to MS->exchange. This tag is for Sell side in case of crossing scenario in trade reporting.

13974.name: AtomEntityType
13974.desc: To indicate the type of hops ATOM generated.

13975.name: TradingClientIdentifier
13975.desc: Used to identify trading client.  String representing a concatenation of Name/Country,Customer/Identity,User.  Application to set and OR to hand off to external venue

13976.name: WorstPrice
13976.desc: The worst expected price level in an order book that a given order could hit.

13977.name: FXEligibiltyCode
13977.desc: Specifies any special eligibility for FX orders

13978.name: MarketMakingStratOrdType
13978.desc: To indicate different order types in market making strategies.

13979.name: CorpActionPrefNo
13979.desc: Prefix Number for a corporate action.Used along with the CorpActionID(13872) and CorpActionSeqNo(13980) to uniquely identify a corporate action in the P2 table

13980.name: CorpActionSeqNo
13980.desc: The sequence in which a corporate action was applied.Used along with CorpActionID(13872) and CorpActionPrefNo(13979) to uniquely identify a corporate action in the P2 database.

13981.name: OnShoreEngineInd
13981.desc: Indicates whether it's an onshore engine instance.

13982.name: ClConflictIntNotifyInd
13982.desc: To indicate whether or not sales trader notified a client in order to mitigate the potential conflicts of interest - 1. aggregate orders and split prints with different clients. 2. principal orders trading contra/alongside with the client's order.

13983.name: LegParPrice
13983.desc: The bond-style percent of par trade settlement price for MAC (Market Agreed coupons) swaps that are legs of a spread trade.

13984.name: SPCSystemDetails
13984.desc: Used by RTIM to store information of position check status information from the system, e.g. Not enough position, for swap position check (SPC) process.

13985.name: BXSResidualModeCode
13985.desc: Specifiies the mode to handle residual

13986.name: MSWMOrderType
13986.desc: For MSWM (Wealth management) orders, indicates the type of order.

13987.name: MSWMDiscretionCode
13987.desc: The type of discretion the client gives to the FA (financial advisor) regarding a particular trade.

13989.name: UnwindPOV
13989.desc: The percentage of predicted volume during position unwind. Used for pre-trade pricing.

13990.name: CrossViaMarcoInd
13990.desc: Determines if the delta of the option trade should be crossed into the SNO central risk book via Marco gateway.

13991.name: HedgeUrgencyType
13991.desc: Determines how fast the SNO central risk book (Plato) should be hedging the positions

13992.name: LegLvlMultiplier
13992.desc: Factor used to calculate spread. LegPrice * Factor. It's the multiplier used to calculate and estimate the price of a strategy used by quoter and the MSSWAT engine.

13993.name: AntiHedgeSideShortSellInd
13993.desc: Used to confirm when risk filling a short sell client and Short Sell Circuit Breaker=Y, that anti-hedge was executed as a short sell by the trader

13994.name: fxNonDeliverableCcy
13994.desc: Indicates which (if any) of the currencies is non deliverable

13995.name: fxDeliveryMethod
13995.desc: Indicates the delivery type of an FX transaction

14004.name: EtpTradeInd
14004.desc: Identifies if the trade is done on Electronic Trading Platform, ETP

14005.name: AlgoParams
14005.desc: Generic parameters tag that can hold any number of algo parameters. Not restricted to any particular strategy. Format:param1=value1,param2=value2...

14006.name: BXSVolDiscretionInd
14006.desc: When VolumeDiscretion is enabled, any residual quantity due to LPOV will be marked as discretionary quantity and potentially traded, subject to return predictions.

14007.name: SwatActionType
14007.desc: Type of action the MSSWAT/legger engine should apply on the strategy.

14008.name: ActualParentOrderUUID
14008.desc: Tag used by ViperRT to capture OrderUUID of the non-transient parent order.

14009.name: PayloadSkipCode
14009.desc: GLM reason for a logical check skip.

14010.name: CaptureCloseImbalance
14010.desc: Indicates if the user wishes to take any available liquidity in the Closing Auction at the indicated uncross price.

14011.name: SPCBusinessDetails
14011.desc: Used by RTIM to store information of details provided by traders, compliance or other stock lending for swap position check (SPC) process.

14012.name: SPCChkOwner
14012.desc: Stamped OM name who's responsible for swap position check (SPC) to avoid duplicate checks and missing checks

14013.name: AthenaScopeInd
14013.desc: Determines if message should be written to Athena.

14014.name: RiskLookupLevelType
14014.desc: Internal control of which report to sends to risk system.  Used by trading application when creating position/order for sell long, check against aggunit to mark SL or SS correctly

14015.name: VolumeTrackingType
14015.desc: Indicate the type of volume client wants to track.

14016.name: AckCorpActions
14016.desc: List of corporate actions that have been acknowledged for this order. [Should only be used internally within a system or process]

14017.name: TransmissionMediumCode
14017.desc: The physical channel or medium used to transmit a message

14018.name: BetaIEDALGORoutingInd
14018.desc: Indicate whether IEDALGO engine routed is BETA version or not, e.g. SEALS engine.

14019.name: RouteToSFEInd
14019.desc: Instructs engine that the order needs to be routed to the SFE (Synthetic Fill Engine) or FIFE in auto recall flow

14020.name: IsSyntheticInd
14020.desc: Instructs the SFE (Synthetic Fill Engine) that the order needs to be synthetically filled.

14021.name: UniqueExecID
14021.desc: An ID that is unique for all 1.0 hops to be used by Viper HDM.

14023.name: FarSideForwardPoints
14023.desc: Forward points at the time of algo termination. If the client is buying, points will be the offer points. If the client is selling, points will be the bid points.

14024.name: NearSideForwardPoints
14024.desc: Forward points at the time of algo termination. If the client is buying, points will be the bid points. If the client is selling, points will be the offer points.

14025.name: AltTermsheetDetails
14025.desc: The path that is a link to the Termsheet Details in the alternate language.

14027.name: overlyingContract
14027.desc: Exchange symbol of the derivative contract linked to the trade

14028.name: PriceFormingInd
14028.desc: Indicates that a given principal order is price forming, i.e. how it is executed will eventually be used to give a price back to a client.

14029.name: SmartShapeIndicCumQty
14029.desc: The indicative cumQty of a client order in a smart shape.

14030.name: NonCancellableBasket
14030.desc: Indicates the Basket Order cannot be cancelled, is eligible for strategy amends only and will not have an associated risk premium.

14031.name: RealizedPnL
14031.desc: The running measure of realized pnl accumulated by the strategy.

14032.name: InitdPdY
14032.desc: Initial dPdY snapshot at order entry to determine leg ratios.

14033.name: RTdPdY
14033.desc: Real Time dPdY snapshot used in price yield conversion.

14034.name: ClipStartTime
14034.desc: Time that the clip was created.

14035.name: ClipEndTime
14035.desc: Time  that the last fill for the clip was received.

14037.name: ClipCumQty
14037.desc: Cumulative quanity filled on the Clip.

14038.name: ClipLeavesQty
14038.desc: Quantity of the Clip open for further execution.  ClipLeavesQty = ClipOrderQty - ClipCumQty.

14040.name: ClipLegged
14040.desc: Indicates if this Clip is legged.

14042.name: PercentOfAuctionCap
14042.desc: The maximum allowed percentage of auction volume an order can take in CLOSE COMPLETION strategy.

14043.name: AutoAffirmationInd
14043.desc: Indicates that the affirmation process between  trading parties is automatic.

14044.name: LimitCheckDetails
14044.desc: MARDM: Tag to collapse and house payload details into MIX message

14045.name: BenchmarkPriceUserDef
14045.desc: User defined price to benchmark the order against. Use in combination with BenchmarkType (14046).

14046.name: BenchmarkType
14046.desc: Type of benchmark used for the order. Use in combination with CustomBenchmarkPrice (14045).

14047.name: ServiceUsageRepScore
14047.desc: The service usage reputational score as determined by a service provider of a particular trading service. e.g. Turquoise Block Discovery. The reputational score is based on the usage by MS trading of that particular service.

14048.name: StrategyAutorollInd
14048.desc: Indicates if strategy will be autorolled when the products on the strategy rollover to a new issue.

14049.name: AggLimitManagerScopeInd
14049.desc: Indicates whether this message is in or out of scope for routing to a limits manager for aggregate limit checking.

14050.name: SoftChargeSourceType
14050.desc: Source of softDollar commision Rate which could be for example from  client or trader used with tag 11421 ( SoftChargeRate )

14051.name: ParentFillUUId
14051.desc: Identifies the parent of this Fill's FillUUId. 23 chars universal unique ID as FillUUId (10901).

14052.name: ParentFillRelType
14052.desc: Describes the type of the relationship between different fills (i.e. reparenting).

14053.name: ExecConsultancyInd
14053.desc: Indicates a sensitive, premium client who requires extra consultancy on their flow.

14054.name: ConditionalRequestUUID
14054.desc: Refers to a conditional (UCOND, UCON8) order's  orderUUD (10914). Used to provide linkage between real orders and conditionals.

14055.name: ConditionalVID
14055.desc: Used to track the overall version of the conditional request. Provides linkage between UNCOND and UNCON8 messages.

14056.name: ExchangeFirmUpID
14056.desc: Refers to a conditional response message's exchange identifier. Depending on the exchange various different external tags will map to this internal one.

14057.name: GLMLimitsDB
14057.desc: The GLM limits database where the limitID applied to a given order or quote resides.

14058.name: BXSDisableExperimentsInd
14058.desc: Used by an upstream application to indicate to BXS to disable all configured BXS experiments for this flow

14059.name: ContingencyOrderReleaseTime
14059.desc: This tag is used in conjunction with ContingencyType(1385) where value = 100(Timer Triggered), this tag contains the Trigger Time. The time will be a UTC timestamp (date and time combination in UTC/GMT timezone)

14060.name: UnderlierRefCurrency
14060.desc: The currency for the underlying instrument at the time the valuation call is made or more generally the time the market data is requested

14061.name: NDFSEFPreferenceInd
14061.desc: Indicates preference for SEF vs nonSEF venue when trading FX NDFs.

14063.name: ClonedEntityInd
14063.desc: Indicates that this entity was cloned by a middleware layer.Use Case: Indicates that viper-RT force-wrote the entity (record) and should not be persisted in viper HDB. Thus eliminating dupes in HDB.May be used for additional use cases.

14064.name: BuySideExchClOrdID
14064.desc: Buy side exchClOrdID(10550) for capturing orders sent to exchange

14065.name: SellSideExchClOrdID
14065.desc: Sell side exchClOrdID(10550) for capturing orders sent to exchange

14066.name: ParentFillVId
14066.desc: Identifies the parent of this fill's FillVId.

14067.name: RouteToAltApplication
14067.desc: User can set this tag to route a given Order to speciifc application. The current use case is for user to route an order to Carbon-Atom ( than Classic)

14068.name: BXSMaskingInd
14068.desc: Indicates if the order is in a masking state. When in a masking state (e.g. out of limit), the BXS engine removes volume scheduled from previous plan that turned out to be non-tradable.

14069.name: MSWMMrgeBlkAvgPx
14069.desc: In MSWM, the average price of a group/block of Orders. WM Infrastructure passes the value to Atom.Group of orders defined by GCMBlockUUID.

14070.name: CreatedByAllocatorName
14070.desc: Name of the allocator within a strategy that created teh order.

14071.name: ExperimentProfileName
14071.desc: Name of the experiment profile used by the order

14072.name: ReportProfileName
14072.desc: Name of the report profile used to generate the report message for the order

14073.name: EvaluationText
14073.desc: Free text describing why the evaluation occurred and the reason why no clip was sent out.

14074.name: EvaluationTime
14074.desc: Time when the evaluation was performed

14075.name: AutoFetchValoren
14075.desc: Indication if Valoren ID for Swiss securities is to be included.

14076.name: MaturityTypeCode
14076.desc: Describes the behaviour of the product at maturity

14077.name: ConditionalRequestVID
14077.desc: Tracks the version of the conditional request ID (tag 14054).

14078.name: AuctionTypeCode
14078.desc: Type of Auction for the exchange trade is routed to.Codes are dictated by the the exchange (i.e. Each exchange may have a different set of codes)

14079.name: TradeAssistantEmail
14079.desc: Email of a group covering a giving account. see long description.

14080.name: TraceTradeMktInd
14080.desc: To indicate the trade status as reportable or non-reportable for Trace reporting perspective.                                                            Exclusively used for trace reporting.

14081.name: FactorType
14081.desc: This field indicates if the Prod Factor being published is publicly acceptable or a projected value. Whenever, the prod factor is published, this field will also be stamped with a static value of 'Public'.

14082.name: SmartShapeDistributeUUId
14082.desc: UUID of each distribute done on the carbon smart shape

14083.name: ApprovedQty
14083.desc: The quantity of shares that have been approved.  Used in cases where the approved quantity is different than the order quantity. Ex. for WM multi-account orders, disapprovals can cause the quantity of approved shares to be less than the order quantity.

14084.name: AllocChangedInd
14084.desc: Indicates that a change has been made to an order allocation.

14085.name: VistaTDSource
14085.desc: Holds the value of the trade directory (TD) from which VISTA received the message

14086.name: VistaScopeInd
14086.desc: Indicates if the trade is scoped in for processing by Vista Brokers

14087.name: BlendedCommissionInd
14087.desc: Scopes in the trade for blended commission calculation

14088.name: BlockAvgPriceType
14088.desc: They type of the average price (ex. Net, Gross) of the trade at the block level.

14089.name: BlockLevelMIXInd
14089.desc: Indicates that MIX is to be applied at the Block level  and not Order level .

14090.name: BlockAggPrice
14090.desc: Contains the aggregated price of the trade at the block level

14091.name: DisplayTypeCode
14091.desc: Derived from P2. Gives the format of the fractional pricing for a Listed Derivative product.

14092.name: EODICScopeInd
14092.desc: End of Day Inter-Company flow indicator. Used to move exposure from the hedge PnL to the swap.

14093.name: EODICScopeCptyInd
14093.desc: Same as EODICScopeInd(14092) except for Counterparties

14094.name: VistaLegacyMultiLegID
14094.desc: The meaning of this tag is the same as multiLegID (10420). It was created for the sole purpose that vista is already mapping 10420 to an xpath and needs a new tag to map to another xpath. Not to be used for anything else.

14095.name: LDExecChargeSrcInd
14095.desc: Indicates the when the chargeType(10040)=3, subtype 292 should be used as an override.

14096.name: MsgHashCode
14096.desc: Contains the hashed value of the message received. Used to verify integrity.

14097.name: VistaBlockMgrOnlyInd
14097.desc: Tag stamped by TDs( Trade Directors) to denote this trade should not be booked, but only used by Vista Block Manager for display.

14098.name: VistaReplayVersion
14098.desc: This tag value is incremented every time a message is replayed.

14099.name: WithholdingTaxRate
14099.desc: The charge rate for the withholding tax

14100.name: SalesSelfTradingType
14100.desc: The type indicates whether self-trading in on or not and which type of self-trading is on. A self-trading order is an order put from Sales system and routed to the next destination via trading system without trader's intervention.

14102.name: HedgeLkChargeRate
14102.desc: Holds the indicative charge rate relating to a client order on the hedge order. The hedge does not have to be a swaps hedge and this tag can be used on any order that is being placed off the back of a client trade. This is related to tag (14103).

14103.name: HedgeLkChargeFormula
14103.desc: Holds the indicative charge formula relating to a client order on the hedge order. The hedge does not have to be a swaps hedge and this tag can be used on any order that is being placed off the back of a client trade. This is related to tag (14102).

14104.name: DisableStatsAggInd
14104.desc: An indicator from client to disable their flows against vNightVision stats aggregation

14105.name: ClTrdSesCloseReleaseOrdInd
14105.desc: Indicates the client's preference for their order to be held in a queue or released to the exchange(will be rejected by the exchange) during day and evening session break.

14106.name: UserAlphaScale
14106.desc: Apply as a multiplier to the alpha signal. Used in conjunction with UserAlphaModeCode (14107) when mode = 4/5/6

14107.name: UserAlphaModeCode
14107.desc: Allows user to control how an order would react to a raw alpha(price return prediction) signal.

14108.name: ETFShadowNAV
14108.desc: manual pricing (Shadow NAVs) for threshold checks

14109.name: IndexPricingValidForTradeDate
14109.desc: Valid composition date for ETF deals

14110.name: priceReceiveTime
14110.desc: Receiving time of the Price for ETF

14111.name: errorMessagePricingInfo
14111.desc: Pricing related Error  message for  ETF deal

14112.name: LegOrderUUID
14112.desc: Used to pass OrderUUID of leg from engine to engine in 35=AB/AC messages.

14113.name: LegOrderVID
